jobs.excerpt: Job Type: Term (Fixed Term)OverviewRAND’s Center on AI, Security, and Technology (CAST), part of the Global and Emerging Risks (GER) Division conducts cutting-edge research on transformative, high-impact technologies—including artificial intelligence and biotechnology—to shape policies that protect global security and advance the public good.
jobs.description:
Job Type:

Term (Fixed Term)

Overview

RAND’s Center on AI, Security, and Technology (CAST), part of the Global and Emerging Risks (GER) Division conducts cutting-edge research on transformative, high-impact technologies—including artificial intelligence and biotechnology—to shape policies that protect global security and advance the public good.

Your work will address key questions related to global and emerging AI and biosecurity risks, understanding options for prevention and resilience, and examining their policy implications.

You will communicate the results of your work to both technical and non-technical audiences through quick-turnaround policy briefs and detailed written research products. A recent example of one of our research products is the Synthesis Screening report, which examined the current state of nucleic acid synthesis screening and offered recommendations for policymakers and industry leaders to further secure these technologies.

RAND's reputation for excellence is built on our commitment to high-quality, rigorous analysis and objectivity. In this role, you will apply quantitative and qualitative skills to rigorously analyze AI and biosecurity problems of national and international importance.

Qualifications

All research positions at RAND require excellent analytic skills; the ability to communicate clearly and effectively, both orally and in writing; the ability to work effectively as a member of a multi-disciplinary team; and a strong commitment to RAND's core values of quality and objectivity.

In addition, successful applicants will have:

  • Experience in nucleic acid synthesis, AI-enabled biodesign, dual-use research of concern, potential pandemic pathogens, personal protective equipment, bioterrorism, or pathogen agnostic biosurveillance preferred.

  • Demonstrated knowledge and ability to analyze or implement policies involving strategy, doctrine, operations, tactics, systems or organization.

  • Ability for quantitative analysis and modeling, including modeling of uncertainty.

  • Experience in government, intelligence community, or other relevant decision-making offices preferred, but not required.

  • Ability to present evidence of research experience, demonstrated through authorship of academic publications, conference presentations, or prior professional reports.

Education & Experience Requirements

RAND is hiring multiple AI & Biosecurity Research Residents at the Associate, Specialist, and Expert levels of experience.

Minimum education and experience requirements at the Associate level include:

A PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, Biology, Physics, Chemistry, Geology, or other natural and physical sciences is required – OR – PhD or equivalent in Policy Analysis or any technical discipline, Health Services Management, Public Health, Epidemiology or Business, with demonstrable proficiency in formal methods of decision support analysis is required.

OR

A Master’s degree in the fields listed above with at least 3 years of relevant professional experience, is required.

OR

A Bachelor’s degree in the fields listed above with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience, is required.

Security Clearance

Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government clearance is preferred but not required.

Location

We are hiring for this position in San Francisco, CA; Washington, DC; Santa Monica, CA; Pittsburgh, PA; and Boston, MA. We offer a hybrid work arrangement, combining work from home and on-site options. Fully remote work will also be considered.

Writing Sample

A writing sample of 3 pages or more is required for this position. Applicants are encouraged to use recent pieces that have been published in academic or other journals, but may use master’s theses or papers written for coursework, prior employment, or internships.

Term

This position is a 3-year term appointment with a possibility of renewal, alongside options for longer term employment.

Salary Range:

Biosecurity Resident, Associate = $126,400 - $183,300

Biosecurity Resident, Specialist = $145,600 - $227,600

Biosecurity Resident, Expert = $175,500 - $274,300

RAND considers a variety of factors when formulating an offer, including but not limited to, the specific role and associated responsibilities; a candidate’s work experience, education/training, skills, expertise; and internal equity. Successful candidates will be offered employment in a specific title, as determined by the candidate’s education and experience. The salary range includes base pay plus RAND’s sabbatic pay (which provides additional compensation above base pay when vacation is taken). In addition, RAND provides strong benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, paid time-off and more.

Role Title: App Security Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging App Security Experts to contribute to a customer’s dynamic project focused on real-world application security. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Design and implement small, purpose-built application fixtures with embedded security vulnerabilities or secure solutions, specifically addressing OWASP LLM risks such as Sensitive Information Disclosure and Excessive Agency.
  2. Develop deterministic test cases and security-context manifests to robustly assess application security posture.
  3. Create detailed hidden answer keys to enable accurate AI or scanner evaluation of vulnerable versus secure code.
  4. Evaluate and iterate on pipeline methodologies to ensure synthetic tasks and fixtures are challenging yet realistic for AppSec assessment.
  5. Document technical insights and methodologies, ensuring clarity in written feedback and communication.
  6. Collaborate through clear and thorough written and verbal communication to share findings and review peer contributions.
  7. Engage with agent-based security architecture and contribute to continuous improvement of the evaluation pipeline.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Extensive experience (ideally 5+ years) in application security, secure software development, or CyberSWE roles.
  2. Strong understanding of OSWE, LLM security, AI-powered static analysis (AI-SAST), and AppSec best practices.
  3. Proven track record designing or evaluating security architecture for traditional and agent-based applications.
  4. Expertise in building, securing, and testing application codebases, including identifying and remediating advanced vulnerabilities.
  5. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a focus on precise technical documentation and collaborative feedback.
  6. Experience with synthetic security fixtures and deterministic testing approaches is highly desirable.
  7. Demonstrated ability to deliver thoughtful insights and actionable security recommendations in a remote contribution context.

jobs.excerpt: This is a fully remote, US-based position, open tocandidates residing in the New Jersey About Us For 40 years, Encore Corporate Travel has helped CFOs, CPOs, and travel leaders reimagine business travel—simpler, smarter, and more personal.
jobs.description:
This is a fully remote, US-based position, open tocandidates residing in the New Jersey

About Us

For 40 years, Encore Corporate Travel has helped CFOs, CPOs, and travel leaders reimagine business travel—simpler, smarter, and more personal.

With 24/7 Traveler Services, proprietary technology, proactive program management, and integrated Meetings & Events, Encore delivers clarity, control, and care across every experience.

As a proudly woman-owned, independent company, Encore moves fast, solves harder problems, and grows with intention, never compromising on the personalized service that sets it apart.

A VIP travelerdoes not want to be asked twice.

The windowseat booked without a reminder. The hotel loyalty number applied before theythink to mention it. The connection they hate, avoided on instinct becausesomeone remembered the last three times it went wrong. That is not service.That is being known, and it is the difference between an agent and a resource.

VIP CorporateTravel Agents at Encore exist because being known does not happen by accident.Dedicated and complex accounts do not land with this role because policyrequires it. They land because the traveler learned, itinerary after itinerary,that their preferences are never an afterthought here.

The Role

As a VIP Corporate Travel Agent, you manage new bookings and changes across air, hotel, rail, and car for Encore's most demanding travel clients: name changes, date shifts, itinerary rebuilds, all handled inside the client's travel policy and inside the traveler's expectations. You carry sensitive, private information with the same care every time, not just when someone is watching.

This is not a booking role. It is a relationship role wearing an agent's title.

What You'll Do

Own every VIP itinerary, start to finish. You book and rebuild international air, hotel, rail, and car reservations, and you do it fluently in the loyalty programs that matter to the traveler holding the ticket.

Protect what's sensitive and keep it compliant. You complete document verification and pre-check for every traveler in your care, advise on entry requirements before they're asked about, and keep every reservation inside the client's policy without being told twice.

Anticipate before they ask. You learn each traveler's preferences and hold them across every booking. An air request with a night away from home is an opening to offer the right hotel, not an afterthought. You close the loop other agents leave open.

Raise the standard for the team. You're a resource to your colleagues, not just your travelers. You answer questions before they're fully asked, and you share the tips and tricks that turn a good file into a clean one. Dedicated and complex accounts land with you because that reputation is earned, one file at a time.


Requirements

What You Bring

Required

  • Extensivetravel industry experience (20+ years), with demonstrated expertise in US domestic travel, international itineraries, fare rules, and loyalty program mechanics
  • Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Advanced, current knowledge of travel industry rules and processes, including document requirements and entry rules that shift by destination
  • The soft skills to guide a traveler to resolution in the fewest exchanges possible, and the persuasive, precise writing to do the same with colleagues and other teams
  • A customer orientation strong enough to build lasting relationships with travelers who do not tolerate friction
  • Ownership of mistakes: you correct them without waiting to be asked
  • The organizational discipline to manage multiple complex or dedicated accounts at once without missing a detail, and to meet service level agreements on every interaction

An asset

  • Formal travel school training
  • Prior experience supporting dedicated or high-complexity accounts specifically
  • Deep knowledge of US-based corporate travel programs and compliance requirements

Shift Options

Available schedules (Eastern Time):

  • Monday to Friday: 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. ET
  • Monday to Friday: 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET

Who Thrives Here

The travelers Encore's VIP agents serve are busy, well-informed, and unforgiving of friction. They will not explain their preferences twice. They want someone who already has the answer ready, not someone still looking for it.

The agents who thrive in this role take that personally, in the best way. They close a file only when it's actually closed. They treat a colleague's question as worth answering fully, because the next complex account might land on that colleague's desk instead of theirs.

If precision and anticipation are how you measure a good day at work, this is where that gets rewarded.

Job Description:

Business Development Representative

Club OS One

THE COMPANY

ClubOS One is a fast-growing, all-in-one gym management software platform designed to streamline operations, increase member engagement, and drive revenue growth for fitness clubs of all sizes. We combine CRM, member sign-ups, billing, scheduling, and payment processing into one powerful, user-friendly solution. As we expand our footprint in the fitness tech space, we're looking for passionate professionals ready to help gyms thrive.

POSITION

The Business Development Representative (BDR) supports the Sales organization by identifying, engaging, and qualifying prospective sales opportunities before transitioning qualified opportunities to the appropriate Sales Representative.

The BDR serves as an important first point of contact for prospective clients and plays a key role in building a healthy sales pipeline. This position is responsible for understanding a prospect's business needs, determining their level of interest and sales readiness, gathering relevant information, and ensuring the Sales team receives well-qualified opportunities with the information needed to move efficiently through the sales process.

In addition to new business opportunities, the BDR supports Back to Base initiatives by identifying and qualifying opportunities within the existing client base for additional products and services.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Respond to and engage assigned leads through telephone, email, and other approved communication channels.
  • Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand the prospect's business, needs, challenges, current solutions, decision-making process, and level of interest.
  • Qualify prospective opportunities using established criteria to determine fit and sales readiness.
  • Schedule qualified prospects with the appropriate Sales Representative and provide a clear, complete handoff of information gathered during the qualification process.
  • Maintain consistent and timely follow-up with leads that require additional nurturing before they are ready to engage with Sales.
  • Conduct outbound prospecting activities as assigned to identify and develop new potential business opportunities.
  • Support Back to Base sales initiatives by reviewing existing client accounts and identifying opportunities for additional products, services, or solutions.
  • Contact existing clients as part of Back to Base campaigns to determine interest, business need, and readiness for additional solutions before transitioning qualified opportunities to Sales.
  • Develop a working knowledge of company products, services, pricing structure, target markets, and ideal customer profiles to effectively identify potential opportunities.
  • Accurately document prospect and client interactions, qualification information, follow-up activities, and outcomes within HubSpot and other designated systems.
  • Maintain accurate lead statuses and ensure opportunities are appropriately progressed, nurtured, disqualified, or transitioned based on established processes.
  • Partner closely with assigned Sales Representatives to understand priorities, target opportunities, qualification expectations, and feedback regarding lead quality.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Customer Success, and other internal teams when opportunities or relevant client information are identified.
  • Meet established performance expectations related to outreach activity, response time, qualified opportunities, scheduled meetings, lead conversion, and Back to Base initiatives.
  • Participate in sales training, coaching, team meetings, and ongoing product education to continuously improve sales development skills and product knowledge.
  • Provide feedback regarding common prospect questions, objections, competitive information, and market trends identified through conversations.
  • Represent the company professionally and create a positive experience during every prospect and client interaction.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.
  • Previous experience in business development, inside sales, lead generation, customer service, account management, or a related customer-facing role preferred.
  • Experience working within a SaaS, technology, payments, fitness, or business-to-business environment is preferred.
  • Experience working with CRM systems such as HubSpot is preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to build rapport quickly.
  • Ability to ask effective discovery questions and actively listen to understand business needs.
  • Comfortable conducting outbound telephone and email outreach to prospective and existing clients.
  • Ability to recognize potential sales opportunities without prematurely advancing unqualified leads.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills with the ability to manage multiple leads and priorities simultaneously.
  • Ability to learn and communicate the value of multiple products and services.
  • Comfortable working toward measurable activity and performance goals.
  • Ability to receive coaching, incorporate feedback, and continuously improve.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate CRM records.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Sales and other departments while maintaining clear ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to remain persistent and professional when prospects are difficult to reach or initially uninterested.

Club OS One

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Number of Openings Available:

1

Worker Type:

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

Job Title

Senior Materials Characterization Support Specialist (REMOTE US or CAN)


Location(s)

US Remote - AL, US Remote - AL, US Remote - AR, US Remote - AZ, US Remote - CO, US Remote - CT, US Remote - DC, US Remote - DE, US Remote - FL, US Remote - GA, US Remote - IA, US Remote - ID, US Remote - IL, US Remote - IN, US Remote - KS, US Remote - KY, US Remote - LA, US Remote - MA, US Remote - MD, US Remote - ME, US Remote - MI, US Remote - MN, US Remote - MO, US Remote - MS, US Remote - MT {+ 25 more}

Job Description

The Senior Materials Characterization Support Specialist serves as a remote technical expert supporting PerkinElmer’s customers, field service engineers, and internal stakeholders throughout North America. This role is responsible for the rapid triage, diagnosis, and resolution of complex hardware, software, and application-related issues across supported Materials Characterization platforms.


Operating as part of the Technical Assistance Center (TAC), this position plays a critical role in maximizing customer instrument uptime, avoiding unnecessary field service visits, enabling first-time-fix outcomes, and delivering a consistently high-quality customer experience. The specialist applies deep technical knowledge, strong diagnostic reasoning, and the ability to visualize systems remotely—often without direct access to the instrument—to resolve known, repeat, and novel issues.


Location: This is a full-time remote position M-F and can be done either in US or CAN.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a primary technical contact for incoming customer, field engineer, and internal support inquiries via phone and email for PerkinElmer Materials Characterization products. Triage requests ranging from basic product information to highly complex service and performance issues involving hardware, software, consumables, or methodology.
  • Perform detailed remote diagnostics of complex electro/mechanical equipment and computer/software systems by interpreting user descriptions, symptoms, error messages, system logs, and/or user generated data.
  • Drive issue resolution toward the most efficient and timely outcome: remote fix where possible, or a well-prepared service event where required. When remote resolution is achievable, guide customers or colleagues through corrective actions to restore performance and uptime.
  • When field service is required, determine likely root cause(s), recommend corrective actions, identify required parts, and document a clear plan of action to enable first-time-fix. If applicable to customer entitlement status, provide professional, accurate quotations for billable services and/or escalate leads for other PE products/services to appropriate internal teams.
  • Serve as a mentor and technical resource for colleagues by acting as liaison between global technical services, training teams, and the North American service organization to disseminate product updates, service notices, lessons learned, and other best practices.
  • Support operational excellence by adhering to documented procedures and maintaining accurate, complete, and timely service records. Ensure documentation quality enables effective handoffs, trend analysis, and timely escalation of emerging issues.
  • Participate in company offered training and development programs to support continuous improvement of technical expertise and soft skills. Training formats may include virtual or live classroom training, hands-on service location visits, field engineer shadowing, and travel as needed
  • Support additional cross-functional or special initiatives based on business needs as interest and workload allow. Contribute expertise in areas such as training/mentoring, SOP/documentation improvement, and/or data analysis.
  • Maintain training and compliance in areas of health and safety, security, environmental and operational aspects of daily activities in the working environment.

Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job at any time.

Critical Skills:

  • Sound technical knowledge in all Materials Characterization product lines supported, including applications knowledge, and including proficiency in all software platforms of associated supported equipment.
  • Ability to apply sound judgment and critical‑thinking skills to complex technical problems, using structured, stepwise diagnostic reasoning and root‑cause analysis, with the ability to mentally model and visualize system behavior without direct access to guide effective remote troubleshooting and resolution.
  • Ability to safely and professionally execute technical work in accordance with written and verbal instructions, including interpreting technical bulletins and service manuals, working effectively under time constraints, maintaining focus and situational awareness, and adhering to universal precautions when working with potential electrical, chemical, radiologic, and biologic hazards.
  • Proficiency with standard computing tools to document work, analyze information, and generate reports, along with the ability to communicate complex technical information clearly and effectively with customers, peers, managers, and other technical support professionals.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Biology, Chemistry, Electronics, or related discipline
  • MUST have expert level experience with Materials Characterization Instrumentation on a repair level as a Subject Matter Expert (5+ years)
  • 5+ years' experience with at least two (2) of the following product technologies: FT-IR, UV-Vis, TEA
  • Role requires 5+ years of experience in a support, service, or an analytical laboratory environment performing duties of a product end user or service technician using Materials Characterization instrumentation.
  • Must be able to travel up to 25% for training (in the USA) and for quarterly field ridealongs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ten (10) years experience in a support, service, or an analytical laboratory environment performing duties of a product end user or service technician using Materials Characterization instrumentation. Experience with all three (3) of the following product technologies: FT-IR, UV-Vis, TEA, is desired
  • Certification through company‑provided training on PerkinElmer instrumentation and software products, or equivalent hands‑on professional experience supporting PerkinElmer systems, is desired.

Working Environment:

  • Primary work environment is a home office or office based setting, supporting customers remotely via phone, email, and computer based systems for a majority of the role.
  • Work is primarily sedentary and computer focused, requiring extended periods of concentration, phone communication, and use of standard office equipment. Must be able to remain in a stationary position more than 25% of the time
  • Job pace may be fast moving, with periods of high workload depending on customer demand and escalations.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this position include without limitation, the ability to observe details at close range distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus in order to perform the essential service functions of this position.
  • Occasional travel may be required for training, team meetings, or visits to customer sites or company training facilities. During these activities, work may take place in laboratory or controlled environments requiring the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) such as lab coats and safety glasses.
  • When present in laboratory or service locations, the role may involve: 1) Moving between labs, corridors, and adjoining rooms, 2) Standing, bending, squatting, stretching, reaching, or working with instruments, tools, or controls, 3) Lifting or moving items typically up to 25 pounds, with infrequent lifting of heavier items as needed
  • Potential exposure to laboratory hazards including chemicals, biological materials, temperature extremes, or regulated waste may occur during training or site visits. All activities are performed in accordance with applicable health, safety, and environmental regulations.
  • Depending on assignment, employees may be required to complete medical clearance, respiratory protection training, and fit testing to support work in controlled environments during training or onsite activities.

The annual compensation range for this full-time position is $82,000 to $105,000 USD. The final base pay offered to the successful candidate will be determined by factors including internal equity, work location, as well as individual qualifications, such as job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability status, age, or veteran status or any other characteristics protected by applicable law. PerkinElmer is committed to a culturally diverse workforce.

Develops integrated digital strategies that support organizational priorities, optimize the customer journey, strengthen audience engagement, and ensure marketing initiatives are effectively planned, prioritized, and delivered.

  • Translate established digital marketing priorities into plans and initiatives that support audience engagement, optimize the customer journey, and support organizational and business objectives.

    • Develop and implement an integrated marketing technology approach that supports customer tracking, audience insights, campaign measurement, personalization, and organizational growth.

    • Works collaboratively with marketing strategists, the content team, creative services, project management, and other cross-functional teams to develop and execute integrated digital plans and initiatives that support organizational goals and deliver a cohesive customer experience.

    • Ensure digital marketing activities comply with brand standards, accessibility requirements, privacy regulations, and organizational governance.

    • Lead the marketing project management team by establishing clear expectations, providing coaching, managing performance, and fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture.

Upon request, the company will engage in an interactive process to identify and implement reasonable accommodations.

This position involves frequent sitting, standing, walking, and reaching, along with regular repetitive hand motions such as typing and mouse use. It requires prolonged periods of desk work and extensive use of standard office equipment. Occasional travel may be necessary.

Regular communication and interaction across various platforms are essential, along with the ability to remain alert, focused, and responsive throughout the workday.

This position also requires proficiency in processing information, communicating across diverse platforms, and analyzing data to inform decision-making. The role involves proactive problem-solving and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to drive organizational objectives, achieve measurable results, and continuous improvement, often with limited direct supervision.

Total Compensation:

Plus:

commonskusupports hundreds of promotional products distributors and suppliers with technology that drive efficiency, growth, and connection. Our skummunity (commonsku + community = skummunity, get it?) is powered byevents,education, andshared knowledgeand is core to who we are.

We’ve grown by being“for promo by promo”and now, we’re scaling our impact to elevating an entire industry. We’d love your help doing it.

Our products are used in a wide variety of industries including building products, aerospace, automotive and transportation, filtration, commercial interiors, waterproofing and wind energy.

A proud member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies, we serve customers in more than 80 countries around the globe. We are committed to delivering positive and powerful experiences, because we are successful only when our employees and customers thrive. We are passionate, we care about people, we perform at a superior level, and we protect others and our environments.

Pay Range

$109,300.00-$150,300.00 Annual

The Sr. Sales Representative for Johns Manville’s Commercial Roofing business is responsible for driving measurable revenue growth, expanding market presence, and building long‑term customer partnerships across the Raleigh territory. This role focuses on creating demand for Johns Manville roofing products and systems, increasing product adoption, and generating sustainable, profitable sales results.


Deliver Territory Revenue & Growth Targets

  • Achieve annual sales quotas and margin goals across assigned commercial roofing product lines.
  • Expand territory revenue by developing and executing a targeted geographic and account‑level growth plan.

Build & Sustain High‑Impact Customer Relationships

Create Market Demand & Competitive Positioning

  • Conduct ongoing market intelligence to anticipate customer needs, assess competitor activity, and identify strategic opportunities.
  • Recommend and execute market‑specific programs to expand product visibility, accelerate adoption, and drive differentiation.

Drive Sales Excellence & Execution

Enhance Customer Capability & Product Expertise

Uphold Operational & Regulatory Compliance

Contribute to Team Success

Requirements & Success Profile

Skills & Performance Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets in a competitive market.
  • Strong capability to introduce and scale new products or systems.
  • Experience influencing third‑party channels, including distributors, contractors, and design professionals.
  • Strong financial acumen to manage budgets, territory expenses, and profitability targets.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship‑building skills.
  • Proven ability to manage complex contracts and multi‑stakeholder decision processes.
  • Strong problem‑solving, organizational, and time‑management skills.

jobs.title: Associate General Counsel - Personal Wealth Products
jobs.excerpt: Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own.
jobs.description:
Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

Empower is transforming how Americans experience wealth, bridging workplace retirement and personal wealth products and services to deliver more holistic, accessible financial solutions. We are seeking a seasoned attorney to join our legal team as a strategic partner to our Personal Wealth product organization.

This role has primary accountability for supporting the development and delivery of personal wealth products. You will partner across retirement, wealth, compliance, and business teams where those areas intersect. Few organizations operate at this scale across both retirement and personal wealth, creating a unique opportunity to design integrated solutions for millions of customers.

You will help design and launch next-generation wealth solutions that reach millions of customers. If you are energized by building, not just reviewing, and want to help shape the future of retail wealth, this role offers a unique platform to do so.

What you will do:

  • Serve as lead counsel to the Personal Wealth product organization, advising on the design, development, implementation and distribution of innovative wealth offerings
  • Partner closely with product, compliance, risk and business leaders from concept through launch, ensuring aligned, practical solutions across legal, risk and compliance while enabling speed to market
  • Coordinate across Empower’s broader legal team to deliver aligned, consistent, and business-oriented guidance, ensuring a “one voice” approach to legal advice
  • Navigate complex legal and regulatory frameworks, including the Investment Advisers Act, the Exchange Act, SEC and FINRA rules, ERISA/DOL fiduciary standards, and state laws and regulations
  • Advise on product structures and distribution across direct-to-consumer and advisor-led channels
  • Provide guidance on SEC and ERISA fiduciary obligations as applicable, Reg BI, conflicts of interest management, and client disclosures
  • Advise on and help shape Empower’s approach to the responsible use of artificial intelligence and data-driven technologies in wealth products, including evolving state and federal guidance and rulemaking related to predictive analytics, conflicts of interest, model governance, and client communications
  • Support product governance, regulatory filings and client-facing materials
  • Advise on third-party partnerships and evolving fintech capabilities
  • Monitor regulatory and industry developments, translating them into practical guidance for product, compliance, and other legal stakeholders

What Sets This Role Apart

  • Direct impact: Shape products that support millions of retirement plan participants and personal wealth clients as their financial needs evolve
  • Builder mindset: Work closely with the product organization to shape strategy and enable execution
  • Innovation with purpose: Help expand access to sophisticated wealth solutions
  • Enterprise impact: Shape products and solutions that serve millions of investors across their financial lifecycle
  • Strategic seat at the table: Partner directly with senior product and business leaders to shape product direction, not just advising on execution
  • Innovation in a regulated environment: Help navigate and define approaches in emerging areas like AI, digital advice, and retail access to new products and services

What You Bring

  • J.D. and active bar membership
  • 15+ years of experience advising retail wealth management businesses (RIA, broker-dealer, or hybrid)
  • Strong knowledge of wealth management legal and regulatory frameworks including deep familiarity with SEC, FINRA, and state regulatory regimes particularly related to duties of care, disclosure, and conflicts of interest
  • Exposure to emerging wealth products including direct indexing, alternatives, retirement income strategies
  • Experience supporting product strategy, development and launch, ideally in a fast-paced or technology-enabled environment
  • Sound judgment and ability to balance legal and regulatory risk with business objectives
  • Comfort operating in evolving or ambiguous regulatory environments
  • Operates as a senior individual contributor with strong cross-functional influence
  • Executive presence and ability to communicate practical legal guidance clearly to senior business, product and other legal stakeholders

Preferred Experience

  • Experience at integrated retirement/wealth service providers, asset managers, RIAs, broker-dealers, fintech platforms, or other scaled financial services firms
  • Strong knowledge of wealth management legal frameworks, with familiarity or experience in retirement/ERISA frameworks strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with digital platforms, data-driven personalization, or fintech partnerships
  • Experience advising on distribution across retirement, direct-to-consumer, and advisor-led channels
  • Experience with product governance committees, disclosure/conflicts governance, and regulatory examinations
  • Familiarity with emerging retail products such as cryptocurrencies, stablecoins and prediction markets

How We Work at Empower

At Empower, how we work matters as much as what we build. We value collaboration, transparency, and shared ownership, and our legal team is viewed as a critical enabler of innovation—not a barrier.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Operates with a “one team” mindset, building strong, trust-based relationships across functions
  • Communicates clearly and pragmatically, translating complex legal concepts into actionable guidance
  • Takes accountability, exercises sound judgment, and leads with integrity
  • Embraces Empower’s values and contributes to a culture where diverse perspectives and ideas drive better outcomes
  • Proactively aligns with legal, compliance, and risk partners to ensure consistent, enterprise-wide positions, avoiding siloed or fragmented advice

Why Empower

Empower is uniquely positioned at the convergence of retirement and wealth. This creates an opportunity to build differentiated products and to do so in a way that meaningfully improves financial outcomes for millions of people. This role offers the opportunity to help define how retirement and wealth solutions converge, an area of increasing focus across the industry, but one where Empower is uniquely positioned to lead.

If you’re looking for a role where you can influence strategy, build innovative solutions, and be part of a collaborative, mission-driven culture, we’d like to meet you.


***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans
  • Generous paid time off upon hire – including a paid time off program plus ten paid company holidays and three floating holidays each calendar year
  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

Base Salary Range

$183,600.00 - $266,250.00

The salary range above shows the typical minimum to maximum base salary range for this position in the location listed. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation offered may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Equal opportunity employer • Drug-free workplace

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age (40 and over), race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

You must have reliable connectivity from an internet service provider that is fiber, cable or DSL internet. Other necessary computer equipment, will be provided. You may be required to work in the office if you do not have an adequate home work environment and the required internet connection.***

jobs.excerpt: Primary Mission:The Assistant Lane Support Subject Matter Expert (SME) is an integral member of the West Virginia National Guard (WVNG) Ridge Runner Irregular Warfare Exercise (IWX) Program, responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of complex Special Operations Forces (SOF) training exercises.
jobs.description:
Primary Mission:

The Assistant Lane Support Subject Matter Expert (SME) is an integral member of the West Virginia National Guard (WVNG) Ridge Runner Irregular Warfare Exercise (IWX) Program, responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and closeout of complex Special Operations Forces (SOF) training exercises. The position assists the Lane Support SME in coordinating logistics, manpower, resources, exercise infrastructure, and administrative requirements across assigned areas of operation.

The Assistant Lane Support SME must demonstrate strong organizational, logistical, asset deconfliction, and project management capabilities while supporting multiple exercises in various stages of development and execution. The position requires effective coordination with military personnel, Government agencies, civilian authorities, and domestic and international exercise participants in a dynamic, mission-driven environment.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Provide operational, logistical, and administrative support to the WVNG Joint Staff Office, WVNG J37, WVNG J3 Joint Operations Center, and Ridge Runner Program in support of exercise planning, coordination, and execution.
  • Assist the Lane Support SME with planning, development, coordination, and execution of Ridge Runner training activities, including Concept Development Conferences (CDC), Initial Planning Conferences (IPC), Mid Planning Conferences (MPC), Final Planning Conferences (FPC), and post-exercise closeout activities.
  • Coordinate with domestic and foreign exercise participants, military organizations, Government agencies, and external stakeholders to synchronize exercise requirements, resources, schedules, and operational support.
  • Support exercise lane development, site preparation, setup, execution, and recovery, including coordination with local business owners, municipal officials, and private landowners for access to facilities, infrastructure, and training locations through the Realistic Military Training (RMT) Packet process.
  • Coordinate with federal, state, and local law enforcement agencies, emergency management organizations, and emergency medical services to support exercise integration, public safety, and operational requirements.
  • Prepare and coordinate exercise notifications and required Memorandums of Understanding (MOUs) or Letters of Understanding (LOUs) with applicable jurisdictions, organizations, and property owners.
  • Assist the Lane Support SME with exercise lane management, safety coordination, logistical support, personnel accountability, and resolution of operational or administrative issues during exercise execution.
  • Support the coordination and delivery of Irregular Warfare training activities, instructional preparation, and exercise-related briefings in accordance with established Ridge Runner training objectives and program requirements.
  • Perform administrative functions including event scheduling, calendar management, email and telephone correspondence, meeting coordination, note-taking, records maintenance, document organization, and tracking of assigned actions.
  • Assist with coordination of foreign participant requirements, including foreign visit requests, installation access procedures, and communication with appropriate Government representatives when required.
  • Maintain effective communication with Ridge Runner leadership, the Lane Support SME, exercise controllers, and participating organizations to identify emerging requirements, resolve coordination issues, and ensure continuity of exercise support.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • None

Required Qualifications and Education

  • Special Operations Experience: Minimum five (5) years of operational experience as an operator within a U.S. Special Operations organization, including USASOC, MARSOC, or NSWDG, with at least three (3) years of administrative or operational support to senior leaders in high-tempo or mission-driven environments.
  • Operational or Executive Support Experience: At least three (3) years providing administrative or operational support to senior leaders in military, law enforcement, executive, or other mission-driven environments will be considered.
  • Organizational and Logistical Management: Demonstrated ability to manage calendars, coordinate travel, track personnel and resources, deconflict logistical requirements, and support complex schedules with accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Discretion and Security Awareness: Experience handling sensitive or confidential information with a strong understanding of operational security (OPSEC), information protection, and applicable security procedures.
  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively across diverse teams, cultures, and organizational levels, including military leadership, Government agencies, civilian stakeholders, and international participants.
  • Problem-Solving and Adaptability: Proven ability to anticipate requirements, resolve issues proactively, manage competing priorities, and adapt to changing operational conditions in high-pressure environments.
  • Education: High school graduate.

Preferred Qualifications and Education

  • Graduate of the U.S. Army Special Forces Qualification Course or a comparable advanced Special Operations qualification course from another U.S. SOF component, including SEAL Qualification Training or the MARSOC Individual Training Course.
  • Five (5) years of documented experience as a primary instructor or course manager at a U.S. Special Operations schoolhouse.
  • Experience supporting joint, interagency, or multinational military training exercises, including exercise planning, logistics coordination, and operational execution.
  • Familiarity with Irregular Warfare training environments, Realistic Military Training (RMT) coordination procedures, and military exercise planning processes.

Work Authorization / Security Clearance requirements

  • Must possess a Secret security clearance or be eligible to obtain and maintain one in accordance with Government and contractual requirements.
  • Must comply with applicable installation access requirements, operational security procedures, and information protection standards.
  • Must be available to participate in pre-exercise planning conferences, coordination meetings, exercise execution, and post-exercise activities as required.
  • Must be capable of performing duties in office and field environments, including varying weather conditions and terrain.

Physical Demands/Work Environment

  • Must maintain the physical readiness necessary to perform assigned duties in a Special Operations training environment, including field movement, exercise setup, and operational support under varying environmental conditions.
  • Environment: Office and field environment
  • Equipment Used: standard office equipment, computer
  • Sitting: 30%
  • Standing: 40%
  • Walking: 30%
  • Lifting: Up to 35lbs. 40% of Time
  • Hours: Full-time work week (Monday through Friday), hours vary during exercise execution, occasional weekends as needed.
  • Travel: 50%

Additional Notes

  • Must demonstrate the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, mission-driven environment with limited supervision.
  • Must exercise sound judgment, professionalism, integrity, and discretion when coordinating with military personnel, Government representatives, civilian authorities, and exercise participants.
  • Must be capable of managing multiple competing requirements while maintaining accountability, responsiveness, and continuity of support throughout the exercise planning and execution cycle.

Affirmative Action/EEO statement

F3EA, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. F3EA, Inc. makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

Other duties

jobs.description:
VARSITY SPIRIT, A VARSITY BRANDS COMPANY - THE DRIVING FORCE IN SPIRIT ACROSS CHEER, DANCE, BAND AND YEARBOOK

For over 50 years, Varsity Spirit has been the leading global source for all things spirit, including cheerleading, dance team, performing arts and yearbook. Focused on safety, entertainment and traditional school leadership, Varsity Spirit’s 5,000+ employees are dedicated to celebrating school spirit. A leader in apparel innovation, educational camps, clinics, competitions, and yearbook, Varsity Spirit impacts more than a million athletes each year.

OUR COMMITMENT TO SAFETY

At Varsity Spirit, the safety and wellbeing of the young people we serve is of the utmost importance. Since our inception 50 years ago, we have been – and remain – steadfastly committed to doing our part to create a safe and positive environment for our participants’ physical, emotional, and social development, and promoting an environment free from abuse and misconduct. Varsity has a zero tolerance for abuse in its programs, events, and associated business activities. Varsity is committed to reporting all suspicions, allegations, and incidents of abuse in full accordance with local laws and reporting requirements. Learn more at Our Commitment to Safety - Varsity.com.

LOCATION: Remote

TRAVEL:Overnight travel based on business needs, butgenerally lessthan 10%

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

We are looking for an energetic and team-oriented individual who is passionate about software design and development across various platforms. An outstanding performer withdemonstratedsuccess implementing technology solutions and the ability to get things done quickly and effectively. Must be comfortable working within a technical team and with business counterparts to raise the bar on our software initiatives.

A truly exceptional software developer will serve as an advocate for a great user experience, and through collaboration with the business teams, envision and design software solutions that are embraced by the user and have a positive impact on the organization. You will help us deliver products to our employees and customers, not just features, implementing and using modern techniques like continuous delivery, DevOps, Micro Services Architecture, and AI-assisted development practices.

This role embraces the use of modern AI tools (e.g., Codex, Claude, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate development, improve code quality, and enhance productivity. The ideal candidateunderstands how toeffectively and responsibly leverage AI while maintaining strong engineering standards, security practices, and critical thinking.

You will not do this alone. You will partner with a team consisting of business analysts, project managers, software architects, DBAs, and business partners to define and build great software solutions. You will coach and mentor team members—including peers and colleagues, not just junior staff—and conduct code reviews that provide real learning and growth opportunities through day-to-day work.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

  • Owns technical design and architecture decisions across the front end and back end for assigned initiatives, from concept through delivery

  • Leads product concept, design, wireframing, and prototyping for new features and systems

  • Designs, documents, and builds new systems and enhancements across the full stack, including UI/UX, application logic, and data layer

  • Designs and implements data models and schemas for relational databases, including Oracle and PostgreSQL

  • Codes across the front end and back end using the team’s core languages and frameworks (Angular, Java, Node.js, TypeScript)

  • Leverages AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Codex, Claude, Copilot) to support coding, debugging, refactoring, and documentation

  • Applies prompt engineering techniques to improve the effectiveness of AI-generated outputs

  • Reviews,validates, and ensures the quality, security, and performance of both human- and AI-generated code

  • Identifiesopportunities to integrate AI/LLM-powered capabilities into applications and internal tools

  • Builds andmaintainssystems in alignment with security best practices (OWASP) and AWS-native security patterns

  • Coaches, mentors, and conducts code reviews for peers and colleagues across both front-end and back-end disciplines

  • Owns the handoff of completed work from build to run, ensuring knowledge transfer, documentation, and change management are complete

  • Contributes to continuous improvement of development processes, including AI-assisted workflows and engineering best practices

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education, Certification and Experience

  • Four-year degreerequiredwith field of study in Information Technology or Computer Science

  • 8–10+ years of combined professional software development experience across front-end and back-end technologies (full-stack experience specifically is notrequiredto meet this threshold)

  • Functional knowledge of GitHub or other mainstream source control products

  • Strong understanding of project lifecycle and delivery approaches,e.g.waterfall, agile, etc.

  • Experience implementing and supporting operational processes, security, and compliance policies

Technology Proficiency

  • Angular (required) and TypeScript

  • Java and Node.js

  • AWS-native services (e.g., Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS/Aurora, ECS/EKS, SNS/SQS, CloudFormation/Terraform/CDK)

  • SQL and relational databases, including Oracle and PostgreSQL

  • RESTful APIs

  • HTML5, CSS, JSON, XML

  • Modern development tooling (Visual Studio,VSCode, Cursor, or similar)

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Maintains a customer focus

  • Deals effectively with ambiguity

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills

  • Action oriented and works with a sense of urgency

  • Utilizes data and analytics to gain understanding of the operations

  • Must be a team player with strong attention to detail and able to work independently

  • Proventrack recordof deliveringtimelyandaccurateresults in a fast-paced environment

  • Excellent critical thinking, problem solving, mathematical skills, and sound judgment

  • Strong business acumen and ability tointerface withnon-technical counterparts

AI-Assisted Development & Tooling

  • Experience using AI-powered development tools such as Codex, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar

  • Understanding of AI-assisted development workflows, including strengths, limitations, and validation techniques

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering concepts for code generation and problem solving

  • Ability to critically evaluate and refine AI-generated outputs to ensure accuracy, security, and maintainability

PREFERRED:

  • React, React Native, andNextJS

  • Familiarity with mobile app development

  • Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes (on AWS ECS/EKS)

  • Experience with SQL administration and performance tuning (Oracle and/or PostgreSQL)

  • Experienceutilizingbusiness intelligence tools such as Power BI

  • Experience with Tailwind CSS

  • Experience building AI-enabled features such as chat interfaces, automation tools, or intelligent workflows

Supervisory Responsibility

  • No direct supervisory responsibilities

  • Mentoring and training of other employees

Physical Demands and/or Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Prolonged Computer Use: Requires the ability tooperatea computer, keyboard, and mouse for extended periods of time, typically 6–8 hours per day.

  • Visual Requirements: Must be able to view a computermonitorforlong periodsand have adequate visual acuity—corrective lenses permitted—to read, analyze, and work with digital information.

  • Workstation Posture: Must be able to remain seated or stationary at a desk for prolonged periods, with the ability to alternate between sitting and standing as needed.

  • Minimal Physical Activity: Occasional movement within the home office environment isrequired. The role may involve light lifting of up to 10–20 pounds (such as computer equipment or peripherals).

  • Communication Abilities: Must be able toparticipatein virtual meetings and communicate clearly through written and verbal channels.

  • Cognitive/Functional Requirements: Must be able to concentrate, problem-solve, and manage multiple concurrent tasks in a computer-based environment.

  • Home Office Environment: Requires access to a quiet, ergonomically suitable home workspace with reliable high-speed internet and minimal distractions during working hours.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job.

JOIN THE BEST TEAM IN SPORT & SPIRIT

At Varsity Brands, we believe every student deserves the opportunity to succeed and every educator wants to make a difference. It takes a team to make a real impact, and through our two divisions – BSN SPORTS and Varsity Spirit – and our network of 6,000+ employees and independent representatives, we are proud to partner with a wide range of educational institutions and club and professional sports to transform the student journey in SPORT and SPIRIT.

OUR VALUES

Service - We lead with heart. We champion community.

Passion - We love what we do. It fuels our purpose.

Integrity - We do what we promise. We own our actions and decisions.

Respect - We earn it by giving it. Because everyone deserves it.

Innovation - We never stop striving to be better. For ourselves and our community.

Transparency - We are committed to openness and honesty in everything we do.

OUR BENEFITS

We are committed to putting you and your families first. For benefits eligible roles, we offer a variety of choices and costs as well as program enhancements that align with our responsibility to elevate the employee experience. Some of our offerings include:

  • Comprehensive Health Care Benefits
  • HSA Employer Contribution/ FSA Opportunities
  • Wellbeing Program
  • 401(k) plan with company matching
  • Company paid Life, AD&D, and Short-Term Disability
  • Generous My Time Off & Paid Holidays
  • Varsity Brands Ownership Program

  • Access to Financial Coaching and member-owned Credit Union

jobs.title: Director - Enterprise Quality Methologies, Governance & Enablement
jobs.excerpt: Become a part of our caring community Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that power exceptional member, provider, and associate experiences.
jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that power exceptional member, provider, and associate experiences.

The Director, Enterprise Quality Methodologies, Governance & Enablement will lead the definition, governance, and enterprise adoption of quality engineering standards, methodologies, compliance alignment, quality intelligence, AI-enabled engineering practices, and transformation enablement. This leader will establish “what good looks like” for Quality Engineering across Humana’s software delivery ecosystem and ensure quality practices are consistently embedded across the SDLC, Agile ways of working, engineering platforms, DevOps governance routines, and responsible use of AI-enabled capabilities.

This role will partner closely with Quality Engineering, Enterprise Engineering Enablement, Agile Office, Product, Engineering, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Audit, Data and AI teams, and segment technology teams to mature enterprise quality practices, strengthen governance frameworks, enable platform adoption, and improve quality outcomes across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Quality Strategy, Policy, and Standards

  • Define and evolve the enterprise Quality Engineering strategy, standards, methodologies, and operating procedures across software delivery teams.
  • Establish SDLC quality standards, policies, and practical guidance that embed quality earlier and more consistently across planning, development, testing, release, and production validation.
  • Create and maintain enterprise engineering best practices, including “What Good Looks Like” guidance for quality planning, test automation, code quality, regression testing, deployment validation, performance testing, release readiness, production quality, and AI-assisted quality engineering practices.
  • Align Quality Engineering ways of working with Agile Office practices, DevOps governance, platform standards, enterprise delivery models, and responsible AI expectations.
  • Partner with engineering enablement teams to ensure quality standards are reflected in enterprise tooling, pipelines, templates, reusable workflows, development practices, and AI-enabled engineering workflows where appropriate.

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering and Transformation

  • Lead the integration of AI-enabled quality engineering practices into enterprise methodologies, governance models, coaching programs, and SDLC quality standards.
  • Define guidance for responsible use of AI in quality engineering, including test design, test generation, defect analysis, requirements analysis, code review support, test data analysis, automation acceleration, quality intelligence, and productivity improvement.
  • Partner with Data, AI, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Engineering stakeholders to ensure AI-enabled quality practices align with enterprise policies, risk controls, privacy requirements, and responsible AI principles.
  • Evaluate opportunities to use generative AI, machine learning, analytics, and intelligent automation to improve quality planning, coverage analysis, risk-based testing, defect prevention, release readiness, and production quality insights.
  • Establish governance and measurement practices for AI-enabled quality capabilities, including adoption, value realization, risk management, human oversight, and continuous improvement.

Governance, Compliance, and Quality Maturity

  • Establish and maintain enterprise Quality Engineering governance frameworks that improve consistency, transparency, risk management, compliance alignment, and responsible AI adoption.
  • Define, implement, and mature a Quality Engineering maturity model that helps teams assess capability, prioritize improvement opportunities, and measure progress over time.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Audit, AI governance, and technology stakeholders to align quality engineering practices with enterprise controls, regulatory expectations, internal policies, and emerging AI governance standards.
  • Develop governance routines, decision forums, scorecards, and reporting mechanisms to monitor adoption of quality standards and identify systemic risks.
  • Use governance insights to drive continuous improvement across SDLC quality practices, DevOps controls, AI-enabled engineering practices, release quality, automation adoption, and production readiness.

Education, Enablement, and Transformation Support

  • Lead organizational enablement programs that help teams adopt enterprise Quality Engineering standards, methodologies, tools, AI-enabled capabilities, and ways of working.
  • Oversee Quality Engineering coaches who guide teams through quality planning, maturity assessments, platform onboarding, automation adoption, AI-assisted quality practices, and SDLC quality improvement.
  • Partner with platform and engineering enablement teams to support onboarding and integration across enterprise engineering platforms, including Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Enterprise, LaunchDarkly, SonarQube, and related quality tools.
  • Lead QE Community of Practice forums, learning initiatives, training programs, enablement content, and knowledge-sharing routines that strengthen enterprise quality capability and AI fluency.
  • Support enterprise quality transformation initiatives by translating strategy into practical adoption models, playbooks, coaching plans, metrics, and change management approaches.

Quality Intelligence and Analytics

  • Define and advance enterprise quality intelligence capabilities that provide actionable insight into engineering quality, SDLC compliance, quality maturity, release readiness, AI adoption, and production quality trends.
  • Partner with data, platform, DevOps, AI, and engineering teams to develop dashboards and scorecards for quality standards adoption, automation coverage, code quality, deployment validation, performance testing, defect trends, governance compliance, and AI-enabled quality outcomes.
  • Leverage quality and engineering metrics, including DevOps, DORA, pipeline, code quality, pull request, build, deployment, AI productivity, and compliance indicators, to guide improvement efforts.
  • Translate quality data into executive insights, risk themes, maturity trends, and recommendations that improve technology delivery outcomes.

QE Audit and Control Support

  • Lead Quality Engineering coordination for internal and external audits, including audit planning, evidence collection, control alignment, response coordination, and remediation tracking.
  • Partner with Audit, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, AI governance, Engineering, and platform teams to ensure Quality Engineering standards and evidence are aligned to applicable controls.
  • Establish repeatable audit support processes, evidence repositories, ownership models, and reporting routines to improve audit readiness and reduce operational friction.
  • Identify audit findings, control gaps, AI-related control considerations, and recurring evidence challenges; partner with stakeholders to drive corrective actions and sustainable improvements.

Leadership and Stakeholder Partnership

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team focused on quality methodology, governance, enablement, coaching, analytics, AI-enabled quality practices, and audit support.
  • Influence leaders and teams across a matrixed enterprise environment to adopt consistent quality standards, measurable engineering practices, and responsible AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, continuous improvement, learning, responsible innovation, and customer-centered quality.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior technology leaders on enterprise Quality Engineering maturity, AI-enabled transformation, risk, compliance, standards adoption, and transformation progress.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of experience in quality engineering, software engineering, DevOps, technology governance, IT risk, compliance, technology enablement, AI-enabled engineering transformation, or related disciplines.
  • 5 or more years of leadership experience managing technical teams, enablement teams, governance functions, or enterprise-scale transformation capabilities.
  • Demonstrated experience defining and implementing software quality standards, methodologies, operating procedures, or SDLC governance practices.
  • Experience applying or governing AI-enabled capabilities in software engineering, quality engineering, test automation, analytics, productivity improvement, or technology transformation.
  • Experience with Agile delivery, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, software engineering controls, release readiness, and production quality practices.
  • Experience developing maturity models, governance frameworks, scorecards, dashboards, and executive-level reporting.
  • Experience partnering with Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Audit, Engineering, Product, AI/Data, and technology leadership stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of quality engineering practices, including test automation, regression testing, deployment validation, code quality, performance testing, defect prevention, and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence enterprise adoption of standards and best practices in a matrixed environment.
  • Strong executive communication, analytical, organizational, and change leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated environment.
  • Experience leading Quality Engineering enablement, Agile transformation, DevOps governance, engineering excellence, AI-enabled engineering transformation, or enterprise platform adoption.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Enterprise, LaunchDarkly, SonarQube, CI/CD templates, reusable workflows, feature flags, code quality tooling, DevOps governance practices, and AI-assisted engineering tools.
  • Experience with audit evidence management, control mapping, SDLC compliance, segregation of duties, access controls, vulnerability scanning, software delivery governance, and AI governance considerations.
  • Experience applying DORA, SPACE, code quality, pipeline, release, AI productivity, quality intelligence, and compliance metrics to improve engineering performance.
  • Experience building Communities of Practice, coaching models, training programs, learning journeys, AI literacy programs, or enterprise enablement frameworks.
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$187,900 - $258,500 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About Us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.
