jobs.title: Senior Node.js Developer (Belarus)
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreFlosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

jobs.excerpt: From screening to research and development, Lunit is transforming how the world advances cancer detection — boldly, intelligently, and with humanity at the core.
jobs.description:
From screening to research and development, Lunit is transforming how the world advances cancer detection — boldly, intelligently, and with humanity at the core.

We build trusted partnerships with clinicians, health systems, and companies worldwide to deliver validated AI solutions that enhance clinical confidence, accelerate discovery, prioritize precision care — and bring the future of cancer diagnostics within reach.

To find out how you could contribute to our mission to conquer cancer as a Customer Education & Engagement Team Manager please read on.

Purpose:

The Customer Education & Engagement Team Manager will own the development and execution of scalable education and engagement programs that enable customers to confidently adopt, optimize, and expand their use of Lunit breast software across USCAN, LATAM, and EU. This role translates customer needs, product capabilities, and clinical workflow requirements into high-impact learning experiences for radiologists, technologists, and clinical and operational teams. Working closely with Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Onboarding/Implementation, the Customer Education & Engagement Lead will build programs that support successful onboarding, on-time go-lives, sustained utilization, and long-term customer advocacy.

What you'll be doing:

  • Lead the regional execution of customer education and engagement programs that drive adoption, proficiency, workflow optimization, and long-term utilization of Lunit breast software.
  • Design and maintain scalable learning pathways
    for customer onboarding, go-live readiness, release-based training, advanced workflow optimization, and ongoing product enablement.
  • Partner with Customer Onboarding/Implementation to embed training milestones, completion tracking, and readiness criteria into customer project plans to support successful deployments and revenue recognition timelines.
  • Develop a comprehensive education calendar that includes live training, virtual sessions, on-demand modules, webinars, masterclasses, user group discussions, and customer community events.
  • Create and maintain high-quality training materials, including e-learning modules, workflow simulations, video tutorials, quick-reference guides, facilitator materials, and customer-facing educational resources.
  • Ensure education content remains aligned with product updates, the Lunit roadmap, regulatory requirements, and evolving breast imaging workflows and clinical guidelines.
  • Partner with Marketing to launch customer education and thought-leadership programs that strengthen Lunit’s market presence, showcase customer expertise, and reinforce Lunit as a premium and innovative partner.
  • Manage and optimize the Absorb LMS customer training experience, including enrollment paths, certification tracking, reporting, learner engagement, and consumption analytics.
  • Leverage Higher Logic Vanilla to support digital community engagement, peer-to-peer learning, customer feedback loops, exclusive educational events, and champion cultivation.
  • Build strong relationships with customer champions, clinical stakeholders, subject matter experts, and internal teams to ensure education programs reflect real-world customer needs and measurable business outcomes.
  • Define, monitor, and report on education and engagement KPIs, including training completion, learner satisfaction, time-to-value, adoption indicators, community engagement, certification progress, and training impact.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Affairs and Marketing to lead the strategy, development, and execution of accredited CME and CEU programs (via ASRT, AHRA, or ACCME) to drive market thought-leadership, lead generation, and user engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to use education as a customer success and commercial enablement tool, helping reduce churn risk, increase utilization, support renewals, and uncover expansion opportunities.

What you will bring to the role:

  • 5+ years managing customer education, clinical training, or customer success enablement within MedTech, Medical Imaging, AI clinical tools, or SaaS.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Sciences, Instructional Design, Business, or a related field (Master's or valid clinical credentials like ARRT (R)(M) or ASMIRT preferred).
  • Deep understanding of breast imaging modalities, radiology operations, and clinical workflows (PACS/RIS) for radiologists and technologists.
  • Active engagement or a robust network within leading societies across USCAN, EU, and LATAM (SBI, ACR, ASRT, EUSOBI, ESR, EFRS, SIBIM, RANZCR, or ASMIRT).
  • Proven ability to leverage society relationships to track clinical trends, source subject matter experts (SMEs), and co-develop educational programming.
  • Demonstrated success designing scalable learning pathways, certifications, and blended curricula (live, virtual, on-demand) using adult learning principles.
  • Hands-on experience with Learning Management Systems (ideally Absorb LMS), community platforms (Higher Logic Vanilla), and content tools (Articulate Storyline/Rise).
  • Exceptional ability to collaborate across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product to translate technical software updates into clinical learning content.
  • Strong operational discipline to manage multiple education initiatives, customer deadlines, and localized assets across regions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the presence and empathy required to train and influence radiologists, techs, and hospital executives.
  • Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, or key European languages is highly advantageous for regional adoption.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30–40% across USCAN, LATAM, and EU for customer go-lives, site visits, and industry events.

What you will receive:

Candidate Sourcing & Talent Pipeline Management

    • LinkedIn Recruiter

    • Employee referrals

  • Share hiring market insights and recruitment recommendations.

Recruitment Operations

  • Keep recruitment pipelines organized and up to date.
  • Track hiring progress and recruitment metrics.
  • Support onboarding activities to ensure a smooth candidate transition.
  • Continuously improve recruitment workflows and operational efficiency.

  • Strong communicator with candidates, clients, and internal stakeholders.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and ownership-driven.

Experience

  • Previous experience in:
    • Talent Acquisition
    • Recruitment
    • Staffing
    • Full-cycle hiring

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience sourcing candidates using:
    • LinkedIn Recruiter
    • Job boards
    • Referrals
    • Networking
    • Boolean search techniques
  • Experience conducting structured interviews.
  • Strong candidate evaluation and assessment skills.
  • Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS).

  • Experience recruiting for remote or international positions.
  • Agency or staffing firm recruitment experience.
  • Experience recruiting across multiple industries and functional roles.

  • Present shortlisted candidates with detailed evaluations.
  • Maintain ATS records and recruitment pipelines.
  • Support onboarding and candidate communications.
  • Continuously strengthen talent pipelines for future hiring needs.

In short: You’ll identify, engage, and hire exceptional talent while providing an outstanding recruitment experience for both candidates and clients.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Time-to-Fill
  • Quality of Candidates Submitted
  • Interview-to-Offer Ratio
  • Candidate Response Rate
  • Client Satisfaction
  • ATS Accuracy
  • Candidate Experience
  • Offer Acceptance Rate

Why Join Us?

  • Own the full recruitment lifecycle from sourcing through onboarding.

  2. Client Interview
  3. Offer & Onboarding

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your recruitment experience, explain how you’ve sourced and evaluated candidates, managed multiple hiring processes, and partnered with hiring managers to deliver successful hiring outcomes. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Building an AI‑first organization is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Job Title: Director - LIMS Strategy - CPG & F&B

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva Systems has built the first modern cloud LIMS system, and we are hiring a Director of LIMS Strategy, QualityOne, to accelerate our growth across global accounts in the Food & Beverage, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), and Chemical Ingredients industries.
In this high-impact role, you will architect and execute the commercial strategy for our LIMS product line within these target sectors. You will act as the ultimate bridge between sales, marketing, product, and services, unifying them into a cohesive market vision while developing and personally delivering key messaging, training sales teams, and establishing industry thought leadership.
We are seeking a visionary leader with deep expertise in laboratory informatics, strong market intuition, and relevant experience in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) supply chain who can seamlessly pivot from high-level strategy to hands-on, day-to-day execution.

Market Expansion & Growth

    • Drive Market Entry: Own the growth and market penetration of Veeva LIMS for QualityOne across target FMCG and their supply chain sectors
    • Act as a Commercial Leader: Operate in a high-visibility, customer-facing commercial capacity to drive positive outcomes for both customers and Veeva
    • Champion Thought Leadership: Serve as an industry evangelist by presenting at major conferences, leading webinars, and authoring content for industry publications

Customer Engagement & Deal Strategy

    • Discovery & Workshops: Lead customer discovery sessions to uncover pain points, define desired benefits, and co-create solutions powered by Veeva LIMS
    • Deliver High-Impact Presentations: Support sales in creating and delivering compelling presentations to prospects, active customers, and executive stakeholders
    • Support Deals: Help prospective customers build their business cases to justify investments and accelerate the sales cycle. Support sales in deal strategy, pricing and proposals
    • Analyze the Competition: Conduct ongoing competitive analysis and develop tactical strategies and materials to win against competitors

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategy

    • Influence Product Roadmap: Provide vital business and technology guidance to the product team to shape new or enhanced features in laboratory informatics software
    • Enable Field Teams: Provide strategic direction and messaging to field-facing teams while building strong relationships with executive leadership
    • Coordinate the Customer Lifecycle: Align and coordinate resources across the entire customer journey, from initial sales to final delivery and beyond
    • Build Communities: Engage deeply with communities of practice and manage relationships with both internal and external stakeholders and partners

Requirements

Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge

    • Informatics Background: 8+ years of experience growing and scaling a technology offering at a laboratory informatics software vendor and/or a laboratory informatics consulting firm
    • Industry Alignment: Proven track record working with Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), supply chain companies, or closely related industries
    • Executive Presence: Proven ability to hold meaningful, strategic conversations with Heads of Quality, QC, and IT leaders regarding software applications and modernization
    • Innovation & Problem Solving: Demonstrated success innovating across complex business processes and technical solutions using critical thinking

Communication & Influence

    • Elite Communication: Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
    • High-Impact Presenter: Dynamic presentation skills with the ability to be clear, concise, convincing, confident, and credible to any audience
    • Relationship Builder: Strong interpersonal skills with a genuine passion for collaborating and working closely with people

Drive & Execution

    • Self-Starter Mentality: Driven and highly motivated leader who is comfortable taking initiative and working independently
    • Execution Excellence: Detail-oriented with a strong, self-imposed standard of quality, diligence, and a hard-working "want to win" attitude
    • Travel Flexibility: Ability and willingness to travel up to 40% for customer meetings and presentations

Nice to Have

    • Quality & Manufacturing Domain Expertise: Industry experience spanning Quality Control (QC), GxP quality content, training management, quality systems processes, or manufacturing
    • Commercial Leadership: Proven experience leading or guiding global sales teams to aggressively pursue and close complex enterprise opportunities
    • Executive Relationship Management: Seasoned background in establishing, expanding, and maintaining trusted partnerships with C-suite and executive-level stakeholders
    • Established Authority: Published thought leadership pieces, whitepapers, or articles within the laboratory informatics domain

Ensora Health is the leading provider of software and services for mental and behavioral health therapists, trusted by over 200,000 individual providers and more than 28,000 practices. With AI-enabled solutions that span practice management to electronic medical records and e-prescribing to billing, we help eliminate administrative complexity and create harmony between therapists, their clients, and the whole healthcare community.

Job Description

As Chief Information Officer (CIO), you’ll lead the technology our teams rely on every day. That includes the systems employees use, the enterprise applications that run our go-to-market and financial operations, our data platform, our corporate website, and our cloud infrastructure.

You’ll lead through strong domain owners, and you’ll stay close enough to the technology to set standards, weigh plans, and ask the hard questions. You’ll work alongside our product general managers, product AI organization, security team, and Finance.

What you’ll do

Set direction and own the enterprise systems estate

  • Set priorities for internal technology against company plans, and hold each domain accountable for delivery.
  • Own our enterprise applications, from CRM and marketing automation through ERP and financials, including the quote-to-cash flow between them.
  • Guide enterprise and data architecture, and lead the integration and data engineers who build it.
  • Run one intake, change-control, and planning cadence so a change in one system doesn’t break another.

Lead operations, data, and IT

  • Lead Enterprise Systems and Revenue Operations, aligning systems ownership with operating responsibility for the go-to-market stack.
  • Lead Cloud Operations across corporate and production environments (AWS and Azure), including availability, performance, cost, and security posture.
  • Lead IT and end-user services: service desk, endpoints, identity and access, Microsoft 365, and Workday administration.
  • Own our Snowflake data platform and integrations, with access governance set jointly with Finance.
  • Own the corporate website, including development, vendor relationships, and change control.

Manage risk, spend, and AI

  • Partner with our security team: you’re accountable for posture and execution, and they set standards and audit.
  • Govern internal process automation and AI agents, including approval gates and production-readiness review, in coordination with the product AI organization.
  • Own the technology budget and major vendor relationships, including planning, negotiation, and ROI.
  • Build and retain a high-performing team with a clear owner for every domain.

What you bring

Required

  • 15+ years in technology leadership, with growing responsibility for teams, programs, and budgets.
  • 8+ years directing technical leaders across multiple disciplines.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise and ERP architecture, data modeling, integration, and data engineering.
  • Experience across enterprise applications and cloud infrastructure, leading through domain owners.
  • Experience leading large-scale technology transformation and consolidation.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and SOC 2 in a regulated, data-sensitive environment.
  • A technical foundation, ideally including early-career engineering experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • SaaS or healthcare experience.
  • Hands-on credibility with modern data platforms such as Snowflake.
  • Contract negotiation experience that protects scope and delivers value.


How you work

  • You explain technology in business terms. You build trust with product, finance, legal, and executive partners.
  • You decide, then hold people accountable. You set direction and empower owners to deliver.
  • You respect the budget. You bring the ROI discipline a finance team expects.

Additional Information

While we've outlined some key qualities we typically seek, it's essential to remember that there might be additional unique strengths and talents you possess that would make you an exceptional match for us, even if they're not explicitly mentioned. Studies have consistently highlighted the significance of this principle, particularly for individuals from disenfranchised backgrounds, including women and other marginalized groups. The message we want to convey is that taking a leap of faith and applying can be incredibly rewarding. Your distinct abilities and perspectives could be exactly what we need to create a more diverse and inclusive team. So, don't hesitate—apply today and let's explore the exciting possibilities together!

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

AtEnsora Health, Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging aren’t just words. We celebrate what makes us unique, foster an ecosystem of inclusion for all and harness our talents to promote diversity of thought and action in everything we do.

We instill Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging into the fabric of our CARING culture and business, as we strive to be recognized not only as the leader in healthcare technology, but also for our intentional efforts to promote a diverse community. ​

​We will champion non-discriminatory practices throughout the employee and customer lifecycle; caring for every person regardless of race, national origin, color, religion, disability, sex, orientation, or familial status.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines.. You will be hired directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an Australian-based premium distributor partnering with professional haircare brands that are known for innovation, quality, and sustainability. Rather than simply supplying products, they focus on helping salon owners and stylists grow thriving businesses through education, support, and long-term partnerships.

Working closely with creative professionals across the industry, they champion brands that inspire artistry, encourage individuality, and deliver meaningful results. Their mission is to empower salon businesses to achieve greater success—both creatively and commercially—by providing the tools, knowledge, and support needed to grow with confidence.

Role Overview: We’re looking for a creative, hands-on Social Media Manager & Video Editor to manage multiple social media accounts of the client. You’ll turn raw footage of hair transformations, product features, educational sessions, and industry events into polished, engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok, while managing content calendars, captions, publishing, and community engagement across several brand accounts.

You’ll also build the business’s TikTok presence from the ground up and support the founder’s LinkedIn content. Working closely with the in-house marketing team, you’ll help maintain consistent brand identities, grow engagement with hairdressers and salon owners, and use creative ideas and AI tools to improve content. As the business grows, there may be opportunities to take on broader marketing responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

Video Editing & Content Creation

  • Edit raw footage into polished, engaging short-form videos for Instagram Reels and TikTok.
  • Adapt video pacing, length, hooks, and formats to suit each platform.
  • Create content featuring hair transformations, educational tips, product features, behind-the-scenes footage, and industry events.
  • Add captions, text overlays, transitions, music, and sound effects while maintaining each brand’s visual identity.
  • Colour-correct and grade footage to ensure hair colour and products look accurate and premium.
  • Repurpose longer videos, educational sessions, and event footage into multiple short-form clips.
  • Use AI tools to streamline editing, generate ideas, and improve content quality.

Social Media Management

  • Manage the main Instagram account and multiple brand-specific social media accounts.
  • Plan and maintain content calendars across all accounts.
  • Write engaging captions that resonate with hairdressers and salon owners.
  • Schedule and publish content consistently across platforms.
  • Maintain consistent content quality, brand voice, and presentation across all accounts.

Community Engagement

  • Respond promptly to comments and direct messages in the appropriate brand voice.
  • Monitor tagged posts and engage with relevant salon and client content.
  • Proactively comment on, share, and interact with posts from the salon community.
  • Build relationships with hairdressers and salon owners to grow engagement across accounts.

TikTok Growth

  • Build and grow the business’s TikTok presence from the ground up.
  • Monitor trends, sounds, and content formats, adapting relevant ideas to suit each brand.

LinkedIn Content Support

  • Assist with managing the founder’s personal LinkedIn profile.
  • Repurpose relevant content from other social channels into posts suited to a professional audience.

Requirements

Must have:

  • 2–3 years minimum experience in video editing and social media management for brands
  • A strong portfolio of short-form video content (Reels and TikTok) showing high-quality editing
  • Advanced skills in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve
  • Solid working knowledge of Instagram and TikTok, including Reels, Stories, trends, algorithms and insights
  • Experience managing multiple brand accounts at once, each with its own voice
  • A strong eye for aesthetics, with a feel for how hair, colour and product should look on camera
  • Clear understanding of how tone and content differ across Instagram, TikTok and LinkedIn
  • Great written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Organised, reliable and self-directed, with strong attention to detail
  • Availability during South Australian business hours

Nice to have:

  • Experience in the hair, beauty or fashion industry, as is a genuine passion for the space
  • Experience using AI tools for video editing and content creation
  • Broader marketing or marketing management experience
  • Familiarity with social scheduling tools such as Meta Business Suite, Later or Planoly

This is a remote role that may be set up as either an independent contractor engagement or via an Employer of Record (EOR), depending on client preferences and legal structure.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Be available for meetings and collaboration during core [AEST or PHT] business hours

    Validar e manter atualizado o inventário de sistemas (telas, relatórios, complexidade), identificando divergências entre o escopo mapeado e a realidade de cada sistema;
    Mapear os processos de negócio impactados pela migração e definir, junto às áreas, os critérios de aceite e homologação por sistema;
    Conduzir o piloto de calibração de esforço (migração de amostra de telas e relatórios) para validar as estimativas de esforço por pacote;
    Elaborar e manter a documentação técnico-funcional dos sistemas migrados;
    Organizar e planejar os testes de homologação, validando a aderência funcional entre o sistema legado e a versão migrada em Forms 12c.

VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de projetos de TI, preferencialmente de migração ou modernização de sistemas legados.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão de cronograma (MS Project ou equivalente).
  • Conhecimento de gestão de riscos, análise de viabilidade (esforço x capacidade) e planos de contingência.
  • Experiência em governança de projetos: reuniões de status, relatórios executivos e escalonamento de desvios.
  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 a 5 anos em gestão de projetos de TI de porte comparável.

VOCÊ SE DESTACA SE TIVER:

  • Conhecimento técnico sobre Oracle Forms e processos de migração entre versões.
  • Certificação em gestão de projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2 ou similar).
  • Experiência com equipes mistas (recursos internos + temporários contratados).
  • Vivência em órgãos públicos ou entidades do sistema S.

FORMAÇÃO ACADÊMICA:

jobs.title: Partnerships Development Associate
jobs.excerpt: 🕙 Role details: This is a full time role (40 hours per week) 💷 Salary: £29,000 - £35,000pa + Performance-related commission + Equity options 🌍 Location: We're a remote first team, based throughout the UK & Ireland.
jobs.description:
🕙 Role details: This is a full time role (40 hours per week)

💷 Salary: £29,000 - £35,000pa + Performance-related commission + Equity options

🌍 Location: We're a remote first team, based throughout the UK & Ireland. We offer the flexibility to work outside of the UK/Ireland up to 90 days per year, however you must be able to work and live permanently within the UK or Ireland, and able to travel to London at least four times a year for company meet ups and additionally as needed.

The role

We're looking for an ambitious, curious and commercially minded Partnerships Development Associate to join our growing commercial team and help bring Isla's technology to more healthcare organisations.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to build a career in consultative sales. You'll combine research and proactive business development with the opportunity to connect with NHS clinicians and decision-makers, understand the challenges they're facing and show them how Isla could help.

You'll take ownership of the early stages of our sales process, from finding and reaching out to potential partners to building relationships, running introductory meetings and demonstrating our platform.

This isn't just about generating leads or booking meetings. You will get to know the people you're speaking to, ask great questions and understand what matters to them. You'll learn to spot where Isla could make a real difference and work closely with our senior Partnership Leads to turn those initial conversations into lasting partnerships.

We're looking for someone who enjoys meeting new people, is naturally curious and loves getting to the bottom of a problem. You'll need the confidence to start conversations, the resilience to keep going when things don't work out and, just as importantly, the ability to listen, build trust and make people feel understood.

You don't need to know the NHS or other healthcare systems inside out. We're much more interested in your attitude, initiative and willingness to learn. If you're excited to take on responsibility early, develop your skills and play a part in changing how healthcare is delivered, we'd love to hear from you!

------

Who we are

Isla Health is a venture-backed health-tech scale-up, supporting our partners across the UK, EU and internationally. We have built a new category of healthcare technology which we refer to as the Digital Pathway Platform (DPP). Founded in 2019, we now support 25% of NHS Trusts and a submission of patient data is made on the platform every 20 seconds

As a company, we're all laser focused on enabling a scalable model of care which empowers healthcare staff and improves patient outcomes. The DPP supports this by setting up digital pathways which are remote-first and asynchronous. As pathways harness sophisticated automation, clinical algorithms and intelligent cohorting, patients always take the optimised route through their pathway, thereby delivering a step change in clinical productivity.

------

Over the next 12 months you will:

  • Identify and develop new opportunities: Research NHS organisations, clinical services and regional priorities to identify where Isla could deliver meaningful value. Take ownership of targeted outbound activity across email, phone and LinkedIn, finding thoughtful and effective ways to engage prospective partners.
  • Lead early-stage customer conversations: Build relationships with clinicians, operational teams and NHS decision-makers. Run initial discovery meetings, asking insightful questions to understand their challenges, priorities and existing ways of working.
  • Demonstrate the value of our platform: Deliver engaging introductory and clinical demonstrations of Isla, adapting your approach to different audiences and helping prospective partners understand how our technology could improve their services.
  • Qualify prospective partnerships: Go beyond generating interest to understand whether there is a genuine opportunity for Isla. Explore customer needs, relevant stakeholders, potential impact and next steps, ensuring opportunities are well understood before progressing them.
  • Build a high-quality commercial pipeline: Work closely with senior Partnership Leads to progress qualified opportunities, providing the insights and context needed to develop successful partnerships. Take ownership of follow-up and maintain momentum throughout the early stages of the sales process.
  • Develop your understanding of the NHS: Build a strong knowledge of NHS structures, clinical pathways and the challenges facing healthcare organisations, enabling you to have increasingly credible and valuable conversations with prospective customers.
  • Continuously improve our approach: Track your activity and opportunities through our CRM, share insights from customer conversations and use data, feedback and AI tools to make our outreach and qualification processes more effective.

Requirements

  • A consultative mindset: You're naturally curious and enjoy understanding people's challenges. You ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully and focus on finding the right solution rather than simply delivering a sales pitch.
  • Exceptional communication skills: You can write clear, concise and engaging outreach that cuts through the noise of a busy clinician's inbox. You're equally confident building relationships, leading conversations and communicating complex ideas to different audiences.
  • Commercial drive: You're proactive, motivated by results and enjoy the challenge of creating new opportunities. You're comfortable picking up the phone, initiating conversations and following them through.
  • Strong research and analytical skills: You enjoy getting to grips with complex topics, digging into data and identifying opportunities. You can connect the dots between an organisation's challenges and where Isla could add value.
  • Confidence and resilience: You're comfortable stepping outside your comfort zone, aren't discouraged by rejection and are always looking for ways to learn and improve.
  • Ownership and initiative: You take responsibility for your work, manage your time effectively and follow through on commitments. You're proactive in finding solutions rather than waiting for direction.
  • Technical aptitude: You're comfortable learning new technologies, confident using tools like Google Sheets and interested in how AI can make your research, outreach and workflows more effective.
  • Collaborative, mission-driven approach: You're excited about Isla's impact on patient care, enjoy working towards shared goals and take pride in seeing opportunities you've helped create develop into successful partnerships.
  • Experience:
    • Ideally, you'll have at least one year's experience in a fast-paced, commercial or customer-facing environment, such as sales, business development or account management.
    • Experience in B2B sales, SaaS or healthcare would be beneficial.

We appreciate you might not meet all of the requirements for this position. If your experience looks somewhat different to the requirements in the job spec but you think you can bring value to this role, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

🏡 Work where you do your best work either from home or at our office in London (Moorgate) 🏢

🕜 Flexible working times

🌍 Work abroad for up to 90 days per year

🏖️ 25 days annual leave on top of bank holidays. Plus, take your birthday off and another significant day off of your choice 🎂

🍜 Quarterly meal on us - enjoy £75 to treat friends or family

🧘‍♀️ Wellbeing allowance - £50 per month for gym membership/wellbeing activities or private medical insurance

💡 Salary sacrifice pension and access to Mintago for retail discounts, financial coaching, childcare vouchers, virtual GP and more

🎉 Enhanced parental leave to support your family when it matters most

🎳 Quarterly company meet-ups

📚 An annual learning budget to support your growth

📈 Share in our success with share options

💗 Work with purpose - you'll be delivering social impact through improved patient healthcare

🚀 Join at an exciting stage - we're a well-funded, rapidly growing health tech company tackling a global challenge

🌱 Help shape the future of Isla - your ideas won't disappear into layers of management. You'll have real ownership, real impact, and help define how we grow the business

------

What is the hiring process for this role?

  1. A video submission. Successful applicants will be invited to submit a quick video so we can get to know the person behind the CV!
  2. An initial call with one of our People Operations team - 15 minutes
  3. A short take-home written task
  4. A role play interview with one of our Partnerships Leads - 30 minutes
  5. An interview with our Director of Partnerships, Chris - 30 minutes
  6. A final interview with our Co-founder/CEO, Pete - 30 minutes

------

Diversity and Inclusion

Isla is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building an inclusive and diverse team. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply. We do not discriminate against anyone on the basis of their race, gender, disability, religion, national origin, age, or any other protected category. We choose to celebrate our team’s differences and see them as one of our most valuable assets.

Recruitment is not one-size-fits-all and we're happy to tailor our hiring process to better meet the needs of individual applicants. Please email with any requests for support.

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Partnerships Manager
jobs.excerpt: About DonorsChooseDonorsChoose is an education nonprofit ensuring every US public school student has the classroom resources they need to learn, grow, and thrive.
jobs.description:
About DonorsChoose

DonorsChoose is an education nonprofit ensuring every US public school student has the classroom resources they need to learn, grow, and thrive.

Founded by a teacher in 2000, DonorsChoose connects educators with a nationwide community of supporters who believe investing in students today will transform tomorrow. Educators request the materials they know their students need, and donors can choose the classroom, community, or cause they want to support. Since our founding, donors have supported 90% of US public schools. Every request is vetted, resources are delivered to classrooms, and donors can see the impact of their support through transparent reporting and updates from students and teachers. Raising $1.9 billion for classrooms, DonorsChoose has earned top ratings from Charity Navigator, GuideStar, and CharityWatch for its transparency, trust, and impact. Our dedicated team works from across the United States to turn resources into opportunities for students and teachers.

About the Corporate Partnerships Team

Our team raises funds for classrooms by building and executing philanthropic partnerships with corporations and renewing and growing those partnerships over time. Read more about our partnerships.

About the Role

DonorsChoose is seeking a Senior Corporate Partnerships Manager to grow and steward a portfolio of strategic corporate partners while helping evolve how we build long-term, mission-driven partnerships.

This is more than traditional account management. Our strongest partnerships create meaningful value for both our partners and the classrooms we serve. Success requires curiosity, commercial thinking, exceptional relationship management, and the ability to translate partner objectives into creative, measurable philanthropic strategies.

As a senior individual contributor, you will own a portfolio of complex corporate relationships who each contribute $250K+ annually, while helping shape partnership strategy, identifying new opportunities for growth, and contributing to how the team continues to evolve.

Primary Responsibilities

Build and Grow Strategic Partnerships

  • Own a portfolio of corporate partnerships, developing long-term strategies that deepen engagement and increase philanthropic investment over time.
  • Build trusted relationships across multiple levels of partner organizations, identifying new stakeholders and opportunities to expand impact.
  • Consistently identify opportunities for renewals, upsells, multi-year commitments, and expanded partnership scope.
  • Contribute meaningfully toward annual fundraising goals through a portfolio of sophisticated corporate partnerships.

Design Thoughtful Partnership Strategies

  • Develop customized partnership strategies that align partner business objectives with DonorsChoose's mission.
  • Translate corporate priorities into high-impact partnerships through creative campaigns, employee engagement opportunities, and storytelling.
  • Use data, insights, and impact reporting to demonstrate value and strengthen long-term relationships.
  • Partner with internal teams to ensure successful implementation while balancing partner experience with organizational scalability.

Lead Complex Cross-Functional Execution

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner across complex partnership engagements.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including Marketing, Revenue Operations, Product, Finance, Impact, and Communications.
  • Anticipate risks, remove obstacles, and maintain momentum across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Ensure exceptional execution from proposal through renewal.

Strengthen Team Capability

  • Share successful partnership strategies and contribute to evolving team best practices.
  • Mentor newer teammates through deal strategy, proposal development, and relationship management, using a B2B consultative selling approach.
  • Identify opportunities to improve partnership operations, processes, and scalability.
  • Bring an external perspective on corporate philanthropy trends, helping the team continuously improve how we engage partners.

Qualifications

You may thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 8+ years of experience, including experience in corporate partnerships, strategic account management, fundraising, business development, consultative sales, customer success, or relationship management.
  • Have successfully secured and managed complex six- and seven-figure partnerships.
  • Are exceptional at building trust with senior leaders and navigating complex stakeholder environments.
  • Think commercially—you naturally identify opportunities to deepen relationships and create mutual value.
  • View feedback as not just a tool for development, but as a catalyst for action. You are someone who embraces constructive insights and shows visible improvement in your next iteration.
  • Are highly strategic without losing sight of execution details.
  • Are a master of prioritization, who thrives on turning ambiguity into execution. You know how to scope a project, balance urgency with thoughtful prioritization across multiple high-value relationships, and keep cross-functional teams moving in the same direction.
  • Enjoy collaborating across functions and are known as someone who makes teams stronger.
  • Care deeply about educational equity and believe philanthropy can be a powerful driver of systemic change.

Level Expectations

Senior Corporate Partnerships Managers independently own the organization's most sophisticated partnership portfolios and consistently deliver against ambitious fundraising goals. They shape partnership strategy, influence how the team approaches relationship management, and serve as mentors and thought partners to colleagues. While they do not directly manage people, they regularly influence cross-functional decisions, improve team practices, and help raise the overall quality of partnership work across the organization.

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation philosophy ensures that we are both externally competitive with tech-forward nonprofits of a similar size and internally fair in our pay practices. The following ranges represent the target offer range given the scope and experience expectations for this role.

  • The hiring salary range for this role is $90,000 - $110,000
  • We have a hiring salary range of $100,000- $120,000 for specific higher cost of labor locations, which include New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Seattle, Boston, and Washington, D.C.

Once employees are hired, everyone at DonorsChoose is eligible to receive annual performance-based raises as they grow in their role. We are open to a variety of experiences, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced or more senior than this job description as posted. If you don’t check every box listed here, or you know you’d bring additional experience to the table, we hope you’ll submit your application.

In addition, we offer full-time staff 25 paid vacation days per year and 11 paid holidays, a rich employer-paid individual and family health plan, a matching 401(k) plan (up to 5% of base salary), annual professional development stipend, and casual and flexible work environment. To learn more about what it is like to work for DonorsChoose, visit our careers page.

Hybrid Workplace and Other Details

In this role, you’ll have the option to work a flexible hybrid schedule in our NYC office, or to work fully remotely from CA, CO, CT, DC, FL, GA, IL, IN, MA, MD, MI, MN, NC, NJ, NY, OR, PA, TN, TX, VA, WA, or WI.

Candidates should expect to travel approximately 8-10 times per year, based on business need. Travel based on business needs including, but is not limited to, internal events such as all staff gatherings, as well as external events such as partner meetings, conferences, and other events as necessary. All work-related travel expenses will be covered by the organization.

DonorsChoose participates in E-Verify. We will provide the U.S. Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.

An important note on communications: All messages from our hiring team will come from an official @donorschoose.org email address. If you ever receive a message about a role with us from a different domain, it’s not from us, and you should not reply or click on any links. We care deeply about your time, your privacy, and your experience—thank you for your interest in joining the DonorsChoose mission!

DonorsChoose Core Values

EQUITY
Combating systemic inequity is crucial to a brighter future for all. This reality fuels our ambitions and drives us to persevere.

INGENUITY

jobs.excerpt: PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised.
jobs.description:
PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real.

Come join us.

Job Summary:

We are looking for enthusiastic candidates interested in applying quantum computing to real-world challenges. At PsiQuantum, we are particularly focused on use cases of quantum computing in chemistry, drug design, materials science, and fluid dynamics. Along these lines, we are offering internships in the areas of quantum algorithms and quantum compilation.

Your work could entail the -

  • Development of quantum algorithms to solve impactful problems,
  • Optimization of ubiquitous subroutines in fault tolerant quantum algorithms,
  • Compilation of quantum algorithms to logical gate sets,
  • Incorporation of architecture-aware optimizations,
  • Estimation of quantum resources.

Prior work in the field of fault tolerant quantum algorithms and compilation is preferred, but enthusiasm for quantum computing is essential.

Desired experience and skills:

  • Currently studying for, or completed a postgraduate degree related to quantum algorithms, quantum circuit compilation, fault tolerance or another aspect of quantum computing OR 5+ years working professionally in one or more of these fields.
  • Experience with programming languages (e.g. Python) and collaborative software development tools (e.g. Git).
  • A creative and adaptable approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative team.

This role maintains a dashboard or similar tracking tool as the single source of truth on open issues and is expected to communicate proactively — no one should have to ask for a status update. Issue Intake and Triage:

Impact Analysis:

  • Conduct thorough impact analyses to determine the scope and severity of each issue, including which clients, members, or files are affected
  • Partner with Data Operations team members (ETL Developer/File Management Analyst, Senior Data Operations Engineer, PBM Claims Adjudication Expert) to validate findings and confirm root cause

Status Tracking and Proactive Communication:

  • Build and maintain a dashboard or similar tracking tool that reflects the current status of all open issues

Cross-Functional Liaison:

  • Serve as the primary liaison between the Data Operations team and Patient Care Advocates on file-related and data issues

Documentation and Process Improvement:

  • Maintain clear documentation of issues, analyses, and resolutions for future reference and audit needs

What you need:

  • 2+ years of experience as a business analyst or in a similar liaison/analyst role; healthcare or PBM experience strongly preferred
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate clearly between technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to break down a reported issue and determine its full scope and impact
  • Experience building and maintaining a dashboard or status-tracking tool (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Smartsheet, Jira, or similar)

About LOVB (League One Volleyball):
League One Volleyball (LOVB) is reimagining women's sports. Launched in 2019, our company is a mission-led sports performance, training and media enterprise that will change the game of volleyball in the USA and empower new generations of female athletes.

It is a groundbreaking time for volleyball in the US with our historic triple Olympic Gold medals in Women's Indoor, Beach and Sitting Volleyball. Volleyball is already the #1 most played girls' youth sport. There are 38M current and former players today. Of major sports, it's the only one that is women-first (~90% of players are female). But the volleyball market has been almost entirely missed by traditional sports investors, brands, and media.

LOVB is capturing this opportunity by creating a strong club business, and from that built-in audience and fandom, is creating the best Pro League in the world and a digital ecosystem that will connect all aspects of LOVB. This community-up approach will drive participation and fandom, while enabling greater empowerment for girls and young women living this amazing sport. In this role, you will join a mission-driven, roll-up-your-sleeves team of innovators and builders who have come together to change the paradigm of professional volleyball and women’s sports.

Department Code & Name: 203 - Marketing - Club

Location: Remote (U.S.-based) with occasional travel for site visits and business-related events

Working closely with the Social Media Specialist, Youth, you will help ideate, create, edit, schedule, and publish content across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. In a remote setting, you will transform photos and videos submitted by clubs, athletes, and events into polished social content. During select tournaments and activations, you will capture and edit content in realtime and help showcase the athlete, club, and fan experience. This role is well-suited for a creative and organized emerging marketer who understands social media and is plugged into youth and club volleyball culture.

Content Creation & Publishing

Required & Preferred Skills/Abilities:

jobs.excerpt: Help make the world more hospitable The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it.
jobs.description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

As Associate General Counsel, Product & Regulatory, you'll own how legal and regulatory judgement shows up inside Mews' product and fintech work, leading a specialist pod of counsel and paralegals and reporting to the Chief Legal Officer. Mews builds tightly integrated SaaS and fintech products, and the hard questions (money transmission, e-money, embedded finance, partner-bank and BaaS models, cross-border operating decisions) need someone who helps product teams work through them in practice, not from a distance. This is a chance to set the bar for how a scaling hospitality-fintech platform builds regulated products responsibly and at pace.

You'll be embedded with Product and Engineering as a genuine product counsel and builder, surfacing and triaging legal and regulatory issues across the design and release lifecycle rather than reviewing work once it's done. You'll own the Product & Regulatory legal remit end to end: setting priorities and the quality bar, deciding what the pod handles directly, what gets standardised, and what gets escalated, and building and managing an appropriately sized team as the work grows. You'll act as the senior legal point person for product-related regulatory matters across the business.

Mews operates in regulated environments, which means product decisions carry real legal and regulatory weight, from AML, BSA, KYC and KYB obligations through to supervisory expectations, audits and market entry. The teams building these products need legal support that moves at their pace and helps them make sound decisions early, with repeatable operating discipline around them. Getting this right is what lets Mews scale regulated and non-regulated products confidently.

What you would do

  • Own the Product & Regulatory legal remit across Mews' SaaS and fintech environment, setting priorities, operating norms and the quality bar for legal support to Product and Engineering.
  • Embed with Product and Engineering as a hands-on product counsel, surfacing legal, regulatory and commercial trade-offs early and resolving them pragmatically across the release lifecycle.
  • Provide senior legal guidance on regulated product design, launch and scaling, including payments, embedded finance, money transmission, partner-bank and BaaS models, and cross-border propositions.
  • Build and manage a small specialist pod of counsel and paralegals, coaching them into strong product partners and building the playbooks, templates and working norms that let teams move faster without adding risk.
  • Use AI to reshape how legal support is delivered into product development, improving speed, quality and consistency across the pod.

AI Fluency Level 3: in this role that means going beyond using AI for your own drafting and analysis. You'll redesign how the pod delivers legal support to product, using AI across intake, issue-spotting, comparison and first-draft playbooks; build approaches the rest of the team can follow, including prompt quality and review discipline; and apply strong legal judgement about when AI output is incomplete, unreliable or too risky to rely on without deeper review.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to "AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates" on Confluence.

What you would bring

  • Significant in-house legal experience in technology, SaaS or fintech, with strong evidence of working closely with product teams rather than reviewing their work after the fact.
  • Strong fintech and regulatory exposure, ideally in payments, embedded finance or money transmission, including releasing regulated products and handling partner-bank or BaaS models.
  • Working knowledge of financial-crime regulation (AML, BSA, KYC, KYB) applied to product and operational decisions, plus experience with supervisory expectations, audits, investigations or regulatory change.
  • A hands-on builder mentality with clear examples of processes, guidance or tooling you've created, and sound commercial judgement that balances legal risk with business outcomes rather than defaulting to "no."
  • People-leadership experience, ideally managing lawyers and/or paralegals, and AI Fluency Level 3 or the equivalent hands-on experience using AI in day-to-day legal work.

Nice to have

  • Experience acting as true product counsel rather than purely commercial counsel.
  • Experience in earlier-stage or scaling environments rather than highly siloed large-enterprise settings.
  • Experience leading a regional or specialist legal team while staying close to product and business execution.

Location: US, UK or EU considered

Salary banding for guidance only.

UK
£105,000—£190,000 GBP

Pay Transparency at Mews

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

  • Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
  • Participation in our company share program
  • Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
  • An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
  • Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
  • A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
  • Relocation options, available after one year
  • Flexible, hybrid working options
  • A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance
  • Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

  • High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.
  • Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.
  • We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.
  • AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

  • Practice Type: High-End Concierge & Telehealth Practice (Serving HNW Clients & CEOs across ~10–11 States)

  3. Process Optimization & SOP Building: Identify operational bottlenecks across our multi-platform tech stack, propose workflow enhancements, and draft clear SOPs to streamline practice efficiency.

  • Athena EHR Management: Maintain pristine patient records, update charts, track lab/diagnostic orders, and manage administrative workflows within Athena EHR.

You are a polished, tech-savvy Medical EA who thrives in elite healthcare environments. You navigate Athena and Spruce effortlessly, leverage modern AI tools to work smarter, anticipate clinical needs before they arise, and deliver the red-carpet administrative experience our high-net-worth patients expect.

jobs.description:
Web Designer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a skilled Web Designer to create polished, user-centered web experiences that balance visual quality with usability. You’ll translate briefs and product goals into wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes, ensuring designs are responsive, consistent, and ready for development.

Working closely with developers and stakeholders, you’ll own your designs from initial concept through implementation review. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented designer who takes pride in their work, communicates proactively, and can manage projects independently in a remote, asynchronous environment.

What You’ll Own

Visual Design & Prototyping

  • Translate project briefs and product goals into clear, user-centered web designs.
  • Create wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes to communicate design concepts before development begins.
  • Balance visual appeal, usability, and business objectives across web experiences.

Responsive Web Design

  • Design and refine layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.
  • Apply responsive design principles to deliver consistent experiences across devices.
  • Consider how layouts and interactions translate into HTML and CSS.

Design System Maintenance

  • Contribute to and improve the existing design system.
  • Maintain consistency across components, typography, colors, spacing, and layouts.
  • Use component libraries and reusable design elements to support efficient workflows.

Developer Collaboration & Handoff

  • Work closely with front-end developers to ensure accurate design implementation.
  • Provide clear specifications, assets, and guidance for layouts and interactions.
  • Answer implementation questions and resolve design-related issues during development.

Feedback & Iteration

  • Incorporate stakeholder and user feedback into design revisions.
  • Refine designs efficiently while keeping the original project goals in focus.
  • Ask clarifying questions and communicate potential blockers early.

Design Quality Assurance

  • Review implemented pages against approved designs.
  • Identify visual inconsistencies, layout issues, and usability concerns.
  • Recommend fixes to maintain a high standard of design quality.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Professional experience in web design, supported by a portfolio demonstrating strong visual judgment, layout skills, and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in a modern design tool such as Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
  • Experience with component libraries, reusable components, and auto-layout workflows.
  • Solid understanding of responsive design principles and how designs translate into HTML and CSS.
  • Familiarity with UX fundamentals, including information architecture, user flows, accessibility, and usability.
  • Strong written and spoken English for clear communication with distributed teams and stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines independently.
  • Strong attention to detail and willingness to refine work based on feedback.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take pride in producing polished, thoughtful design work and maintain high standards without constant supervision.
  • You communicate proactively, clarify requirements early, and keep collaborators informed.
  • You respond constructively to feedback and focus on delivering the best outcome for users and the business.
  • You work effectively in an asynchronous environment and manage your workload reliably.
  • You collaborate well with developers and understand the importance of accurate design handoffs.
  • You take ownership of your designs from concept through final implementation review.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality, user-centered web designs that align with project goals.
  • Responsive layouts that deliver consistent experiences across devices.
  • A well-maintained design system with reusable, consistent components.
  • Clear handoffs that help developers implement designs accurately.
  • Timely, thoughtful revisions based on feedback.
  • Implemented pages that closely match approved designs and meet quality expectations.

Typical Day

You’ll begin by reviewing feedback and comments on active design files and prioritizing your work. Depending on project needs, you may refine a landing page, develop a reusable design component, or revise a product interface.

You may also meet with a developer to discuss a design handoff or clarify an interaction. Later in the day, you’ll review completed work for quality, update project notes, and document progress so teammates across time zones can continue smoothly.

  • Initial Screening
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding
