jobs.description:
Platform Owner

POSITION SUMMARY


This role is charged with named, end-to-end accountability for one or more of Speedcast's strategic TechOps platforms. The Platform Owner is the platform's highest technical authority, responsible for availability, performance, security, cost, and service quality on the platform.

Speedcast is the world's trusted partner for edge compute solutions and critical remote connectivity, enabling operations across the most demanding environments on Earth. We connect vessels, offshore platforms, mining sites, and enterprise customers in places where connectivity is not a convenience. It is an operational necessity.

Day to day, this means executing a disciplined operating cadence, owning the primary vendor relationship, and working across Product Management, Solutions Engineering, and support teams to keep the platform operating and evolving effectively. The Platform Owner co-signs roadmap commitments, defines standard deployment designs, ensures operational readiness at scale, and builds the runbook library and knowledge transfer that allow Tier 1/2 teams to operate the platform sustainably.

This is a senior individual contributor role and the primary growth track for engineers who want to move from execution into ownership, cross-functional leadership, and vendor and customer engagement, without moving into people management. The right candidate is technically deep, operationally disciplined, and comfortable operating as the named authority for a platform that the business depends on.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


• Serve as the named technical authority and accountable owner for one or more assigned TechOps platforms, responsible for availability, performance, security, cost, and service quality.

• Execute a structured operating cadence: daily platform health checks, weekly NOC sync, monthly maintenance and service reporting, quarterly disaster recovery testing and vendor QBRs, and an annual strategy refresh.

• Own all Tier 3 incident escalations for the assigned platform; maintain the configuration baseline; lead maintenance windows with full change management discipline, including risk assessment and rollback planning.

• Identify and implement tooling and automation improvements to reduce operational toil and improve platform reliability.

• Work in close partnership with a paired Product Manager. Product defines the strategic direction, commercial priorities, and scoped roadmap sequencing with user stories.

• Provide the operational reality, technical feasibility assessment, and implementation ownership that ensures every roadmap commitment will be delivered and sustainably operated.

Drive performance through operational data and share insights with the Product Manager to inform roadmap conversations, surface feasibility concerns early, and co-own the outcome of every platform-affecting decision. No committed roadmap item proceeds without the Platform Owner's sign-off on operational cost and viability.

• Own the primary vendor relationship for the assigned platform, including Technical Account Manager (TAM) engagement, escalation paths, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs).

• Represent Speedcast's operational requirements in vendor roadmap discussions; monitor version currency, end-of-life risk, and the competitive landscape.

• Manage platform license utilization and drive ongoing cost efficiency.

• Conduct monthly service reviews with the NOC and Service Delivery teams, covering platform and customer-level service reports, and contribute to the Monthly Operating Review (MOR).

• Act as the technical bridge during customer escalations; support onboarding of new customers and use cases onto the platform.

• Provide platform briefings to internal stakeholders and executive audiences as required.

• Develop and maintain a comprehensive runbook library in partnership with functional groups, enabling Tier 1/2 teams to resolve the most common incident types independently, without Platform Owner involvement.

• Deliver structured knowledge transfer and training to support teams for new features; cross-train to establish sustainable supportability.

• Maintain current documentation across architecture, configuration standards, and operational procedures; contribute to Platform Owner standards development for cross-platform consistency and peer review.

• Provide Product Management with structured monthly operational signal — escalation patterns, capacity trends, incident root causes, and customer feature requests — as data-driven input to roadmap prioritization.

• Co-sign roadmap commitments with the paired Product Manager, providing technical and operational feasibility assessment before items enter the committed roadmap.

• Maintain a technical debt register for the platform and proactively surface remediation recommendations.

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related field. Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered in lieu of formal qualification.


EXPERIENCE


Essential

• 5+ years in network operations, systems engineering, or platform/infrastructure engineering, with demonstrable progression from hands-on delivery into technical ownership and accountability.

• Proven Tier 3 incident command experience, with the ability to lead complex, multi-system incidents to resolution under pressure while maintaining clear stakeholder communication.

• Direct vendor management experience, including owning technical escalations, QBRs, and named TAM relationships for enterprise or carrier-grade platforms.

• Track record of producing high-quality operational documentation — runbooks, architecture notes, configuration standards — used by other teams without further guidance.

• Strong ability to implement/understand IP networking and the connectivity stack (TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, SD-WAN, or equivalent) relevant to the assigned platform's operational context.

• Practical experience with change management, ITSM tooling (ServiceNow or equivalent), and operational security practices including patch management and vulnerability triage.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear engineering documentation and present confidently to technical peers, operational teams, and senior stakeholders.


Nice-to-Have

• Experience in satellite, maritime, or remote-site connectivity environments (VSAT, LEO/Starlink, OneWeb, or equivalent).

• Familiarity with AIOps and observability tooling such as BigPanda or Grafana.

• Experience collaborating with or embedded within a Product Management function, contributing operational feasibility input to roadmap decisions.

• Experience with automation and working knowledge of any scripting language and any of the following; Terraform, CloudFormation, Puppet, Chef, Ansible, Salt and/or Kubernetes is highly valued.



Desirable

• A strong command of English is required. Additional working languages — French, Spanish, Portuguese, or Arabic — are an advantage in Speedcast's multi-national operating environment.


ABOUT SPEEDCAST


Speedcast is a leading communications and IT services provider, delivering critical communications services to the Maritime, Energy, Mining, Media, Telecom, Cruise, NGO, Government, and Enterprise sectors. The company leverages its global network platform to provide fully connected systems that harness technologies and applications to transform what remote operations can achieve. With the world's most comprehensive network, Speedcast enables faster, seamless pole-to-pole coverage from a global hybrid satellite, fiber, cellular, microwave, MPLS, and IP transport network with direct access to public cloud platforms. With a passionate customer focus and a strong safety culture, Speedcast serves more than 3,200 customers in over 140 countries. Learn more at www.speedcast.com.

jobs.excerpt: The Centre for Information Resilience (CIR) is an independent organisation dedicated to exposing human rights violations and threats to democracy.
jobs.description:
The Centre for Information Resilience (CIR) is an independent organisation dedicated to exposing human rights violations and threats to democracy. We achieve this through open-source research, digital investigations, capacity-building with local partners, and collaboration with media to amplify our impact.

CIR was born out of a determination to expose those spreading harm – online and offline – around the world, particularly in areas of violent conflict, such as Ukraine, Sudan and Myanmar. Our projects are at the forefront of efforts to investigate and document human rights abuses, war crimes, harms targeting women and minorities, and influence operations. We work closely with multilateral and national justice accountability bodies.

We're always looking to connect with experienced investigators who specialise in collecting, analysing, and interpreting open-source data to generate actionable intelligence. Whether you're currently working in the private sector, law enforcement, journalism, or national security, we want to hear from you.

Role details

The role:

The Open-Source Data Collection and Verification Analyst will work in a team dedicated to investigating war crimes and human rights abuses associated with the conflict in Ukraine. They will focus on systematic collection, verification, and archiving of open-source material related to the war in Ukraine. The analyst will contribute to and maintain structured evidence datasets drawn from social media, messaging platforms, and other open sources, supporting large‑scale databases that underpin investigations, reporting, and public-facing mapping products.

Contract Type: Contractor x 2

Contract duration: ASAPUntil 31 March 2027

Hours needed for this role:  Full time.

Languages: You must be able to speak and write English. Ukrainian and/or Russian language proficiency desirable.

Location: Remote. The candidate may make use of CIR’s office premises in Westminster, London or Kyiv, Ukraine.

Closing date: Wednesday 27th October at 23:55pm.

Requirements

Main Responsibilities

  • Collect, verify, and archive large volumes of open-source material, including social media posts, messaging platform content (e.g. Telegram), videos, images, satellite imagery, and other digital data related to the Ukraine conflict.
  • Apply OSINT verification techniques, including geolocation, chronolocation, metadata analysis, and source evaluation, to ensure collected material meets relevant evidentiary, analytical, and quality standards.
  • Structure, tag, and catalogue open-source material within evidence databases to support efficient retrieval, analysis, and long‑term preservation.
  • Collaborate closely with investigators, analysts, and CIR’s Data and Technology Team to ensure collected material supports investigative, legal, and public reporting needs.
  • Deliver training and mentoring to colleagues and partners on best practices for open-source evidence collection, verification, and archiving.
  • Uphold CIR’s standards for ethical, safe, and secure investigative practice, ensuring compliance with organisational policies and safeguarding requirements, including risk mitigation and responsible handling of sensitive or graphic content.

Essential Criteria:

  • Demonstrable prior experience of OSINT collection, verification, and archiving.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical terminology for lay audiences and to support clear, concise and timely reporting.

Desirable Criteria:

  • Prior experience of digital evidence handling, assessment, or e-discovery practices.
  • Prior experience of delivering training, skill-sharing, or capacity-building, particularly in OSINT contexts.
  • Working proficiency in Ukrainian and/or Russian languages.

Recruitment Process

To apply, please submit your CV and complete the application form questions. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview, which can be conducted remotely unless specified otherwise. CIR encourages applicants from under-represented communities.

CIR is an equal opportunities employer. If you require adjustments or additional support to complete this process, please let us know in your application.

About the role
Spektra Systems runs four product brands (CloudLabs, CSP Control Center, SaaSify, CloudEvents) plus the parent company site at spektrasystems.com. Each one has its own audience, voice, and pricing motion — labs platform for ISVs and educators, CSP control plane for cloud distributors, SaaS-platform tooling for software vendors, events platform for hackathon hosts.
You own the marketing surface across all of them. Most execution happens through AI coding agents — Claude Code, Cursor, GPT, whatever works. What you bring isn’t typing. It’s taste, brand discipline, and the architectural judgment to know when to trust the agent, when to push back, and when to throw it out and start over.
This isn’t a “prompt engineer” job. It isn’t a “frontend dev who uses Copilot sometimes” job either. It’s a hybrid: you direct AI agents to do the bulk of implementation, you review ruthlessly, and you own the outcome — across five distinct brands.

What you’ll do
  • Ship marketing pages, landing pages, and microsites across all five Spektra properties using Claude Code (or equivalent) as your primary execution engine. You iterate via screenshots, browser inspection, and tight critique loops — not line-by-line typing.
  • Hold each brand’s voice and visual identity distinct — CloudLabs is opinionated and transparent (publishes pricing competitors hide); CSP Control Center is procurement-focused and technical; SaaSify is partner-channel-led; CloudEvents is energetic and event-driven; Spektra Systems is the trust-and-compliance parent. You can rewrite any AI-generated copy so it sounds like the right one.

  • Own SEO end-to-end across every site: canonical URLs, redirects, structured data, internal linking, top-traffic-URL protection through migrations. You spot when the agent silently breaks SEO and you recover before it ships.

  • Run competitive research and translate findings into design and content choices that fit each brand — not just bullet points.
  • Decide when to share components across brands and when to keep them separate. Build a shared design-system foundation where it accelerates work, fork where each brand’s identity demands it.
  • Push back on AI output when it’s wrong. The agent will produce visually generic, brand-violating, SEO-broken, or copy-bloated work confidently. Your job is to catch it before merge.

  • Run competitive research and translate findings into design and content choices that fit each brand — not just bullet points.
  • Decide when to share components across brands and when to keep them separate. Build a shared design-system foundation where it accelerates work, fork where each brand’s identity demands it.
  • Push back on AI output when it’s wrong. The agent will produce visually generic, brand-violating, SEO-broken, or copy-bloated work confidently. Your job is to catch it before merge.

What we’re looking for
  • AI fluency. You’ve shipped real production work with Claude Code, Cursor, or similar. You know which model to reach for, when to start fresh vs. continue a session, when to spawn a sub-agent, and how to give an agent the context it actually needs (paths, line numbers, prior-art file references — not vibes).
  • Design taste. You know that monochromatic isn’t always bad and that color variety isn’t always good. You don’t confuse“looks like a generic SaaS template”with“shipped.”
  • Multi-brand judgment. You can hold five distinct voices in your head and switch fluently between them. You don’t homogenize everything to the same template.
  • Frontend chops. Astro, Next, React, Tailwind v4, modern build tooling, OKLCH color, dark/light theming. You read code fluently even when you didn’t type it. You knowgit.
  • SEO depth. You know what a canonical loop is and why it hurts. You know when a 301 is right and when it isn’t. You’ve broken SEO and recovered from it
  • Bias to ship. You’d rather merge an iteration today than perfect tomorrow.
  • Comfortable with brutal feedback loops. Most of what you build will get critiqued and reworked. You don’t take it personally; you take it as signal.

What we don’t care about
  • Years of experience. Show us output.
  • Whether you “can also code without AI.” Obviously you can. That’s not the point.

jobs.description:
Senior Sales Executive Position Summary

The Senior Account Executive owns two motions simultaneously: converting inbound leads into new customers and expanding revenue with current customers who raise their hand, grow their business (providers, locations, claim volume), or are routed to sales when Support surfaces an opportunity. On the acquisition side, this means responding to inbound interest fast, running a consultative discovery process, and carrying deals from first contact through a signed agreement. On the expansion side, it means understanding what each practice has today, identifying where DentalXChange products and services can solve real problems, and executing cross-selling and upselling conversations with the same rigor applied to net-new business.

This is a full-cycle sale role. The Senior Account Executive manages their own pipeline, owns their forecast, and is accountable for both new logo attainment and expansion revenue from current customers.

Why does this role matter?

This role, like all frontline sales positions at DXC, is vital to not only increase our market share with net new customers, but to also ensure all customers are taking full advantage of our suite of intelligent tools to both maximize the success of their practice or practices, but also to ensure revenue growth and stickiness for DXC in order for us to meet our monthly, quarterly, and yearly revenue and growth goals.

What impact will the new hire have in their first 6 months?

The impact this hire has the potential to make in their first 6 months is very large. The time from when a new sales associate starts to when they can effectively communicate the value proposition and manage a pipeline resulting in consistent wins is typically a long one. The faster this new hire can get up to speed and proficient in navigating their sales conversations with confidence, the faster they can contribute to the overall sales number. Additionally, the speed and effectiveness that they display has the potential to raise the bar for the rest of the team and show what is possible when we approach our role with a new perspective and optimistic vigor. A rising tide lifts all boats after all.

What's the growth trajectory for this position?

This position may be an entry level position within the DXC sales organization but should not be viewed as entry level for sales work in general. Effective new hires have the ability to grow and take on larger customers, more complex sales motions, and eventually transition into enterprise level sales or account management roles. The expectation is that a new sales associate must be in seat and carrying a quota for 12 months before being eligible for promotion to the next level or to transition to another role or department.

What You'll Be Doing As Our Senior Sales Executive

Inbound Lead Management and New Business Acquisition

• Respond to inbound leads within a defined SLA window; prioritize speed without sacrificing personalization.
• Conduct structured discovery calls to understand each practice’s workflows, pain points, and goals before presenting a solution.
• Tailor product demonstrations to the specific operational context of each prospect, not a generic deck run.
• Manage all active opportunities in Salesforce with accurate stage, close date, and next step documentation.
• Own the full sales cycle from first contact through contract execution, working with internal stakeholders as needed to remove blockers.
• Build relationships with dental consultants, DSO administrators, and practice advocates who can surface and influence buying decisions.

Cross-Sell and Upsell with Current Customers

• Engage current customers handed to sales because they raised their hand, are growing or were flagged by Support as a sales opportunity.
• Identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities based on practice size, claim volume, and gaps in their current DXC product footprint.
• Execute expansion conversations with the same preparation and follow-through applied to new business, not as an afterthought.
• Coordinate with Client Success on accounts that need support before an expansion motion makes sense.
• Track and report on expansion revenue alongside new logo metrics as part of regular forecasting.

Pipeline Management and Forecasting

• Maintain an accurate, up-to-date pipeline always; CRM hygiene is not optional.
• Participate in weekly pipeline reviews with clear visibility into deal stage, risk, and expected close.
• Submit weekly and monthly forecasts with confidence levels and supporting rationale.
• Flag deal risks early rather than holding them until close week.

Other Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

• Consistently meet company and department policies and expectations including those surrounding attendance.
• Comply with all federal, state, accreditation and institutional policies and procedures.
• Maintain confidentiality standards and expectations.
• Exhibit exceptional internal and external customer service with all individuals.

• Live DentalXChange’s company values: Actively Care, Try Hard, Be Humble, and Feedback is a Gift.

• Other duties as assigned.

What You'll Bring To The Team As Our Senior Sales Executive

• Associate degree or 2 years of related experience preferred.
• Minimum 2 years of B2B sales experience; SaaS or health-tech background a plus.

jobs.title: Chief Development Officer
jobs.excerpt: At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure.
jobs.description:
At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. Backed by decades of experience in design, construction, and operations, we don’t just build, we execute with purpose.

Our Values

  • Client First Alignment: We align every solution to our clients’ goals.
  • Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency and precision.
  • Operational Excellence: Decades of experience drive our high standards.
  • Safety & Integrity: Safety is non-negotiable. We lead with integrity and transparency.
  • Ownership Mentality: We think like owners, because we are.

Position Overview:

The Chief Development Officer (CDevO) is responsible for leading Montera's development organization and overseeing the front end of the hyperscale data center development lifecycle as the company expands its national development platform.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and serving as a member of the executive leadership team, this role will own development strategy, market and site selection, land acquisition and control, utility and power strategy, technical due diligence, entitlement, permitting, and overall development readiness through handoff to the delivery organization.

The ideal candidate brings extensive experience developing large-scale data center or other complex infrastructure projects, deep expertise in powered-land development, and a strong understanding of the technical, commercial, and regulatory factors that influence project feasibility. Success in this role means building a scalable development organization, identifying and mitigating risk early in the development lifecycle, and consistently advancing projects from initial opportunity through construction readiness.

This is a hands-on executive leadership opportunity for someone who enjoys building teams and processes while remaining directly involved in high-value development projects and strategic decisions.

Key Responsibilities and Deliverables:

Development Strategy & Market Selection

  • Lead Montera's overall development strategy and powered-land pipeline, identifying and prioritizing target markets based on power availability, customer demand, infrastructure, economics, and execution risk.
  • Develop and execute strategies for expanding Montera's development portfolio while aligning opportunities with customer requirements and long-term business objectives.
  • Establish repeatable processes and evaluation frameworks for moving opportunities from initial market screening through development and construction readiness.
  • Champion a data-driven approach to market selection, site prioritization, and development risk assessment.
  • Partner with executive leadership to evaluate potential development opportunities, capital commitments, and strategic investment decisions.

Site Origination, Land Acquisition & Development

  • Oversee site origination, evaluation, acquisition, and land-control activities across target markets.
  • Lead negotiations and development strategies involving landowners, brokers, developers, and other commercial stakeholders.
  • Oversee land transactions, purchase and sale agreements, options, easements, title matters, and development agreements.
  • Evaluate site constraints, infrastructure availability, development costs, and execution requirements before committing significant capital.
  • Establish and maintain senior relationships with landowners, brokers, municipalities, developers, and other stakeholders critical to successful site development.

Power Strategy, Utilities & Infrastructure

  • Lead utility engagement, load requests, interconnection strategy, and energization planning for new and existing development opportunities.
  • Evaluate power availability, utility capacity, grid constraints, energization timelines, financial requirements, and potential curtailment exposure.
  • Develop relationships with utilities, transmission providers, and other infrastructure stakeholders to support reliable and timely power delivery.
  • Oversee the evaluation of utility infrastructure requirements, commercial arrangements, and associated development risks.
  • Ensure that power availability, infrastructure readiness, and energization schedules are integrated into site selection and development decision-making.

Technical Due Diligence & Development Readiness

  • Own the full site due diligence process across environmental, geotechnical, civil, survey, title, water, wastewater, telecommunications, power, and related disciplines.
  • Ensure development risks, constraints, costs, schedules, and technical requirements are fully understood before significant capital commitments.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Technology, and Delivery teams to ensure development sites meet customer specifications and technical requirements.
  • Oversee development-stage design coordination, constructability reviews, budget considerations, and schedule risk assessments.
  • Ensure fiber connectivity and telecommunications infrastructure requirements are incorporated into site planning and technical evaluations.
  • Maintain executive accountability for the technical and commercial readiness of development sites before transitioning projects to the delivery organization.
  • Establish clear development-to-delivery handoff standards, ensuring project risks, commitments, budgets, schedules, and outstanding requirements are documented and communicated.

Entitlements, Permitting & Community Engagement

  • Lead land-use strategy, zoning, rezoning, annexation, parcelization, easements, entitlement, and development permitting activities.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with municipalities, counties, regulatory authorities, and authorities having jurisdiction.
  • Oversee permitting strategies and regulatory approvals to support project schedules and construction readiness.
  • Lead site-level community engagement and government affairs strategies to support successful project development.
  • Incorporate sustainability considerations, including energy, water, emissions, waste, land use, and biodiversity, into development planning and decision-making.
  • Identify and mitigate regulatory, political, community, and environmental risks that could affect development timelines or project feasibility.

Organizational Leadership, Reporting & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Build and scale Montera's Development organization as the project portfolio grows, recruiting and developing a high-performing multidisciplinary team.
  • Establish clear accountability, performance expectations, reporting standards, and operating rhythms across the development function.
  • Provide executive leadership with consistent visibility into development pipeline status, project risk, schedules, capital requirements, and key decisions.
  • Collaborate with Delivery, Engineering, Product, Technology, Finance, and Commercial teams to align development activities with broader company objectives.
  • Support customer and leasing discussions as Montera's senior authority on development strategy, project feasibility, and site readiness.
  • Develop scalable development processes, governance frameworks, and decision-making tools that support disciplined execution as the organization expands.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, speed, and operational excellence within the development organization.

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Real Estate Development, Business, Planning, Energy, or a related discipline.
  • 15+ years of experience in data center development, large-scale infrastructure, energy, real estate development, or comparable environments.
  • Significant leadership experience overseeing a development function, multidisciplinary team, or major development portfolio.
  • Demonstrated experience taking large-scale development opportunities from site origination through land control, due diligence, entitlement, power/interconnection, permitting, and construction handoff.
  • Deep understanding of utility engagement, power availability, interconnection processes, energization schedules, and related commercial considerations.
  • Strong experience managing land transactions, purchase and sale agreements, options, easements, title matters, and development agreements.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary technical diligence and translating findings into commercial, investment, and development decisions.
  • Strong understanding of zoning, entitlement, permitting, regulatory approvals, and community engagement.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex development risks across power, infrastructure, environmental, technical, commercial, and regulatory disciplines.
  • Experience building and scaling teams, processes, and organizational capabilities within a high-growth environment.
  • Ability to work effectively with utilities, government officials, landowners, consultants, customers, investors, and executive leadership.
  • Strong commercial judgment, executive presence, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout the United States to support development activities and strategic business needs.

Preferred Skills:

  • Direct experience leading hyperscale data center development or other large-load infrastructure projects.
  • Experience building and managing a national or multi-market powered-land development pipeline.
  • Established relationships with utilities, landowners, municipalities, developers, and infrastructure stakeholders across key U.S. markets.
  • Experience evaluating large-scale power and infrastructure requirements, including utility capacity constraints, interconnection strategies, and energization risks.
  • Familiarity with data center design requirements, fiber connectivity, site infrastructure planning, and construction readiness considerations.
  • Experience managing community engagement, government affairs, and sustainability considerations for complex infrastructure projects.
  • Ability to leverage data, market intelligence, and decision-support tools to evaluate development opportunities and prioritize investments.
  • Experience establishing development processes, reporting frameworks, and governance standards within a growing organization.
  • A hands-on leadership style that combines executive-level strategy with detailed project execution.
  • Ability to operate independently, take ownership of ambiguous problems, and collaborate effectively in a founder-led, high-growth environment.

Work Environment & Physical Demands:

  • Remote Work: Montera operates as a remote-first company. Employees are expected to maintain a professional, reliable remote work setup and appropriate availability during working hours.
  • Travel Requirements: Regular domestic travel is required for site visits, utility and stakeholder meetings, development activities, and company leadership sessions.
  • Physical Demands: This role involves standard office and computer-based work, participation in virtual and in-person meetings, and periodic visits to active development and construction sites, which may involve walking on uneven terrain and working in outdoor environments.
  • Montera will provide reasonable accommodations to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role, consistent with applicable law.

Benefits

Why Join Montera?

At Montera, you'll shape the next generation of digital infrastructure while being supported by a team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term partnership. We're a remote-first company that empowers our people with flexibility, ownership, and meaningful rewards.

This position offers the opportunity to build and lead the development function within a rapidly growing hyperscale data center platform. Rather than overseeing a narrow segment of the development lifecycle within a large organization, you'll work directly with the CEO and executive leadership team to shape Montera's development strategy, establish a national powered-land pipeline, and advance complex infrastructure projects from initial market identification through construction readiness.

As Chief Development Officer, you'll have meaningful influence over the company's long-term growth strategy, development investments, organizational capabilities, and execution standards.

Compensation:

At Montera, we believe great work starts with investing in great people. That is why we offer a competitive and thoughtful total compensation package designed to recognize the value each team member brings.

Our compensation ranges are informed by market data and aligned to job level and role. When making hiring and compensation decisions, we consider a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, training, competencies, and overall business needs.

The reasonable compensation range for this executive role is commensurate with experience and will be discussed during the interview process.

Our Benefits at a Glance:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: We pay 90% of health premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Generous Time Off: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off per year, which includes holidays, PTO, and sick time.
  • Parental Leave: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off after 6 months of employment.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) plan with immediate eligibility, no vesting requirement, and employer match contributions up to 6%.
  • Learning & Development Reimbursement: Up to $3,500 reimbursed annually for approved courses, certifications, conferences, and professional development opportunities.
  • Extra Support: Remote work stipend to help you stay connected.

At Montera, you'll have the autonomy to do great work and the benefits to thrive personally and professionally.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Salesforce Platform Strategy & Delivery
jobs.excerpt: Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation.
jobs.description:
Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.

What We Need

NetBrain is seeking a hands-on Senior Manager of Salesforce Platform Strategy and Delivery to lead the operating model, roadmap, governance, and day-to-day delivery of its Salesforce platform. This is not a position for someone who intends to operate primarily through delegation. The director will work directly in the details of intake, triage, requirements, solution design, backlog management, QA, user acceptance testing, releases, deployments, documentation, and production support. The successful candidate will combine platform leadership with the willingness and technical ability to help the team execute.

Salesforce is central to NetBrain’s commercial and operational processes. The environment supports a mature and highly integrated business, with substantial demand from Sales, Customer Success, Support, Finance, Partners, and other business functions. The incoming director will bring structure to a significant backlog while balancing current business needs, platform reliability, technical-debt remediation, and major transformation initiatives.

The position will work closely with NetBrain’s existing Salesforce platform manager and developer, planned additional engineering capacity, business stakeholders, and external advisors. The director will be accountable for creating a sustainable Salesforce operating model and ensuring that the team works on the highest-value priorities in the appropriate sequence.

What You'll Do

Platform strategy and roadmap

  • Own and maintain the Salesforce platform roadmap.
  • Translate business strategy into sequenced platform initiatives, releases, and measurable outcomes.
  • Balance capacity across business transformation, business-as-usual support, platform reliability, and technical-debt remediation.
  • Incorporate relevant recommendations from platform assessments and external advisors.
  • Present priority, capacity, dependency, and risk trade-offs to leadership.
  • Ensure that urgent requests do not continuously displace strategically necessary work.

Intake, triage, and backlog management

  • Own how Salesforce work enters, moves through, and leaves the team.
  • Personally participate in request triage, requirements clarification, scope definition, and effort assessment.
  • Distinguish incidents, minor enhancements, major projects, maintenance, and architectural remediation.
  • Establish practical prioritization criteria based on business value, urgency, effort, risk, and dependencies.
  • Maintain an actionable backlog with clear ownership, acceptance criteria, target releases, and status.
  • Push back constructively when requests are incomplete, duplicative, unscalable, or lower priority.
  • Prevent informal messages and executive requests from bypassing the agreed operating process.

Hands-on platform delivery

  • Work directly with administrators, developers, and business stakeholders to move priority work forward.
  • Assist with Salesforce configuration, Flow, troubleshooting, data analysis, security, permissions, and operational support as needed.
  • Evaluate technical designs and identify downstream effects across automation, data, integrations, CPQ, and user experience.
  • Review Apex and integration solutions sufficiently to assess maintainability, testing, security, and operational risk.
  • Step into release preparation, deployment coordination, defect resolution, and production validation.
  • Contribute directly when the team needs help rather than limiting the role to status reporting and delegation.

QA, UAT, releases, and deployments

  • Establish a predictable release calendar and release-readiness process.
  • Define acceptance criteria before development begins.
  • Coordinate functional, technical, integration, regression, and business-user testing.
  • Ensure that developers are not solely responsible for validating their own work.
  • Manage UAT planning, stakeholder participation, defect resolution, and business signoff.
  • Lead go/no-go decisions, deployment planning, rollback preparation, and post-release validation.
  • Improve sandbox, environment, source-control, and deployment practices.
  • Create visibility into work waiting for testing, approval, deployment, or remediation.

Architecture and technical governance

  • Establish practical standards for when to use standard configuration, Flow, Apex, managed packages, middleware, or external services.
  • Partner with technical team members to remediate legacy automation and reduce platform technical debt.
  • Review integrations for scalability, supportability, security, data ownership, and business value.
  • Participate in technology evaluations before new systems are selected or procured.
  • Guide build-versus-buy decisions and evaluate the downstream effect of new platforms on Salesforce.
  • Maintain appropriate internal ownership when external consultants or implementation partners are engaged.

CPQ and commercial transformation

  • Support changes to products, pricing, approvals, quoting, contracting, renewals, and related sales workflows.
  • Help govern the evaluation and potential implementation of a future CPQ or Revenue Cloud solution.
  • Coordinate business requirements, architecture decisions, partner selection, testing, migration, and adoption.
  • Ensure that CPQ transformation aligns with NetBrain’s broader SaaS commercial model and Salesforce roadmap.

Documentation and knowledge management

  • Establish a shared, searchable, and maintainable source of truth for the Salesforce platform.
  • Require current documentation for architecture, integrations, automation, releases, operating procedures, and key business logic.
  • Create standards for technical design decisions, ownership, backup ownership, and knowledge transfer.
  • Reduce dependency on information held by a single employee.
  • Ensure documentation is incorporated into delivery rather than treated as optional follow-up work.

Team and stakeholder leadership

  • Lead the day-to-day Salesforce operating model across functional and technical contributors.
  • Clarify decision rights, responsibilities, handoffs, and escalation paths.
  • Create productive partnership among Salesforce, Sales Operations, Customer Success, Support, Finance, Partners, IT, and leadership.
  • Protect the team from uncontrolled demand while maintaining a responsive service orientation.
  • Coach team members and create clear accountability without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Communicate platform performance, delivery progress, constraints, and risk to Chief Customer Officer and other leaders.

What You Bring

  • Substantial experience leading and working hands-on within mature Salesforce environments.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a Salesforce roadmap, backlog, release process, or platform operating model.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Sales Cloud and Salesforce platform administration.
  • Experience gathering requirements and translating business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Experience with intake, prioritization, QA, UAT, release management, and deployments.
  • Ability to work across configuration, Flow, data, security, integrations, and technical design.
  • Sufficient Apex literacy to review solutions, evaluate risk, and collaborate credibly with developers.
  • Experience supporting complex integrations and cross-functional business processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to challenge requests, resolve competing priorities, and communicate trade-offs to senior leaders.
  • Strong documentation, process-design, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Willingness to remain hands-on while leading the team and platform.
  • Manual Dexterity: Repetitive motion of wrists, hands and fingers for using a computer.
  • Stationary Tasks: Sitting for extended periods, remaining in a stationary position.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Salesforce CPQ, Revenue Cloud, or another complex quote-to-cash transformation.
  • Experience supporting a SaaS or enterprise software company.
  • Experience with Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Agentforce, AI-assisted workflows, or MCP-based integrations.
  • Experience with Salesforce DevOps, source control, automated testing, and structured release pipelines.
  • Experience remediating Workflow Rules, Process Builder, legacy Flow, or accumulated platform technical debt.
  • Experience evaluating managed packages, integration tools, and implementation partners.
  • Experience operating in a fast-changing, private-equity-backed, or post-investment environment.
  • Relevant Salesforce certifications. Certifications are useful but will not substitute for demonstrated delivery and leadership.

What We Offer

Our comprehensive compensation package is vital in how we recognize our people for the impact they make on us reaching our goals as a company.

For this role, the estimated base is $160,000 - $180,000 + Bonus. The actual salary may vary based on a range of factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

The range listed above is a guideline and may be modified. People Experience offers a comprehensive benefits package in addition to cash compensation that includes but is not limited to 401k and medical/dental coverage. Speak with your Recruiter for more details on our Total Rewards philosophy.

jobs.title: QA and UAT Tester
jobs.excerpt: The QA and UAT Tester is responsible for ensuring that software releases meet functional, quality, and business acceptance requirements before reaching production, through rigorous manual and UAT testing.
jobs.description:
The QA and UAT Tester is responsible for ensuring that software releases meet functional, quality, and business acceptance requirements before reaching production, through rigorous manual and UAT testing. This is a defined growth role: the successful candidate is expected to progressively build test automation skills and contribute an increasing share of automated coverage over time, supported by structured training and mentorship, with a clear path toward a Test Automation Engineer profile as capability develops.

Test Planning & Case Design

  • Writes clear, traceable test cases and scripts from requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

  • Maintains an organised, up-to-date test case repository aligned to current functionality.

  • Ensures test coverage maps back to requirements and identifies gaps before test execution begins.

  • Participates in requirement/acceptance-criteria reviews to raise testability concerns early.

Manual & UAT Test Execution

  • Executes functional, regression, and end-to-end test cycles according to the test plan.

  • Plans and coordinates UAT cycles with business stakeholders, including scheduling, scripts, and sign-off.

  • Documents test results, evidence, and outcomes clearly for audit and traceability.

  • Flags scope, environment, or data issues that put a test cycle at risk.

Defect Management & Reporting

  • Logs defects with clear reproduction steps, evidence, severity, and priority.

  • Tracks defects through to resolution and retests fixes before closure.

  • Maintains accurate defect status and communicates blockers or high-risk defects promptly.

  • Analyses defect trends to identify recurring problem areas.

Quality Gate & Release Readiness

  • Contributes to and upholds the team's Definition of Done and quality gate criteria.

  • Provides a clear go/no-go quality recommendation ahead of each release.

  • Escalates quality risks early rather than allowing them to surface at release time.

  • Maintains release-level test summary documentation for audit and stakeholder visibility.

Test Automation Skill-Building & Contribution

  • Actively develops automation skills through training, mentorship, and hands-on practice as part of an agreed development plan.

  • Contributes to and maintains automated test scripts for repetitive regression scenarios, with support from senior team members.

  • Progressively takes on greater ownership of automation as competence grows, moving from assisted to independent contribution.

  • Shares learnings and automation progress with the wider QA and development team.

Collaboration with Development & Product

  • Works closely with developers, Business Analysts, and the Product Owner to clarify requirements and acceptance criteria.

  • Participates in sprint planning, refinement, and review to provide a quality perspective early ("shift-left" testing).

  • Pairs with developers to understand root causes of defects and prevent recurrence.

  • Provides constructive, timely feedback on testability and edge cases during design and development.

Continuous Improvement & Documentation

  • Identifies and proposes improvements to test processes, templates, and tooling.

  • Maintains clear, current test documentation and a shared testing knowledge base.

  • Actively participates in retrospectives and follows through on agreed improvement actions.

  • Stays current with testing best practice and emerging automation tools/techniques.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • ISTQB Foundation Certification (or equivalent testing certification) is advantageous.

  • 1-3 years' experience in manual and/or User Acceptance Testing (UAT) within a software development environment.

  • Experience writing clear, traceable test cases and test scripts from requirements and acceptance criteria.

  • Experience executing functional, regression, and UAT test cycles and documenting results.

  • Experience logging, tracking, and retesting defects using a defect-tracking tool (e.g. Jira, Azure DevOps, Zephyr, Xray).

  • Working understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile/Scrum ways of working.

  • Basic SQL skills for data validation and test-data setup.

jobs.excerpt: POSITION SUMMARYThe IT Systems & Security Support Analyst – Tier III provides advanced technical support and operational administration for enterprise technology systems, network infrastructure, Microsoft environments, identity and access management, backup and recovery solutions, and business-critical applications.
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The IT Systems & Security Support Analyst – Tier III provides advanced technical support and operational administration for enterprise technology systems, network infrastructure, Microsoft environments, identity and access management, backup and recovery solutions, and business-critical applications. This role serves as the highest level of internal technical support, resolving complex issues, performing root-cause analysis, and ensuring the reliability, security, and continuity of IT services.

The position also supports Microsoft SQL Server environments and database-dependent applications by monitoring system health, troubleshooting connectivity issues, supporting backup and recovery processes, and performing approved maintenance activities. Advanced database administration, architecture, and performance optimization responsibilities are escalated to the Director of Information Technology or designated specialists.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Advanced Technical Support

  • Provide Tier III support for endpoints, infrastructure systems, network services, identity management, and enterprise applications.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware, operating system, software, authentication, connectivity, and performance issues.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and recommend corrective actions to prevent recurring problems.
  • Support employee onboarding, offboarding, device deployment, account provisioning, and access management.
  • Administer approved privileged-access controls, including local administrator permissions and Windows LAPS.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge-base articles.
  • Provide guidance and escalation support to Tier I and Tier II support personnel.

Network & Infrastructure Support

  • Monitor and support network infrastructure, including switches, wireless networks, firewalls, VPN services, DNS, DHCP, and internet connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot network performance, routing, switching, authentication, and connectivity issues.
  • Implement approved configuration changes and assist with service restoration during outages.
  • Coordinate issue resolution with vendors, service providers, and technology partners.
  • Escalate significant infrastructure, architectural, or security concerns as required.

Backup, Recovery & Business Continuity

  • Administer and monitor enterprise backup and recovery solutions.
  • Review backup jobs, alerts, retention policies, and system health to ensure successful operations.
  • Investigate failures and perform approved restoration and recovery activities.
  • Conduct periodic recovery testing and maintain disaster recovery documentation.
  • Support business continuity initiatives and escalate potential data loss or recovery risks.

Database and Application Support

  • Support Microsoft SQL Server environments and database-dependent applications.
  • Monitor database availability, backups, scheduled jobs, and overall system health.
  • Troubleshoot authentication, permissions, connectivity, and application integration issues.
  • Assist with approved maintenance, patching, backup, restoration, and testing activities.
  • Maintain documentation related to SQL environments, service accounts, dependencies, and recovery procedures.
  • Escalate advanced database administration, tuning, design, and data integrity concerns.

Security, Compliance & Documentation

  • Implement and support approved security controls and best practices.
  • Monitor for vulnerabilities, unauthorized access, and control deficiencies and report findings appropriately.
  • Participate in audits, compliance reviews, risk assessments, and security investigations.
  • Assist with remediation efforts affecting endpoints, infrastructure, identity systems, and backup environments.
  • Maintain accurate records of system configurations, changes, incidents, and operational procedures to support continuity and knowledge transfer.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Networking, or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
  • Three to five years of progressively responsible IT support and systems administration experience, or infrastructure support.
  • Demonstrated experience providing advanced technical support within Microsoft-based environments.

KEY COMPENTCIES

  • Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong analytical and root-cause analysis capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Customer-focused service orientation.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and manage competing deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Technical Knowledge

  • Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows 11, endpoint management, and identity administration.
  • TCP/IP networking, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, switching, wireless networking, VPNs, and firewall technologies.
  • Enterprise backup and recovery platforms such as Veeam Backup & Replication or equivalent solutions.
  • Microsoft SQL Server, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), database connectivity, permissions management, and backup/recovery concepts.
  • Cybersecurity best practices, including multifactor authentication, privileged access management, encryption, and least-privilege principles.

Preferred Certifications

  • CompTIA Network+
  • CompTIA Security+
  • Microsoft Certifications

Typical Physical Demands and Working Conditions

  • Requires regular sitting, standing, bending, and use of computer equipment.
  • Requires normal hearing and visual acuity necessary to perform job duties.
  • Occasional lifting and movement of technology equipment may be required.

jobs.description:
Position Title: Technical Solution Architect

Location: Virtual, United States

Employment Type: Full-Time

Onsite, Remote/Flexible, or Hybrid: Remote

Department: Professional Services – Technology Services

Hiring Manager: Director, Technical Services

Travel: Minimal (Up to 5%)

Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, HSA, FSA, 401(K), life insurance, parental leave, and mental health resources all beginning on first day of employment. See Benefits section below for more details.

COMPANY SUMMARY:

Here at Aprimo, our mission is to empower the marketing organizations of today to build the brands of tomorrow. Aprimo is a pioneer of the marketing resource and digital asset management space, and we deliver an innovative, industry-leading SaaS solution that changes the way companies like AT&T, National Park Foundation, Laborie, and Bank of America work, create, collaborate, and learn in order to deliver exceptional brand experiences at scale.

Aprimo helps enterprises unleash the power of their content by providing a marketing automation software and digital asset management software that manages the behind-the-scenes activities involved in marketing. Our product allows companies to manage content planning, creation and distribution all in one place, store content and media in a shared repository, and receive in-depth insights into how content performs.

Founded in 1998, Aprimo has five offices internationally, including Chicago headquarters, and offers a flexible work-from-home/remote-work policy.

Named a Leader in Digital Asset Management (DAM) and Marketing Resource Management by Forrester and winner of the 2021 Tech Cares Award for our work with Aprimo HELPS, we build on the power of our people to make an impact both in our industry and in our communities.

POSITION SUMMARY:

As a Technical Solution Architect, you will work with our sales team, leadership team, technical team, and other internal stakeholders to understand the business challenges faced by our customers when needing to integrate with Aprimo, establish and define KPIs, and drive value using the Aprimo platform. You will help to advance integration maturity by providing guidance to customers and partners around common patterns, use cases, governance, and other best practices. You will work with the technology leadership and architecture teams to define how Aprimo’s platform will integrate across all the enterprise’s lines of business and products. You will own the estimating phase and support the creation of SOW and contracts. You will lead technical projects and guide a team of skilled technical and functional team members through all phases of project implementation.

WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

  • Designing transformational technical solutions using integration methodologies and working directly with customers to meet their business requirements in accordance with industry best practices
  • Partnering closely with Sales, Delivery Managers, Functional Solution Architects and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs
  • Assisting clients in consistently meeting/exceeding goals and metrics through established industry measurement criteria and best practices, and serving as a trusted advisor to the client and their partners
  • Leading and mentoring the development team on the project
  • Enforcing sound development practices and ensuring the quality delivery of enterprise solutions
  • Identifying and leading internal strategic initiatives to grow the consulting practice, as well as serving as an active contributor to the overall knowledge base and expertise of the community.
  • Working collaboratively and utilizing very strong communications skills, especially in teaching complex concepts, and creative, prescriptive thinking
  • Additional duties and ad-hoc projects as assigned

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS & WHY YOU’RE A GREAT FIT FOR THE ROLE:

  • The Essentials
    • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree, preferably in Computer Science
    • Advanced experience (5 to 10 years) with solutions design and delivery - you’ll have a proven track record of successful delivery on customer projects, preferably B2B enterprise implementations
    • Experience overseeing team members
    • Ability to understand complex enterprise requirements and craft tailored solutions using an Integration API based approach
    • Proven project management skills
    • Strong critical thinking skills, including ability to identify suboptimal processes
    • Detail-oriented individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies
    • Cutting edge innovator who continually studies new technologies and functionality and is involved in projects that push the capabilities of existing technologies.
    • Travel to client site approximately 5% but may be higher or lower based on the client engagement.
  • Additional Successful Qualities
    • Ability to be a Key innovator and problem solver, driving conversations with Enterprise Architects, CTOs/CIOs, and Business Stakeholders armed with best practices for Integration design, KPI measurement, Development Process, and Application Governance
    • A broad perspective on API and integration patterns, use cases, technologies, and trends
    • Excellent written, presentation and overall communication skills
    • Ability to carry a conversation with stakeholders, prospects, Senior members within an organization
    • Ability to demonstrate the value of Aprimo’s technology and offerings and align those to an enterprise’s needs
    • Ability to liaise with Sales team to drive deals
    • Past experiences leading enterprise-wide integration initiatives, giving you an understanding of the challenges accomplishing widespread organizational change and the hindsight to address them
    • Ability to advise and mentor diverse teams using influence and adaptive communication strategies
    • Ability to evaluate current Marketing tech stack to uncover technical needs and process gaps and, based on these discoveries, make recommendations for improvement with different lines of business while making use of the Aprimo platform and supporting applications
    • Comfortable multitasking across parallel work streams, juggling different roles and priorities in each
    • A strong willingness and comfort in diving into new situations, learning about new technologies quickly, and debating different approaches and points of view

APRIMO CULTURE & WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:

  • Aprimo offers a forward-thinking, progressive and employee-first culture that is based in both collaboration and flexibility with team members who are friendly, intelligent and enthusiastic people that are committed to the product and mission here at Aprimo.
    • With 5 offices worldwide and teams spread throughout the US, EMEA and Philippines, our multicultural teams work cross-departmentally and across continents and cultures towards a shared goal.
    • We offer a diverse environment that promotes DEI efforts, values multiple perspectives and fresh thinking and which includes Aprimo HELPS, an employee resource group (ERG) that is dedicated to giving back to our local communities
  • Through its relaxed environment, Aprimo embodies a more casual “Silicon Valley” atmosphere.
    • We have a casual dress code that allows employees to express themselves as individuals and which fosters a creative and free-thinking approach to problem solving and business solutions. And it also allows us to wear hoodies and shorts during internal meetings.
  • Unlimited PTO, flexible work schedules and all positions allowing for either entirely remote or hybrid working arrangements create a deeply rewarding work-life balance.
    • Our unlimited PTO encourages employees to take time off to un-plug, rest, and recharge.
    • With flexible work schedules, employees can attend to personal matters, such as stepping away to pick up their children from school or to get a much-needed haircut.
    • In a recent internal survey, 89% of staff cited work-life balance as being one of the most rewarding aspects of working at Aprimo!
  • Part of the key to our success is that team members are not only successful at collaboration and open communication, but that they are also given a great deal of autonomy and freedom in their own individual roles.
    • Our culture is not a micro-managing environment – rather, employees are encouraged to be self-starters, to voice new ideas, and to exercise ownership in their individual roles.
    • As such, individual team members can leave a lasting impact and footprint within the organization – in fact, our average employee tenure is 7.7 years.
  • Aprimo employs a “choose your own adventure” approach to career advancement.
    • Staff members are not siloed into roles and for many of our teams there is no set ladder that one needs to climb to achieve growth and promotion.
    • Rather, we emphasize an organic approach to career development in which employees can and do frequently transition into newly created roles within their own teams or transition into other departments based on their interests in exploring new skills and responsibilities.
    • For additional learning and development, we recently rolled out Udemy, which is an online learning platform that employees have access to and which features over 200,000 courses on a wide variety of business topics.
  • Ranked #1 in AI Metadata & Search by Forrester, Aprimo sits on the cutting-edge of technology and is paving new paths forward by incorporating AI (artificial intelligence) into our product offerings.
    • We offer generative AI in a secure environment built for brand safety and governance. Our AI-powered content operations platform, with industry leading digital asset management (DAM) software at its core, helps to optimize the creative process and improve the user experience with better search, recommendations, categorization and summarization.
    • Our AI empowers marketing teams to automate tasks, analyze data, and personalize content, ensuring scalability without sacrificing productivity.
    • AI automatically identifies asset characteristics and transforms them into words a human would search for. Translation, image alterations, personalization, and more are all streamlined by AI.
    • With our platform, marketers can efficiently produce a larger volume of content, engage customers on a personalized level, curate relevant materials, and make data-driven decisions to drive their content strategies forward.
    • Our AI offers up to 72% increase in discoverability and productivity, up to 61% reduction in production time, and up to 66% faster time to market.

APRIMO BENEFITS WE OFFER:

  • Target Compensation: Annual base salary target of $115,000 to $155,000 USD depending on job related knowledge, skills, and level of experience. This is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, or other law.
  • Competitive commissions structure
  • Competitive benefits coverage that begins on the first day of employment, and includes:
    • Medical benefits with low premiums and choice of two programs (PPO or High Deductible)
    • Dental benefits with choice of two programs (PPO or HMO)
    • Vision benefits program
    • Health savings account (HSA)
    • Flexible spending accounts (FSA) for medical care, dependent care, and commuter/transit benefits
    • 401(K) savings plan that matches the first 4% of compensation at 100%, and the next 2% at 50%
    • Basic life insurance covered at 100% and twice the base salary, with additional voluntary/optional coverage available
    • Disability insurance covered at 100% for 10 weeks for short term disability and covered at 50% for long term disability
    • For both biological and adoptive parents, maternity leave is paid at 100% for up to twelve weeks and paternity leave is paid at 100% for six weeks
    • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) that provides employees with mental health resources and therapy consulting

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be able to remain in stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods and performing sedentary work that primarily involves sitting/standing
  • Must be able to move about to accomplish tasks or moving from one worksite to another
  • Must be able to perform light physical work that includes lifting or moving objects up to 20 lbs. or medium work that includes moving objects up to 50 pounds on occasion
  • Must be able to communicate with others to exchange information, including conveying detailed or important spoken instructions to others accurately, loudly, or quickly
  • Must possess the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication at normal speaking levels
  • Must be able to repeat motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers (i.e., repeated typing, etc.)
  • The worker is required to have close visual awareness to perform an activity and to assess the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned, such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading.
  • This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, etc.

EEO STATEMENT:

Aprimo provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identification, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Aprimo complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.excerpt: About Reserv Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims.
jobs.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

As Director, Financial Operations, you will own the financial operations function that safeguards more than $1B in client loss funds across the U.S. and UK/Lloyd's markets. This is the senior-most operational leadership role for our loss fund function. You will set strategy, design the control environment, and own the relationships and outcomes that keep client money accurate, compliant, and trusted.

You will report to the VP, Claims Operations and lead the function through two pillars: Fund Operations & Reconciliation, led by a Manager who reports to you, and Governance. This role sits within Operations rather than Finance, so you will need to speak the language of finance fluently while keeping the function accountable to operational and client outcomes. You are the person the organization trusts to confirm that every dollar is where it should be, every control is working, and every regulatory obligation is met.

If you have the vision to build a governance framework that gives the business confidence in how client money is controlled, and the operational discipline to run it day in and day out, we invite you to join us.

Who you are

You are a builder and an operator. You can stand up a controls framework from first principles and still roll up your sleeves on a complex consolidated reconciliation. You think in systems, but you are accountable for individual transactions.

  • A leader of leaders who builds, coaches, and holds accountable a team that includes managers and senior analysts, not just individual contributors.
  • Fluent in both treasury/finance and claims operations, and able to translate between them.
  • Deeply versed in financial controls: segregation of duties, dual authorization, sign-off protocols, and audit readiness.
  • Comfortable owning banking and payment-partner relationships and acting as the financial decision-maker for the function.
  • Calm under regulatory and client pressure, and ready to be the escalation point when money is in question.
  • A strong communicator who can move between a claim specific nuance and high-level customer or oversight narratives.
  • Energized by ambiguity and scale. You want to design the structure, not inherit a finished one.

What we need

We need you to own the function end-to-end across leadership, controls, banking, regulatory, and technology.

Function Leadership & Strategy

  • Own the loss fund financial operations function across the U.S. and Lloyd's markets, covering multi-line, all LOBs, and $1B+ AUM.
  • Lead two pillars: directly manage the Manager who runs Fund Operations & Reconciliation, and lead the Risk & Compliance Governance pillar.
  • Set the operating model, staffing plan, and performance standards for the growing function.
  • Act as the primary financial escalation point for client disputes.

Controls & Governance

  • Design, document, and maintain the internal controls framework, including dual authorization policy, the segregation-of-duties (SOD) matrix, the monthly sign-off protocol, and the regulatory filing calendar.
  • Set and enforce authorization thresholds, and serve as a required approver on routine and large or unusual fund movements
  • Own the monthly consolidated reconciliation package and sign off on it by the defined deadline, ensuring exceptions are escalated immediately rather than held to month-end.

Banking, Treasury & Payments

  • Own & govern all loss fund banking and partner relationships.
  • Maintain oversight of liquidity and funding adequacy across all client programs.
  • Oversee U.S. trust account management and Lloyd's Premium Trust Fund (PTF) compliance.

Regulatory & Compliance

  • Own escheatment/unclaimed property obligations and 1099/W-9 vendor tax compliance through the Governance pillar.
  • Ensure audit readiness and serve as the senior point of accountability for internal and external audits.
  • Ensure compliance with state DOI regulations across all U.S. jurisdictions and with Lloyd's/FCA requirements, including trust deeds, reporting obligations, and bordereaux.

Technology & Continuous Improvement

  • Own all technology recommendations for the function.
  • Partner with Engineering & Product to build better internal & external client facing products to enhance user-experience
  • Collaborate with Data to enhance team reconciliation and reporting efficiency and to scale the function as the customer and program count grow.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in financial operations, treasury, or loss fund management, preferably within a TPA, carrier, or insurtech.
  • 3+ years leading leaders (managing managers or senior team leads), ideally across multiple time zones / continents.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a financial controls environment, including segregation of duties, authorization frameworks, reconciliation sign-off, and audit support.
  • Deep knowledge of loss fund mechanics, including U.S. trust accounts and Lloyd's Premium Trust Fund / delegated authority structures.
  • Strong command of GAAP accounting practices, U.S. state DOI regulations related to loss funds, and the UK Financial Conduct Authority framework.
  • Experience owning banking relationships and managing wire/EFT and payment-partner operations.
  • Proven ability to operate as a credible financial counterpart to senior leadership, product/engineering and data counterparts within an organization.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to convey complex financial and control information clearly to non-financial and executive stakeholders.
  • Advanced skills in Excel and business intelligence tools such as Looker or Tableau (SQL), plus experience with enterprise tooling such as the Microsoft 365 Suite.
  • Experience with claims management systems, particularly Snapsheet, is a plus (but not mandatory).

How this role differs from the Manager, Financial Operations

The Manager, Financial Operations leads the Fund Operations & Reconciliation pillar and reports to this Director. The Manager runs day-to-day reconciliation, payment auditing, and pillar-level reporting. The Director owns the entire function, including both pillars, the governance and controls framework, banking relationships, regulatory accountability, and technology strategy, and is the senior approver and escalation point above the Manager.

Director, Financial Operations

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

JOB SUMMARY:
