jobs.excerpt: The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.
jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Security Engineer, Network & Zero Trust, to own the network pillar of Sezzle's zero-trust program: every connection explicitly allowed, authenticated by service identity, and attributable after the fact — across our Kubernetes clusters, AWS accounts, and the paths between them.

You will take ownership of our network-policy program — default-deny micro-segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters — and carry the rest of the pillar forward with it: identity-aware service-to-service transport, per-application private access, flow-level visibility, and network configuration managed as reviewed code.

This is an engineering role: you will write the policies, the tooling, and the rollout automation yourself, and you will carry changes through other teams' services without breaking delivery. You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and detection and response, and with the platform and IAM teams on service identity — your network controls are what their work relies on, and your telemetry is what their detections run on.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows — flow analysis, policy generation from observed traffic, drift review — that let the team segment a large estate.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own east-west segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters: design the segmentation model, derive network policies from observed traffic, and keep every workload reachable only through explicitly allowed, identity-bound paths — a default that holds as the estate grows, not a one-time project.
  • Deliver identity-aware transport — design and roll out mutually authenticated, encrypted service-to-service connections (mTLS), so that authorization decisions rest on verified service identity.
  • Keep a live map of the network: VPC peerings, tunnels, cross-account links, and every public entry point — built from cloud APIs and reconciled continuously, so every path into production is known and justified.
  • Own segmentation of production and the cardholder-data environment: implement and enforce the CDE and high-trust-tier boundaries, review every peering and public exposure against them, and run segmentation testing with the security team.
  • Partner with IT on private access: evaluate and help deliver per-application access (ZTNA) for engineers and operators reaching production systems.
  • Own network telemetry: flow logs east-west and north-south, with enough identity on both ends that "who talked to what, when" is answerable in minutes — and feed it to our SIEM for the detection team.
  • Own cluster admission control and hold the line on drift: workload admission policy (pod security, image provenance, network policy), security groups and firewall rules declared in git, applied only through the IaC pipeline, with admission control at the gate and drift detected and reverted automatically.
  • Contain: build the levers that let us isolate a workload or segment quickly when detection flags lateral movement, and take part in incident response when the network is in play.
  • Participate in threat modeling and design reviews for anything that changes how traffic flows, and in the on-call rotation for the controls you own.

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of experience in security, network, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on ownership of network controls in cloud production environments.
  • Deep, practical Kubernetes networking knowledge: CNI, NetworkPolicy semantics, DNS, ingress/egress — and experience rolling segmentation out on live clusters without outages.
  • Strong AWS networking: VPCs, subnets, security groups, peering and Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, load balancers, flow logs.
  • Hands-on experience with mTLS and service-to-service authentication (service mesh, proxies, or CNI-level encryption).
  • Infrastructure as code as your default way of working — Terraform and Helm or equivalents, through merge requests and CI, across repositories you don't own.
  • Ability to write real code (Go, Python, or Bash) for tooling and automation, not only configuration.
  • Ability to investigate directly with packet captures, flow logs, and system-level data.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS network requirements — segmentation, scoping of the cardholder-data environment, segmentation testing.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Cilium / eBPF in production, including Hubble or equivalent flow observability.
  • mTLS at fleet scale, including certificate lifecycle — service mesh (e.g., Istio, Linkerd, Cilium service mesh) and workload identity standards such as SPIFFE/SPIRE.
  • You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — flow analysis, policy generation, drift review.
  • Experience evaluating or deploying ZTNA / identity-aware proxy products. ● Policy-as-code and admission control (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, conftest).
  • Experience with network detection — IDS/IPS, anomalous-flow and lateral-movement detection — and with containment during incidents.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 and with FFIEC-style examination expectations for network security. ● Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or other regulated environments.

About You:

  • You'd rather close a path than document it - an allow-list that exists in production beats a diagram of how the network should look.
  • You change other teams' systems without breaking them - you roll out in observe mode first, measure, and earn the right to enforce.
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.excerpt: Hello, potential future Oatly employee.  It’s us, the original oatmilk company that started in Sweden back 25 or so years ago and has since expanded to the U.
jobs.description:
Hello, potential future Oatly employee. It’s us, the original oatmilk company that started in Sweden back 25 or so years ago and has since expanded to the U.S., where we’ve continued growing at a rate such that we need more brilliant minds to come work with us to keep the momentum going and the oatmilk flowing.

Sustainability, health, and transparency are the core values that guide everything we do. Basically, we exist to help people live a healthier life without recklessly taxing the planet’s resources in the process, and to change the food system for the better. We drive that change through the power of oats and through a significant reduction in cow’s milk consumption. If any of this resonates with you, then maybe you’d like to work for Oatly, too. Now onto the formal stuff.

We are looking for a Manager, Category Management + Insights to join our team. This role will be responsible for building Oatly’s reputation as a best-in-class category and insights leader at all levels with our key customers.

Here are the things we want to hire you to do:

  • Collaborate with Sales teams on key account objectives and identify opportunities to educate customers about plant-based foods, our categories, and our brand

  • Build custom analyses using syndicated scan, consumer, and shopper card data, translating those insights into compelling presentations addressing each customer’s unique goals

  • Leverage data as a foundational springboard from which all recommendations are built

  • Be the functional expert on all syndicated data, including leading the optimization and development of Oatly insights reporting and scorecarding across the NA business unit

  • Develop a mastery of Oatly’s category, customer, consumer, and competitive performance that will inform our narrative and recommendations

  • Lead with a bias for the facts and demonstrate that Oatly’s category and insights leadership will help drive customer growth and profit

  • Question assumptions about major trends, validating or redefining those assumptions into new narratives both internally and externally

Here are the things we think you need:

  • Bachelor’s Degree Required

  • 6+ years of CPG experience, with an emphasis on Sales, Category Management, and Insights

  • Retailer-facing experience preferred

  • Demonstrated deep understanding and experience with Syndicated Data and platforms (Nielsen, Spins, IRI)

  • Experience with Panel and Shopper Card Data (e.g., Numerator, Stratum, Shopper360)

  • Expert knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint/presentation-building skills

  • Exceptional storytelling ability and presentation skills – be able to find and tell the compelling narrative that can be told through data

  • Passion for seeing the forest through the trees, how different pieces connect to the whole, and delivering insights that keep the big picture in mind

  • Ability to connect disparate data sources, interpret analysis results, and communicate analytical findings and business insights to diverse audiences

  • Naturally curious and self-motivated with the ability to embrace change and deliver results, managing multiple/diverse priorities

And here’s another list of qualities we think make a good Oatly team member:

  • You feel connected to our mission of encouraging health, sustainability, and transparency

  • You are a self-starter who doesn’t need direct supervision to motivate you for success – we believe strongly in building a culture of individual accountability and ownership and need partners that can embrace that mentality

  • You are ready to make your mark in a smaller, growing brand, leveraging your experience to deliver amazing results and build an outstanding company

  • You have an entrepreneurial spirit in that you’re comfortable with ambiguity and are energized by the process of building something lasting from the ground up

  • You enjoy sharing your quirkiness and talents with your coworkers

Another bulleted list felt a bit too…bullet-y. So we wrote this long, awkward sentence to let you know all the ways we sweeten the deal when you work with us, like flexible vacation (take it when you need it), really great benefits (yes, pet insurance is in there), paid volunteer days off throughout the year (doing good is fun), free six packs of...(drumroll)…oatmilk, and you’ll also get genuinely great coworkers who are rooting for each other and the company to thrive. Oh, one more short but very important sentence: We are nimble and agile (not chaotic) in how we work, and we’re grounded in a long company history dating way back to the last century.

The salary for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to geographic location, internal equity, experience, education, specialty, and training. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. Compensation may also include bonus, commission, or equity as applicable. Our good faith estimate for base salary is $120,000.

jobs.description:
DDC IT Services is seeking a Senior IBM z/OS Systems Programmer to join their growing team. The qualified individual will provide planning, which includes development of implementation and installation plans for IBM Mainframe projects. The implementation plan shall include: detailed steps and requirements to successfully implement OS’s, software or hardware upgrades, or installations to IBM System z/OS mainframe platform. 

***Position is contingent on contract award.***



Requirements:

  • Provide timelines and milestones required for implementation or upgrade of the IBM mainframe platform to meet government established project deadlines.
  • Use required software tools, including IBM System Modification Program/extended (SMP/e), IBM system utilities (including IEBGENER (generalized copy utility), IEBCOPY (utility to copy, compress, merge partitioned data sets), IDCAMS (access method services), to create, populate, update and configure required datasets and parameter libraries and members to successfully implement software installations and upgrades on the IBM mainframe platform.
  • Create and deliver detailed installation/upgrade documentation, using government specified software and processes and formats. This documentation will include detailed dataset names, configuration parameters, and installation/upgrade procedures used to install/upgrade the IBM mainframe OS, software or hardware. 
  • Use IBM SMP/e to successfully receive and apply z/OS software and other related software on an IBM Mainframe. This includes interpreting SMP/e output messages to resolve software installation issues and requirements, use SMP/e panels to manage software installation packages, define SMP/e required parameters to successfully install and maintain OS and associated software products.
  • Create, define and manage system and user catalogs on the IBM Mainframe platform. This includes using the appropriate catalog management utilities to create, update, merge and debug system and user catalogs.
  • Diagnose and resolve IBM z/OS system abends and abnormal operating environment problems using system logs, and other available logs and documents. This includes creating and interpreting system traces and dumps, job output, and monitoring tools.
  • Create, populate, secure and troubleshoot IBM z/OS USS (UNIX Systems Services) file systems and mount points. Manage the USS environment on an IBM z/OS mainframe platform.
  • Create/update and debug z/OS parameters using government processes and procedures and requirements (aka PARMLIB).
  • Plan, create and update accurate, detailed documentation for IBM z/OS mainframe platform software/hardware installation/upgrades.
  • Use IBM z/OS mainframe job processing to analyze and debug batch processing issues. This includes an understanding of dispatching priorities and IBM z/OS mainframe security products and standard IBM mainframe software integration.
  • Use IBM z/OS mainframe communications products, including Virtual Telecommunications Access Method (VTAM), Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), and File Transfer Protocol (FTP).
  • Create, update, and debug Job Entry Subsystem (JES2) parameters and statements.
  • Use knowledge of storage management tools and techniques including Data Facility Hierarchical Storage Manager (DFHSM), IBM utility used for backup and recovery (ADRDSSU), Systems Managed Storage (SMS) and virtual tape systems to perform installation, upgrade and debugging of IBM z/OS platform issues

Qualifications:

  • Clearance: Secret
  • IAT-I Certification
  • Bachelor's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math and seven years' experience installing/maintaining an IBM z/OS, utilization of required software tools and utilities, implementation and testing of related software.

Or

  • Ten years' experience installing/maintaining an IBM z/OS, utilization of required software tools and utilities, implementation and testing of related software.

Job Title: Associate Director, Small Molecules & Biologics Logistics Operations (Remote

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Description

General Summary:

The Associate Director of Logistics Operations is responsible for management and execution of all Small Molecule & Biologics product distribution and product movement logistics in support of product delivery.


This includes establishing, championing, and implementing end to end management of clinical/development and commercial shipments with real-time tracking and troubleshooting of issues. This person will manage Temperature Controlled logistics shipments, 3PL management, carrier management, import/export compliance and product distribution.


The role works closely with couriers, Clinical Operations, CMO scheduling staff, QA and other stakeholders to plan and execute product movement logistics. The Associate Director is integral to the success of the clinical and commercial programs at Vertex.


Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Plays a key role in the commercialization strategy for small molecule [CF & Pain] and biologics including processes and technological requirements.
  • Management of all site-to-site materials movement including, but not limited to API, Start Material, SDD, DS, DP and other materials involved on manufacturing / testing / release of Clinical and/or Commercial products across the network (Internal / External / 3PL / etc.)
  • Accountable for establishing programs/partnerships and supporting sourcing & selection activities of global 3PLs that can be used by the business to deliver outsourced services for warehousing, transport and international logistics.

  • Oversees Logistics Service Provider (LSP) performance, including: relationship management, service/performance, audit and qualification, RFI/RFP’s, continuous improvement and support of contract related activities (i.e. CDA, MSA, SOW, Rate Card, etc.).
  • Develop continuous improvement plans for Vertex’s Logistics infrastructure.* Assist in the identification and implementation of continuous improvement opportunities and customer satisfaction opportunities.
  • Identify, initiate, and manage cross-functional logistics projects using appropriate project management expertise and methodologies.
  • Manage the operational aspects of on-going projects and serve as liaison between project management, project team, Quality, and line management.
  • Oversee LSP’s trade management activities and enforce corporate compliance as it pertains to the transportation of goods domestically and internationally, including troubleshoot of trade related issues.
  • Represent and contribute on behalf of the Global Logistics functions when the organization engages in strategic projects, business ventures or seeks to expand into emerging and new markets; seeks to rationalize, review or invest in technology platforms that affect the logistics organization directly or indirectly.
  • Facilitate cross-functional team collaborations as well as support executive leadership and stakeholders within the business in developing business strategies, inclusive of long-term goals and objectives.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate complex issues and solutions enterprise-wide.
  • Excellent team player who is able to build and sustain respect and trust at all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to anticipate adverse scenarios and provide contingency plans to address them.
  • Sound judgment and business acumen with personal versatility and flexibility as the business and team evolves.
  • Direct experience with managing logistics and temperature control / cold chain operations.
  • Proven supervisory experience and demonstrated ability to develop direct reports.
  • Has familiarity with managing Logistics with a network of both internal and external (CDMO)manufacturing sites.
  • Has an excellent understanding of Good Distribution Practices in the Pharmaceutical Industry.
  • Has a working knowledge of Trade Compliance requirements.
  • Has knowledge of Logistics systems such as TMS, WMS and system / carrier integrations.
  • Demonstrated ability to successfully plan and optimize all resources of a group or function(budgets, staff, technology, succession planning, etc.) for advancement of all goals and objectives.

  • Ability to influence others in sensitive or difficult situations.
  • Ability to think critically and demonstrate troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to function efficiently and independently in a changing environment.
  • Familiarity with various regulations including those related to hazardous shipments, employee safety, and freight classifications.
  • In depth experience in Microsoft Excel (tables, arrays, formulas, conditional formatting).

Education and Experience:

  • 7-10+ years progressive experience in Supply Chain, Logistics and/or manufacturing leadership roles in the pharmaceutical industry – Experience with Biological products and Genetic and Cell Therapy technologies is strongly preferred.
  • Master’s degree in business or supply chain or industrial engineering or finance preferred.
  • Experience in building and managing complex Global Supply Chain Logistics operations and Network Design principles.
  • Thought leader in Logistics, Warehousing and Transportation with a proven ability to innovate and implement practical, compliant solutions.
  • Proven ability to work seamlessly across teams and develop excellent partnerships with peers.
  • Demonstrated understanding of the principles and regulations associated with GDP operations.

jobs.excerpt: About Scene Health Scene is reimagining medication adherence with our 360° model of care, bringing the gold standard of Directly Observed Therapy into the digital age.
jobs.description:
About Scene Health

Scene is reimagining medication adherence with our 360° model of care, bringing the gold standard of Directly Observed Therapy into the digital age. Through personalized video coaching, engaging education, and motivational support, we connect healthcare professionals, patients, and their families to solve the $500B problem of medication nonadherence.

Through our mobile app, patients connect with pharmacists, nurses, and health coaches through quick daily video check-ins, anytime, anywhere. We make medication management engaging and supportive while helping patients overcome challenges and barriers related to social determinants of health.

Job Overview

Scene Health is on a mission to solve medication non-adherence. We’re a diverse team of designers, technologists, researchers, and public health enthusiasts committed to building high-impact technology that helps patients get better faster.

Scene provides a platform of mobile and web-based applications used in the US and abroad, which means a wide variety of work day-to-day. Our team is constantly taking on challenging and exciting problems, with the goal of making a serious impact on the lives of patients. We work with world-renowned clinicians and scientists to help patients facing significant health challenges. Our solution is offered to patients with infectious and chronic diseases such as tuberculosis, HIV, hepatitis C, opioid addiction/substance abuse, diabetes, asthma, and mental health. We partner with academic medical centers and adherence experts across the country to develop and validate our tech-enabled solution.

We are looking for a passionate and motivated Patient Engagement Specialist for Research and Clinical Trials, who will deliver Scene’s digital adherence monitoring programs for academic and commercial research partners reporting to the Associate Program Manager. You will help study participants take their first critical steps toward better health. Scene serves patients virtually with chronic and behavioral health conditions. Our clinical pilot and trial management customers and their participants value meaningful support and engagement that is delivered routinely and rapidly.

In this role, you will be involved in programs to support research studies and clinical trials to deliver asynchronous monitoring of participants’ medication adherence to investigational study drugs and novel interventions. The Patient Engagement Specialist’s role involves helping research and clinical trial study sites and their patients begin a standardized medication adherence program that will help them track their progress, and establishing a responsive routine of documenting participant medication adherence. Starting and finishing strong in the monitoring program is paramount to study success.

You will also be involved in clinical programs monitoring patients’ adherence to prescription medications as a part of routine care. These programs can include populations with substance use disorders, chronic illnesses and mental health conditions. We take an engaging approach to motivate patients toward lasting change for healthy outcomes.

We are a distributed team with collaborations all over the country, so this is a remote position. If you’re an empathetic and passionate individual who loves interacting with patients and clients, wants to help others, and cares about impacting the community, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Completes daily reviews of all patient video submissions when ingesting medications, and responds as appropriate per engagement and escalation protocols, and documents actions taken
  • Updates and maintains a database of patient-level notes daily
  • Conducts data entry, data quality check, and data reconciliation exercises to ensure consistent documentation
  • Conducts technical training with study sites to help patients use Scene Health’s mobile application and to resolve technical challenges when using the web platform
  • Prepares written reports and maintains records of program monitoring activities
  • Works collaboratively with a cross-functional team to identify, develop, evaluate, and refine new processes and features of the Scene Health program
  • Provides management with patient feedback and/or recommendations for program and product improvement
  • Other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of related experience
  • High school diploma
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Proficiency with database systems and mobile applications
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a healthcare related field or equivalent experience
  • Experience in a healthcare, clinical research, or a digital health setting
  • Familiarity or experience with substance use/abuse and mental health care and programs, especially recovery support services and peer support approaches
  • Directly Observed Therapy, peer counseling, or other community health work experience
  • Open to alternative work schedules

Note: Interested candidates should be prepared to provide references as a part of the interview process.

**We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas at this time.

jobs.excerpt: Jooble — це глобальна продуктова IT-компанія, що трансформує сферу працевлаштування.
jobs.description:
Jooble — це глобальна продуктова IT-компанія, що трансформує сферу працевлаштування.

Щомісяця мільйони людей у 66 країнах світу використовують Jooble для пошуку роботи та найму талантів. За цим стоїть команда з понад 300 професіоналів, які поєднують глибоку експертизу в аналітиці, технологіях та роботі з даними, щоб зробити цей процес простішим і ефективнішим.

Сьогодні Jooble входить до ТОП-10 найвідвідуваніших сайтів світу у сегменті Jobs and Employment, підтверджуючи свій глобальний вплив.

Про роль

Нам важливо, щоб вебсайт Jooble залишався серед лідерів у результатах пошуку роботи, посилював присутність у балканському регіоні — і, можливо, саме ти допоможеш нам у цьому.

Це можливість розвинути навички пошуку та аналізу даних, прокачати навички копірайтингу для міжнародної аудиторії та здобути досвід спілкування з партнерами з різних країн (Cербія, Греція, Хорватія). Ти зможеш бачити реальний вплив своєї роботи на зростання глобального продукту.

Якщо немає досвіду — це ок!

Ми активно розглядаємо кандидатів без досвіду, оскільки для нас в першу чергу важливі метч за цінностями, твоя мотивація та зацікавленість розвиватися саме у пошуку партнерств, outreach/linkbuilding.

На тебе чекають такі задачі:

  • Шукати якісні веб-сайти, блоги, онлайн-платформи за допомогою SEO інструментів (Ahrefs, SEMrush і тд)

  • Аналізувати та відбирати знайдені сайти за нашими параметрами (трафік, показники зростання сайту, кількість і якість зворотних посилань)

  • Знаходити контакти відповідальних осіб (власники сайтів, веб-майстри, копірайтери та інші) та писати їм "холодні" листи з пропозицією співпраці. Листування може відбуватись за допомогою різних сервісів (Email, Linkedln тощо)

  • Працювати з відмовами задля досягнення КРІ та отримання результату (кількість угод)

  • Долучатися до онлайн зустрічей та презентацій із зацікавленими партнерами та відвідувати командні зустрічі

  • Самостійно займатися пошуком нових стратегій outreach та можливостей для реалізації поставлених цілей

Ми шукаємо людину, яка:

  • Має велике бажання працювати у сфері outreach/linkbuilding

  • Готова шукати підхід до кожного та вміє пояснювати складне простими словами

  • Не боїться відмов і готова працювати з запереченнями

  • Має навички самоорганізації та бажання працювати з метриками й чіткими КРІ

Буде плюсом:

  • Досвід у сфері продажів, комунікаціях, залучення клієнтів або в customer service

  • Розуміння того, як працює механізм лінкбілдінгу та як посилання впливають на сайт

  • Досвід побудови комунікації з носіями мови (сербська, грецька або хорватська)

  • Володіня англійською мовою на рівні В1 та вище.

Ми надаємо повністю оплачуване навчання після отримання оферу, яке допоможе тобі глибоко зануритися в напрям та розібратися з процесами. Ми не залишаємо з матеріалами «сам на сам» — навчання проходить із підтримкою тренера та команди.

Як проходить і з чого складається навчання?

  • Навчання відбувається в перший місяць роботи, повний робочий день, оплачуване;

  • Формат — онлайн, відеолекції та GoogleMeet-зустрічі з нашим тренером;

  • Доступ до постійної підтримки від наших тренерів.

Якщо ти впізнав/-ла себе, маєш готовність вчитись та зростати, відправляй своє резюме!

Наступні кроки: дзвінок із рекрутером -> HR-інтерв'ю -> письмовий тест на знання англійської мови -> інтерв'ю з Team Leader -> фінальне інтерв'ю - offer від Jooble

Дізнавайся більше про Jooble та Про кар'єрне зростання в outreach, а також підписуйся на наш телеграм канал.

Place of work: Remote, Slovakia
Base salary:  minimum 2000€ / monthly (depending on experiences and quality of the candidate)

About the role:

As a ServiceNow Developer, you will be at the heart of our digital transformation initiatives, developing and customizing solutions that
leverage the full potential of the ServiceNow platform. This role demands a blend of technical prowess in both front-end and back-end
development, deep understanding of ServiceNow’s ITSM, ServOps, and Asset Management modules, and the ability to craft solutions that meet complex business needs.

Design, develop, and implement tailored solutions within the ServiceNow platform, focusing on ITSM, ServOps, and Asset Management modules.

• Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
• Customize and enhance ServiceNow applications and workflows to optimize processes and user experiences.
• Develop both client-side and server-side scripts to enhance functionality and create seamless integrations.
• Ensure solutions are developed with high standards of security, data protection, and compliance.
• Manage the full software development lifecycle, including testing, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
• Develop and maintain technical documentation for ServiceNow applications and integrations.
• Conduct code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of development practices.
• Provide mentorship and support to junior developers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and collaboration.
• Stay abreast of the latest ServiceNow features, updates, and best practices to drive innovation and efficiency.

About you:

• Proven experience as a ServiceNow Developer, with a strong portfolio showcasing expertise in ITSM, ServOps, and Asset Management modules.
• Deep knowledge of ServiceNow development practices, including client and server-side scripting, application UI configuration, and custom application development.
• Proven experience working with workflows in one or more key areas of the ServiceNow platform (ITSM, ITOM, PPM, CSDM, HRSD)
• Solid experience of JavaScript, Glide Script and AngularJS/HTML/CSS.
System integration experience using web services and other web-based technologies such as XML, HTML, CSS, HTTP, REST/SOAP.
• Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and tools.
• Excellent problem-solving abilities, with a keen attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality work.
• Strong communication skills, capable of engaging effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Certifications in ITSM, ServOps, and Asset Management ServiceNow modules is highly regarded.

Education Requirements/Qualification:
• ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) - optional
• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) - mandatory
• Any other ServiceNow Certification or Micro-Certification - optional

Languages:

Good English level is required (B2 or higher).

Our ambitions will bring the very best out in you. You’ll be pushed to aim higher and really own your work. You’ll be encouraged and supported to make things happen, too. It can be challenging. But, as the progress you make will help improve the lives of millions, it’ll be worth it.

This is stepping up to a challenge.

This is work that’ll move you.

Note: Please send your CV only in English language.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Precision Medicine Executive, Rare Blood Disease Tri-State

Location: Remote, US


About the Job:

The Precision Medicine Executive, Rare Blood Disease is a field-based commercial role focused on encouraging diagnostic testing and enhancing patient identification for systemic mastocytosis and future precision medicine therapies within Sanofi’s portfolio. This individual will partner with key accounts, diagnostic laboratories, and cross-functional Sanofi teams to support disease education, testing adoption, and account-level execution aligned to business and patient needs.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you'll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.


Main responsibilities


  • Build relationships with key account stakeholders, including pathology, laboratory, clinical, and executive decision-makers, to support appropriate diagnostic testing and patient identification.
  • Develop and execute account plans that advance high-quality diagnostic, biomarker, and genomic testing aligned to Rare Blood Disease priorities.
  • Educate stakeholders on systemic mastocytosis, diagnostic pathways, and the role of precision medicine in patient care.
  • Partner with commercial, medical, marketing, access, and field teams to deliver approved education, resources, and account-level initiatives.
  • Identify and communicate customer needs, market insights, diagnostic barriers, and opportunities to improve testing pathways.
  • Serve as a regional subject matter expert for diagnostics and precision medicine in systemic mastocytosis and future applicable therapies.
  • Represent Sanofi at relevant local, regional, and national congresses and customer-facing forums in accordance with company policies.
  • Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements, healthcare laws, Sanofi Code of Conduct, and EBI Guidance

About You

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotechnology, or related life sciences industries and in diagnostics or precision medicine
  • Ability to travel regularly within the assigned geography.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, business, or a related field.
  • Background in pathology, molecular biology, diagnostics, hematology, oncology, rare disease, or precision medicine.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and planning skills with the ability to work effectively in a field-based, cross-functional environment.
  • Working knowledge of diagnostic testing, biomarker or genomic testing, and patient identification pathways.
  • Experience engaging external healthcare stakeholders and account decision-makers in complex clinical or laboratory environments.
  • Experience supporting specialty product launches, indication expansions, diagnostic strategy, or market development.
  • Understanding of diagnostic market dynamics, including reimbursement, regulatory, policy, provider, patient, and payer considerations.
  • Ability to influence without authority, build credibility, align stakeholders, and drive adoption of new approaches or technologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with a patient-focused and compliance-oriented mindset.

Why choose us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.​​
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.​​
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.​​
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.​

jobs.excerpt: Suralink® is the agentic automation platform for accounting professionals and their clients, leading the global charge in AI-driven accounting technology.
jobs.description:
Suralink® is the agentic automation platform for accounting professionals and their clients, leading the global charge in AI-driven accounting technology. As the leading AI platform for accounting firms, Suralink serves more than 50% of the top 100 enterprise accounting firms in the United States and has over 800,000 users globally.

Our mission is to empower the people we serve to redefine the meaning of efficiency in the accounting technology industry. Our award-winning SaaS platform was built for CPA firms, providing a simple, secure way to manage audit, tax, and advisory engagements.

Recognized for growth, innovation, and culture, we foster a highly collaborative, remote-first environment where exceptional, motivated professionals can make a meaningful impact. If you're passionate about building relationships and driving growth at a fast-growing SaaS company, we'd love to talk with you

Who we are looking for:

We are looking for a HubSpot-focused Marketing Operations Specialist to help run the systems, data, and reporting behind our demand generation and pipeline. Day to day, you will build and maintain workflows, lists, and campaign operations in HubSpot, keep our data clean, and produce the reporting Marketing relies on. This role is a good fit for someone with a solid HubSpot foundation who wants to build their skills in marketing operations and take on more strategic work over time.

Reporting directly to the Revenue Operations Manager, you will work closely with Marketing, learn how our revenue systems fit together, and take on more ownership as you grow in the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain HubSpot workflows, lists, forms, properties, and campaign assets, following our established standards and naming conventions

  • Support campaign and webinar operations end to end, including list builds, registration and follow-up workflows, and post-event data cleanup

  • Support lead management and lifecycle stage processes, and troubleshoot routing and lifecycle issues as they come up, escalating changes to routing rules or lifecycle definitions to the Revenue Operations Manager

  • Apply and QA our attribution and UTM standards so source data stays accurate and reportable

  • Support Marketing with CRM administration, including property requests, pipeline and deal stage hygiene, and user issues, in partnership with the Revenue Operations Manager

  • Monitor integrations between HubSpot and our marketing tech stack, and flag and help resolve data sync issues

  • Run regular data quality audits covering duplicates, enrichment gaps, standardization, and imports

  • Build and maintain HubSpot reports and dashboards for funnel, campaign, and pipeline performance, and flag trends or anomalies to the team

  • Document processes and system configurations, and help train Marketing users on new features and process changes

Experience and Professional Qualifications:

  • 2+ years in marketing operations, including hands-on HubSpot experience building workflows, lists, properties, and reports

  • Working experience building HubSpot workflows, lists, properties, and reports

  • Strong attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work

  • Comfortable in spreadsheets and with basic data work such as pivot tables, lookups, and cleaning and importing data

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including documenting processes and explaining your work to non-technical teammates

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

  • HubSpot Academy certifications, such as Marketing Hub Software or Reporting

  • Experience in a B2B SaaS environment

  • Exposure to HubSpot custom objects, integrations, or data enrichment tools

  • Exposure to attribution, funnel reporting, or UTM tracking

  • Interest in BI tools, SQL, or AI tools that make operational work faster

Competencies

  • Systems and Automation Orientation:Looks for ways to make repetitive work faster and more reliable through automation and better process.

  • Attention to Detail:Holds a high bar for data accuracy and consistency, and catches issues before they reach a report.

  • Analytical Thinking:Uses data to answer questions, checks whether the numbers make sense, and can explain what a report shows.

  • Communication:Explains their work clearly, keeps stakeholders updated on requests, and raises problems early.

  • Ownership:Follows through on commitments, sees work through from request to finished result, and asks for help when stuck.

  • Curiosity and Coachability:Asks good questions, learns quickly, and uses feedback to get better.

At Suralink, our values guide everything we do:

  • Customer Obsessed: We seek to understand those we serve deeply and are committed to serving them better than anyone else.

  • Passionately Motivated: We care about what we do, which drives us to work hard, show grit, and go above and beyond to achieve great outcomes.

  • Constantly Improving: We are eager to learn and grow. Challenges are opportunities to innovate and enhance our solutions.

  • Team Focused: We know that our success is built together. We support one another and celebrate team achievements.

  • Highly Reliable: We demonstrate good judgment, honor our commitments, and are accountable for our results.

Why Suralink?

There’s a lot to love about working at Suralink! Here are a few of the benefits you can expect:

  • Remote-friendly policy

  • Medical/vision/dental insurance

  • Flexible PTO policy and ten paid holidays

  • Parental leave

  • Professional development allowance

  • Community involvement

Founded in 1962, the mission of KOA is “connecting people to the outdoors and each other,” and those who represent the brand share the values of being family-oriented, passionate, entrepreneurial, customer-focused, and innovative. At KOA, we believe the outdoors is fun and for everyone. We are committed to having an environment where all are treated with dignity and respect. We strive to:

  • intentionally create a sense of community and belonging for our guests, employees and franchise partners
  • continually educate ourselves and expand our knowledge to foster an inclusive and supportive environment
  • sustain a culture that promotes diversity of thought and experiences
  • ensure everyone has the ability to experience the outdoors and that our facilities are accessible to all
  • drive change in our company and industry through action and implementation

Summary:

The SEO Manager manages and executes KOA's organic search and discovery programs across traditional search engines, AI-powered discovery experiences, and local search. This role supports the development of KOA's national Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and multi-location/local SEO strategy and translates that strategy into measurable programs, recommendations, and improvements across KOA.com and KOA's campground network. The SEO Manager serves as KOA's primary subject-matter expert for organic search and discovery, with broad working knowledge across technical SEO, content, on-page optimization, authority/off-page signals, site performance, structured data, Google Business Profiles, local citations and profiles, and emerging AI discovery. The SEO Manager identifies visibility gaps and opportunities, develops actionable recommendations, coordinates implementation with Product, Engineering, Content, Digital Experience, Media, Analytics, franchisees, and agency partners, and measures whether those actions improve qualified visibility and business outcomes. SEO Manager also manages the day-to-day operation of KOA's local-search program, including vendor and tool relationships, profile standards, reporting, franchisee support, education, and issue escalation.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to identify and prioritize technical SEO requirements and risks, including crawlability, indexability, rendering, canonicalization, redirects, structured data, internal linking, Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile performance, and platform migrations.

  • Develop recommendations for KOA's evolving GEO and AI-discovery approach, including entity clarity, authoritative content, structured information, citation-worthiness, content accessibility, and emerging machine-readable discovery requirements; coordinate approved improvements with relevant teams.

You will research existing products within assigned niches, identify market gaps and improvement opportunities, and develop enhanced product concepts supported by detailed analysis of competitors, customer feedback, and market trends. Your insights will guide the company in selecting and launching high-potential private label products in the premium outdoor and fitness category, where products are complex, design-intensive, and built for long-term performance.

This is a high-impact, analytical, and cross-functional role that combines market research, product strategy, and business analytics to identify and execute winning product opportunities.

About the Company:

The company is an e-commerce brand built around movement, energy, and family fun. Best known for its high-quality outdoor and fitness products especially premium trampolines designed for safety, durability, and joy the brand is expanding rapidly across global marketplaces. It values initiative, analytical thinking, and people who take ownership of their work. If youre passionate about e-commerce, innovation, and high-quality products, this is your opportunity to make a measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development of consumer-focused and enterprise-level product lines defining strategy, vision, and roadmap supported by internal and external analysis.
  • Manage the entire product lifecycle from concept through design, prototyping, testing, and launch, ensuring alignment with business goals and brand strategy.
  • Conduct deep niche and competitor research on Amazon and broader markets to identify opportunities for new products or improvements to existing lines.
  • Use data-driven decision-making leveraging market trends, customer insights, pricing analysis, and cost-performance data to guide product direction.
  • Perform deep-dive analytics on customer behavior, product performance, and category trends to uncover actionable insights.
  • Develop detailed requirements, product specifications, and user stories, ensuring clear communication with engineering and sourcing partners.
  • Manage prioritization and trade-offs between customer experience, product performance, and operational complexity.
  • Work closely with sourcing agents and suppliers (especially in China) to evaluate manufacturing options, ensuring quality, compliance, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Brand Managers, Marketing, Operations, and Finance to ensure smooth product delivery, launch, and adoption.
  • Define and monitor key business metrics (sales, conversion, retention, cost, ROI) to measure success and optimize product performance post-launch.
  • Prepare comprehensive documentation including specifications, manuals, packaging guidelines, competitor analyses, and user stories.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant safety, quality, and regulatory standards.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree in Business, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in product development for an e-commerce company selling on Amazon.
  • Proven ability to analyze market data and identify profitable opportunities in the outdoor, fitness, or consumer product categories.
  • Experience in business analytics, financial/strategic analysis, or data modeling for product or project decision-making.
  • Strong project management skills with experience leading cross-functional teams.
  • Advanced analytical and quantitative reasoning skills able to use data to drive actionable insights.
  • Familiarity with analytics, data visualization, and querying tools (SQL, Excel, BI platforms, etc.).
  • Creative and innovative mindset with an eye for design, functionality, and customer experience.
  • Engineering or technical background and strong understanding of manufacturing and sourcing processes.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of collaborating with global teams and suppliers.

  • Competitive and timely compensation.

  • Creative freedom and ownership over product concept development.
  • Make a visible impact - your ideas directly influence what we launch.

jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to own our larger accounts and multi-phase programs, from signed contract through discovery, build, launch and the first months after go-live.

This is a senior delivery role. You are accountable for the budget, scope, timeline, and the customer relationship on every project you run, and you carry the conversations that come with them. We want someone who has already managed complex enterprise implementations, understands the challenges of ERP integration, and who has worked in a delivery model where AI does a meaningful share of the work. In this model, you understand that the project manager’s job is to make sure the work is defined well enough for AI and human steps to flow smoothly and with minimal intervention.

What you will do

  • Own the project from signature to post-launch and deliver it on time, in scope, and on budget.

  • Turn the contract into a work breakdown with estimates that roll up to the sold number, and close discovery with the Solution Architect on that basis.

  • Keep the backlog ready. Every piece of work has a trace to the agreed solution design, acceptance criteria, an estimate and its dependencies before it goes to the team.

  • Keep the project record complete, with every project meeting recorded and filed so the design, the plan and the team’s AI tools can work from it.

  • Run the project week to week. Record and communicate budget burn, risks and mitigations, blockers with an owner and a date, dependencies on the customer’s IT and ERP partners, and a status the sponsor can act on without a call.

  • Carry the hard conversations. When scope or expectations drift, say what it costs, defend the team’s estimate and the agreed scope, and route the rest through change control.

  • Keep the customer relationship and the team healthy through the hard parts. The sponsor and customer trust your numbers, and the team trusts you to protect their estimates and their time.

  • Take the first call on customer escalations and bring rebaselines and change orders to the customer on your own.

  • Mentor Project Managers and build the templates, dashboards and working practices the PMO runs on.

What we are looking for

Experience and qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Seven or more years managing software implementation projects with a contracted budget for enterprise customers, with commerce, PIM or ERP integration projects in the Microsoft ecosystem strongly preferred.

  • Experience delivering in an AI-accelerated methodology, where meeting records, solution design and backlog quality are what the AI tools and the engineers build from, and where you have seen what happens when they are not in order.

  • A track record of turning a Statement of Work and its change orders into a work breakdown that rolls up to the contract, and of holding that number through delivery.

  • Working knowledge of Dynamics 365 from the project side, enough to understand what the integration work is and why it takes the time it does.

  • Fluent with the work management, time tracking and financial tools a delivery team runs on, and used to keeping them reconciled.

Skills

  • Writes work definitions and acceptance criteria that a developer can build from without a conversation.

  • Delivers a firm message to an enterprise customer with the data behind it and stays in the room when it gets hard.

  • Builds trust with the customer and their team early, and keeps it through a firm conversation or a change order.

  • Reads budget burn and acts on a deviation before it becomes an overrun.

  • Holds several accounts at once without losing accuracy on any of them.

  • Writes updates a director or a customer sponsor can act on without a call.

  • Uses AI tools daily in their own work and checks what they produce before it reaches anyone else.

Who you are

You like owning a number and a customer relationship at the same time, and you’re comfortable being the person who says what a change will cost. You would rather define the work properly once. You have already worked with AI in delivery, you have an opinion on where it helps, and you want to be on a team that is putting it to work. You take ownership, build trust, drive innovation and succeed together, and you expect the same of the people around you.

Other information

  • Employment type: Full-time (40 hours/week)

  • Start date: Upon agreement

  • Location: Remote (U.S.), occasional travel for kickoffs and go-lives

  • Reports to: Director of Project Delivery, Commerce North America

  • Compensation: USD 80,000–100,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications.

About Truvio

Truvio is a fast-growing SaaS company that combines established Microsoft Dynamics ISVs into one product portfolio built for Dynamics 365, helping customers get more value from their ERP investments. With our core values Take ownership, Build Trust, Drive innovation and Succeed together, we are about 450 employees worldwide across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.

jobs.excerpt: Job DescriptionThe Role The HR Solutions Enablement team builds effective, scalable, and cohesive HR solutions that minimize redundancy and deliver seamless data and insights for a better end-user experience.
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Role


The HR Solutions Enablement team builds effective, scalable, and cohesive HR solutions that minimize redundancy and deliver seamless data and insights for a better end-user experience.


You’ll join a team that implements Workday and integrated third-party HR technology solutions to streamline operations and reduce friction. The team also provides Tier 2 support to business users. As the Sr. HR Technology Analyst for Hourly Compensation, you’ll design, configure, and maintain complex compensation processes across multiple countries and facilities, each with distinct requirements. This role combines consultative problem-solving, end-to-end execution, and the ability to influence without formal authority to deliver high-impact HR solutions.

Success in this role requires strong collaboration, consultation, and influence skills. You’ll partner with teams across the business to understand their challenges and implement optimal technology solutions—for example, translating hourly wage structures, step-progression rules, premiums, and allowances into robust, scalable Workday solutions that are accurate, compliant, and auditable.


The ideal candidate brings extensive hands-on experience with Workday Compensation configuration, working knowledge of adjacent Workday modules, and a passion for continuous improvement and solution design. You’ll serve as a Workday subject-matter expert and solution designer who improves system effectiveness, user experience, and operational scalability. Familiarity with emerging AI-powered tools and agents is valued, particularly where they can improve the end-user experience, Workday configurations and business processes.


Flexibility is important, as this role may occasionally require work outside standard hours to support global stakeholders and critical projects.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and configure end-to-end Workday solutions for global hourly compensation, including compensation packages, grades, grade profiles, steps, eligibility rules, and plan assignments.
  • Configure and maintain complex hourly compensation components, including:
    • Base wage structures and wage scales
    • Premium pay structures and differential rules
    • Automatic step-progression schedules based on anniversaries, hours worked, or other business rules
    • Local allowances such as COLA, hazard, seniority, tool, transportation, and housing allowances
    • 13th- and 14th-month pay or similar country-specific components, where applicable
  • Translate requirements from local collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), country legislation, and compensation policies into clear, sustainable, and testable Workday solutions.
  • Design and maintain compensation eligibility rules using job profile, location, union or collective agreement, employee type, and other relevant attributes.
  • Lead or support projects to standardize and expand hourly compensation configuration, including discovery, design workshops, configuration, testing, deployment, and hypercare.
  • Partner with Payroll and Integration teams to ensure Workday compensation configurations support accurate downstream pay calculations and payroll processing.
  • Collaborate with Reporting and Analytics teams to ensure hourly compensation data supports downstream reporting, compliance, benchmarking, and decision-making.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues related to hourly compensation, including eligibility errors, incorrect rates, step-progression defects, and missing allowances.
  • Execute and coordinate unit, integration, regression, and end-user testing; develop thorough test scenarios and maintain documentation describing solution configuration and expected outcomes.
  • Evaluate Workday releases and assess impacts to Compensation configuration, integrations, reporting, security, and business processes.
  • Apply Workday security and access controls, support data audits and control activities, and ensure configuration changes are documented, traceable and approved through established governance processes.
  • Validate, reconcile, and execute EIBs and other mass data updates in accordance with established data-quality and change-control standards.

Core Capabilities

  • Configuration and solution design: Independently turns complex hourly compensation problems into scalable Workday designs that balance standardization, usability, compliance and maintainability.
  • Stakeholder and consulting skills: Builds trust with HR, Compensation, Payroll, Labor Relations, and Technology stakeholders; clarifies requirements; and influences decisions with clear options and recommendations.
  • Execution discipline: Plans and delivers configuration work from design through testing, deployment, and hypercare with strong ownership and follow-through.
  • Continuous improvement and analysis: Uses data and root-cause analysis to diagnose issues and identify opportunities for process improvement, automation and better user experience.
  • Quality, governance, and controls: Maintains high standards for documentation, testing, change control, auditability, security and sustainable solution design.

Required Qualifications

  • You have 7+ years of progressive experience in HR technology, HRIS, compensation, or a related field, including at least 4 years of hands-on Workday configuration experience with a focus on Compensation.
  • You have advanced knowledge of hourly compensation practices, including wage scales, step progression, premiums, allowances, and related eligibility rules, and can model them cleanly in Workday.
  • You are fluent in Workday Compensation building blocks, including compensation packages, grades, grade profiles, steps, eligibility rules, and plan assignments, and understand how they work together.
  • You have built or supported Workday custom reports and calculated fields tied to compensation.
  • You are comfortable using Workday EIBs and mass-update patterns to safely move data at scale, including validation, reconciliation, and post-load review.
  • You can translate dense policy, legislation, and CBA language into clear, testable configurations and explain the logic to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You have experience working across multiple countries or regions and navigating different regulatory and contractual environments to implement complex hourly compensation solutions.
  • You demonstrate professionalism, discretion and sound judgment when accessing sensitive employee information, using it only for legitimate business purposes and authorized work activities.
  • You bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail, data quality, and root-cause analysis.
  • You manage your work independently in a structured, change-managed environment and consistently deliver on your commitments.
  • You communicate clearly, in writing and in meetings, with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What Will Give You An Edge

  • You hold a Workday Pro certification in Compensation or comparable advanced Workday training.
  • You have supported large hourly or manufacturing populations and understand the realities of plant and operations environments.
  • You have translated union or collective bargaining agreements into Workday designs for pay, step progression, premiums and allowances.
  • You have worked across additional Workday domains, such as Core HCM, Absence, Benefits, Recruiting, Talent, or Advanced Compensation, to design end-to-end HR solutions.
  • You understand Workday security fundamentals, including domain and business process security, role-based access, audit requirements, and internal controls.

This role leads business requirements, functional design, governance alignment, testing, and stakeholder decision-making across master data domains. The MDG Functional Lead translates business needs into scalable SAP MDG solutions while guiding the technical teams responsible for configuration, integrations, and development. This is a functional leadership role, not a primary ABAP development position. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Serve as the SAP MDG functional lead and subject matter expert for assigned master data domains. Lead discovery, requirements, process design, and functional solution workshops with business and IT stakeholders. Translate business and governance requirements into functional specifications, process designs, and acceptance criteria. Own functional solution decisions and recommend scalable, supportable SAP MDG approaches that balance business value, user experience, and complexity.

Define functional requirements for MDG data models, workflows, business rules, validations, search, duplicate checks, and replication. Provide functional guidance to technical teams responsible for configuration, integrations, interfaces, and custom development; review delivered solutions for alignment with approved designs.

Lead functional delivery for Material, Business Partner (Customer and Supplier), and/or Finance master data domains. Apply deep knowledge of domain processes, data dependencies, controls, and governance requirements to solution decisions.

Partner with Data Owners, Data Stewards, and process leaders to define priorities and improve master data processes. Translate data governance policies into functional controls, validations, approvals, and data quality requirements. Lead cross-functional analysis and resolution of recurring process and data quality issues.

Validate end-to-end MDG processes and confirm solutions meet approved business and governance requirements. Provide functional leadership for data migration readiness, validation, and business sign-off during phased SAP rollouts. Maintain functional design, decision, process, and testing documentation.

Lead continuous improvement of workflows, user experience, governance controls, and process efficiency. Represent the functional workstream in upgrades, enhancements, rollout planning, and SAP MDG roadmap initiatives.

jobs.description:
Devenez chauffeur indépendant avec DriiveMe Partenaire

Accédez à des missions rémunérées de convoyage de véhicules partout en France, avec une organisation flexible et des frais de route pris en charge.

👉 Inscrivez-vous ici pour accéder aux missions :

DriiveMe est la plateforme leader européen du convoyage de véhicules. Chaque mois, plus de 20 000 missions rémunérées sont proposées à notre communauté de chauffeurs et convoyeurs indépendants partout en France.

Les grands acteurs de l’automobile font confiance à DriiveMe pour déplacer leurs véhicules : Stellantis, Aramisauto, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar, et bien d’autres.

Partout en France, des centaines de sociétés ont besoin de déplacer des véhicules d’un point A à un point B. Elles publient chaque jour leurs besoins sur DriiveMe afin de proposer ces missions à la communauté DriiveMe Partenaire.

En quoi consiste une mission DriiveMe ?

C’est simple : en tant que chauffeur indépendant, vous conduisez un véhicule d’un point A vers un point B. Voici comment ça fonctionne :

  1. Vous créez votre compte sur

  2. Vous accédez aux missions disponibles dans votre région.

  3. Vous consultez le trajet, la rémunération et les conditions de chaque mission.

  4. Vous réservez en quelques clics les missions que vous souhaitez réaliser.

  5. Le jour de la mission, vous récupérez le véhicule au point de départ et le livrez au point d’arrivée.

  6. Une fois la mission terminée et validée, vous recevez votre paiement automatiquement sous 10 jours.

Pourquoi devenir chauffeur indépendant avec DriiveMe Partenaire ?

  • Complément de revenus : chaque mission est rémunérée, avec un prix connu à l’avance.

  • Organisation flexible : vous choisissez librement les missions que vous souhaitez effectuer.

  • Frais de route pris en charge : carburant et péages sont remboursés selon les conditions de la mission.

  • Plateforme simple et intuitive : consultation, réservation et suivi des missions en ligne.

  • Missions partout en France : de nouvelles opportunités sont publiées chaque jour.

Combien suis-je rémunéré ?

Votre chiffre d'affaires dépend du nombre de missions que vous choisissez de réaliser.

Chaque mission dispose d’une rémunération spécifique, définie selon le trajet, le nombre de kilomètres et la complexité du transport.

Avant de réserver une mission, vous connaissez les informations essentielles : lieu de départ, lieu d’arrivée, rémunération et conditions de prise en charge. Vous êtes libre de réserver uniquement les missions qui vous conviennent.

Profil recherché

Pour rejoindre DriiveMe Partenaire, vous devez idéalement :

  • disposer d’un permis B valide ;

  • être indépendant ou prêt à le devenir ;

  • être sérieux, ponctuel et rigoureux ;

  • respecter les procédures de prise en charge et de livraison des véhicules ;

  • être disponible pour réaliser des missions ponctuelles dans votre région ou ailleurs en France.
