1 big thing: Axios is a growth-focused media company dedicated to helping people get smarter, faster, on what matters. We’re looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer who pairs strong product-engineering fundamentals with modern AI-native development practices to build and scale the systems and experiences that power Axios’ core products.

Why it matters: At Axios, we deliver clear, trustworthy, and informative news to millions of readers every day. As a Full StackSoftware Engineer, you’ll build the interfaces, services, APIs, and data flows behind our audience-facing products and publishing tools.

AI has become a core part of how we build software. You’ll use coding agents and other AI tools throughout the development lifecycle—from understanding problems and exploring solutions through implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and operation. You’ll remain accountable for the architecture, quality, security, and product outcomes of everything you ship.

You’ll work with product managers, designers, and engineers across disciplines to build resilient systems that embody Axios’ commitment to clarity and make our readers smarter.

Responsibilities:

As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you’ll deliver high-quality, reliable product features across Axios’ frontend and backend systems, using modern agentic development practices to accelerate delivery and ensuring performance and stability across our publishing and delivery platforms. Key responsibilities include:

  • End-to-end feature development: Own features across the frontend, APIs, business logic, data layer, testing, and production systems. Turn product problems into clear technical plans and reviewable units of work, using AI agents thoughtfully across research, prototyping, implementation, testing, refactoring, and documentation.
  • Frontend development: Create accessible, responsive, and maintainable interfaces using JavaScript or TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks such as Next.js.
  • Backend and API development: Build production services and APIs that support Axios’ products and publishing workflows, and create clear contracts that can be understood and used reliably by people, applications, and AI-powered tools.
  • AI-enabled product development: Identify opportunities where models, agents, retrieval, or intelligent automation can create meaningful value for readers or internal teams. Build those capabilities with clear user controls, measurable behavior, appropriate guardrails, and an understanding of when conventional software is the better solution.
  • Quality and reliability: Write automated tests, improve performance, and contribute to logging, metrics, tracing, security, and operational reliability.
  • Collaboration: Partner with product, design, quality engineering, and other developers to clarify requirements, explain tradeoffs, and deliver effectively. Participate in code reviews, pairing, onboarding, and mentorship.
  • Product and technical improvement: Understand how technical work supports readers, editorial workflows, and business goals.Improve existing systems through thoughtful refactoring, sound technical decisions, and practical experimentation with emerging engineering approaches.

Skills:

The ideal candidate is a thoughtful engineer who cares about user experience, reliability, scalability, and maintainable code—and who has moved beyond occasional AI assistance to using agents as a substantive part of their engineering practice. You should have:

  • Experience: 2-5+ years of professional software development experience, with production experience in frontend, backend, or full-stack development and the ability to contribute across the stack.
  • AI-native development: Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools—such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools—to complete meaningful, multi-step software work, rather than only generating snippets or using autocomplete.
  • Agent direction and context: Ability to write clear specifications and acceptance criteria, provide relevant context, break work into appropriately scoped tasks, decide what to delegate, and guide an agent when its initial approach is incomplete or incorrect.
  • Verification and engineering judgment: Ability to review AI-generated code critically, validate assumptions against the actual system, identify security and maintainability risks, and recognize when an agent-produced solution is plausible but wrong. You understand that AI increases the importance of sound architecture, testing, and human judgment.
  • Frontend development: Experience building production interfaces with JavaScript or TypeScript and React, preferably with Next.js or a comparable modern framework.
  • Backend development: Experience building production services and APIs. Our backend systems primarily use Go and Python, and you should be comfortable working in or learning either language.
  • Data fundamentals: Experience with relational databases, SQL, schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Quality and security: Experience with unit and integration testing, accessibility, input validation, authentication, authorization, and common web security practices.
  • Engineering judgment: Ability to own scoped work, make sound tradeoffs, navigate ambiguity, and connect technical decisions to product and business goals. You can evaluate when an AI-assisted or AI-enabled approach creates real leverage and when a straightforward deterministic solution is more appropriate.
  • Communication: Ability to explain technical decisions, risks, blockers, and tradeoffs clearly to engineering and cross-functional partners.
  • Continuous learning: Curiosity about rapidly changing models, tools, and development practices, paired with an evidence-based approach to evaluating them. You share what works, identify what does not, and help the team improve its practices over time.

We’ll be even more excited if you have:

  • Experience building production AI-enabled features using model APIs, structured outputs, tool or function calling, retrieval, or agent workflows.
  • Experience evaluating and operating AI-enabled systems through regression tests, evaluation harnesses, tracing, feedback loops, model or prompt versioning, cost and latency monitoring, or human-review paths.
  • Experience extending AI development environments through MCP servers, agent tools, repository instructions, reusable skills or plugins, custom workflows, or automated code review.
  • Production experience with Go or Python.
  • Experience with gRPC, Protocol Buffers, generated clients, or service-oriented architectures.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, orchestration, or CI/CD.
  • Experience with caching, background jobs, queues, or asynchronous processing.
  • Experience with CMS, publishing, media, subscription, search, or other consumer-facing products.
  • Experience operating production systems with observability, performance optimization or benchmarking, or accessibility testing.

What success looks like:

  • Valuable, accelerated delivery: You ship useful features from concept through production and use AI to shorten research, implementation, and feedback cycles without creating avoidable rework.
  • Sound AI leverage: You delegate meaningful work to agents, give them the context and constraints needed to succeed, and verify their output before it reaches users. You know when AI adds value and when it introduces unnecessary complexity.
  • Quality and reliability: Your work is maintainable, well-tested, secure, accessible, observable, and dependable.
  • Product impact: You make technical decisions that support Axios’ readers, products, editorial workflows, and business goals.
  • Team and system improvement: You contribute to a stronger team through collaboration, code reviews, pairing, mentorship, and thoughtful improvements to existing systems. You leave behind better documentation, tests, context, tools, and development patterns that make future work easier for both people and agents.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $130,000 - $165,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account the cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. COMPANY DESCRIPTION:

Veracross provides SaaS-based School Information Systems (SIS) designed to meet the specific needs of independent K-12 schools worldwide. A Specialist Implementation Manager independently leads all aspects of successful implementations of the Veracross software, with deep expertise in Student Billing and its connected modules. The role calls for a strong understanding of the Veracross software package, excellent project management skills, and effective communication (written and verbal). Projects are executed on time and on budget, while fostering trusting relationships with implementing schools and their Business Offices. As team and customer needs evolve, the role will extend to other areas of the Veracross platform.

  • Change management: orchestrate successful change management, where tailored configurations are office-tested, revised, approved, and deployed, with extra care given to the Business Office's daily operations.
  • Department workflow consulting: model and document the ways the school's different departments will use the Veracross product(s) across their first operational year.
  • Develop, coordinate, and execute project plans, task schedules, and resource activities to ensure on-time and effective project delivery
  • Work with the Lead Project Manager to build Business Office implementation plans tied to Student Billing and connected module configuration

  • Lead direct training engagements for multiple school departments, and ensure school personnel complete required self-paced trainings
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure all phases of the implementation are executed as necessary
  • Act as an internal subject matter expert for Student Billing, coaching other Implementation Managers and helping build their billing consulting skills
  • Develop tailored support handoffs after go-live and contribute to internal documentation and best practices for Student Billing and connected module implementations
  • Gather client feedback and work with internal teams to improve the implementation process and product offerings
  • Support implementation projects for North American schools as needed.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Accounting degree, studied accounting topics in university (for instance as part of a business degree, or relevant experience in a Business Office (Bursary) setting

  • Experience working in or with an independent school Business Office a plus
  • A solid understanding of accounting fundamentals, particularly as they relate to billing: the accounting equation; the chart of accounts; the general ledger and journal entries; accounts receivable and cash processing; reconciliations; fiscal period and fiscal year closing; and standard financial reporting (balance sheet, trial balance, profit and loss)
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, including comfort with public speaking, presentation delivery, and presenting to finance leaders such as Bursars and Business Managers
  • Ability to make complex decisions and recommendations under limited direction, using a high degree of initiative and independent judgement
  • Ability to learn complex, enterprise-level software systems at a level that supports teaching others
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Problem-solving skills with ability to perform root cause analysis
  • Highly organised, with the ability to self-manage in a remote
  • Flexibility to occasionally work outside standard UK hours to support North American projects
  • Ability to travel up to 15% of the time, primarily within the UK and Europe

We are looking for someone who enjoys turning complex, sometimes ambiguous problems into working solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong technical development skills with an analytical, consultative mindset—someone who can understand operational challenges, identify opportunities, develop and implement solutions, and work with stakeholders to ensure those solutions deliver value.


The work centers on Service Level Requirements (SLRs) that govern contractual performance across the program, with additional support to broader Navy performance initiatives such as World Class Alignment Metrics (WAM). Key priorities include identifying performance improvement opportunities, strengthening the effectiveness of Plans of Action and Milestones (POAMs), and developing AI-enabled tools and workflows that help the team move from reactive analysis to proactive performance management.


This role sits at the intersection of applied analytics, AI solution development, and operational performance consulting. You will work closely with analysts, engineers, and performance leaders to translate business needs into practical technical solutions, while helping expand the team's ability to use AI, automation, and reusable code in everyday operations.


This position is remote.


Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you.

  • Develop and deliver practical solutions using Python, AI, data analytics, and automation to address real-world operational performance challenges.

Outsource Ability is recruiting on behalf of a UK serviced accommodation operator for a confident and self-sufficient Sales Consultant.

You will handle sales conversations with property owners, explain and close the client's service offer, and hand each signed property over to the onboarding team — acting as the main point of contact for the owner through the sales process.

Key Responsibilities

Sales and Closing

  • Handle sales calls with property owners promptly and professionally.
  • Explain the client's offer clearly and confidently, using the agreed positioning and figures.
  • Handle objections and answer owners' questions directly, without referring routine queries back to the client.
  • Close agreed deals, issue contracts and collect onboarding fees and payments.
  • Follow up on open leads and carry out light lead nurturing, primarily by telephone and email.

Handover to Onboarding

  • Hand each signed property over to the onboarding team once the deal is closed.
  • Ensure the onboarding team receives all relevant property and owner information agreed during the sales process.

CRM and Record-Keeping

  • Maintain accurate lead records, statuses and next actions throughout the sales process.

Systems

  • GoHighLevel
  • AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude, used to streamline daily tasks and operations

Experience with every system is not essential, but you must be confident learning new technology.

What We're Looking For

Essential

  • Proven sales background with a demonstrable record of hitting targets.
  • Experience closing deals over the telephone.
  • Able to think on their feet and handle objections confidently, in line with the agreed scripts and SOPs.
  • Excellent telephone manner, with strong spoken and written English.
  • Comfortable working from scripts, SOPs and structured CRM processes, with strong discipline around notes, statuses and next actions.
  • Highly organised, with strong follow-up discipline.
  • Available to take and make calls throughout the working day.

Advantageous

  • Serviced accommodation, short-term rental, lettings or wider property experience.
  • Experience communicating with UK consumers.
  • Experience using GoHighLevel or a comparable CRM.
  • Familiarity with AI tools in a professional environment.

Remote Work Requirements

Applicants must:

  • Be based in South Africa.
  • Have a modern laptop or PC (Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent, minimum 8GB RAM).
  • Have a stable fibre internet connection with a minimum of 50 Mbps download and 50 Mbps upload.
  • Have a functional UPS, inverter or power station able to run a router and laptop for a minimum of 2–4 hours during load shedding.
  • Have a professional, noise-cancelling headset with a clear microphone.
  • Have a quiet workspace suitable for telephone calls and video meetings.
  • Be available for the agreed hours during UK business times.

You will serve as a trusted advisor, helping shape how leaders contribute to high-profile external and internal moments while translating complex healthcare topics into compelling, accessible narratives.

Key Responsibilities

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, resourceful, and highly organised Project Manager – Real Estate & Property Development to help drive complex real estate projects forward, from land acquisition and due diligence through zoning, permitting, approvals, and ongoing project coordination.

This role is ideal for someone who understands the practical realities of real estate development and can manage multiple stakeholders, navigate approval processes, track outstanding documentation, and keep projects moving without needing constant supervision.

You will work closely with attorneys, tenants, government offices, city and state authorities, utility providers, and other stakeholders to coordinate requirements, resolve obstacles, and ensure important tasks are completed on time.

The ideal candidate is a strong independent problem-solver who takes ownership, anticipates potential delays, and consistently follows through. You should also be comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT to support research, organise information, draft correspondence, and identify next steps, while independently verifying information before acting on it.

Experience with U.S. real estate processes is strongly preferred.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Real Estate Project Coordination

  • Manage and coordinate real estate and property development projects from acquisition through due diligence, approvals, and ongoing execution.
  • Track project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, deadlines, and outstanding requirements.
  • Coordinate land acquisition activities and support due diligence processes.
  • Monitor project progress, identify delays, and proactively implement solutions to keep projects moving.
  • Manage multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously while maintaining accurate records and clear priorities.

Zoning, Permitting & Approvals

  • Coordinate zoning, permitting, and other regulatory approval processes with relevant authorities.
  • Follow up with city and state government offices regarding applications, outstanding documentation, approvals, and project requirements.
  • Track approval statuses, submission deadlines, and dependencies between different stages of a project.
  • Identify potential roadblocks and work proactively with relevant stakeholders to resolve them.
  • Maintain organised records of applications, permits, correspondence, approvals, and supporting documents.

Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination

  • Communicate professionally with attorneys, tenants, government representatives, utility providers, and other project stakeholders.
  • Follow up consistently on outstanding actions, legal documentation, approvals, and information requests.
  • Coordinate with water companies and other utility providers to manage service requirements, connections, approvals, and project-related dependencies.
  • Maintain clear communication between stakeholders to ensure everyone understands outstanding requirements and next steps.
  • Escalate complex issues when necessary, while taking initiative to identify practical solutions before escalation.

Documentation & Project Administration

  • Maintain accurate, centralised project documentation, trackers, correspondence, and records.
  • Monitor outstanding documents, signatures, submissions, approvals, and follow-up actions.
  • Use spreadsheets, shared documents, email, calendars, and project management tools to organise workflows and maintain visibility across projects.
  • Provide regular progress updates, highlighting completed tasks, outstanding items, risks, blockers, and upcoming deadlines.
  • Ensure information is accurate, organised, accessible, and kept up to date.

AI-Assisted Research & Productivity

  • Use professional AI tools such as ChatGPT to conduct preliminary research, organise information, draft correspondence, summarise documents, and identify potential next steps.
  • Apply AI tools to improve administrative efficiency, structure project information, and support decision-making.
  • Independently verify AI-generated information, particularly when dealing with legal, regulatory, zoning, permitting, or other critical project requirements.
  • Use sound judgement when handling confidential project information and ensure sensitive information is shared only through approved tools and channels.

Minimum Requirements

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience managing real estate, property development, or closely related projects.
  • Practical experience coordinating project activities involving multiple stakeholders, documentation, deadlines, and dependencies.
  • Experience with land acquisition, due diligence, zoning, permitting, or regulatory approval processes.
  • Strong organisational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Proven ability to manage projects independently and follow through without repeated reminders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify blockers, recommend solutions, and drive tasks to completion.
  • Professional proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT for research, drafting, information organisation, and workflow support.
  • Ability to independently verify information and exercise sound judgement when using AI-generated outputs.
  • Comfortable using spreadsheets, shared documents, email, calendars, and project tracking tools.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with U.S. real estate markets, including familiarity with local zoning, permitting, municipal approvals, and property development processes.
  • Experience coordinating directly with attorneys, tenants, city or state authorities, and utility providers.
  • Exposure to water service applications, utility connections, infrastructure requirements, or related property development processes.
  • Experience managing complex, unconventional, or non-standard projects requiring initiative and independent problem-solving.
  • Familiarity with project management software and document management systems.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for moving projects forward and consistently follows through on commitments.
  • Proactive Problem-Solving: Identifies obstacles early, investigates solutions, and takes action rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Organisation & Attention to Detail: Maintains accurate documentation, tracks dependencies, and ensures deadlines and outstanding requirements are not overlooked.
  • Stakeholder Management: Communicates effectively with diverse stakeholders and maintains professional relationships.
  • Independent Judgement: Makes informed decisions, recognises risks, and knows when to escalate complex issues.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable navigating unfamiliar processes and managing projects that do not always follow a straightforward path.
  • AI & Technology Proficiency: Uses AI tools and digital platforms confidently to improve research, organisation, communication, and productivity.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking ownership of complicated projects and figuring out how to move them forward. You should be resourceful enough to chase outstanding approvals, investigate delays, coordinate different parties, and recommend solutions without needing someone to manage every step for you.

The successful candidate will demonstrate practical real estate project experience, strong independent judgement, and a consistent track record of turning outstanding tasks into completed outcomes.

Candidates who rely heavily on reminders, struggle to manage documentation, overlook important details, or lack practical experience navigating approvals and multiple stakeholders are unlikely to be a suitable fit.

jobs.excerpt: 🤙🏼 About gaiiaAt gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers.
jobs.description:
🤙🏼 About gaiia

At gaiia, we're building the leading platform for Communications Service Providers (CSPs) that truly care about their customers. Our core product is an operating system (OS) for telcos that manages billing, operations, automation and everything in between.

We're passionate about taking care of our people, and it's not just lip service. We want you to focus on your job while we care for everything else. We offer competitive pay and benefits, attractive stock options, unparalleled transparency, and a 100% remote environment. We're excited to have you join us for your next career adventure!

🎭 Role & Team

Following our $40M Series B, we’re scaling our technical teams, and we’re hiring our first dedicated recruiter to lead it. As our first Technical Recruiter, you’ll report directly to our CEO and own technical hiring end to end: sourcing, screening, interview coordination, candidate experience, offer, and close.

This is a true founding seat. There is no People team, no recruiting ops, and no inherited sourcing playbook today. You’ll inherit Rippling as our ATS and a dedicated Slack channel for candidate submissions, and you’ll build everything else. You’ll partner closely with our CEO and our Sr. Director, Customer Solutions Engineering to calibrate the profile, hold the bar, and move fast.

The searches you’ll take over

Your first priorities are Forward Deployed Engineer and Data Migration, two customer-facing technical roles on our Customer Solutions Engineering team. These engineers combine deep networking knowledge with strong TypeScript/JavaScript and modern tooling, and they work directly with our customers to get them live on gaiia. Adjacent profiles such as Solutions Architect, Implementation Engineer, Integration Engineer, and Professional Services Engineer draw from the same talent pool. As gaiia grows, you’ll also support product engineering hiring (backend, frontend, infrastructure, AI/agentic).

A successful candidate is energized by white space. You build the playbook instead of waiting for one, and you’re technically credible enough to run a first conversation with a senior engineer from the telco and network-vendor world.

🪄 What you’re going to do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for the Forward Deployed Engineer and Data Migration roles, then expand to broader engineering hiring.
  • Build and continuously refine Boolean search strategies in LinkedIn Recruiter, and source directly through GitHub, networking and telco communities, and referrals.
  • Screen profiles at high volume and run initial phone screens, making fast, disciplined yes/no calls.
  • Assess candidates on networking depth, TypeScript/JavaScript, curiosity about modern tooling (AI tools, n8n, Zapier), and customer-facing experience, and submit only candidates who clear the bar, with honest candidate briefs.
  • Coordinate scheduling across our interview process.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience. Our bar for candidate communication is very high.
  • Confirm work authorization early and flag AI-generated or fraudulent resumes.
  • Partner with our CEO and engineering leaders to sharpen the ideal candidate profile from interview feedback, and push back when the bar slips.
  • Set up Rippling workflows and report funnel metrics to leadership without being asked.
  • Negotiate and close offers in a market-calibrated comp posture.

🌈 Who we're looking for

  • A scrappy, self-sufficient operator who doesn’t need a support staff to be effective.
  • A quality-over-volume mindset. You won’t send us low-signal candidates just to hit a number.
  • A direct, no-BS communicator who gives and takes real-time feedback, including uncomfortable truths, with candidates, hiring managers, and the CEO.
  • Comfort partnering directly with an executive, with the confidence to challenge and calibrate.
  • Strong opinions about tools, held loosely. You work pragmatically with what’s available.
  • Enough fluency in networking, TypeScript, and integration work to tell real depth from hand-waving.
  • Proficiency in English (French is a bonus).
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to meet key candidates in person and join critical interview loops and team offsites.

🎖️ Qualifications

Recruiting fundamentals

  • 5+ years of technical recruiting, with a track record of sourcing technical talent (not just sales or operations roles).
  • Proven experience filling niche, hard-to-fill technical roles, and examples of where those candidates came from.
  • Boolean search expertise, and comfort reviewing 50–100 profiles in a session.
  • Direct sourcing strength. You don’t rely on inbound applicants or agencies.
  • Experience closing candidates and negotiating offers.
  • Familiarity with the networking, telecom, and infrastructure space. You don’t need to be an expert, but you recognize signal words like ISP, OSS/BSS, MPLS, provisioning, and TypeScript.

Technical screening fluency

  • Networking concepts, the deepest must-have: you can tell when a candidate actually knows networking.
  • TypeScript/JavaScript: you can assess whether someone is genuinely productive or only conversant.
  • APIs, Postman, and integration patterns: you know what a strong answer to “walk me through a recent integration you built” sounds like.
  • Awareness of whether candidates actually use AI tools and workflow platforms (n8n, Zapier).

Nice-to-have

  • Experience recruiting for ISP, telecom, or networking-software companies.
  • Familiarity with names like Cloudflare, Cisco, Itential, Calix, Ciena, Nokia, Juniper, and Arista.
  • Experience recruiting Forward Deployed Engineers, Solutions Engineers, or Professional Services Engineers at SaaS companies.
  • Prior experience as a solo or near-solo recruiter, or at a startup or scale-up.
  • Hands-on Rippling experience, or a track record of ramping quickly on modern ATS tools.
  • Experience hiring for AI-native or AI/agentic platform companies.

jobs.description:
ABOUT BETTER IMPACT

Our mission is simple: better volunteerism, stronger communities. Better Impact provides software that helps nonprofits, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and companies recruit, schedule, communicate with, and track volunteers and their impact.We advance volunteerism by equipping the professionals who make it happen with the technology, benchmarks, and community they need to run effective volunteer programs.

Today, our products support more than 85,000 organizations, millions of volunteers, and over 600 million volunteer hours across the nonprofit, public, healthcare, and corporate sectors. Our vision is a world where volunteerism is recognized, resourced, and respected in every community.

We are a growing, private-equity-backed business focused on meaningful work

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design a quality strategy that works across .NET, PHP, and Node and TypeScript. You're not bringing a single-stack playbook. You're defining an approach to quality that holds up across a portfolio of different systems.

Build the automation layer. API and end-to-end test coverage, integrated into each platform's delivery pipeline, with agentic and AI-driven tooling brought in deliberately so coverage scales without adding headcount for every new surface.

Define and own the quality gates across all products. No ticket exits development without a clear testing designation. Nothing ships to production without documented evidence that tests passed on an environment that genuinely mirrors production, same stack and same configuration. You own the standard, and you own sign-off on environment parity.

Own regression protection through various legacy technology modernization eforts. Build the safety net that lets engineering re-platform aggressively without silently breaking customer-facing behavior. This is the difference between a modernization that ships and one that stalls under fear of breaking things.

Embed quality into each development teams delivery cycle rather than bolting it on at the end. You'll partner with engineering leadership across platforms and with product owners, and make quality a discipline teams rely on rather than a checkpoint they route around.

Requirements

WHO YOU ARE

You have deep experience in software quality, with real depth in test automation. You are not a manual-QA manager looking to direct a team of testers. You've built systems, architected automated suites, and made hard calls about what to test and how.

You have built or substantially rebuilt a quality function before, ideally across more than one stack or product. You know what it takes to create standards where none exist and to get engineering to adopt them without resentment.

You are fluent in modern automation and comfortable that the stacks differ. You can reason about quality in a .NET system, a PHP system, and a Node and TypeScript system, and design an approach that generalizes rather than one that only fits what you already know.

You treat AI and agentic tooling as the force multiplier that makes cross-stack quality possible for a small team.

You have protected a product through a major migration, re-platform, or rewrite, where regression was the central risk and the cost of getting it wrong was customer trust.

You understand that a multi-region SaaS product carries uptime and SLA obligations, and you build quality processes with that reality in mind.

About Synapticure

Synapticure is the largest, most comprehensive specialty care and life sciences company in the country for those living with neurodegenerative diseases. Founded by patients and caregivers living with these diseases, we are redefining the care and the research paradigm for conditions like Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS in all 50 states.

Our business is powered by two connected engines.

The CARES Engine (Clinical Operations)

A scalable, 50-state virtualized clinical network providing timely access to expert neurologists and cutting edge treatments with wraparound care coordination and behavioral health support. Our team creates personalized care plans focused on education and empowerment, connecting patients with a multidisciplinary team of subspecialty neurologists, geriatricians, psychologists, and care coordinators who collaborate to deliver comprehensive care.

The CURES Engine (Research & Innovation)

Leveraging our deeply engaged, well characterized national patient cohort, CURES partners with life science, pharma, biotech, and medical device companies to accelerate the development of neurodegenerative treatments, spanning discovery stage lab services, clinical trial services, and real world evidence data and analytics.

Partnering with providers, health plans, and life sciences companies, including CMS' GUIDE dementia care model, Synapticure is dedicated to transforming the lives of millions of individuals and their families living with neurodegenerative diseases.

About the Role

    We're hiring a Manager, Licensing & Credentialing to lead our licensing, credentialing, and payer enrollment function. You'll combine operational leadership and direct ownership of complex, high-priority licensing and credentialing workflows (including the full provider onboarding and offboarding process and license pathway determinations) with day-to-day leadership of our L&C team. You will ensure providers stay licensed and credentialed as we grow into new states and payer relationships. It's behind-the-scenes work, but it supports every patient in its own way: every license kept current and every enrollment completed on time is what lets a patient see their provider without interruption.

The Day-to-Day

    Provider Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Own the full onboarding sequence end-to-end: execute license pathway determinations, perform compact licensure assessments (IMLC/PSYPACT/NLC/APRN), manage start-date sequencing, transcript/employment verification, and COI tracking.
  • Run sanction/exclusion screening at onboarding and set up DEA registration where applicable.
  • Own the offboarding and termination process end-to-end: deactivating licenses, payer enrollments, and supervision agreements, notifying payers, and archiving records.

    • Licensing & Credentialing Operations Support

  • Support and oversee multi-state provider licensing applications and renewals (executed by State Licensing leads), maintaining the Master Licensing Sheet and State Coverage Maps to prevent lapses.
  • Support and oversee payer enrollment and credentialing across Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers (executed by Payer Enrollment leads), including CAQH/Availity management, revalidations, and re-credentialing cycles.
  • Monitor APP restrictions, practice authority, and state board notifications to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.
  • Serve as the go-to escalation point for complex or unusual licensing, credentialing, and billing/care operational questions.

    • Collaboration Agreements & Credentialing Committee

  • Execute and maintain collaboration/supervision agreement tracking and routine drafting, transitioning toward full operational ownership under the Director's coaching.
  • Execute Credentialing Committee logistics, managing scheduling, agendas, and documentation while partnering with the Director on committee discussions.
  • Support payer contracting, denials, and appeals, coordinating with the Director on escalation pathways.

    • Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Manage and coach the L&C team: workload distribution, regular feedback, performance management, and professional development.
  • Set team priorities, process standards, quality checks, and SOP Playbooks for licensing and credentialing work.
  • Hold regular 1:1s with your team.
  • Partner with the Director of Practice Operations on team capacity, staffing needs, and workflow design as the team grows.

    • Reporting, Compliance & Process Improvement

  • Own regulatory and compliance documentation to keep the organization audit-ready and support internal/external audits.
  • Maintain routine tracking and metrics (license status, credentialing turnaround time, expirables, payer rosters) for leadership visibility.
  • Spot inefficiencies in L&C workflows and drive continuous improvement by leveraging tracking technology, systems optimization, and automation to accelerate onboarding timelines.
  • Lead internal and external operational communications regarding licensing and enrollment status.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of direct, hands-on experience in state provider licensing, credentialing, and payer enrollment/revalidation workflows.
  • 2-3+ years of team leadership or people management experience managing a licensing and credentialing team or operational function.
  • Solid understanding of the broader U.S. healthcare landscape: payers, regulatory environment, and care delivery models within telehealth.
  • Working knowledge of compact licensure pathways (IMLC, PSYPACT, NLC, APRN Compact).
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills, with comfort owning ambiguous, detail-heavy processes independently.
  • Familiarity with credentialing/licensing tracking software and CAQH/PECOS.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting CMS reimbursement programs or PC-MSO structures.
  • CPCS or CPMSM certification, or actively pursuing.
  • Background in a multi-market, high-growth, or telehealth healthcare environment.
  • Familiarity with leveraging automation or technology integrations to optimize credentialing workflows.

Compensation

Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Our Values

We are a remote-first company. While our team is located all across the United States, these core principles tie us together around a common identity:

  • Relentless focus on patients and caregivers: We are determined to provide an exceptional experience for every patient we have the privilege to serve, and we put our patients first in everything we do.
  • Embody the spirit and humanity of those living with neurodegenerative disease: Inspired by our founders, families, and personal experiences, we recognize the seriousness of our patients' circumstances and meet that challenge every day with empathy, compassion, kindness, joy, and hope.
  • Seek to understand, and stay curious: We start by listening to one another, our partners, our patients, and their caregivers. We communicate with authenticity and humility, prioritizing honesty and directness while recognizing we always have something to learn.
  • Embrace the opportunity: We are energized by the importance of our mission and maintain a strong bias toward action.

Benefits & Perks

Full time employees are eligible for:

  • Remote First: Work from anywhere in the 50 United States, with home office technology provided.
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision insurance options for you and your family.
  • Financial & Retirement Support: 401(k) plan with employer matching, plus short and long-term disability, and basic and supplemental life insurance.
  • Time Off & Leave: 15 vacation days, 5 sick days, 12 paid holidays, and 2 floating holidays, plus a fully paid end-of-year company holiday break (typically Christmas through New Year's).
  • Wellness & Family Growth: Comprehensive family-building and fertility services through Kindbody (where available) at a 20% discount, 24/7 mental health support via Health Advocate and Talkspace (including 12 free on-demand sessions per year), and access to One Medical.

Travel Requirements & Remote Workplace Setup

We're a remote-first company and provide the necessary technology to work from home. Most roles involve only occasional travel, such as for team meetings or professional collaboration events, unless otherwise specified in the job-specific details above.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Synapticure is an equal opportunity employer and a remote-first workplace. We believe that embedding equity, inclusion, compliance, and operational excellence across all aspects of our employee lifecycle directly reflects our core values. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please apply even if you feel you do not meet all qualifications.

JOB SUMMARY:

Natera is seeking a Data Privacy Director to help advance and operationalize the enterprise privacy program across our commercial, clinical, and product environments. This is a broad, hands-on leadership role supporting the full range of the Privacy team's work — from privacy impact assessments and regulatory analysis to contract and legal privacy-focused reviews — with a strong business-enablement orientation. This role reports to the Vice President, Data Privacy and partners with cross-functional teams to embed privacy principles throughout the lifecycle of data, technology, and innovation initiatives. The Director may also provide guidance and mentorship to privacy team members and external resources supporting the program.

The Director will also serve as a key integration point between Privacy and Product, embedding privacy-by-design into product and software development lifecycles and partnering with engineering to make privacy practical and scalable. In partnership with Medical Affairs, Clinical Operations, and Data Sciences (R&D), this leader will also enhance and maintain data governance frameworks that support clinical research initiatives and the responsible use of data for quality improvement and development activities. Together, these efforts will help strengthen Natera’s privacy program, building efficient, repeatable processes that expand team capacity while enabling responsible innovation and growth.

Regarding culture, we seek people who demonstrate Natera's values, enjoy challenging problems, empower others to thrive, lead by example, and adapt their playbook when necessary.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Privacy Program Enablement

  • Lead privacy impact assessments, regulatory analyses, and risk-based recommendations that balance compliance with business enablement

  • Conduct privacy reviews of contracts and legal engagements, drafting recommendations for counsel review, alignment, and approval

  • Apply a risk-based lens to enable business decisions

  • Build efficient, repeatable processes and tooling that scale program capacity within a resource-constrained team

  • Provide direction and mentorship to team members and external resources as the program scales

Privacy Integration & Engineering

  • Serve as the integration point between Privacy and Product/Engineering, embedding privacy-by-design into product and software development lifecycles

  • Partner with technical teams to translate privacy requirements into practical controls, patterns, and reusable technical solutions

  • Support privacy engineering practices that operationalize compliance without slowing delivery

Data Use Governance & Decision Frameworks

  • Implement standardized, risk-based frameworks for data access, sharing, secondary use, and commercial/partnership data usage

  • Drive consistency in how data use decisions are evaluated, approved, and documented across the organization

Data Ethics & Responsible Data Use

  • Operationalize guardrails for use of sensitive and regulated data, AI/ML training data, and advanced analytics

  • Embed ethical considerations into governance processes and decision-making

Commercial & Clinical Data Ecosystem Governance

  • Govern data flows and usage across marketing/advertising technologies, commercial partnerships, and third-party data sharing

  • Serve as the embedded privacy partner for Medical Affairs and Clinical Operations, advising on privacy requirements for clinical research protocols, clinical trials, real-world evidence studies, and secondary use of clinical data

  • Collaborate with Clinical Operations to ensure data flows and consent frameworks align with applicable regulations (HIPAA, IRB requirements, GCP guidelines) and internal governance standards

  • Support privacy for clinical research, clinical trials, and secondary research use of data

  • Enable business teams to leverage data responsibly while minimizing regulatory and reputational risk

  • General healthcare compliance background (e.g., fraud, waste & abuse, Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute, Sunshine Act)

  • Experience working across commercial, clinical, and product/technology environments

  • Familiarity with AI/ML and advanced analytics governance concepts as they relate to data use and ethics

  • Strong ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across functions

  • Experience leading, mentoring, or managing privacy professionals or cross-functional teams

  • Experience with program management and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Google Workspace)

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • A systems thinker who connects fragmented processes into cohesive, scalable solutions

jobs.title: AI Industry Associate/Lead
jobs.excerpt: The Future of Life Institute (FLI) is hiring an AI Industry Associate/Lead to develop a vision for a pro-human path for AI development, framed around controllable, verifiable, human-centered AI tools, as opposed to the development and adoption of maximally autonomous general AI systems.
jobs.description:
The Future of Life Institute (FLI) is hiring an AI Industry Associate/Lead to develop a vision for a pro-human path for AI development, framed around controllable, verifiable, human-centered AI tools, as opposed to the development and adoption of maximally autonomous general AI systems. The AI Industry Associate/Lead will engage with policy makers on how AI innovation and safety regulation can go hand in hand.

We are open to hiring a range of seniorities for this role. Exact title and scope will reflect the successful candidate's experience.

This role will report to our Head of European Policy and Research.

Who we are

FLI educates and engages lawmakers, key stakeholders, and the general public about transformative technologies and their implications. We advocate for policies and approaches that mitigate catastrophic risks while advancing positive futures for humanity.

Humanity stands at a fork in the road with AI. One path races to replace humans as creators, caregivers, decision-makers, and workers—threatening our economy, security, civil liberties, democracy, and the human experience. But a better path exists: trustworthy, controllable AI tools that amplify human capability, strengthen institutions, and help us solve problems we cannot solve alone.

This role will focus on developing and advocating a credible strategy for AI that does not depend on building maximally general, autonomous systems to replace humans wholesale. Instead, we can build an economically powerful alternative rooted in reliable, verifiable, controllable, human-directed, and purpose-driven AI.

As AI Industry Associate/Lead, you will:

    • Strategy development (as Lead): Develop a rigorous argument that a credible AI strategy need not depend on building or adopting maximally general, autonomous AI systems.

    • Tracking industry developments: Monitor and support non-hyperscaling technical paths. This includes the development of efficient/smaller models, open-source and open-science AI, physical AI/robotics, and high-value industrial and scientific data applications.

    • Engage stakeholders and build coalitions: Interface with policymakers interested in exploring sovereign AI strategies including Brazil, Canada, EU Member States and its AI Office in Brussels.

    • Translate strategy into concrete asks: Produce policy-ready recommendations for policymakers.

Required qualifications:

    • Experienced technology strategist, ideally in AI policy. This could be within industry, at a start up, or within the policy space.

    • Sufficient technical fluency in advanced AI — capabilities trajectories, agentic systems, evaluation and verification methods — to engage credibly with technical experts and to hold a position against the prevailing scaling consensus.

    • Experience engaging policymakers outside of the US and China, or a demonstrated capacity to do so.

Required skills and qualities:

    • Excellent written and spoken communication, able to produce policy-ready analysis and to represent FLI in expert and/or high-level settings.

    • Proven experience translating technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

    • Stakeholder management and partnership building skills, ideally across institutions, industry and international partners.

    • Independence and initiative — comfortable owning a strategy line and moving quickly in a fast-changing field.

    • Alignment with FLI's mission of mitigating catastrophic risk while advancing positive futures.

Preferred qualifications, skills and qualities:

    • A graduate degree in a relevant field — economics, computer science, or a technical AI discipline.

    • Previous experience at a tech start up, or similar experience of how things get done in the technology industry.

    • Background in, or close knowledge of, a safety-sensitive industrial sector where reliability is a hard operational requirement rather than a preference.

    • An existing network among frontier AI researchers and relevant policymakers.

Location: We are happy to consider candidates in any location, but would have a preference for those based in or willing to relocate to Europe.

Application Deadline: 15th November 2026. We may move this role to rolling applications after this deadline.

Start Date: We'd like the chosen candidate to start as soon as possible after accepting an offer.

Application Process: Apply by uploading your resume, alongside a short answer to the following questions:

  • In 200 words or less, please describe a time when you successfully persuaded a group of people to change course. What was your strategy and what actions did you take concretely?

  • In 200 words or less, how can and should states not exporting major AI models pursue "sovereign AI"?

Please apply via our website. Email applications are not accepted.

FLI aims to be an inclusive organization. We proactively seek job applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. If you are passionate about FLI’s mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role even though you may not check all the boxes, please still apply. We would appreciate the opportunity to consider your application.

Questions may be directed to .

About the Future of Life Institute

Founded in 2014, FLI is an independent non-profit working to steer transformative technology towards benefitting life and away from extreme large-scale risks. Our work includes grantmaking, educational outreach, and policy engagement.

Our work has been featured widely, including in The Washington Post, Politico, Vox, Forbes, The Guardian, the BBC, The Economist and Wired.

Some of our achievements include:

  • Superintelligence Statement, an open letter calling for a prohibition on the development of superintelligent AI until there is strong public buy-in and scientific consensus that it can be developed safely and controllably. The letter has been signed by more than 130,000 people, including Yoshua Bengio, Geoffrey Hinton, Steve Wozniak, Richard Branson, Steve Bannon, Prince Harry and Susan Rice.

  • The Asilomar AI Principles, one of the earliest and most influential sets of AI governance principles.

  • The Pro-Human AI Declaration, a document with five guidelines on how AI development must be centred on humanity first, created during a meeting of bipartisan civil society groups spanning faith, labour, and think tanks.

  • How would a nuclear war between Russia and the US affect you personally?- A scientifically accurate simulation showing the consequences of nuclear war, with over 6 millions views and a feature in Time Magazine.

  • AI Safety Index - an objective rating of AI companies on key safety and security domains, as judged by experts in the field.

FLI is a largely virtual organization, with a team of approximately 40 distributed internationally, mostly in Europe and the US. We have four offices: Campbell in California, Brussels in Belgium, London in the UK, and Washington DC. We meet in person as a full team twice a year.

Nitro is an AI-native data platform that democratizes life sciences data for non-technical commercial teams, turning fragmented HCP/HCO, prescription, and industry data into decisions the field can act on. We're looking for a QA Engineer to drive quality for the platform and help modernize how we test it. Here, testing isn't a gate bolted onto the end of shipping, it's part of the same function as building and deploying. You'll own your share of that full chain. This is a junior role for someone who wants to build a real career in QA and automation. You'll start hands-on with day-to-day testing and grow into broader ownership of our test automation as you develop. We're investing in making our testing environment more AI-forward, and you'll have real room to shape and extend that work, not just maintain what exists. The function itself is evolving, too: our Operations org is moving from traditional QA toward evaluating AI-native systems, and this role is your entry point into where that's headed.

  • Own day-to-day QA across releases: new data connectors, schema changes, customer rollouts, platform upgrades, ensuring changes are solid before they reach customers
  • Help cut down false-failure noise in the test suite and improve how efficiently it runs, so the team can trust what it's telling them
  • Get close enough to the business logic behind our data pipelines to know not just whether a test passes, but whether it's testing the right thing
  • Build new automations as new features roll out

Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

The Senior GIS Developer is a member of the GIS Development team responsible for building and supporting GIS solutions that enable Zayo’s business and network operations. The role works primarily with our custom QGIS Application, ESRI ArcGIS technologies, enterprise databases, and related business systems to deliver desktop and web-based mapping capabilities.


This GIS ecosystem along with other fiber management tools is core to Zayo’s architecture and fundamentally supports the company’s overall business strategy. The ideal candidate combines strong GIS and software-development skills with sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and support server-based geoprocessing tools and automated data-update processes using Python and SQL.
  • Build QGIS plugins and custom forms using Python/PyQGIS and Qt-based interfaces to support data acquisition, editing, validation, geoprocessing, and system integration.
  • Manage, Deploy and Support our Zayo QGIS Custom Plugins and work closely with the GIS Principle Software Engineer on the innovation of these tools, system integration and architecture diagrams.
  • Designing and implementing organization-wide GIS Standards for all Server, Cloud, Web, Desktop products and enterprise database structures we support.
  • Build and maintain FME Flow or Python-based ETL and scheduled data-processing workflows that automate mapping, data-management, and recurring GIS operations.
  • Develop and maintain network-routing solutions using shortest-path algorithms while accounting for complex dependencies, constraints, and business parameters.
  • Produce clear technical documentation, coding standards, workflow guidance, and training materials; provide knowledge transfer through demonstrations or remote training sessions.
  • Contribute to software-development activities throughout the development lifecycle, working collaboratively within an Agile/Scrum team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Geography/GIS, Computer Science, or a closely related discipline with a strong foundation in geographic concepts and principles.
  • Minimum of five to seven (5–7) years of relevant GIS and software-development experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python for GIS automation, geoprocessing, ArcGIS web applications, REST services, and network-analysis workflows.
  • Understanding of SDLC practices, source control, testing, debugging, and maintainable code design; strong analytical skills and attention to data quality.
  • Strong knowledge of algorithms, data structures, data modeling, and distributed systems, with practical experience applying these concepts to network and spatial problems.
  • Proficiency with Esri’s ArcGIS platform, including desktop, online, server, enterprise database, vector-data, geoprocessing, and spatial-analysis capabilities.
  • Strong web-development skills using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with experience working with ArcGIS JavaScript APIs, Web AppBuilder, ArcGIS Server services, and other relevant API libraries.
  • Experience designing or consuming APIs and integrating GIS with external business or operational systems.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills, with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, preferably PostgreSQL/PostGIS, plus solid knowledge of vector data, geoprocessing, spatial analysis, coordinate systems, and topology.
  • Experience with telecommunications, outside plant (OSP), fiber network inventory, route planning, or network design.
  • Hands-on experience with QGIS and PyQGIS; experience creating plugins, custom processing tools, forms, or workflow extensions.
  • Experience leading user training, writing technical process documentation, or supporting GIS users across multiple teams.

Our client, a new Silicon Valley based profitable B2C product startup building innovative mobile solutions for the planet, is now looking for a talented and experienced Engineering Manager to run the operations team.

﻿﻿

Location: Ukraine\Poland, Europe﻿
Type: Remote, Full-time
Start date: ASAP
About project and role:

Based in Silicon Valley and backed by top-tier venture capital, we build consumer technology products that help millions of people stay secure, private, and connected online.
Our flagship VPN product serves over 10 million monthly active users across mobile and desktop platforms. With additional products in development, it were scaling globally and investing heavily in product quality, performance, and growth.

The company is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the Operations team — the team responsible for a large-scale server fleet spanning thousands of servers across dozens of countries and multiple hosting providers, serving millions of users. ﻿The role is open in Poland and Ukraine; strong candidates from elsewhere in Eastern Europe will also be considered. Working hours follow CET (±2h), with travel expected once or twice a year for team workshops.

The Engineering Manager will own what the team delivers. That means leading the engineers, building on-call and incident management that works around the clock, keeping fleet reliability, utilization, and cost visible in numbers, and serving as the primary point of contact for R&D and the business on anything that touches infrastructure. The role reports to the Head of Engineering & Operations.

This is a management role with a technical backbone. The Engineering Manager will not be the deepest engineer in the room — the team has that depth — but needs enough technical grounding to make good calls, challenge the team, and step in when it matters.

What you'll do:﻿

  • ﻿﻿Lead the Operations team: priorities, 1:1s, growth and performance — and own the outcomes
  • Build and run on-call and incident management: 24/7 coverage on a paid weekly rotation, severity levels, clear communication, blameless postmortems. You are the escalation point, not a link in the base rotation
  • Make alerting mean something: less noise, every page tied to an action, runbooks and automation for the fixes that keep repeating
  • Organize how Operations works day to day — team meetings, planning cadence and the processes between them — and run the async standups across R&D and Operations, clearing blockers before they turn into delays
  • Shape how Operations works as an engineering team — practices, standards and habits, not just processes
  • Plan Operations work together with the Head of Engineering & Operations, product management, R&D and the business
  • Coordinate staged infrastructure rollouts with the mobile and backend teams
  • Take part in RFCs and reviews of changes that touch infrastructure
  • Work with our vendor lead on capacity planning and fleet cost across multiple hosting providers; keep utilization, reliability and cost visible in numbers
  • Stay hands-on when it matters: a hard incident, a design review, a change you want to understand before it ships
  • Use and evaluate AI tooling as part of the workflow — we use it across operations, code review and research﻿

The stack you will work with:

﻿﻿Linux on bare metal across multiple hosting providers, multi-IP networking; WireGuard, OpenVPN and IKEv2; Ansible, Terraform, CI/CD and provisioning automation; Prometheus, Loki and Grafana, Grafana OnCall, ClickHouse.

Wath you bring:﻿

  • 2+ years formally managing an infrastructure or DevOps team — 1:1s, performance and priorities, not technical leadership alone
  • 5+ years of hands-on engineering in infrastructure, DevOps or SRE
  • Comfortable with Linux, networking and infrastructure-as-code at the level of reviewing a change, not writing one every day
  • You have organized on-call before: set up or reshaped a rotation and an incident process, and lived with the results
  • Experience running infrastructure at scale on bare metal across multiple data centers and hosting providers. A single public cloud alone is not enough
  • Startup or scale-up experience: you have built processes where none existed, kept calm when priorities moved, switched from an incident to a vendor call in the same hour, and thought about cost per server
  • You take ownership. You do not need someone above you to make the call; you make it and stand behind it
  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing) — enough to challenge the team and debug alongside them when needed
  • Fluent in English (Upper-Intermediate or above) — ﻿you will run meetings and write for the whole company every day

Highly Valued:﻿

  • A track record of measurably improving reliability or cost — fewer incidents, shorter recovery, lower cost per server
  • Hands-on experience with VPN or tunnelling protocols (WireGuard, OpenVPN, IPsec/IKEv2) and traffic obfuscation
  • Infrastructure security and compliance: hardening, audits, SOC 2-style controls
  • Prometheus, Loki and Grafana, Grafana OnCall, ClickHouse
    • Ansible, Terraform and CI/CD for provisioning at fleet scale

Why This Role:﻿﻿﻿

  • Scale that is real: millions of users on thousands of servers across dozens of countries and multiple hosting providers. The problems are not hypothetical
  • On-call, incident management and the team's operating rhythm are yours to build
  • A short reporting line to the Head of Engineering & Operations; decisions do not wait

jobs.description:
The Data Analyst for Value-Based Insights (VBI) is responsible for transforming Medicare (CMS) claims data into metrics, benchmarks, and measures that power WellSky's VBI product for Home Health and Hospice providers and payers. This role builds and maintains claims-based data extracts and performance measures, translates CMS methodologies and regulatory rules into production analytics, and partners with product and engineering to deliver trusted, data-driven insights. The work is retrospective, methodology-driven, and directly tied to how agencies measure and improve value-based performance.

Location: This is a remote position. Candidates located within 50 miles of WellSky’s headquarters in Overland Park, KS will join our WHQ community and participate in our in-office collaboration experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain claims-based data extracts and measures from CMS data sources, including the Chronic Conditions Warehouse (CCW) and Limited Data Set (LDS), to support VBI Home Health and Hospice solutions.
  • Develop and maintain performance measures such as HHVBP claims-based measures, MSPB-PAC, Functional Items, hospitalization/ER/PPH/DTC rates, utilization and efficiency metrics, length of stay, and composite/percentile scores.
  • Interpret CMS regulations and annual Final Rules (e.g., HHVBP methodology, eTPS calculations) and translate measure specifications into accurate, reproducible SQL logic.
  • Write and optimize SQL against large claims datasets in BigQuery; contribute to data pipelines, quarterly lookup-table refreshes, and extract automation.
  • Produce referral pattern, competitive analysis, market/benchmark extracts, and validate outputs against CMS public benchmarks (e.g., Home Health Compare) and client expectations.
  • Investigate data quality issues and metric discrepancies, and document methodology, data sources, and assumptions so results are auditable and repeatable.
  • Prepare data for downstream BI/visualization layers (e.g., Sisense) and collaborate with product managers and engineers to define technical requirements and analytical interpretations.
  • Perform other job duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications:  

  • Bachelor's degree in quantitative, health-informatics, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 2–4 years of experience in data analysis, with demonstrated proficiency in SQL against large, complex datasets.
  • Direct experience working with Medicare/CMS claims data (e.g., CCW, LDS, LDS/RIF files, or comparable claims sources).
  • Comfort with healthcare claims coding structures (e.g., ICD, HCPCS/CPT, revenue codes, DRGs).
  • Ability to translate written specifications or methodologies into analytical logic and validate results for accuracy.

 

Preferred Qualifications:     

  • Knowledge of Home Health and/or Hospice operations, post-acute care, or value-based care programs (e.g., HHVBP, HHVBP eTPS, hospice HIS/HOPE).
  • Experience with CMS quality/value-based program methodologies and familiarity with reading CMS regulations/Final Rules.
  • Hands-on experience with BigQuery (or a comparable cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake) and a BI tool such as Sisense, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Familiarity with risk adjustment or benchmarking concepts.
  • Scripting experience (e.g., Python) for data transformation and automation.

Job Expectations:

  • Willing to work additional or irregular hours as needed, particularly around quarterly CMS data refreshes and annual Final Rule cycles.
  • Must work in accordance with applicable security and HIPAA policies to safeguard company and client protected health information.
