jobs.description:
The Principal AI Search & Conversation Architect will be responsible for designing and leading the architecture of a next-generation conversational AI platform that replaces traditional search with intelligent dialogue. This role owns the systems that understand user intent, determine what information is needed to satisfy a request, retrieve data from multiple real-time providers, reason across competing options, and generate conversational responses that lead users from discovery to transaction.

The successful candidate will architect the AI orchestration layer that coordinates multiple large language models, specialized agents, retrieval systems, recommendation engines, and external APIs into a single seamless conversational experience. Rather than returning lists of search results, the platform will assemble and rank information from ticketing providers, hotels, airlines, restaurants, transportation services, mapping platforms, weather services, and other third-party data sources, presenting recommendations through natural conversation.

This role requires deep experience designing AI-native systems capable of planning multi-step tasks, maintaining conversational context, coordinating tool execution, ranking competing results, and continuously adapting recommendations based on user feedback throughout a conversation.

The Principal Architect will define the technical vision, establish architectural standards, evaluate emerging AI technologies, mentor senior engineers, and make long-term decisions regarding LLM strategy, retrieval architecture, agent design, memory management, semantic search, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and AI evaluation frameworks.

The position requires extensive experience building large-scale distributed systems, production AI platforms, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), multi-agent orchestration, function calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), recommendation systems, API orchestration, prompt architecture, conversation state management, personalization, and low-latency cloud infrastructure. Experience with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, open-source language models, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, DSPy, vector databases, graph databases, and modern AI infrastructure is highly desirable.

The Principal AI Search & Conversation Architect will work closely with the company’s other Principal Architects responsible for backend infrastructure, payments, blockchain, messaging, mini-programs, and platform services to ensure the conversational platform integrates seamlessly across the entire ecosystem while maintaining exceptional scalability, reliability, performance, and user experience.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience architecting and delivering production-scale AI platforms used by large numbers of users.
  • Demonstrated leadership as a Principal Engineer, Chief Architect, Distinguished Engineer, or equivalent senior technical role.
  • Deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, multi-agent systems, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, and modern AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of recommendation engines, ranking algorithms, personalization, and conversational AI.
  • Extensive experience designing distributed, cloud-native systems capable of operating at global scale with high availability and low latency.
  • Hands-on experience integrating complex third-party APIs and building systems that combine multiple real-time data sources into a unified experience.
  • Exceptional architectural judgment with the ability to simplify complex technical problems into scalable, maintainable solutions.
  • Proven ability to lead senior engineering teams, mentor architects and principal engineers, establish engineering standards, and make long-term technical decisions.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across engineering, product, and executive leadership.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for building category-defining products and solving problems that have not been solved before.
  • A track record of shipping ambitious, innovative products rather than simply maintaining existing platforms.

Solutions not problems .

  • Creative problem solver who can courageously propose and support new ideas to our organization. Not interested in best practices, lets build something better!
  • Ability to adapt. An ideal candidate will welcome the opportunity to solve a broad range of problems using a wide array of technologies.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities and general growing pains of an early-stage technology company
  • An exceptional entrepreneurial judgment that fosters independence over micro-management
  • Understanding of football and international sports a huge plus

Ole Ole is located in beautiful Austin Texas, however, this role requires some travel we are privately held and rapidly growing!

Build the AI that replaces search with conversation.

AskOle is building something fundamentally different from today’s ticket exchanges, online travel agencies, and search engines.

Today, users do all the work. They search, filter, compare, open dozens of tabs, read reviews, check maps, compare hotels, look for restaurants, and try to figure out the best option.

We’re eliminating that entire experience.

A fan should simply say:

“I need two tickets for Manchester United vs Arsenal on Saturday.”

AskOle responds naturally:

“I found four excellent ticket options based on value and location. Since you’re traveling from London, would you like me to recommend hotels within walking distance of Old Trafford? I also found several restaurants that match your preferences and the best pub for pre-match atmosphere. I can book everything together in one transaction.”

That conversation replaces hundreds of clicks.

We’re looking for the Principal Architect who will build the intelligence behind that experience.

What You’ll Build

You’ll architect the AI orchestration layer that powers every AskOle conversation.

This is not another chatbot.

You’ll build a conversational commerce platform capable of understanding intent, gathering information from dozens of independent systems, reasoning over the results, ranking recommendations, asking intelligent follow-up questions, and delivering answers that feel like speaking to an expert concierge.

The platform will combine live inventory from ticket providers, hotels, airlines, restaurants, transportation, hospitality providers, maps, weather, events, reviews, and future partners into a single conversational experience.

The user never searches.

The AI does.

No pathetic AI inflated resumes or using someone else's resume

OleOle is building a global football super app combining social networking, messaging, live scores, short-form video, gambling, commerce, payments, translation, and mini programs into a single ecosystem focused entirely on football.

The vision is to create the first true “WeChat for football” — a platform where fans, clubs, brands, leagues, sportsbooks, creators, and merchants can communicate, transact, and engage directly inside one global environment.

Unlike traditional social media platforms, OleOle is built specifically for sports fans and designed around communication, real-time engagement, commerce, and community.

The platform combines elements of:

  • Twitter/X style social conversation
  • TikTok-style short-form video
  • WhatsApp-style messaging
  • live score platforms
  • programmable commerce
  • mini program ecosystems similar to WeChat

All integrated into a single football-first platform.

Core Platform Vision

OleOle is designed around several key ideas:

Communication First

Fans can communicate directly with:

  • clubs
  • brands
  • sportsbooks
  • creators
  • media companies
  • other fans

through follows, messaging, sharing, comments, and real-time translated conversations.

Mini Program Ecosystem

OleOle is building a mini program platform that allows brands and partners to launch experiences directly inside the platform without requiring fans to download separate applications.

Initial mini program categories include:

  • Games
  • News
  • Merchandise
  • Ticket Sales
  • VIP Hospitality
  • Gambling

Fans can:

  • follow or unfollow mini programs
  • communicate directly with brands
  • share mini programs with friends
  • receive translated content automatically

Brands can communicate directly with followers within platform communication limits designed to prevent spam and preserve user experience.

Real-Time Translation

A core component of the platform is AI-driven real-time translation across conversations, content, video, messaging, and mini programs.

The goal is to remove language barriers between global football fans and allow mini programs to operate across dozens of languages automatically.

This creates a global communication layer connecting fans, clubs, brands, and creators worldwide.

Wallet + Payments Infrastructure

OleOle includes an integrated Wallet ID and payment infrastructure powering:

  • commerce
  • rewards
  • gambling
  • digital collectibles
  • mini program transactions
  • creator payouts

The platform is designed around programmable commerce and frictionless fan engagement.

Technology Stack

OleOle is being built as a native Rust platform focused on:

  • scalability
  • performance
  • real-time communication
  • low-latency systems
  • global infrastructure
  • payments
  • social engagement
  • video delivery

The company is also building:

  • AI translation systems
  • football history AI infrastructure
  • developer platforms
  • mini program tooling
  • programmable payment rails

The Long-Term Vision

OleOle’s long-term vision is to become the global operating system for football fans:

  • social networking
  • communication
  • commerce
  • gaming
  • gambling
  • content
  • ticketing
  • rewards
  • programmable fan experiences

all inside one interconnected ecosystem.

OleOle – Where Fans Kick Off

jobs.description:
Game Engineer (remote, contract-to-hire, Latin America)

Location: Latin America preferred (remote)

Reports to: Director of Technical Production

Engagement type: Full-time contract (40 hours/week), 5–6 months, with the intent to convert to a long-term role

Language requirement: Professional or fluent in English; Spanish preferred

About Endless Access

Our vision is simple: the whole world, empowered.

Endless Access works to close the global digital divide by helping young people in underserved communities become creators of technology, not only consumers of it. Our learning programs teach a new generation to design and build their own games and digital projects using free, open-source tools, delivered through mentors, instructors, and partners around the world.

These learning programs center around our flagship game, Threadbare. Students develop their skills and ambitions as they transition from playing the game to helping build it. Threadbare is developed in the open, by our Games team and a growing community of contributors. As our programs reach more learners in more regions, we are growing the team that keeps the game stable, fun, and welcoming to the people learning to build it.

About the Role

Endless Access is seeking a mid-level Game Engineer, based in Latin America, to join our Games team and help build Threadbare, an open-source, community-built narrative adventure game made with the Godot engine. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will ship features, fix issues, and help keep the game stable, performant, and fun to play.

You will work closely with our senior game engineer as well as our creative director, producer, and contributor community. Most of your time will go to game development on the Threadbare roadmap. A smaller part of the role connects you with our learning programs, where you will guide learners who are building the game alongside us.

This is a 5–6 month contract, and we are hiring with the clear intent of finding someone we would want on the team long term.

If you enjoy working in an existing codebase, care about how changes feel to players, and like helping newer developers grow, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Game Development (60%)

  • Build and ship gameplay features, UI, and systems, from design spec to release.
  • Fix bugs and improve performance, stability, and load times.
  • Work with design and art to turn ideas into playable builds, and give feedback on feasibility and scope.
  • Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and take part in code reviews with the team.
  • Estimate your work, flag risks early, and keep the team informed through planning and regular updates.
  • Contribute to the tools, pipelines, and documentation that make the team faster.

Learning and Community (40%)

  • Review code from learners in our game development programs and give clear, encouraging written feedback.
  • Collaborate with our Learning Experience team on tooling that supports our game development curriculum, as the roadmap allows.
  • Join occasional community events, such as game jams and livestreams.

Skills and Experience

Essential

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering, including hands-on work on shipped or live games.
  • Experience shipping or maintaining a released game or live product as part of a team, working alongside other engineers, designers, and artists.
  • Comfortable with Git-based workflows, code review, and working in an existing codebase.
  • Willingness to mentor early-career game developers by reviewing their code and giving written feedback.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially in a remote, asynchronous team.
  • Familiarity with open-source communities and contribution practices.
  • Able to work independently and to ask for help at the right time.
  • Professional or fluent English.

Desirable

  • Experience with the Godot engine (GDScript)
  • Accessibility or inclusive design experience in games.
  • Experience with learning or educational games.
  • Familiarity with analytics, live ops, or build and CI pipelines.
  • Spanish ability.
  • An interest in our mission to expand access to technology.

How We Work

Endless Access is a fully distributed, global nonprofit. Most of the team works remotely and asynchronously across many countries, and this role is no exception: it is fully remote and based in Latin America, collaborating daily with teammates and contributors across multiple time zones, much of it in writing, in code review, and over video. We are looking for someone who thrives in a self-directed, cross-cultural environment, and who communicates clearly and openly in writing.

Not Sure You Meet 100% of the Requirements?

Studies show that women and people from underrepresented backgrounds often hesitate to apply unless they meet every listed qualification. Building a truly inclusive digital future means bringing together diverse perspectives and experiences; if you are excited about this role and our mission to expand access to technology, we strongly encourage you to apply even if you do not check every box. Your perspective could be exactly what we need.

Endless is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who share our passion for games, education, and creating opportunities for underserved learners. Endless provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

🎭 About the role

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our Billing team and help shape how CSPs bill, collect, and get paid in gaiia. You’ll design clear, durable experiences for invoicing, payments, discounts, and collections, working closely with product and engineering to go from problem to shipped solution.

You’ll work from user research, customer feedback, support tickets and conversations with our implementation team, and you’ll prototype quickly to test ideas with your squad before they ship. The goal is to make billing simpler, faster and more trustworthy for operators and their subscribers. You’ll also help evolve our Boréal design system so we can keep shipping consistently high-quality experiences as we scale.

  • Transparent charges: You’ll make charges and adjustments easy to explain for the people who answer for them. Think proration and clawback visibility, invoice detail, and previews before generation.
  • Flows across personas: One billing event moves through a CSP admin, a support agent, and the subscriber. You’ll design the journey between them. Think checkout, collections, client portal, and the communications that connect them.

Leidos Energy is seeking an accomplished Senior Proposal Manager to lead complex, strategic, high-value, high-visibility, and high-risk commercial pursuits.


This individual will lead cross-functional proposal teams and serve as a strategic partner to Growth/Business Development, technical and operational leadership, pricing, contracts, and senior stakeholders.

The Senior Proposal Manager will drive teams toward cohesive, customer-focused winning strategies that differentiate Leidos while ensuring full compliance with customer requirements. Success requires the ability to lead experienced and senior professionals with differing technical, business, or strategic perspectives; respectfully challenge assumptions; facilitate decisions; and maintain momentum with urgency and purpose.

The successful candidate will have deep knowledge of industry-standard proposal management practices, governance, compliance, and quality and be able to articulate the purpose and business value of proposal activities, including color reviews, risk and pricing reviews, compliance reviews, and quality reviews. This individual must apply these practices intelligently based on the needs of the pursuit rather than simply following process.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead complex, strategic, high-value, high-visibility, and/or high-risk commercial pursuits from pre-proposal planning through submission and post-submittal activities.
  • Lead cross-functional teams, establishing clear expectations, accountability, decision points, and momentum throughout the pursuit.
  • Serve as proposal strategy lead and strategic partner to Growth/Business Development, senior engineers and technical leaders, operations, pricing, contracts, and leadership.
  • Navigate differing perspectives, respectfully challenge assumptions, and drive timely decisions that strengthen the solution and Leidos' competitive position.
  • Translate customer requirements, competitive intelligence, technical solutions, and business objectives into a cohesive, customer-focused proposal strategy.
  • Lead development of compelling win themes, discriminators, value propositions, proof points, and messaging that clearly communicate why Leidos' solution is different and why that difference matters to the customer.
  • Analyze RFPs, RFQs, RFIs, and other commercial solicitations to identify requirements, evaluation criteria, risks, gaps, dependencies, and strategic response considerations.
  • Own proposal compliance and establish proposal structure, schedules, compliance matrices, content plans, author assignments, review plans, checkpoints, and decision points.
  • Lead kickoffs, solutioning and strategy sessions, color/team reviews, recovery activities, senior-level reviews, and final quality reviews.
  • Tailor proposal processes and governance based on opportunity value, complexity, competitive position, risk, schedule, and customer expectations while maintaining required compliance and quality.
  • Provide clear, constructive guidance to authors, engineers, SMEs, and leaders to improve responsiveness, differentiation, customer focus, and proposal quality.
  • Ensure technical, management, contractual, risk, and pricing strategies align with the overall proposal strategy.
  • Identify execution, compliance, strategy, and schedule risks early; develop recovery plans; and elevate issues requiring leadership decisions.
  • Maintain team focus and momentum through challenging schedules, competing priorities, ambiguity, and changing customer requirements.
  • Mentor proposal contributors and support continuous improvement of proposal processes, governance, templates, tools, training, and best practices, including lessons learned.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree with at least eight (8) years of relevant proposal, business development, or related experience, including significant experience leading complex commercial proposals. Additional relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree, consistent with Leidos requirements for the position level.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, strategic, high-value, high-visibility, and/or high-risk pursuits through the complete proposal lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence senior engineers, technical leaders, and business leaders; navigate competing viewpoints; facilitate difficult discussions; establish alignment; and drive timely decisions.
  • Strong understanding of commercial procurement, competitive proposal development, customer evaluation processes, and proposal strategy.
  • Demonstrated expertise translating customer requirements, competitive positioning, technical solutions, and business objectives into compelling, differentiated proposal strategies and content.
  • Expert knowledge of proposal compliance, lifecycle processes, and governance, including compliance matrices, color/team reviews, risk and pricing reviews, review checkpoints, and final quality reviews.
  • Ability to articulate the purpose and business value of proposal processes and gain team commitment to the appropriate level of rigor.
  • Strong experience developing win themes, discriminators, value propositions, executive summaries, proof points, and customer-focused messaging.
  • Strong leadership, facilitation, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to respectfully challenge senior stakeholders and drive accountability and results.
  • Expert Microsoft Word skills and exceptional written, verbal, editing, and presentation preparation capabilities.
  • Ability to synthesize complex technical and business information and communicate it clearly and persuasively.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead geographically dispersed, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced commercial environment with rapid-turn pursuits and multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, and SharePoint.
  • Due to the nature of the role, U.S. Citizenship is required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • APMP, Shipley, SMPS, or other recognized proposal-management certification.
  • Experience supporting engineering, energy, infrastructure, utilities, or other complex commercial/technical markets.
  • Significant experience leading large or strategically important commercial pursuits.
  • Experience in high-volume, fast-paced commercial proposal environments requiring speed, agility, customer focus, and disciplined decision-making.
  • Experience leading senior-level proposal strategy sessions, color reviews, and recovery efforts.
  • Experience developing scalable or tiered proposal processes based on opportunity size, complexity, risk, and schedule.
  • Experience mentoring technical staff new to proposal development.
  • Experience with electronic procurement and proposal submission portals.
  • Experience leading or supporting live orals, presentations, and/or demonstrations.

We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

jobs.description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are pioneers at heart. What this means, is that we are always leaning forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating.

Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 20+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients' problems, no matter where you are in the world.

ABOUT YOU

As an Account Manager, Programmatic, you will support the execution and optimization of programmatic campaigns within our retail vertical. You’ll work closely with Account Leads, Coordinators, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality work, drive performance, and ensure strong client satisfaction. You bring a mix of strategic thinking, operational excellence, and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate closely with internal teams to deliver client-first recommendations and programmatic best practices.
  • Manage day-to-day campaign execution, optimizations, pacing, and reporting.
  • Support the development and presentation of programmatic strategy to improve client performance.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through clear communication and timely updates.
  • Identify performance trends, troubleshoot issues, and apply data-driven insights.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to Coordinators, helping them grow in their roles.
  • Contribute to a positive team culture by demonstrating our core values.
  • Bring forward new ideas, tools, and approaches to push innovation and improve workflow.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of programmatic media experience, ideally across CTV, Display, and Video; exposure to Native, Audio, or OOH is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience in retail marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, Target, or Best Buy.
  • Proficiency in major DSPs (TTD & DV360 preferred) and familiarity with Ad Servers.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Experience training or guiding junior team members is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

WHAT IMPRESSES US

  • Experience in supporting campaign management in Google Ads (GDA and YouTube) and/or Amazon DSP
  • Comfort with advanced functions in Excel and/or Google Sheets functions
  • Proactivity, creativity, and enthusiasm; demonstrating you’re eager to roll up your sleeves and be hands on, learn, and grow
  • An exceptional eye for detail
  • Love for working with numbers and uncovering trends

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our benefits package:

  • Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • 401k plan, plus matching
  • PTO
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Parental Leave

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a pioneering technology and marketing services company that creates integrated end-to-end digital experiences for brands such as Google, KFC, Philips, Audi, Twitch, Patagonia, eBay and more. Its team of 2,500+ digital specialists across 30+ locations on 5 continents delivers pioneering work on a global scale with a boutique culture.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

jobs.description:
Na Zup, acreditamos que o futuro é construído por pessoas que desafiam o presente. Nosso propósito é criar tecnologias que transformam o mercado e elevam a experiência dos nossos clientes.

Você será responsável por liderar decisões complexas de arquitetura, definir padrões de engenharia para múltiplas equipes, otimizar integrações de infraestrutura e garantir a resiliência operacional, além de fomentar ativamente a cultura de excelência técnica através de mentoria.

O que esperamos que você saiba

  • Desenvolvimento avançado em Java 11+ utilizando Spring Boot, Spring Cloud e Spring Data.

  • Construção de integrações eficientes com mensageria (Kafka/RabbitMQ) e bancos de dados (Postgres, Redis e MongoDB).

O que acontece após minha aplicação na vaga interna?

Confirmada sua candidatura e analisado que seu perfil faz sentido para a posição escolhida, comunicaremos via e-mail a liderança e BP imediatos sobre sua aplicação em seleção interna.

jobs.description:
Job Description

The Opportunity:


In this position, the Sponsored Research Contract Administrator will manage pre and post award activities for an assigned portfolio of contracts within the Office of Sponsored Research unit using knowledge of contract management rules and regulations, financial budget management, technical expertise, and analytical skills, including guidance on what issues may present a compliance liability to the university. Serve as a liaison among university administration, principal investigators, faculty, staff, and funding agency representatives. Responsible for providing guidance to principal investigators regarding federal and non-federal contract administration, including but not limited to adherence to FAR, DFAR, Part 2 CFR 200 of the Uniform Guidance and other government regulations including applicable policies, procedures, rules and regulations of the university and sponsoring agency. Responsible for monitoring and reporting on budget management of contracts awarded to the university. Responsible for recording and maintaining sponsored projects information in the university systems.


This position is eligible for hybrid/remote work.


About us

For over 100 years, Embry-Riddle has been the world's leading aviation and aerospace university, educating more than 30,000 students across residential campuses in Daytona Beach, Florida, and Prescott, Arizona, as well as through a global network of Worldwide locations and online programs. With more than 165,000 alumni around the world, our impact reaches every corner of the aerospace, aviation, defense and technology industries.

Today, our faculty, researchers and professional staff are advancing innovation across aviation, space, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, autonomous systems and next-generation engineering. Working alongside industry leaders, government agencies and innovators, they are solving real-world challenges and shaping the technologies that will define tomorrow.

Whether you are an educator, researcher, administrator, technologist or industry professional, your work at Embry-Riddle will contribute to something bigger than a job. Join a community driven by discovery, purpose and excellence—and help shape the future of aerospace.

  • Generous Time Off: Enjoy up to 18 days of paid leave in your first year, including 3 days granted upon hire and 15 days accrued throughout the year. You'll also receive 9+ paid holidays, including the day after Thanksgiving and the week between Christmas Eve and New Year's Day.
  • Tuition Coverage: Get 100% tuition coverage for yourself for one undergraduate and one graduate degree, and discounted rates for your spouse and dependent children up to age 26.
  • Retirement Contributions: ERAU contributes 6% of your base salary to your retirement plan and offers a 4% matching contribution – with no vesting period.
  • Personal Leave: Relax with 15 days of personal leave for non-exempt employees or 18 days for exempt full-time employees in your first year.

Compensation

The annual salary range for this role is up to $62,000. The final offer will be based on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience, as well as applicable state regulations, internal equity, and business needs, and may fall outside of the stated range.

Qualifications

Required Education and Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's degree in business or related field with 3-5 years of related experience.
  • CRA and/or Contract Certification(s) and master’s degree a plus.
  • In lieu of a bachelor’s degree, 5-10 years of experience in contracts, grants, or financial management will be considered.
  • Experience with sponsors who support aeronautical research (FAA, DoD, USAF, USSF, NASA etc.) a plus.
  • Excellent attention to detail, outstanding customer service and strong communication skills are required for this position.
  • Pre-award Contract management experience or demonstrated experience with managing multi-part contract proposals, technical documents, and budgets.
  • Post-award Contract management experience or demonstrated experience with managing multi-part contracts, technical documents, and budgets.
  • The ability to manage a high volume of work and competing deadlines in a fast-paced, deadline-driven work environment.
  • Comfort working remotely and using tools to facilitate remote work, e.g., Teams, Zoom.
  • Comfort with business systems that hold financial and administrative information, such as Workday.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365, to include Microsoft Word, Shared Drives, OneDrive, and Excel, to include use and understanding of Excel formulas.
  • Effective analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Familiarity with contracting guidelines as detailed in the FAR, DFAR, ITAR and CFR, also experience with STTR and SBIR contracts is a plus.
  • Experience working in higher education with knowledge of Sponsored Research, including the principles, methods, and procedures of contract administration and compliance.

Application process/requirements


To submit your application for this opportunity, please visit the Embry-Riddle Career Site and search for requisition number R310831. Please attach all relevant materials to your application when you apply online. Complete submissions include:

  • Cover letter
  • Full Resume
  • Contact information for at least three professional references (please note that references may be contacted as part of the interview/screening process)

Current Embry-Riddle employees: Please apply directly through the ERAU Employee Hub Central application within Workday.

Embry-Riddle does not accept unsolicited assistance from staffing or recruitment agencies. Agencies interested in partnering with the University should contact and should not contact hiring managers or other University employees directly. To preserve the integrity and authenticity of our hiring process, candidates are expected to participate without AI-assisted coaching, real-time response generation, or recording during interviews or assessments. Embry-Riddle does not use AI to automatically screen, rank, or select candidates.

jobs.excerpt: About Gumball DigitalGumball Digital is a performance marketing company that builds and operates consumer-focused digital brands.
jobs.description:
About Gumball Digital

Gumball Digital is a performance marketing company that builds and operates consumer-focused digital brands. Through brands like ActiveTrials, Benefinds, and Homebase, we combine proprietary technology, data, and marketing expertise to create high-performing customer acquisition platforms.

We’re intentionally small, profitable, and fast-moving. We give talented people the autonomy to own important parts of the business and make decisions that have an immediate impact.

Gumball builds consumer web experiences and the internal tools used to manage them. Our products include mobile-first acquisition funnels, dynamic forms and surveys, administrative tools, and reporting interfaces used across multiple brands.

We are hiring a Front-End Engineer to turn product requirements into clear, responsive, and reliable interfaces. You will work across customer-facing sites and internal tools, make practical design decisions, and collaborate with a senior engineer who provides the backend services your work requires.

Our current front-end stack is TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, and Material UI. It is a starting point, not a fixed requirement for every future problem. You should be comfortable working in this stack while remaining flexible enough to evaluate and adopt different tools when the product’s needs justify them. Most customer traffic is mobile, so mobile behavior is a core engineering requirement.

What you will do

  • Build and maintain responsive customer-facing experiences and internal web applications.
  • Create forms, surveys, editors, dashboards, and reusable interface components that are clear to first-time users.
  • Translate written requirements, brand direction, and stakeholder feedback into finished interfaces.
  • Make thoughtful decisions about layout, typography, interaction, and responsive behavior. Collaborate with the senior engineer and stakeholders when a decision affects product behavior, shared systems, or more than one brand.
  • Work with the senior engineer to define the solution. They provide the backend services and data contracts; you integrate them into the interface and identify what the front end still needs.
  • Handle loading, success, empty, validation, and failure states instead of treating the first render as complete.
  • Build for mobile use, accessibility, browser compatibility, and maintainability.
  • Test your work as a user, document the results, and respond to feedback from quality assurance and code review.
  • Keep tickets and pull requests aligned when requirements change.
  • Support production incidents when assigned by the Engineering Lead.

What we are looking for

  • Professional experience building and shipping front-end web applications, regardless of framework.
  • Experience building responsive, mobile-first web applications.
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, component design, forms, validation, and browser behavior.
  • The ability to make sound interface decisions without requiring a finished design for every screen.
  • Experience integrating front-end applications with APIs or database-backed services.
  • A record of owning work through implementation, testing, pull-request review, and follow-up.
  • Clear written communication and the judgment to ask for input before assumptions become rework.
  • Availability during the team’s Eastern Time workday.

Helpful, not required

  • React, TypeScript, Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, or Material UI.
  • Consumer acquisition funnels, multi-step forms, survey builders, or administrative tools.
  • Complex forms, validation, data tables, drag-and-drop editors, rich text, data visualization, or conditional interfaces.
  • Front-end performance, automated testing, or accessibility work.

How the team works

You report to the Engineering Lead, who is also the senior engineer, and work closely with the Technical Project Manager and business stakeholders. The Engineering Lead partners with you on the solution and provides the backend your interface needs. You own the quality, usability, and implementation of the front end.


Salary

The pay range for this role is:

$80,000.00 - $100,000.00 USD per year (Remote (United States))

Zum provides safe, reliable, technology-enabled student transportation for school districts. We are growing quickly: new districts, new yards, and new markets launch while existing ones are still being built out. The VP of Operations runs a multi-market in the east region P&L, leads general managers and their teams, and owns the operating rhythm that keeps buses running safely and on time. START-UP MODE

  • Launch new districts and yards while running existing ones, moving people and fleet across markets as needed

  • Renewals and collections: Lead renewals and AR, including disputed invoices and liquidated damages

  • People leadership: Lead and coach GMs and field managers, handle performance issues, and run promotion panels

  • Safety and compliance: Lead incident reviews, make documented discipline decisions, and oversee training and records

  • Labor relations: Support bargaining, grievances, arbitration, and CBA implementation

  • Customer relationships: Serve as senior operational contact for district leaders

  • Driver pipeline: Oversee hiring, spare ratios, CDL training, retention, and recognition

  • Fleet and technology: Evaluate routing vendors and support yard and equipment readiness

As a Technical Support Engineer at Dataminr, you'll be the go-to problem-solver for our enterprise customers, digging into authentication issues, platform hiccups, and integration headaches to figure out what went wrong and how to fix it. The role covers troubleshooting SSO configurations, debugging alert delivery across email, mobile, webhook, and API channels, and working through customer-side network and environmental issues, often tracing problems back through logs and data to pin down the root cause. This is a fully remote role with a consistent shift that may fall outside standard business hours, plus participation in an on-call rotation that includes occasional weekend coverage.

AI Innovation at Dataminr

Working at Dataminr you’ll have the opportunity to tackle the most exciting trends in AI on a daily basis to power a revolutionary product that uncovers critical events around the world as they unfold.

Regenerative AI: our AI technology, ReGenAI, is a new form of generative AI that automatically regenerates real-time Live Event Briefs as events unfold. Learn more here.

Agentic AI:we recently launched our Agentic AI capability, what we’re calling our Intel Agents, that autonomously generates critical context for our clients on real-time events, threats, and risks allowing them to see the clearest, most accurate view of what’s happening on the ground. Learn more here

Multimodal AI: our platform detects events from many different types of data (images, video, sensor data, audio, and text in over 150 languages). Learn more here.

The opportunity

  • Configure and deploy SSO integrations for enterprise customers across various identity provider environments, and troubleshoot authentication failures when they arise
  • Investigate and resolve login failures, platform access issues, and browser-level problems
  • Debug alert delivery failures across email, mobile, webhook, and API channels
  • Troubleshoot customer-side environmental issues including network, firewall, proxy, and DNS configurations
  • Support API troubleshooting and integration-related cases
  • Investigate logs and data to identify patterns and root causes
  • Take charge of all customer issues, including questions about product functionality, initial troubleshooting, identification of root causes, issue resolution, and communication
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success on identifying and resolving product defects
  • Be an active contributor to our knowledge base and other support documentation

At Dataminr, we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don’t meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed.

  • 3+ years of experience in a technical support, systems engineering, or related technical role
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot independently across unfamiliar systems

  • Experience with API troubleshooting or integration support

jobs.excerpt: About the Role:You track culture before it surfaces in a brief.
jobs.description:
About the Role:

You track culture before it surfaces in a brief. You have strong opinions about what makes content work on a platform, and you understand how audiences truly behave—how they form communities, participate in conversations, and move between discovery and action. You bring craft to strategy: your briefs sharpen the problem, your frameworks drive execution, and your thinking gives creative and community teams somewhere real to go.

ServiceNow's social presence is where we reach enterprise buyers across the platforms where they're actually present—Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, X, and emerging channels. We're building an always-on social program rooted in authentic storytelling, cultural relevance, and genuine community engagement—one that proves B2B tech can be creative, insightful, and genuinely interesting.

This role owns the strategic vision for ServiceNow's social and content program across all platforms and partners with creative teams, product marketing, editorial leadership, and community managers to bring that strategy to life with excellence and intention. You'll define what our brand sounds like and stands for in social spaces. You'll identify where to expand and evolve our content approach based on audience behaviors and insights. You'll tap into and activate our community to find moments that drive buzz and cultural relevance.

You'll report to the Director of Social Media with direct accountability for building brand awareness, credibility, and relevance across social channels.

What You'll Do:

  • Own Social Strategy Across Social Platforms: Define the strategic vision and positioning for ServiceNow across Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, X, and emerging channels. Develop a forward-looking roadmap aligned to our editorial calendar, product launches, thought leadership moments, and cultural opportunities. Identify opportunities to expand into new content pillars and evolve existing pillars based on audience behaviors, engagement patterns, and strategic insights. Establish clear audience targets and platform-specific strategies that reflect how to reach enterprise buyers organically across each channel.
  • Build Content Architecture: Develop integrated content strategies and always-on programming architectures that translate ServiceNow's positioning into scalable, channel-native programs. Serve as steward of the brand across social, ensuring all content reflects our visual standards, tone, and perspective. Partner closely with creative teams to brief, concept, and execute channel-right content across photo, video, thought leadership, and community-generated content. Write creative briefs and social strategies that give creative teams a genuine problem to solve, framing the strategic challenge with precision, clear point of view, and useful constraints. Test content formats and creative approaches to optimize for engagement, reach, and audience connection.
  • Cultivate & Activate Community: Tap into and activate ServiceNow's community of practitioners, builders, and decision-makers to uncover insights and identify moments of cultural relevance. Mine community conversations and user-generated content for signals that inform new strategic challenges and social moments. Develop community-first campaigns and activations that drive buzz, engagement, and strengthen brand perception. Build a community-first mindset into the always-on program that strengthens brand perception and creates space for authentic dialogue.
  • Leverage Performance & Insights: Use performance data and audience insights to refine content strategy, optimize for emerging opportunities, and identify moments worth amplifying. Translate analytics and learning into strategic recommendations that inform content evolution and platform investment. Make the case for strategic pivots and new directions backed by evidence and cultural insight.
  • Lead Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with product marketing to identify moments to integrate ServiceNow products and narratives into social storytelling. Collaborate with editorial and brand strategy teams to ensure social strategy aligns with broader brand positioning and messaging. Work with customer marketing and proof teams to bring customer success stories and proof points to life on social—identifying authentic moments and opportunities to amplify customer advocacy. Work with paid media and performance teams to identify amplification opportunities and ensure social content gets the media support it deserves. Build trusted relationships with stakeholders across creative, product, data, and marketing disciplines.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Monitor trends across business, tech, culture, and social media to inform proactive, culturally relevant activations. Track platform evolution, emerging features, and shifts in audience behavior across all channels. Build and maintain social listening programs and cultural trendspotting frameworks that inform strategic decisions. Be the person who flags when we need to try something new before everyone else does.

What You Need:

  • 10+ years of demonstrated experience in social and content strategy, with a track record of building differentiated strategies (not just executing against an existing calendar) across brand channels, always-on programs, or editorial-led social presence.
  • Deep platform fluency across LinkedIn, Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms. You understand algorithmic distribution, paid amplification mechanics, community dynamics, and how cultural moments surface and move across platforms. You know the difference between platform best practices and genuine cultural insight.
  • Proven strategic leadership defining content architecture, positioning, and audience strategy for always-on brand channels. You've shaped how a brand shows up in social spaces with consistency, intention, and authenticity.
  • Brief-writing and strategic communication craft. Your briefs create useful constraints, build a clear point of view, and give creative teams problems worth solving. You can distill complex brand challenges into actionable narratives and present strategic work with confidence.
  • Data literacy and analytical rigor. You know how to define the right KPIs, interpret performance dashboards, and translate findings into strategic decisions. You're comfortable asking hard questions when you don't have the answers yet.
  • Experience in B2B, tech, or complex categories where audience trust, credibility, and thought leadership matter. Bonus if you've worked in AI, enterprise software, or similar spaces.
  • Strong cross-functional operator mindset. You build trust with stakeholders across disciplines—from creatives to product teams to executives—and lead through influence and the quality of your work, not just authority.
  • Creative judgment and attention to detail. You have a strong point of view on what makes content work. You care deeply about consistency, craft, and quality. You understand that millions of eyes may see your work—it must be excellent.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit. You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, parachuting into unfamiliar territory, rapidly developing context, and moving with confidence. You introduce and establish new ways of working.

CEO Effectiveness & Executive Leadership Support

Board Governance & Executive Communications

jobs.excerpt: ​​Looking for Philippines-based candidatesJob Role: Customer Service & Sales Administration Assistant Compensation range: $1,800 AUD - $2,200 AUD / Monthly Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx.
jobs.description:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Customer Service & Sales Administration Assistant

Compensation range: $1,800 AUD - $2,200 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an established Australian supplier to the hospitality and accommodation industry, with around three decades of experience in the market. The business specialises in supplying a broad range of products used by hotels, serviced apartments, resorts, and other accommodation providers, combining everyday operational supplies with more bespoke products.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a friendly, confident, detail-oriented Customer Service & Sales Administration Assistant with strong telephone communication skills and proven practical MYOB invoicing experience to join our Australian administration team.

The PRIMARY responsibility is to be the first point of contact for all incoming calls during agreed coverage hours. You will answer customer enquiries, take orders and manage call transfers and follow-ups. You will also proactively call existing customers to maintain relationships, encourage repeat orders and introduce relevant additional products.

Another part of the outbound work involves following up new prospects identified and supplied by our external telemarketing company, including customers who have requested a brochure, quotation or product samples. This is relationship-based sales support, not a high-pressure cold-calling position.

MYOB invoicing is a preferred skill, not merely an advantage. When call coverage permits, you will support the Australian office with sales orders, customer invoicing, basic bookkeeping and general office responsibilities. A strong customer-service focus is essential, together with an excellent telephone manner, clear and confident communication skills, and a very good command of written and spoken English.

You will work closely with the existing two-person administration team, applying excellent numerical accuracy, common sense and confidentiality.

Key Responsibilities

Inbound Telephone Reception & Customer Service – First Priority

  • Be the primary first person to answer all incoming customer and business calls during agreed Australian business-hour coverage, using the company’s VoIP softphone.
  • Answer calls promptly and professionally; handle straightforward enquiries before referring matters to the appropriate Australian colleague.
  • Take telephone orders and carefully confirm customer details, product codes, quantities, requested delivery dates and delivery instructions.
  • Assist callers with product enquiries, stock availability, customer-specific prices, order status, invoices, freight and delivery information.
  • Transfer calls efficiently; record accurate messages and ensure agreed callbacks are completed.
  • Handle complaints or service issues calmly and escalate complex matters promptly.
  • Prioritise incoming calls over routine outbound calls and non-urgent administration; maintain reliable call availability throughout the agreed coverage window.
  • Create accurate notes of calls, customer requests and follow-up actions in company-approved systems.

Existing Customer Relationships, Retention & Upselling

  • Make proactive outbound calls to existing customers to maintain relationships and understand ongoing supply needs.
  • Follow up customers who have not ordered recently and encourage appropriate repeat purchases.
  • Check on upcoming purchasing requirements and remind customers to replenish regularly ordered supplies.
  • Introduce suitable new, complementary or premium products based on the customer’s business and purchasing history.
  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities in a helpful, consultative manner without high-pressure selling.
  • Follow up quotations, brochures, samples, previous enquiries and outstanding orders.
  • Arrange product information, samples or quotations with the sales and administration teams as authorised.
  • Record customer feedback, interest, ordering intentions and next follow-up dates accurately.
  • Pass larger opportunities, non-standard pricing requests or important account matters to the Australian sales team.

Follow-Up of New Prospects Provided by the Telemarketing Company

  • Contact potential customers on approved lead lists provided by the company’s external telemarketing agency.
  • Prioritise prospects who have requested product information, samples, quotations or a follow-up conversation.
  • Introducing the company and relevant product ranges confidently and professionally.
  • Confirm buyer details, purchasing needs and product interest without duplicating the telemarketing agency’s initial prospecting unnecessarily.
  • Arrange and follow up catalogues, samples and quotations; contact prospects after samples are received to encourage trial orders.
  • Accurately log call outcomes, objections, promised actions and next-contact dates.
  • Escalate high-value opportunities and complex negotiations to the Australian sales team; respect do-not-contact requests and company calling procedures.

MYOB Invoicing, Accounts & Bookkeeping Support – Prefer

  • Switch between phone coverage and MYOB work efficiently, ensuring incoming calls remain the first priority.
  • Prepare and process customer sales orders and invoices accurately using MYOB, assisting the Australian office with its regular invoicing workload.
  • Check customer details, product codes, quantities, customer-specific prices, discounts, GST and freight charges before finalising invoices.
  • Ensure invoices are complete, accurate and processed promptly; handle recurring and repetitive invoicing tasks consistently.
  • Review orders and supporting documents; identify duplicate entries, incomplete information, unusual figures and discrepancies before processing.
  • Maintain accurate MYOB customer, accounting and transaction records and well-organised supporting files.
  • Assist with customer account enquiries, payment allocation, basic account reconciliation and accounts receivable follow-ups where required.
  • Escalate unusual transactions, discrepancies or uncertainty to the Australian team rather than guessing.
  • Learn the company’s product codes, pricing structures, purchasing patterns and order-to-invoice procedures.

General Administration, Order Processing & Email Support

  • Provide general administrative support to the Australian team, including processing telephone, email and online customer orders.
  • Respond professionally to routine customer and supplier emails and follow up outstanding requests.
  • Use Microsoft Outlook confidently for folders, attachments, search, correspondence and day-to-day email management.
  • Prepare, update and maintain documents using Microsoft Excel and Word (Microsoft 365).
  • Manage electronic attachments, filing, customer details, transaction records and correspondence accurately.
  • Conduct Google and online research; verify business addresses, contacts, product information, delivery details and other operational information.
  • Assist with repetitive administrative tasks, basic reporting and other company-approved applications.
  • Follow documented procedures, use practical judgement and communicate promptly when instructions or information appear inconsistent.

Team Support, Microsoft Excel & Numerical Skills

  • Work closely with the existing administration and sales teams to complete day-to-day work accurately and on time.
  • Take ownership of assigned customer follow-ups, invoicing and administrative tasks; communicate status and escalate problems promptly.
  • Be comfortable checking invoice totals, prices, quantities, GST, percentages, discounts and freight charges.
  • Sort and filter data in Excel, use common formulas and relevant lookups, and work with company-provided applications.
  • Learn the company’s products, customers, systems and processes, and continually improve personal accuracy and productivity.
  • Be willing to learn about the company’s products, customers, systems and processes.
  • Work closely with the existing administration team to ensure day-to-day tasks are completed accurately and on time.
  • Support the team by taking ownership of invoicing and other administrative workloads.
  • Communicate clearly with team members and escalate issues when appropriate.
  • Follow established procedures while also using practical judgement when something does not appear correct.

AI & Technology

  • Experience using modern AI productivity tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI programs will be considered an advantage.
  • The successful candidate may use approved AI tools for appropriate tasks such as:
    • Improving routine email correspondence.
    • Assisting with general research.
    • Summarising non-confidential information.
    • Helping with Excel formulas.
    • Improving administrative productivity.
  • Confidential company, customer, supplier, pricing, financial or personal information must never be entered into an unauthorised public AI system.
  • Training will be provided regarding the company’s approved use of AI.
  • AI-produced work must be reviewed for accuracy, and company requirements must always be followed.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in customer service, sales administration, order processing, accounts administration or a closely related role.
  • Strong telephone and customer-service skills, with a friendly, confident and professional manner, an excellent command of spoken and written English, and the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with customers.
  • Proven experience handling inbound calls and making outbound customer follow-up calls; ability to build rapport and recommend appropriate products.
  • PROVEN, HANDS-ON MYOB invoicing experience is favourable, together with good basic bookkeeping and accounting knowledge.
  • Willingness to complete a practical MYOB invoicing test and live inbound/outbound customer call role-play during recruitment.
  • Excellent numerical skills and strong attention to detail, especially with invoices, orders, prices, GST and freight.
  • Excellent Microsoft Outlook skills and strong competence with Excel, Word and Microsoft 365.
  • Good common sense, independent problem-solving, organisational skills and ability to notice rather than overlook discrepancies.
  • Ability to manage several responsibilities while keeping incoming phone calls as the immediate priority.
  • Professional customer email skills, sound Google research ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar products and systems.
  • Ability to work independently and consistently in a remote environment, communicate issues early and maintain strict confidentiality.
  • Highly organised and able to manage repetitive tasks consistently and accurately.
  • Ability to follow procedures while also knowing when to ask questions.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

jobs.description:
Schedule:
Monday - Friday (40 hrs/wk)

8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Department: Genomics Analysis - 396

***Exact compensation will vary based on skills and experience.***

Primary Purpose:

The Clinical Variant Scientist is responsible for the interpretation and classification of genetic variants identified through clinical testing, ensuring accurate and clinically relevant reporting. This role involves reviewing genomic data, applying established guidelines (e.g. ACMG, AMP, ClinGen), and integrating evidence from scientific literature, databases, and internal resources. The scientist collaborates with laboratory teams, genetic counselors, and medical directors to provide high-quality variant assessments and reports that support patient care. Additional responsibilities include maintaining up-to-date knowledge of genomic research and guidelines, contributing to quality assurance processes, and assisting in the development of standard operating procedures and best practices for variant interpretation. This position requires that roughly 85-95% of time is spent on analysis of clinical cases, with the remainder of time spent on other duties. This position demands focused individuals with attention to detail and strong critical thinking skills.

This is a fully remote position and will be focused on analysis of Oncology NGS tests and somatic variant interpretation.

About ARUP:

ARUP Laboratories is a national clinical and anatomic pathology reference laboratory and an enterprise of the University of Utah and its Department of Pathology. Based in Salt Lake City, Utah.

ARUP proudly hires top talent to create a work environment of diversity, professional growth and continuous development. Our workforce is committed to the important service we provide to over one million patients each month. We always strive for excellence and have a strong desire to have involvement with the advances in medicine and the role laboratory services plays within each patient’s life. We never forget that there is a patient behind every specimen we receive.

We are looking for individuals who want to contribute to ARUP's culture of accountability, integrity, service, and excellence. Consider joining our dynamic team."

Essential Functions:

Perform either somatic or germline variant interpretation using standard nomenclature and professional standard classification guidelines (e.g. ACMG, AMP, ClinGen).

Evaluate quality of data produced from clinical laboratory testing, primarily from next generation sequencing/massively parallel sequencing (NGS/MPS) platforms.

Research and determine clinical significance of variants based on medical literature, external databases, and computational prediction software.

Understand basic concepts in protein structure and function, RNA splicing, and gene regulation, and how these relate to genetic mechanisms of disease and sequence variants observed in a given specimen.

Understand experimental methods, data analysis methods, and inferences that can be applied to both single-gene experimentation and high-throughput analyses.

Collect and integrate data from multiple sources within the context of cancer biology and/or heritable disorders, and the potential impact on clinical care.

Perform data entry with high accuracy and be able to recognize inconsistencies and initiate resolution.

Assess the plausibility of laboratory results through correlation of data with patient demographics and clinical symptoms.

Draft clinical reports with accuracy and consistency for review by medical directors.

Work effectively with other scientists, staff, directors, and management to troubleshoot unique scenarios, identify areas to optimize and improve processes, and implement changes in clinical workflows.

Maintain continual compliance with policies, procedures, and record keeping necessary to meet the standards of regulatory agencies.

Accept, resolve, and assist in the resolution of problems.

Perform assessment of peers performing non-waived testing as a Qualified Observer after two years’ experience.

Flexible schedule determined by operational needs and may include occasional weekends to meet clinical reporting requirements.

Other duties as assigned.

Physical and Other Requirements:

Stooping: Bending body downward and forward by bending spine at the waist.

Reaching: Extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction.

Mobility: The person in this position needs to occasionally move between work sites and inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.

Communicate: Frequently and effectively communicates with others.

PPE: Biohazard laboratory environment that requires use of personal protective equipment in accordance with CDC and OSHA regulations and company policies.

ARUP Policies and Procedures: To conduct self in compliance with all ARUP Policies and Procedures.

Sedentary Work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects.

Fine Motor Control: Picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than with the whole hand as in handling.

Vision: Having close, far, and peripheral visual acuity to perform a variety of tasks such as make general observations of depth and distance.

Color Vision: Perception of and ability to distinguish colors.

jobs.description:
About Cerby

At Cerby, security is everyone's business.

Cerby extends your security perimeter to include your disconnected applications, providing identity automation and eliminating manual processes. It's one of the biggest blind spots in enterprise security, and we're the team closing it. If you want to work alongside the team solving one of the hardest, most overlooked problems in security, you're in the right place.

Founded in 2020, Cerby is backed by leading investors and trusted by enterprises across the globe.

About The Role

As a Solutions Engineer on our Solutions Engineering team, you will be a key technical partner to our sales and customer success organizations, helping prospects and customers understand how our Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions can solve their most complex security and compliance challenges. In this salaried, full-time role, you will own the technical aspects of the sales cycle—from discovery and solution design to customized demonstrations and proof-of-concept initiatives. You will work closely with account executives, product management, and engineering to translate business requirements into scalable, secure architectures leveraging modern identity standards. This role is remote-friendly but requires residence on the East Coast of the US, and is ideal for a self-motivated, highly organized team player with strong communication skills and hands-on IAM experience.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with account executives throughout the sales cycle to understand customer requirements and design tailored IAM and IGA solutions that address security, compliance, and operational needs.
  • Lead and deliver high-impact product demonstrations that showcase core IAM/IGA capabilities, including access governance, provisioning, lifecycle management, and policy enforcement.
  • Design and build custom demo environments and proof-of-concept (POC) implementations, including data modeling, configuration, and integration with customer systems.
  • Engage with technical stakeholders (security teams, identity architects, IT operations, developers) to perform technical discovery, requirement gathering, and solution validation.
  • Architect and explain solutions using modern identity standards and protocols such as SCIM and SAML, as well as REST-based API integrations with directories, HRIS, and SaaS applications.
  • Create technical documentation, solution diagrams, and implementation guides that clearly articulate recommended architectures and integration patterns.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management and Engineering to relay customer feedback, influence product roadmap priorities, and stay ahead of evolving IAM and IGA use cases.
  • Support RFP/RFI responses and security questionnaires by contributing accurate, detailed technical content related to IAM/IGA capabilities and integrations.
  • Deliver presentations and technical workshops—both remote and onsite—for prospects, customers, and partners, tailoring the level of depth to executive, business, and technical audiences.
  • Work cross-functionally with Customer Success and Professional Services to ensure a smooth handoff from pre-sales to implementation, aligning expectations and solution design.
  • Continuously refine and improve demo scripts, environments, and technical sales assets to increase effectiveness and repeatability across the Solutions Engineering team.
  • Maintain a high level of self-organization and ownership over your territory, managing multiple opportunities, POCs, and stakeholder demands in parallel.
  • Stay current on industry trends and best practices in IAM, IGA, and security to serve as a trusted advisor to customers and internal teams.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, supportive team culture by sharing knowledge, mentoring peers, and participating in internal enablement sessions.

Qualifications

  • Located on the East Coast of the United States, with the ability to work effectively with customers and internal teams across US time zones.
  • Proven experience (typically 3+ years) in a Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Pre-Sales, or similar technical customer-facing role supporting enterprise solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platforms, including configuration and deployment of common use cases.
  • Strong understanding of modern identity standards and protocols such as SAML and SCIM, with the ability to design and explain end-to-end authentication, authorization, and provisioning flows.
  • Experience building, testing, and troubleshooting RESTful API integrations between identity platforms and third-party applications, directories, or HR systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and deliver compelling technical demonstrations and proof-of-concept environments customized to customer requirements.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to confidently engage executives, business stakeholders, and deep technical audiences.
  • Proven organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple concurrent opportunities, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with a track record of taking initiative, solving problems independently, and driving opportunities forward.
  • Collaborative team player who thrives in cross-functional environments and contributes positively to team culture and shared goals.
  • Comfortable using common tools in a pre-sales environment (e.g., diagramming tools, CRM systems, collaboration platforms) and documenting technical solutions clearly.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in IAM/IGA and technical sales.
  • Bonus: Experience with additional identity standards (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect), directory services (e.g., AD, LDAP), and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).

jobs.description:
TREND Health Partners is a tech-enabled payment integrity company.
