jobs.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest is where hundreds of millions of people around the world discover ideas and turn inspiration into action. Our mission is to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and our values guide how we build, operate, and lead: Put Pinners First, Aim for Extraordinary, Create Belonging, Act as One, and Win or Learn.

Ads brings together Product and Engineering to build the products and systems that power Pinterest’s advertising platform across advertiser and Pinner experiences, enabling sustainable growth while protecting the quality and integrity of the product experience. This organization sits at the intersection of business strategy, scaled engineering systems, and product innovation, making it one of Pinterest’s most business-critical teams.

About the Role

We are hiring a Chief of Staff to the GM, Ads (Product, Engineering, Data Science) to help scale the organization, sharpen executive decision-making, and drive the operating agenda for this high-impact team. This Chief of Staff (CoS) will act as a senior strategic operator and trusted advisor who connects big-picture priorities with day-to-day execution, serving as a force multiplier for the GM and the broader leadership team.

The role is designed for a leader who can:

  • Operate as a thought partner to senior executives, with strong business and technical intuition
  • Build and run scalable operating mechanisms that drive clarity, accountability, and outcomes
  • Translate complex, ambiguous challenges into structured decisions, owners, and execution plans
  • Represent the organization in critical cross-functional forums with confidence and credibility across senior technical and business leaders

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a strategic partner and force multiplier to the GM, Ads and the broader Ads leadership team, helping them stay focused on the most important company and organizational priorities.
  • Own and continuously refine the executive operating agenda in partnership with leaders and TPMs, including strategic planning, goal setting, quarterly and annual business reviews, leadership offsites, and decision forums.
  • Lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives that improve Ad’s execution across Product and Engineering, operating effectiveness, and business impact, stepping in to drive structure, alignment, and momentum where ambiguity is highest.
  • Translate ambiguous business, technical, and organizational problems into clear frameworks, options, recommendations, and decisions for the VP and leadership team.
  • Use data, qualitative insight, and organizational “listening” to identify risks, diagnose operating gaps, and proactively surface tradeoffs and implications to leadership.
  • Build alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, Data Science, Finance, Recruiting, People, and GTM partners, ensuring the Ads organization’s priorities, risks, and resource needs are well understood and integrated into company planning.
  • Design, implement, and evolve operating mechanisms that improve prioritization, decision quality, communication, and follow-through (for example, leadership cadences, decision logs, roadmap and investment reviews, and accountability trackers).
  • Support organizational planning and growth, including team structure, headcount and investment tradeoffs, leadership effectiveness, and operating-model evolution as the business and technology landscape changes.
  • Develop executive-level communications and narratives (for example, decision memos, business reviews, strategy updates, board and ET prep) that clarify strategy, progress, tradeoffs, and decisions for varied audiences.
  • Represent the Ads organization in critical forums with the Office of the CEO, other functional Chiefs of Staff, and cross-functional leadership groups, modeling the high standards of quality, efficiency, and operational rigor expected of the Office of the CEO and broader executive community.
  • Act as a culture carrier for Pinterest’s values, helping the organization Put Pinners First, Aim for Extraordinary, Create Belonging, Act as One, and Win or Learn in how it plans, executes, and communicates.
  • Collaborate with finance teams to manage budgets, optimize spending, and identify opportunities for efficiency and/or investment.
  • Understand, interface and work closely with recruiting and people orgs to evaluate and nurture healthy, cooperative engineering teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in strategic operations, business operations, program leadership, product operations, technical program management, consulting, finance, or a related role in complex, fast-moving organizations.
  • Experience operating as a trusted partner to senior executives or leadership teams, with a track record of shaping priorities, driving decisions, and landing complex, cross-functional programs.
  • Strong strategic judgment and systems thinking, with the ability to connect company and Ads priorities, organizational dynamics, technical realities, and execution constraints into a coherent plan.
  • Proven ability to lead high-impact initiatives from ambiguous problem definition through measurable outcomes, including establishing clear success metrics, governance, and accountability mechanisms.
  • Exceptional analytical skills; able to use both quantitative and qualitative data to diagnose issues, frame options, and influence decisions with clear, structured recommendations.
  • Outstanding executive communication skills, including the ability to craft concise narratives, decision memos, business reviews, and leadership communications for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, build trust quickly, and drive alignment across senior stakeholders with competing priorities and perspectives.
  • Experience designing and scaling operating mechanisms, planning processes, or organizational systems that improve focus, execution, and cross-functional alignment.
  • High integrity, discretion, and judgment; comfortable operating with access to sensitive information and navigating nuanced people, organizational, and business situations.
  • Comfort working at the intersection of technical, product, and business environments; you do not need to be the deepest technical expert, but you must be able to engage credibly with senior engineering and product leaders.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience partnering directly with Engineering, Product, or other technical executive teams as a Chief of Staff, strategic advisor, or senior TPM/strategic operations leader.
  • Experience in advertising, marketplace, platform, infrastructure, or other scaled technology environments where monetization, reliability, and user experience must be balanced thoughtfully.
  • Experience with organizational design, headcount planning, business planning, or executive-level operating rhythms (for example, OKR cycles, QBRs, investment reviews, or board/ET prep).
  • Experience partnering with Finance, Recruiting, People, or GTM teams on business-critical initiatives that span strategy, operations, talent, and culture.

Relocation Statement:

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

  • We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.

US based applicants only
$178,561—$367,626 USD

Our Commitment to Inclusion:

Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Coordinator
jobs.excerpt: A RecargaPay está procurando uma liderança técnica para conduzir a governança de segurança da informação da empresa: o arcabouço de políticas e normas, a gestão de riscos, a continuidade de negócios, a conformidade com auditorias e reguladores e a governança de identidades e acessos (SailPoint, Google Workspace, AWS IAM), incluindo identidades não humanas e acessos privilegiados, com automação em N8N.
jobs.description:
A RecargaPay está procurando uma liderança técnica para conduzir a governança de segurança da informação da empresa: o arcabouço de políticas e normas, a gestão de riscos, a continuidade de negócios, a conformidade com auditorias e reguladores e a governança de identidades e acessos (SailPoint, Google Workspace, AWS IAM), incluindo identidades não humanas e acessos privilegiados, com automação em N8N.

Em uma fintech regulada, cada controle precisa ser definido, executado, medido e comprovado. Esta pessoa vai orientar o time de analistas que faz isso acontecer.

Por que esta vaga é importante

Governança fraca, planos de continuidade não testados e acessos mal controlados, em especial contas de serviço e privilegiadas, são fontes diretas de risco e de apontamentos de auditoria. Por isso, a RecargaPay busca quem dê direção técnica a um time que transforma políticas e controles em prática verificável, automatizada e pronta para auditoria.

Responsabilidades

  • Responder pela governança de identidades e acessos: ciclo de vida (joiner / mover / leaver) e certificações no SailPoint, RBAC, segregação de funções (SoD), menor privilégio e acessos no Google Workspace e no AWS IAM.
  • Governar identidades não humanas (contas de serviço, service accounts, chaves de API, tokens e credenciais de aplicações) e acessos privilegiados (contas administrativas, acesso just-in-time, break-glass): inventário com dono definido, ciclo de vida, rotação de credenciais e revisão recorrente.
  • Direcionar automações no N8N (provisionamento, aprovações, notificações e integrações entre SailPoint, Google Workspace, AWS e sistemas de RH/ITSM) para eliminar trabalho manual e gerar evidências.
  • Produzir indicadores e relatórios de governança (SLA de acessos, contas órfãs, acessos privilegiados, status de riscos, testes de continuidade e apontamentos) e apresentá-los ao CISO e à liderança.
  • Liderar tecnicamente o time de Analistas, direcionar prioridades, definir padrões técnicos, revisar entregas, dar feedback e desenvolver as pessoas.
  • Manter o arcabouço de governança de SI (políticas, normas e procedimentos) e conduzir a gestão de riscos de SI e de terceiros: avaliações, planos de ação, acompanhamento de remediação e reporte ao CISO e aos comitês.
  • Responder pela gestão de continuidade de negócios: análise de impacto (BIA), planos de continuidade e recuperação, testes periódicos e acompanhamento das lições aprendidas, alinhados à ISO 22301.
  • Liderar a conformidade e a prontidão para auditorias e reguladores (ISO 27001, ISO 22301 e normas do Banco Central): controles, evidências, respostas e acompanhamento de apontamentos até o encerramento.

Requirements

  • Vivência prática em gestão de identidades e acessos com SailPoint (IdentityIQ ou Identity Security Cloud), Google Workspace (administração avançada) e AWS IAM (policies, roles, federação/SSO).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado de identidades não humanas: contas de serviço, service accounts, API keys, tokens, secrets e identidades de workload; inventário, ownership, rotação de credenciais e desativação segura.
  • Experiência com acessos privilegiados e contas administrativas: menor privilégio, segregação entre contas administrativas e pessoais, acesso temporário (just-in-time), contas de emergência (break-glass), monitoramento e revisão periódica de privilégios.
  • Domínio de conceitos de acesso (RBAC/ABAC, SoD, SSO, SAML/OIDC, SCIM, MFA) e familiaridade com automação em N8N (ou plataformas equivalentes), APIs REST, webhooks e JSON.
  • Capacidade de comunicar riscos e resultados de forma executiva ao CISO, a comitês e a áreas de negócio.
  • Experiência comprovada em governança, risco e conformidade (GRC) de segurança da informação: políticas, normas, controles e ciclos de auditoria interna e externa.
  • Experiência em gestão de continuidade de negócios: BIA, planos de continuidade e recuperação (BCP/DR) e execução de testes. Conhecimento de frameworks e regulações aplicáveis (ISO 27001, ISO 22301 e normas do Banco Central).
  • Experiência em liderança técnica de equipe: direcionar prioridades, revisar o trabalho de analistas, dar feedback e desenvolver pessoas.

Diferencial

  • Controle de acessos para IA internas: identidades e permissões de agentes e aplicações de IA, escopo de acesso a ferramentas, integrações e dados, e trilha de auditoria das ações executadas.
  • Certificações como CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, ISO 22301 (Lead Implementer ou Lead Auditor), SailPoint ou AWS Security Specialty; experiência com PAM/gestão de segredos e IaC (ex.: Terraform) aplicada a IAM.
  • Inglês para leitura técnica e interlocução com fornecedores.

Benefits

  • Salário competitivo e alinhado ao mercado.
  • Trabalho remoto — esteja onde estiver, você faz parte do time!
  • Auxílio home office com um depósito mensal no app RecargaPay.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico sem coparticipação.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Vale-refeição flexível (via Flash).
  • TotalPass para cuidar da sua saúde

Diversidade & Inclusão na RecargaPay

No RecargaPay, você tem liberdade para ser quem você é. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas e experiências nos tornam mais criativos, inovadores e fortes. Aqui, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas para se expressar de forma autêntica. Valorizamos cada trajetória e as múltiplas formas de enxergar o mundo, sem distinções.

Sobre o uso dos seus Dados

Ao compartilhar seu currículo conosco, você autoriza o uso de seus dados para análise durante o processo seletivo e, possivelmente, para outras oportunidades dentro do grupo RecargaPay. Você pode solicitar a atualização ou exclusão de suas informações a qualquer momento, conforme a LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados).

What You'll Bring

  • BA/BS degree in Business Administration or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Proficiency in English.
  • Experience managing vendor performance programmes, KPIs, scorecards, and improvement plans.
  • Strong relationship management skills, with the ability to engage effectively at both operational and executive levels.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across global teams.
  • Experience with TrackWise, Salesforce, Sciforma, or similar systems is advantageous, along with strong Microsoft Office skills, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work accurately under pressure, and meet challenging deadlines.

jobs.description:
Technology Job Description


Lead complex Workday programs from mobilization through stabilization, balancing delivery discipline, client outcomes, team leadership, client financial management, sales opportunity management, and commercial performance.

We Are

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps organizations build their digital core, optimize operations, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance services. We combine our strength in technology with deep industry experience, functional expertise, and global delivery capabilities to help clients reinvent how they operate and create lasting value.

Our Workday practice helps clients transform finance, human resources, planning, payroll, and related enterprise processes through Workday strategy, implementation, optimization, and application managed services. Our teams bring together business, functional, technical, data, integration, change, and program leadership capabilities to deliver measurable outcomes.

You Are

A seasoned Workday Delivery Lead who brings structure, transparency, and momentum to complex transformation programs. You combine delivery discipline, commercial judgment, client financial management, sales opportunity leadership, and the ability to align senior business and technology stakeholders around measurable outcomes.

You are comfortable operating with client executives, Workday functional and technical teams, third parties, and global delivery teams. You communicate clearly, anticipate issues before they become obstacles, and create an environment where teams deliver high-quality work with accountability and confidence.

The Work

· Lead Workday implementation, deployment, optimization, or application managed services programs from mobilization through stabilization and transition.

· Own the integrated delivery strategy and plan, including scope, schedule, milestones, dependencies, resources, deliverables, acceptance criteria, financials, and contractual commitments.

· Establish program governance, decision forums, status reporting, escalation paths, quality controls, and documentation standards appropriate to the engagement.

· Drive cross-functional coordination across Workday functional workstreams, integrations, data conversion, security, reporting, testing, change management, training, cutover, deployment, and support.

· Partner with client sponsors and program leaders to clarify priorities, resolve decisions, manage expectations, and maintain alignment to business outcomes.

· Maintain active management of risks, actions, issues, decisions, assumptions, and dependencies, with clear owners, target dates, mitigation plans, and escalation when progress stalls.

· Monitor delivery health and take timely corrective action to protect scope, schedule, quality, budget, team sustainability, and client satisfaction.

· Own the management of client and engagement financials, including budget planning, revenue and cost forecasting, staffing and utilization, margin performance, invoicing, change control, commercial tracking, variance analysis, and timely corrective action.

· Plan and facilitate executive steering committees, program leadership meetings, status reviews, and working sessions that result in clear decisions and actions.

· Coordinate release, testing, cutover, operational readiness, go-live, command-center, and stabilization activities using evidence-based entry and exit criteria.

· Ensure delivery methods, quality controls, security expectations, and contractual commitments are understood and followed across the engagement team.

· Lead, coach, and develop project managers and cross-functional team members while promoting collaboration, inclusion, accountability, and sustainable ways of working.

· Build trusted relationships with clients, Workday, ecosystem partners, third parties, and internal stakeholders to support successful delivery and future opportunities.

· Identify, qualify, and manage expansion and follow-on sales opportunities by understanding client priorities and unmet needs and partnering with account, sales, and practice leadership to shape solutions, estimates, proposals, staffing strategies, presentations, and the transition from sales to delivery.

· Maintain visibility into the sales opportunity pipeline, next steps, owners, dependencies, and risks, and support disciplined progression through applicable sales-stage governance.

· Capture lessons learned, reusable assets, and delivery insights that strengthen the Workday practice and improve future engagements.

Here’s What You Need:

  • Minimum of 8 years of experience leading enterprise technology, ERP, or business transformation initiatives, including responsibility for end-to-end delivery.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience leading Workday implementation, deployment, optimization, or support engagements.
  • Minimum of 4 years experience leading at least two end-to-end Workday deployments through planning, design, configuration, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization.
  • Minimum of 4 years experience leading cross-functional teams spanning functional, technical, integration, data, security, reporting, testing, and change disciplines.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associates Degree, must have minimum 6 years of work experience)

Bonus Points If:

  • Demonstrated experience managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, quality, and change control.
  • Experience communicating with executive sponsors and translating detailed delivery information into concise, decision-oriented reporting.
  • Experience managing client and engagement financials, including budgets, revenue and cost forecasts, staffing, utilization, margin, invoicing, commercial performance, and contract obligations in a consulting or client-services environment.
  • Experience managing a sales opportunity pipeline, including opportunity identification and qualification, client needs discovery, solution shaping, estimating, proposal development, sales-stage governance, and coordination with account and practice leadership.
  • Working knowledge of Workday implementation methods and lifecycle activities, including tenant strategy, testing cycles, data conversion, integrations, security, cutover, and production readiness.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead distributed teams and collaborate across client, partner, vendor, and global delivery organizations.
  • You have led large, multi-workstream, multi-country, or global Workday transformation programs.
  • You have experience with Workday Human Capital Management, Financial Management, Payroll, Adaptive Planning, Supply Chain Management, or cross-platform transformation programs.
  • You hold an active Workday certification or have completed Workday delivery training relevant to program leadership.
  • You hold a recognized delivery, project, program, or agile credential, such as PMP, PgMP, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent certification.
  • You have experience recovering challenged programs, managing complex commercial situations, or leading high-risk cutover and deployment activities.
  • You have external client-facing consulting experience and a track record of managing sales opportunities, supporting pursuits, shaping solutions, and contributing to account growth.
  • You have experience leading distributed, offshore, or global delivery teams and third-party vendors.

  • Забезпечувати баєрів робочими активами: збирати запити на акаунти, BM і сторінки, формувати заявки на закупівлю, отримувати, перевіряти й видавати дозволені до використання активи.

  • Вести реєстр інфраструктури: BM → акаунти → сторінки → пікселі → платежі → профілі.

  • Щодня контролювати стан активів: статуси, верифікації, ліміти, залишки й обмеження; підтримувати резерв дозволених активів і відновлення після інцидентів через офіційні процедури.

Оптимізація кампаній і робота з креативами до задач не входять.

  • Глибоке знання Meta Business Manager: ролі й доступи, верифікації, Account Quality, білінг, пікселі/CAPI.

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an Instructional Design Manager who will lead the instructional design team (including instructional designers and instructional technologists) to produce high-quality online courses and instructional assets delivered using advanced learning technologies.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an Instructional Design Manager who will lead the instructional design team (including instructional designers and instructional technologists) to produce high-quality online courses and instructional assets delivered using advanced learning technologies. The manager will provide leadership in designing, developing and supporting online instruction, evaluating the effectiveness of that instruction, and planning for improvement that utilizes emerging best practices and innovations.

This position leads the Johns Hopkins School of Nursing's instructional design team, which partners with faculty and subject matter experts to design, develop, and continuously improve courses and learning experiences across the school's educational offerings. Reporting to the Director of Instructional Design, the Instructional Design Manager serves as the school's lead instructional design liaison to its programs and initiatives

Specific Duties & Responsibilities

Management and Supervision

  • Hire and supervise instructional designers, instructional technologists and other part-time members of the instructional design team.
  • Provide leadership to the instructional design team to produce pedagogically sound web-based courses by modeling effective instructional design, communicating with team members regarding required and completed tasks, outlining project plans, and providing status reports.
  • Build a high functioning team that is highly collaborative with other departments to ensure that dependent processes between departments function optimally and that the student experience in online courses is of a high-quality befitting our nationally ranked programs.
  • Develop instructional technologies project costs for grant and other related activities.
  • Monitor and manage risks to achieve goals and minimize negative impacts on course development and other instructional activities.

Instructional Design and Evaluation Leadership

  • Collaborate with the Associate Dean for Teaching and Learning and other members of the Academic Team to formulate support and evaluation strategies for online programs and courses.
  • Design production procedures to enable timely, efficient, consistent, and quality course development.
  • Provide educational programs designed to enhance the pedagogical expertise of faculty teaching in all programs offered by the school.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of online instructional approaches used within the school’s courses and develop plans for continuous quality improvement with faculty and the instructional team.
  • Provide solutions to instructional design related challenges using strong negotiation and problem-solving skills.
  • Apply Instructional Design project management best practices to lead team members through course development cycles.
  • Produce reports regarding online courses for distribution to school and university administrators, including but not limited to course enrollments, evaluations, and schedules.
  • Ensure that online courses, degree programs, and the delivery of distance learning are incompliance with university, state and federal regulations, guidelines and policies.

Instructional Design

  • In addition to serving as the manager for the team, serves as the lead instructional design liaison for one or more academic programs within the school.
  • Assist faculty in selection, use, design, and evaluation of web-based instructional strategies and technology.
  • Use the latest tools and technologies for online course development.
  • Assist faculty and instructional design team to use templates as a guideline for developing courses and modules.
  • Working with Information Technology Services, provides documentation and training resources to students and faculty in the use of instructional technologies used to support online instruction.
  • Assist with the writing and execution of grants to support the development of online courses or modules.
  • Research current and upcoming technologies and delivery modalities to guide growth and relevance of the instructional design team.
  • Other duties as assigned.

In addition to the duties described above

  • Serve as the lead instructional design liaison to SON academic programs and coordinate design priorities across programs with program leadership and faculty.
  • Lead course quality assurance using Quality Matters standards, including guiding the team and faculty through course reviews and improvement plans.
  • Lead design and development of courses, including establishing and maintaining SON course templates and standards for consistency across programs.
  • Turn strategy into operational procedures and workflows for the team.
  • Support university and school-level planning, assessment, and evaluation processes with data and reporting on online course development and quality.
  • Support strategic initiatives related to online learning quality, accessibility, learning analytics, faculty development, and continuous improvement of digital learning environments.


Minimum Qualifications
  • Master’s Degree in Instructional Design, Instructional Technology, Education, or related field.
  • Five years related experience including,
    • Supervisory experience and management skills.
    • Experience in instructional design and development with emphasis on designing both fully online and hybrid online academic courses.
    • Experience integrating technology into online instruction.
  • Additional education may substitute for required experience and additional related experience may substitute for required education beyond a high school diploma/graduation equivalent, to the extent permitted by the JHU equivalency formula.


Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with academic course design, project management, and Storyline or other course authoring tools strongly preferred
  • Record of publications and/or presentations related to instructional design, education, learning technology or other related fields.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems (preferably Blackboard).
  • Three or more years of experience managing a team of instructional designers through multiple concurrent course development projects.

Technical Qualifications & Specialized Certifications

  • Should have membership/direct affiliation with professional associations and organizations that support future thinking around distance education.

Technical Skills & Expected Level of Proficiency

  • ADA Compliance - Advanced
  • Adult Learning Principles - Advanced
  • Educational Technologies - Advanced
  • Instructional Strategies - Advanced
  • Learning Management Systems - Advanced
  • Learning Theory - Advanced
  • Process Improvement - Advanced
  • Project Management - Advanced

The core technical skills listed are most essential; additional technical skills may be required based on specific division or department needs.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Department Overview

The Ecosystem Operations Team delivers solutions to the public safety sector. The group is committed to providing technology and tools which will allow customers to focus on their mission, and enable them to respond faster with smarter and safer decisions. The group builds integrations between different products and features such as Computer Aided Dispatch (CAD), Records Management Systems (RMS), Jail Management Systems and Evidences management among other offerings. Interfaces are typically between Motorola Solutions, Inc. (MSI) products and third party applications. The team is in charge of API Enablement front, providing solutions and governance over product API in the ecosystem internally or externally exposed.


Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to drive the testing strategy and execution for our API governance and integrations platform. In this role, you will act as a quality advocate from both a product development and a platform engineering perspective. You will ensure the robustness of our internal and external APIs, validate API Gateway configurations, and mandate governance processes. This role requires a balance of hands-on automated script development, strategic manual testing, day-to-day sprint validation, and clear documentation practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • API & Gateway Validation: Test and validate API Gateway connections, routing rules, rate limiting, and security policies for all onboarded APIs.
  • Governance Assurance: Mandate and verify API governance processes, ensuring all new and updated APIs strictly comply with MSI ecosystem standards before deployment.
  • Automated & Manual Testing: Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for backend services and UI components (like the API Hub), while executing deep-dive manual exploratory testing for complex integrations.
  • Sprint Execution: Lead day-to-day sprint validation, partnering with Product Owners and Developers to define clear acceptance criteria and ensure seamless feature delivery.
  • Documentation & Runbooks: Maintain and review structural and user documentation, ensuring developer portals, API specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger), and QA runbooks are accurate and up to date.
  • CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated test suites directly into CI/CD pipelines (mostly GitHub Actions) to block non-compliant code from reaching production.
  • Mentorship: Act as the subject matter expert on software quality, guiding mid-level engineers and cross-functional teams on testing best practices.


Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Ability to communicate in English on a daily basis (advanced level).
  • 5+ years of experience in professional software testing, encompassing both manual and automated methodologies.
  • Deep expertise in testing RESTful web services, API architectures, and system integrations.
  • Demonstrated experience with API Gateways (preferably Azure APIM) and validating governance policies.
  • Strong understanding of Agile Software Development practices and active participation in sprint ceremonies.
  • Must be able to obtain background clearance as required by government customers.

Additional qualifications and experience that would be helpful:

  • Experience building automation frameworks using tools like Robot Framework, Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
  • Experience with Cloud technologies (Azure preferred) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity Git and CI/CD concepts (GitHub Actions).
  • Previous experience operating within a platform team setting.

None


Relocation Provided

None

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in Poland

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara’s investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.description:
About Endpoints News Media Company, LLC

Endpoints News, founded in 2016, is a leading news media company with a clear mission: to deliver the best news product in biopharma and be the essential daily read for industry leaders globally. Now a part of the Financial Times family, Endpoints News has 290,000+ registered readers and continues to grow its reach with breaking news, in-depth analysis, live and virtual events and award-winning journalism.

The Role

This is a leadership role. You lead the technology function across engineering, delivery and operations: setting the standard, making the calls, growing the people, running the work, and answering to the business for what it delivers.

You also ship. The team is small and everyone at Endpoints is an IC at some level, including the people who lead. You'll be in the codebase every week and carrying real work of your own, because that's how things get built here and because it's the only way to lead a team this size credibly.

You'll report to the SVP, Design, Product and Technology and work alongside them daily. A lot of the job is the two of you thinking out loud: what's worth building, what it would take, what it would cost. You'll help shape the technical strategy together (architecture direction, build-versus-buy, where the platform goes next), with the SVP owning the final call and the direction for product and design. The technical thinking is yours, and we'd much rather hear "here's how we could do that" than "here's why we can't".

You'll be the technology counterpart to editorial and commercial leadership. The remit is wider than engineering. Delivery, technical program management, the operational layer, the business systems the company runs on, and the vendors who extend the team all sit with you, and the team beneath you will grow to reflect that.

This role is based in the United States and is fully remote.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and grow the technology team across engineering, delivery and operations. Own the people side fully — hiring, performance, development and the hard conversations — and manage through a manager as the function scales.
  • Shape the technical strategy with the SVP — architecture direction, build, buy and integrate calls, and where the platform needs to go next. The SVP owns the final decision; you own the thinking that informs it and the delivery that follows.
  • Turn product direction into shipped work. Own everything between the outcome, standard and date and working software in production — scoping, technical requirements, sequencing, and the commitments we make back to editorial and business stakeholders.
  • Run delivery across the technology function. Own the cadence, the dependencies and the visibility that lets the rest of the company know what's coming and when.
  • Answer for what the team ships. Set the standard, review architecture and overrule it on technical grounds where required, and put mechanisms in place that catch problems before production.
  • Ship code every week. The team is small and everyone here builds, including the people who lead. You'll carry real work of your own — the hard problems, the spikes that set direction, the things that have to land — alongside the team rather than above it.
  • Stand up new products and evolve the existing ones across news, subscriptions and identity, data and events, including the wind-down of what the new platform replaces.
  • Lead security across everything we run: what's exposed, who has access, what's still running that shouldn't be, third-party risk, and the response when something happens.
  • Own the content and data spine. You and your team build the spine, not the surface: the interface is design's - our designers author the design system and ship it to production themselves. Shape the content model, keep the CMS moving, build the APIs and MCP services every surface and every team draws on, and finish that shift across the rest of the estate.
  • Own the operational layer — environments, CI, previews, observability, and the road to production that lets a designer ship with confidence.
  • Own the internal systems and tooling the business runs on — the integrations across CRM, events, email and subscriptions, and the services that let business teams work directly with our own data.
  • Direct the contractors and vendors who extend the team, and hold their output to the same standard as our own.
  • Get sound AI-assisted work from non-engineers live quickly, and know when it isn't sound.
  • Partner with editorial and business leadership to turn ideas into shipped features at the pace a newsroom requires.

Technical Requirements

Our actual stack, not a generic list. We care more about depth than about covering every line.

Hands-on, Every week
  • TypeScript, Node.js, modern tooling
  • Payload CMS on PostgreSQL, or equivalent depth in a headless, code-first CMS
  • Content modeling and API design — GraphQL and REST
  • Next.js, and Astro with React islands
  • Application security — authentication and authorization you can demonstrate are enforced, secrets management, dependency hygiene, least privilege
  • LLM-native workflow — AI tools as a core part of how you and your team build, and knowing where not to use them
Depth you've built before, even where you now direct it
  • Identity and payments — SSO/OIDC (we run Logto), Stripe, entitlements, paywall logic
  • AWS — Lambda via OpenNext, S3, CloudFront, IAM, RDS — and containers on Kubernetes
  • Security operations — attack surface and asset inventory, decommissioning, access lifecycle, credential rotation, logging that can answer a forensic question
  • Incident response — containment, evidence, and reporting that states what the logs show
  • Privacy and compliance — GDPR and CCPA, consent and tracking, data retention
  • PHP, MySQL, Python/FastAPI, Elasticsearch, message brokers

What We're Looking For

  • A leader first. 5+ years leading technical teams, including managing engineers directly and managing through other managers. You've hired, developed and exited people, set a team's standard, and been accountable for what it delivered.
  • And a builder every week. Everyone at Endpoints contributes as an IC at some level, and at this team size that includes you. You'll be writing and shipping production code regularly, not symbolically.
  • Leadership beyond engineering. You've owned delivery, operations, vendor relationships and stakeholder commitments — not just the codebase — and you've been the person the business holds to account for technology outcomes.
  • And a builder every week. Everyone at Endpoints contributes as an IC at some level, and at this team size that includes you. You'll be writing and shipping production code regularly, not symbolically.
  • You take a short ask and build the right thing. A sentence of business intent is enough for you to come back with what it means technically, what it costs and what it breaks.
  • Real backend and infrastructure depth, even where you no longer use it daily. You'll be accountable for work you don't write.
  • You've worked where designers ship their own code.
  • You've directed contractors and vendors and held their output to your own standard.
  • A thinking partner. The SVP will bring you ideas and expect a real conversation: what it would take, what it would break, and what a better version might be. You make your case, and you commit once the call is made.
  • Comfortable being the technical voice in a room of editorial and commercial leaders, and translating in both directions.
  • A background in media or publishing is a strong plus, not a requirement.

Compensation

Total compensation opportunity: ~$215,000, inclusive of ~$175k base and ~$40k annual bonus.

It's important to note that salary information provided in job descriptions is subject to change and may be dependent on a variety of factors such as location, experience, and qualifications. The salary range provided is meant to give potential applicants an idea of the compensation they can expect, but it is not a guarantee of a specific salary. Actual salary may vary based on individual factors and negotiations. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on salary history or other personal factors.

Why Join Us?

🌍 Work From Anywhere!

👥 Positive, Supportive, and Collaborative Work Culture.

🌴 Paid Time Off: Generous PTO is offered annually, plus 12 company holidays and 2 floating holidays!

🩺Medical Insurance: Endpoints pays 70% of premiums for employee, spouse, and/or dependents.

🦷Fully-Paid Benefits for Employees: Dental and Vision insurance, Short-Term and Long Term Disability, $50,000 Basic Life and AD&D Insurance, and our Employee Assistance Program.

We are committed to fostering an environment that is inclusive, transparent, and collaborative. Why You'll Want to Join

jobs.excerpt: The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.
jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Security Engineer, Network & Zero Trust, to own the network pillar of Sezzle's zero-trust program: every connection explicitly allowed, authenticated by service identity, and attributable after the fact — across our Kubernetes clusters, AWS accounts, and the paths between them.

You will take ownership of our network-policy program — default-deny micro-segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters — and carry the rest of the pillar forward with it: identity-aware service-to-service transport, per-application private access, flow-level visibility, and network configuration managed as reviewed code.

This is an engineering role: you will write the policies, the tooling, and the rollout automation yourself, and you will carry changes through other teams' services without breaking delivery. You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and detection and response, and with the platform and IAM teams on service identity — your network controls are what their work relies on, and your telemetry is what their detections run on.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows — flow analysis, policy generation from observed traffic, drift review — that let the team segment a large estate.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own east-west segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters: design the segmentation model, derive network policies from observed traffic, and keep every workload reachable only through explicitly allowed, identity-bound paths — a default that holds as the estate grows, not a one-time project.
  • Deliver identity-aware transport — design and roll out mutually authenticated, encrypted service-to-service connections (mTLS), so that authorization decisions rest on verified service identity.
  • Keep a live map of the network: VPC peerings, tunnels, cross-account links, and every public entry point — built from cloud APIs and reconciled continuously, so every path into production is known and justified.
  • Own segmentation of production and the cardholder-data environment: implement and enforce the CDE and high-trust-tier boundaries, review every peering and public exposure against them, and run segmentation testing with the security team.
  • Partner with IT on private access: evaluate and help deliver per-application access (ZTNA) for engineers and operators reaching production systems.
  • Own network telemetry: flow logs east-west and north-south, with enough identity on both ends that "who talked to what, when" is answerable in minutes — and feed it to our SIEM for the detection team.
  • Own cluster admission control and hold the line on drift: workload admission policy (pod security, image provenance, network policy), security groups and firewall rules declared in git, applied only through the IaC pipeline, with admission control at the gate and drift detected and reverted automatically.
  • Contain: build the levers that let us isolate a workload or segment quickly when detection flags lateral movement, and take part in incident response when the network is in play.
  • Participate in threat modeling and design reviews for anything that changes how traffic flows, and in the on-call rotation for the controls you own.

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of experience in security, network, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on ownership of network controls in cloud production environments.
  • Deep, practical Kubernetes networking knowledge: CNI, NetworkPolicy semantics, DNS, ingress/egress — and experience rolling segmentation out on live clusters without outages.
  • Strong AWS networking: VPCs, subnets, security groups, peering and Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, load balancers, flow logs.
  • Hands-on experience with mTLS and service-to-service authentication (service mesh, proxies, or CNI-level encryption).
  • Infrastructure as code as your default way of working — Terraform and Helm or equivalents, through merge requests and CI, across repositories you don't own.
  • Ability to write real code (Go, Python, or Bash) for tooling and automation, not only configuration.
  • Ability to investigate directly with packet captures, flow logs, and system-level data.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS network requirements — segmentation, scoping of the cardholder-data environment, segmentation testing.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Cilium / eBPF in production, including Hubble or equivalent flow observability.
  • mTLS at fleet scale, including certificate lifecycle — service mesh (e.g., Istio, Linkerd, Cilium service mesh) and workload identity standards such as SPIFFE/SPIRE.
  • You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — flow analysis, policy generation, drift review.
  • Experience evaluating or deploying ZTNA / identity-aware proxy products. ● Policy-as-code and admission control (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, conftest).
  • Experience with network detection — IDS/IPS, anomalous-flow and lateral-movement detection — and with containment during incidents.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 and with FFIEC-style examination expectations for network security. ● Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or other regulated environments.

About You:

  • You'd rather close a path than document it - an allow-list that exists in production beats a diagram of how the network should look.
  • You change other teams' systems without breaking them - you roll out in observe mode first, measure, and earn the right to enforce.
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewVoted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Human-Centered Design (HCD) Manager to bridge the gap between user needs and technical execution. You will lead qualitative research, map user journeys, build interactive prototypes, and run usability tests to ensure our products are intuitive, accessible, and impactful for the physicians, clinical staff, billers, front-desk teams, and patients who rely on them every day. In a clinical setting, a confusing screen costs a provider time, adds to burnout, and can affect patient safety, so this role carries real weight. You will thrive here if you love sitting with users in their actual workflows, can turn messy observations into clear direction, and can defend design decisions with evidence.

Key Responsibilities

User Research

  • Conduct contextual inquiries, interviews, field observations, and surveys with physicians, clinical staff, billers, and patients to uncover explicit and latent needs.
  • Partner with account managers and support teams to surface usability pain points from client feedback and support tickets.

Synthesis & Strategy

  • Translate research into personas, journey maps, service blueprints, and system workflows across clinical, operational, and billing processes.
  • Present insights to product and executive leadership to shape roadmap priorities.

Ideation & Prototyping

  • Facilitate cross-functional design workshops and build low- to high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
  • Design AI-powered features (AI charting, AI agents) that keep clinicians in control and make AI output easy to review and correct.

Usability Testing

  • Plan, moderate, and analyze formative and summative usability tests to iterate on designs before and during development.
  • Evaluate safety-critical workflows such as medication management and e-prescribing, and support ONC Safety-Enhanced Design testing.

Collaboration & Governance

  • Partner with product managers, business analysts, and engineers in Agile/Scrum teams to maintain design integrity from concept through release.
  • Uphold accessibility standards (WCAG, Section 508) and HIPAA-safe research practices across all products.

Leadership

  • Build and scale WRS Health's HCD practice, including research operations, templates, and standards.
  • Mentor designers and researchers, and coach teammates on human-centered methods.

Qualifications

Required

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Centered Design, Human-Factors Engineering, Interaction Design, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3 to 6+ years of professional experience in HCD, UX design, or user research, including enterprise or regulated-industry experience.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in prototyping software (Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD), qualitative research methodologies, usability testing frameworks, and Agile/Scrum delivery flows.
  • Accessibility: Working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG standards and how to apply them in practice.
  • Core Competencies: Strong empathy, verbal storytelling, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to defend design decisions with data.
  • A portfolio or case studies demonstrating end-to-end research, synthesis, prototyping, and measurable impact.

Preferred

  • Experience designing for EHR, practice management, revenue cycle, telehealth, or other health IT products.
  • Familiarity with clinical workflows and terminology across ambulatory specialties.
  • Knowledge of ONC Safety-Enhanced Design (user-centered design and summative testing) requirements, NISTIR 7804, or ISO 9241-210.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted or automation features, including human-in-the-loop review patterns.
  • Prior experience leading or mentoring designers/researchers, or building a design function from the ground up.
  • Experience with remote research and unmoderated testing tools and product analytics platforms.
  • Clinical background or prior work in a medical practice setting.

A Day in the Life

Your days move between the field, the whiteboard, and the prototype. You might start by joining the product team's stand-up to flag a research insight affecting an upcoming sprint, then sit in (virtually or on-site) with a specialty practice to watch how the front desk, medical assistants, and physicians actually work, noting the workarounds they've built and where the screens slow them down. Later, you could be synthesizing those observations into an updated journey map, facilitating a workshop with product managers, engineers, and billing specialists to sketch solutions, or moderating a usability test of a new AI charting feature to see how a clinician reviews and trusts AI-drafted notes. Before the day ends, you refine prototypes in Figma based on what you learned, check designs against accessibility standards, share prioritized recommendations with product leadership, and make time to coach the designers and researchers on your team.

Success Metrics

  • Measurable usability gains: Improved task success rates, time-on-task, error rates, and System Usability Scale (SUS) scores for redesigned workflows, including fewer clicks and less documentation time for key clinical tasks.
  • Research-driven roadmap: Consistent monthly contact with users across specialties, with a clear, visible share of roadmap items originating from or validated by HCD research.
  • Fewer usability issues post-release: Decline in usability-related support tickets, rework, and post-launch design defects.
  • Accessibility and certification compliance: New and updated features meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards at release, and ONC Safety-Enhanced Design documentation is completed on time.
  • Adoption and satisfaction: Higher feature adoption (including AI features) and improved client satisfaction or NPS for redesigned areas.

Job Details

  • Job Type: Full-time | Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

Compensation will be based on location, experience, and qualifications.

jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
