jobs.description:
O3 Solutions provides a digital project management platform purpose-built for capital projects. Driven by industry best practices, including Advanced Work Packaging (AWP), Agile, and Lean methodologies, O3 helps teams of all kinds achieve measurable success from early phase planning through execution, systems completion, and start up.

At O3, we are committed to building a team of talented, passionate individuals who are dedicated to reshaping the future of the construction industry. Our people are the driving force behind everything we achieve, and we’re always looking for exceptional talent to join us on our journey.

About the role

The Sr. Cloud Engineer shares responsibility for the design, build, and operation of O3’s cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on senior role for someone who brings ideas forward: you will propose how our environments should evolve, make the case for it, and build it alongside the team. O3 runs primarily on Microsoft Azure and has expanded into AWS and GCP. Day to day you will design and manage scalable, secure, and reliable cloud environments, take a leading hand in infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD, and serve as a senior escalation point for the team.

What you'll do

  • Design, implement, and operate scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure supporting O3’s applications and services, primarily on Microsoft Azure, as well as AWS and GCP.
  • Contribute to the technical direction of O3’s cloud platform by bringing forward proposals for what should be built next along with the reasoning and trade-offs, and carry them through once agreed.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code (IaC) pipelines using Terraform or OpenTofu, contributing reusable modules that keep every environment version-controlled and reproducible.
  • Build and maintain continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins to ensure rapid and reliable delivery within an Agile (Scrum) environment.
  • Administer and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access policies, and hybrid identity configurations.
  • Design and operate O3’s platform on Azure PaaS and managed services, including supporting Windows and Linux servers (patching, backup, and disaster recovery).
  • Own capacity planning and scaling for O3’s platform: autoscaling, load testing, multi-region design, and cost at scale. Evaluate container orchestration options (including Kubernetes), make recommendations, and lead the migration of existing workloads onto Kubernetes if needed.
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions (PagerDuty, Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, SIEM) to ensure system reliability, performance, and scalability. Continuously optimize infrastructure for cost and performance.
  • Ensure all cloud infrastructure adheres to security best practices and O3’s compliance obligations, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, GDPR, and other relevant frameworks.
  • Design and enforce zero-trust architecture, network segmentation, MFA, and least-privilege access controls.
  • Work closely with development, operations, security, and product teams to align cloud infrastructure with O3’s strategic goals and project requirements.
  • Partner with the Cloud Security Engineer so that security review is built into IaC and CI/CD rather than bolted on after deployment.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for the team, resolving complex networking, systems, and application issues.
  • Automate repetitive operational tasks through scripting (PowerShell, Python, Go, or C#) to reduce toil and improve reliability.
  • Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for all infrastructure, runbooks, and standard operating procedures, including the reasoning behind architectural decisions.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews.

Serving members across all 50 states, Connexus Credit Union is a member-focused cooperative that is proud to return profits to member-owners through high yields for checking accounts and deposit products, as well as competitive rates on our loans. We are a remote first employer with the majority of our employees residing in the upper Midwest.

As an employer we foster collaboration and high performance to achieve excellence. We holistically care for and develop our employees to thrive personally and professionally. We are proud to share our success with our employees and those we serve.

  • 20 days of paid time off and 10 paid holidays

  • 401K Retirement with up to 6% employer match
  • Excellent Health, Dental, Vision insurance, including multiple plan options
  • Health Savings Account with generous employer contributions

  • Tuition Reimbursement from $4,000 - $7,000 per calendar year

About the Role:

The Service Desk Specialist is the first point of contact for end-user technical support, resolving hardware, software, network, and system issues efficiently. The role troubleshoots technology issues, manages incidents and service requests, supports remote and on-site users, and escalates complex issues when necessary. The specialist also maintains troubleshooting guides and knowledge base content and collaborates with other BT teams to secure technology, implement solutions, meet service-level commitments, and improve service delivery. This role requires excellent customer service, strong follow-through, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Responsibilities:

End User Support:

  • Acts as the first point of contact for user phone calls and self-service submitted support tickets to the Service Desk.
  • Triages and accurately documents user support issues according to defined procedures, focusing on impact and urgency.
  • Acts as a liaison between customers and technical escalation teams, communicating technical information in layman’s terms.
  • Resolves incidents with known solutions, according to support standards and defined procedures.
  • Regularly reviews tickets logged in the ISM platform and assigns them to the appropriate team for a timely response.
  • Escalates more involved issues to the Senior Service Desk Specialists or the appropriate Tier 3 support teams as needed.
  • Provides excellent customer service support with a focus on enhancing the user experience, including scheduled visits to assigned locations.
  • Follows through to ensure all assigned tasks are appropriately communicated and resolved to the users’ satisfaction.
  • Works on departmental projects as needed and performs other duties as assigned.

Records & Document Management:

  • Assists in preparing hardware, software, and process-related documentation such as troubleshooting guides and knowledgebases articles.
  • Ensures the confidentiality and security of records are maintained.
  • Reviews and maintains Service Desk documentation and knowledge base articles.
  • Regularly reviews tickets assigned to Service Desk and BT teams for a timely response as measured against Service Level Agreements (SLA’s).
  • Meets regularly with the manager to review work, discuss project status, recommend process changes, voice concerns, and seek guidance as necessary.
  • Complies with all Federal Regulations as they pertain to the job duties, including BSA.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Position Requirements:

  • This position is Remote.
  • Your schedule will be Monday – Friday 8:30am – 5:30pm CST.
  • You will be required to work an on-call schedule approximately 1 week every 6 weeks from Tuesday-Tuesday scheduled. The on-call rotation schedule may include after hours, weekends, and holidays.
  • Associate’s degree or commensurate experience is Required.
  • 1+ year of prior Service Desk IT Troubleshooting experience is Required.
  • Ability to troubleshoot issues, problem solve, and multi-task with attention to detail is Required.
  • Customer-oriented positive attitude with strong time management, initiative, and work ethic is Required.
  • Effective communication (interpersonal, verbal, and written) skills, analytical ability, judgment, and a demonstrated ability to work effectively with the credit union team members is Required.
  • Strong computer skills including MS Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.) is Required.
  • Experience creating support documentation is Required.

About the Role

The Senior Director, Corporate Marketing owns how A-LIGN is seen, heard, and trusted, leading corporate communications, brand marketing, and the creative design function, translating company strategy into a differentiated presence in the market. In this role, you will be responsible for the strategic direction and day-to-day execution of corporate communications, brand marketing, and creative across every channel A-LIGN goes to market through. As the Senior Director, Corporate Marketing, you will build and lead a multidisciplinary team spanning design and communications, while managing public relations (PR) agency and freelance partners to extend capacity. A-LIGN will depend on you to define brand architecture and messaging standards, govern visual and verbal identity globally, elevate corporate and executive thought leadership, and use artificial intelligence (AI) and self-service tools to scale creative delivery. This role partners closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, People Operations, and executive leadership to ensure corporate marketing investment tracks to business outcomes. The ideal candidate is a senior marketing leader with brand and communications depth who pairs genuine craft standards with commercial accountability, builds durable process, and thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

Reports to

Senior Vice President, Marketing

Pay Classification

Full-Time, Exempt

Responsibilities

BRAND MARKETING

  • Own A-LIGN’s global brand strategy (architecture, corporate positioning, messaging framework, and verbal identity) and govern its consistent application across every market-facing channel
  • Define and maintain the messaging hierarchy that connects the corporate narrative to service line, industry, and persona-level messaging so every go-to-market team works from a single source of truth
  • Partner with Product Marketing, which owns content strategy and production, to ensure content reflects corporate positioning, messaging, and brand standards
  • Plan and lead brand marketing campaigns that build awareness, authority, and reputation, partnering with Demand Generation and Product Marketing so brand investment amplifies pipeline programs
  • Own brand health measurement, including awareness, share of voice, brand sentiment, reputation, and message resonance, and present performance and recommendations to executive leadership on a regular cadence
  • Conduct ongoing research into industry trends, customer insights, and the competitive landscape to identify white space and keep A-LIGN’s voice ahead of a crowded compliance market
  • Protect the A-LIGN brand by governing trademark and logo use, partner and co-branding standards, and the accuracy and compliance of public claims, in partnership with Legal

CORPORATE COMMUNICATIONS

  • Own the external communications strategy, including press releases, media relations, and announcement planning for certification, product, partnership, and corporate milestones, directing the PR agency to earn coverage that builds authority
  • Build and run the LinkedIn and social program across the corporate channel and executive and practitioner voices, setting the editorial approach, publishing cadence, and engagement standards
  • Direct the corporate and executive thought leadership program, working with internal subject matter experts and the global go-to-market function to define areas of focus and convert practitioner expertise into differentiated market commentary
  • Build and run the awards and speaking program: identify high-value awards, conferences, and industry events, and prepare and submit nominations and speaking proposals that position A-LIGN leaders and practitioners as industry authorities
  • Partner with executive leadership to build executive visibility, including media and speaking preparation, bylines, and executive social presence
  • Amplify external news, brand messaging, and company milestones to employees through internal channels, and support executive leadership on company-wide announcements in partnership with People Operations
  • Serve as the final review on external-facing communications, holding accuracy, tone, and message alignment
  • Partner with Sales, Partnerships, and People Operations to extend brand messaging into customer, partner, and employer brand communications
  • Own crisis and reputation management, including the issues and crisis communications playbook, reputation monitoring, and spokesperson readiness, and lead the cross-functional response with Legal, Security, and executive leadership when an issue could affect A-LIGN’s credibility

CREATIVE

  • Lead the creative function end to end, setting the standard for design and campaign creative while building the briefing structure, review cadence, and production process that allow the team to deliver at speed
  • Hire, develop, and lead the creative design team, and manage agency, freelance, and production partners to extend capacity without diluting quality
  • Own brand guidelines, visual identity, and templates, and govern their consistent application across the company, including video, web, and event content produced by other teams
  • Optimize creative delivery with AI by evaluating and adopting AI-enabled design and workflow tools and setting guardrails that protect brand quality, accuracy, and intellectual property
  • Build self-service creative capabilities, including templates, brand asset libraries, and intake workflows, so teams across the company can fulfill routine creative requests without creating a bottleneck for the creative team
  • Maintain tight working alignment with the Product Marketing content team on video and multimedia production, setting shared briefs, brand standards, and review processes so content is on brand and delivered at speed
  • Partner with Demand Generation and Product Marketing to integrate creative into program planning from the outset, ensuring brand and messaging directly strengthen campaign performance

LEADERSHIP & OPERATIONS

  • Build, develop, and lead the corporate marketing team across communications, brand, and creative, defining the structure, hiring plan, and goals as the function scales
  • Set the annual corporate marketing plan, priorities, and key performance indicators (KPIs) in step with the company go-to-market strategy, and report results to the Senior Vice President, Marketing, and executive leadership on a regular cadence
  • Plan and manage the corporate marketing budget, allocating investment across communications, brand, and creative programs and across in-house and external resources, including the PR agency and freelance partners, and hold the team accountable to output and outcome targets
  • Lead corporate messaging and communications planning for major company moments, such as acquisitions, leadership changes, new service launches, and rebrands

Minimum Qualifications

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Design, Business, or other relevant field

EXPERIENCE

  • 10+ years of corporate marketing, communications, brand, or creative experience, including 4+ years leading and developing teams
  • Proven track record of building and executing brand and communications strategies that delivered measurable business results in a B2B environment
  • Experience leading corporate communications, brand, and creative functions, including direct management of designers and communications professionals
  • Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, and production partners against scope, budget, and quality standards
  • Experience leading executive visibility, media relations, and crisis or issues communications, including working directly with C-suite leaders and PR agencies
  • Hands-on experience adopting AI tools and self-service workflows to improve creative or communications productivity while protecting brand quality
  • Proficiency with social media, media monitoring, and creative production tools, and reporting platforms used to measure brand, reputation, and communications performance
  • Exposure to the cybersecurity, compliance, or professional services industry is a plus

SKILLS

  • Exceptional writing and editing ability, with the judgment to set editorial standards for others and raise the quality of work you did not create yourself
  • Strong creative point of view; you can direct design and brand creative work, give specific and actionable feedback, and defend a creative decision with clear reasoning
  • Comfortable translating brand, communications, and reputation activity into commercial metrics; you can build a performance dashboard and present it to an executive audience
  • Highly organized operator who builds structure around creative and communications work: briefs, calendars, review cycles, and clear ownership
  • Sound judgment and composure under pressure, with the executive presence to advise senior leaders on reputation-sensitive decisions and communicate with credibility in high-stakes moments
  • Effective cross-functional collaborator with a track record of working well with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Legal, and People Operations to launch integrated programs
  • Self-motivated and comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and agility is valued
  • Strong attention to detail, with a drive to continuously raise the quality and impact of your team's work

  • Competitive Bonus Structure

  • Paid Office Closure December 25-January 1
  • Vacation Bonus

A-LIGN is the leading provider of high-quality, efficient cybersecurity compliance programs. Combining experienced auditors and audit management technology, A-LIGN provides the widest breadth and depth of services including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HITRUST, FedRAMP, and PCI. Technical Support Manager

OUR COMPANY

SimX is a fast-growing company that has brought virtual and augmented reality to medical simulation training. At the end of 2024, we were acquired by Madison Industries, a partnership that has provided a surge in resources to accelerate our growth and mission. Our professional-grade VR system is the first of its kind, used by physicians, nurses, and paramedics to reduce medical errors and save lives.

Over the last decade, demand for our product has exploded; we are now used by 10 of the nation’s top 15 hospitals, including world-renowned institutions like the Cleveland Clinic, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Pennsylvania, our product is used around the world, and our technology is deployed across more than 50 US Military installations. We are looking for a mission-driven Technical Support leader to help us continue this momentum and achieve our mission to save lives around the world through better, faster, and more accessible simulation training.

THE JOB

SimX is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Technical Support Manager to join our team in a hands-on, player-coach capacity. You will be responsible for managing a small team of support specialists while staying actively involved in resolving day-to-day client issues. You will ensure the seamless and efficient delivery of technical support to our valued clients, playing a critical role in maintaining customer satisfaction, driving product adoption, and contributing to the overall success of SimX. This role requires a strong blend of technical expertise, people management skills, and a customer-centric mindset.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership & Support Operations:

  • Directly manage, mentor, and guide a small team of Technical Support Specialists, conducting regular 1-on-1s and managing team performance.
    ●Manage scheduling, queue distribution, and escalation paths to ensure complete support coverage.
    ●Establish and maintain efficient support workflows, processes, and best practices.
    ●Oversee the ticketing system (e.g., Zendesk, Jira Service Management) and actively work technical tickets alongside your team to ensure timely and accurate resolution of customer inquiries.
    ●Own key support metrics, monitoring and ensuring compliance with service level agreements (SLAs), including response times, resolution times, and customer satisfaction scores.
    ●Develop and maintain a comprehensive knowledge base and self-help resources for customers and internal staff.
    ●Identify and analyze support trends to proactively address potential issues and improve product usability.
    ●Create a customer feedback gathering process and report to share with the Operations team on a monthly basis.
    ●Provide IT support for internal team members (hardware/software issues, troubleshooting, etc.).

Customer Relationship Management:

  • Act as a point of escalation for complex or critical customer support issues, taking hands-on ownership to ensure timely and satisfactory resolution.
    ●Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customers, understanding their unique needs and challenges.
    ●Monitor customer satisfaction levels and implement strategies to continuously improve the customer support experience.
    ●Gather customer feedback and advocate for product improvements that enhance usability and address customer pain points.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure a cohesive and seamless customer experience.
    ●Collaborate with Engineering, QA, and Product teams to escalate complex technical issues and provide valuable customer feedback.
    ●Contribute to the development of product documentation and training materials.
    ●Participate in product release planning to ensure the support team is prepared for new features and updates.

    MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
    ●Bachelor's degree in a technical fi eld (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology) or equivalent experience.
    ●Minimum of 5 years of experience in a technical support role, with at least 2 years in a management capacity.
    ●Proven ability to build, motivate, and lead a successful technical support team. Strong understanding of software troubleshooting methodologies and best practices.
    ●Experience with ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, Jira Service Management) and knowledge base management.
    ●Excellent communication (written and verbal), interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
    ●Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    ●Strong customer-centric approach with a passion for providing exceptional support.
    You must live in and be authorized to work in the United States. Depending on the position we may have a preference to a specific location, but are generally open to remote work within the continental United States.

    PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
    Note: these are not required to be a successful applicant, but we'd love it if you have one or two! Please also feel free to let us know if you have skills not listed here that you think would make you a great fit for our company.
    ●Experience supporting SaaS or cloud-based software solutions.
    ●Familiarity with virtual reality (VR) or augmented reality (AR) technologies.
    ●Experience in the healthcare or simulation industry.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Target salary range: $95,000 - $125,000 annually; commensurate with experience

●Remote work environment

  • SimX covers 99% of employee premiums and 50% of dependent premiums for medical, dental, and vision
    ●401(k) with employer matching
    ●Company laptop, home office credit, and internet reimbursement
    ●Unlimited PTO

    SimX is an equal opportunity employer. Our goal is to have a workforce that represents the full diversity of the health professionals that we aim to train and the patients whose care we want to improve. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. SimX is committed to making reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.
    The hiring department will conduct interviews of qualified individuals prior to requesting a criminal background check, and no job application submitted prior to such interview shall inquire into an applicant's criminal history. If this position is subject to a background check for any convictions related to its responsibilities and requirements, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation including criminal history. Criminal history will not automatically disqualify a candidate.

jobs.description:
The Bonadio Group is currently seeking a Learning Experience Developer. This role is part of the Bonadio University team and works with learning designers, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to develop engaging self-study and virtual instructor-led learning. The developer transforms approved designs and content into polished, accessible, accurate, and CPE-compliant learning experiences aligned with learning objectives. The role focuses primarily on hands-on development while contributing creative and practical build recommendations. Our is open to considering remote candidates located in the Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) time zone.


The ideal candidate is a skilled learning developer with strong eLearning, motion graphics, visual design, and digital media expertise. They use modern learning technologies and AI to create scalable, innovative learning solutions that enhance the quality, creativity, and reach of the firm’s learning programs.


Responsibilities:


Learning Experience Development

  • Develop interactive self-study eLearning, virtual instructor-led training (vILT) and other modalities from approved design documents, storyboards and source content, ensuring deliverables are engaging, accurate and aligned with learning objectives.
  • Build support materials, including slide decks, facilitator guides, participant guides, pre-work, job aids, evaluation surveys, knowledge checks and other measurement tools defined in the approved learning design.
  • Partner with Service Line Training Directors and other content builders to enhance, complete and apply firm branding to training materials, including taking over partially developed work and bringing it to a polished final product.
  • Create custom multimedia interactions that elevate the learner experience and support scalable, reusable solutions.

AI-Enabled Development

  • Use generative AI and platform-embedded AI tools responsibly and skillfully to accelerate the creation of scripts, assessments, job aids, graphics and video while maintaining high quality and sound instructional standards.
  • Follow firm standards for responsible AI usage, verifying AI-generated content for accuracy, consistency and alignment with firm expectations.
  • Test new AI features and share practical findings with the Learning Design & Experience Specialist, Learning Experience Manager and the broader Bonadio University team.

Quality, CPE Compliance & Accessibility

  • Build the Continuing Professional Education (CPE) elements called for in each approved design, including review questions with feedback, polling and engagement elements, and final assessments, in accordance with applicable NASBA/AICPA standards.
  • Maintain and provide course documentation, word counts, CPE calculations, assessment materials and development information required to support CPE review and audit readiness.
  • Quality-check deliverables before release, applying accessibility standards and firm brand guidelines.

Learning Technology

  • Partner with Learning Operations to publish SCORM packages and test and maintain content in the LMS and related firm platforms, ensuring courses function and track correctly.
  • Build reusable templates, components and assets that improve consistency, scalability and speed across the team's programs.
  • Stay current with industry-standard learning technologies and recommend practical additions or improvements to the team's development toolkit.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Support

  • Work closely with the Learning Design & Experience Specialist to translate approved designs into finished programs, offering recommendations for efficient, effective and innovative builds while maintaining alignment with the approved design strategy.
  • Coordinate with SMEs across service lines, industries and firm leadership to gather source content for development and manage review cycles while respecting client commitments.
  • Communicate content gaps, dependencies, risks and roadblocks early so that decisions can be made before they affect quality, scope or timing.

Project Management

  • Manage multiple development projects simultaneously, balancing timelines, review cycles, version control and available capacity.
  • Ensure deliverables meet quality standards and deadlines while maintaining efficiency in execution.

Required qualifications:

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in instructional design, learning and development, multimedia development, digital media or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • A minimum of two years of experience developing multimodal training materials for adult learners.
  • Advanced development skills in Articulate Storyline 360 and Rise 360, including the ability to create custom interactions.
  • Strong digital media, multimedia and visual design capability, with proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud applications.
  • Working knowledge of adult learning principles and the ability to apply them to course development for an optimal learner experience.
  • Excellent writing, editing and proofreading skills, with the ability to shape provided technical content into clear, concise learner-facing material.
  • A polished, creative portfolio demonstrating current eLearning and digital media development standards, including custom Storyline 360 interactions, Rise 360 development, instructor-led or virtual learning materials, assessment examples, and at least one before-and-after example showing how source content was transformed into a completed learner experience. Applicants should identify any portfolio elements substantially generated by AI and clarify their own contribution.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working in professional services, accounting or a similar regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with NASBA CPE standards and QAS self-study requirements.
  • Advanced video editing, audio, motion animation or graphic design skills using tools such as After Effects, Premiere Pro, Camtasia or Vyond.
  • Experience publishing and troubleshooting content in an LMS using SCORM or xAPI.
  • Experience building materials for virtual classrooms in Microsoft Teams.
  • Experience creating workflow-embedded learning, performance support or other scalable learning products and systems.

The salary range for this position is $60,000 to $65,000 and is commensurate with experience.


Hours of Operation:

  • Our office hours are from 8:00 a.m. until 5:00 p.m. Monday through Friday
  • Our summer hours are from 8:00 a.m. until 5:00 p.m. Monday through Thursday, with Flex Friday scheduling available in accordance with firm policy and business needs
  • We pride ourselves on our flexibility; however, the ability to work additional hours will be needed at peak times

At The Bonadio Group, we believe that an inclusive work environment allows all of our people to achieve their greatest potential and the greatest results for our clients and communities. Bonadio is committed to the principle of equal treatment and opportunity for all people. The Firm is committed to fostering and managing diversity in the workplace as an integral part of its practice and service to clients. The Firm values the rich variety of perspectives and experiences offered by those of different backgrounds. This diversity strengthens our institution and enables it to better respond to our clients’ needs in an increasingly global profession.

In the fast-changing accounting industry, The Bonadio Group is always on the cutting edge of growth and innovation. With our great mentoring and training programs, you’ll be exposed to diversity of work, the ability to tackle more interesting issues, and have a path to Partnership. You’ll be working with great people and great clients where you can truly make a difference. Apply online, get on board, and grow with us. You’ll be glad you did!

jobs.title: Closing Advocate
jobs.excerpt: Are you ready to be a big part of something big? At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience.
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We’re a group of go-getters who decided they didn’t want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

What We Offer

  • An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

  • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 2,500 team members worldwide, and our CAR Group Tour means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

  • Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You’ll Do

The position of Closing Advocate(CA) is responsible for the coordination between the Buyer, Seller, Sales Reps and any third-party vendors as we progress from a Fully-Executed Contract to the Closing. Essentially, the Closing Advocate is the quarterback for the deal ensuring that everyone is doing what they are supposed to be doing.

  • Assist Closing Advocates on getting titles and lien releases in

  • Prepare DMV work for closing team

  • Check DMV work once received by Closing Advocates to ensure everything is correct and filled out properly

  • Make sure all documents that are needed are available for DMV work

  • Make daily calls to banks to check status of titles and lien releases within 5 business days

  • Assist closing team in notarizing documents when needed

  • Get electronic titles printed out once lien has been released via fax to the DMV

  • Drop off DMV to the Sarasota Tax Office for DMV processing

  • Once DMV work comes back in from the DMV office, go through the documents to ensure title work was done correctly and prepare completion packets

  • Track and keep updated all DMV work submitted to the Sarasota Tax Office

  • Assist closing team in preparing for requesting duplicate titles

  • Sending documents to the correct DMV if a duplicate title is needed

  • Reach out to any DMV offices to find out what is needed to request a duplicate title

  • Advise closing team what is needed if when requesting a duplicate title

  • Go through all waiting on banks to make sure we have not been waiting more than 15 business days for titles or liens

  • Sending USCG paperwork via fax or email

  • Assist Closing Quality Control Admin with preparing completion packets

  • Open incoming USPS mail and assign title or lien releases to the proper deal folder in the CQC office. Update deal notes and update staging to either waiting on address confirmation,(depends on the deal) prepping s/b packet, or DMV prep if we are doing title work

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree and/or 2+ years in sales customer service operations

  • Serious dedication to customer service - our team members hold themselves to a high standard and we would expect anyone new to bring the same work ethic to the table.

  • Motivated by participating in a successful close - Not all deals are destined to close and there are some that will close no matter what blows up. However, the majority of the deals will only close with focused leadership and will fail without it. The Closing Advocate is the leader. Your pay will be commensurate with your ability to close your deals.

  • Flexibility - Designed to be an M-F role, it may not always be depending on the particular deal you are working on. There will be times where you're assigned a deal that will require attention in the evening or on the weekend to keep it on track or to assure that it closes properly.

  • Ability to multi-task - Our Closing Advocates are working 35-50 deals during the busy season! This requires some intense multi-tasking skills. Our software system and processes will support you so that nothing is slipping through the cracks, but you will have to have the brain for it. If you get overwhelmed easily, this is not the right role for you.

  • Comfortable with technology - You don't need to be a tech guru, but you will need to know how to download files (and find them later!), attach files, use Google products, scan documents and learn a new system.

  • Proactive management - Your actions will trigger forward movement to a closing. You will need to feel comfortable in the driver's seat, following up, not leaving loose ends and letting a manager know when something seems like it is headed towards a customer service issue.

  • Communication intelligence - What this means is that you need to know when a phone call is more appropriate over an email, or when an email makes more sense than a phone call. We will train you, but you will need to be humble enough to ask questions when you are unsure how to proceed. You will need to know when you should turn on the charm or when it's time to get down to business. You will be working with a lot of stakeholders in a deal. Some of these personalities are more pleasant than others. Your communication style should always be professional no matter how high emotions or tensions are running. Your fellow CAs come to work with a purpose, help each other out, and contribute to a productive and work environment. Every phone call, text or decision should be recorded in the deal to assure that all parties associated with the deal are updated accordingly.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity employer where hiring is based entirely on business needs, job requirements, and individual merit.

Job Title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer – DO178

Location: Remote - Canada

Pay Range: $90,000 - $110,000 CAD, plus bonus eligible

Who we are: Lynx delivers modular, open standards–based software that transforms how high-assurance, mission-critical edge systems are built, deployed, and maintained. Our secure edge computing solutions enable innovation and operational excellence in the world’s most demanding environments, from aerospace and defense to commercial and industrial systems. We partner across industries including automotive, medical, and critical infrastructure to deliver tailored solutions aligned with each customer’s mission and operational requirements. Our key products and services are:

  • MOSA.ic: LYNX MOSA.ic™ is a modular software framework and architecture purpose-built for mission-critical edge computing. Based on the Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA), it provides a flexible foundation for building secure, scalable, and certifiable edge systems.
  • LYNX MOSA.ic.AI: LYNX MOSA.ic.AI is a unified CPU and GPU software platform that enables deterministic, certifiable deployment of AI and advanced workloads in mission-critical edge systems. It brings control, performance, and lifecycle governance together, allowing AI to operate predictably within safety-critical environments without compromising certification or system integrity.
  • CoreSuite 2.0: CoreSuite 2.0 is Lynx’s safety-critical GPU for graphics enablement framework designed for mission-critical edge computing systems. It provides hardware-accelerated graphics, visualization, and video processing capabilities that can be certified for high-assurance systems.
  • Services: Lynx Services is Lynx’s professional services organization that helps customers design, integrate, certify, deploy, and maintain safety- and security-critical systems. It supports industries like aerospace, defense, automotive, and industrial computing through consulting, engineering, integration, and lifecycle support, reducing development risk and accelerating certification in standards-driven, mission-critical environment.

Role Overview

As a DO-178/DO-254 Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Engineer at Lynx, you will be responsible for ensuring that our software development processes and deliverables meet DO-178 and DO-254certification standards. You will work closely with software engineers, certification authorities, and project leads to plan, execute, and audit quality activities across the software development lifecycle. You’ll help shape Lynx’s software quality processes, tools, and culture to scale reliably, safely, and efficiently.

In addition, you will provide focused support for safety relevant verification activities, including tracing safety mechanisms, identifying gaps in safety critical requirements, and coordinating with Engineering to ensure that verification evidence adequately covers safety impacting functionality for CoreSuite and related product components.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support DO-178C and DO-254 certification activities (SOI-1 through SOI-4) across multiple programs, working closely with senior SQA engineers
  • Assist in preparation, review, and refinement of certification artifacts (PSAC, SDP, SVP, SCMP, etc.) to ensure consistency and quality
  • Perform SQA audits, compliance checks, and support gap tracking between planned processes and actual execution
  • Support day-to-day certification execution, including:
  • o Organizing deliverables
  • o Tracking review comments and closures
  • o Maintaining certification evidence packages
  • Participate in configuration management and change control activities (e.g., CCB, baseline tracking)
  • Assist in preparing for customer, Safety Manager/DER, and internal audits
  • Work closely with engineering teams to ensure certification requirements are properly implemented and understood
  • Learn and support traceability activities (SLR/HLR/LLR/test/evidence)
  • Contribute to improving internal SQA processes, templates, and workflows to enable repeatable certification execution
  • Shadow and learn from senior SQA engineers to build deep knowledge of CoreSuite certification approach and tools

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Software, Systems, Electrical, or related field)
  • 2–5+ years of experience in hardware/software engineering or systems engineering
  • 2+ years in software quality,
  • Basic understanding of software and hardware development lifecycle and documentation practices
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to learn quickly in a structured, process-driven environment
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work across engineering and program teams
  • Willingness to grow into a long-term certification and SQA role

Preferred / Desirable Qualifications

  • Exposure to DO-178C, DO-254 or similar safety-critical standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, etc.)
  • Experience supporting certification, audit, or compliance activities
  • Familiarity with configuration management and collaboration tools (e.g., Git, Jira, Confluence)
  • Basic understanding of embedded systems, operating systems, or hypervisors
  • Experience working in aerospace, defense, or safety-critical domains

This is a remote position.

Principal AI Solution Architect
GenAI, Agentic AI & Platform | Senior Contractor / Consulting Role
Role Overview
Provide deeply hands-on architecture leadership across a portfolio of secure, reusable, production-ready GenAI, RAG, agentic AI, intelligent document-processing, multimodal and AI-enabled applications. Own architecture coherence, reusable platform direction, standards and technical assurance, connecting immediate use-case delivery with repeatable capabilities.
Work as one of two senior contractors, partnering directly with the Lead Full-Stack GenAI Developer and internal engineering, data, infrastructure, architecture and control teams. Build technical spikes and deployable reference implementations, contribute shared-platform code, review implementation and materially co-implement at least one representative end-to-end use case on the reusable foundation.
Core ecosystem: Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Foundry, Databricks and approved open-source technologies.
Key Responsibilities
  • Own target-state, transition-state and use-case architectures from discovery through production, covering applications, agents, tools, models, enterprise data, APIs, user channels, workflows and operational controls.
  • Design, implement and validate reusable RAG, agentic RAG, document-processing, multimodal, tool-calling, deterministic workflow-plus-agent and human-in-the-loop patterns.
  • Define platform boundaries and co-build model access, agent execution, tools, gateways, registries, retrieval, evaluation, tracing, observability, feedback, release controls and GenAIOps foundations.
  • Lead evidence-based technology decisions across Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI capabilities, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Databricks, MLflow, Unity Catalog, Azure application/integration services and approved open-source frameworks. Enable model, provider, framework, orchestration and vector-store flexibility without unnecessary complexity.
  • Define model/endpoint abstraction, routing, quotas, fallback and controlled provider selection; agent, tool, prompt, API and MCP connector registration/lifecycle; and versioning of software, prompts, configuration, models, agents and evaluation assets.
  • Establish identity, least-privilege authorization, separation of duties, permission-aware retrieval, data isolation and lineage, network boundaries, private connectivity, secrets, key management and secure service integration.
  • Define measurable non-functional expectations for quality, availability, scalability, latency, throughput, concurrency, resilience, recovery, continuity, supportability, maintainability, capacity and cost, proportionate to each use case. Establish evaluation thresholds, release evidence, human review, monitoring, auditability, provenance and source evidence.
  • Embed security, privacy, data governance, risk and Responsible AI controls, including human authorization before consequential actions, safe failure, escalation, content/tool restrictions, auditable overrides and traceability from user request through downstream actions.
  • Define progression from PoC to MVP and production across data, environments, controls, testing, deployment, monitoring, support and recovery. Own architecture decision records, interface standards, technical risks, dependencies and assurance checkpoints.
  • Validate decisions through working code, tests, traces, benchmarks and deployment evidence. Research and evaluate current technologies, creating working comparisons when recommendations depend on technical behaviour. Troubleshoot cross-platform issues, mentor engineers and transfer knowledge; use implementation lessons to continuously improve architecture and reusable capabilities.
  • Review platform and use-case code, code organization, integration contracts, deployment patterns and non-functional evidence for conformance, modularity, security, reliability, operational readiness and appropriate reuse. Provide actionable code-level feedback and verify resolution.

Requirements

Required Qualifications
  • Substantial architecture ownership for production GenAI, RAG, agentic AI or intelligent automation in complex enterprises.
  • Current Python and API-development proficiency to build, debug and review production-quality code; recent shared AI platform/application repository contributions through reference implementations, reviews, automated tests or production troubleshooting.
  • Ability to validate architecture using Azure and Databricks environments, deployment configuration, traces, evaluations and working code.
  • Current practical Microsoft AI ecosystem and Microsoft Foundry knowledge supported by implementation or technical evaluation, rather than certification alone.
  • Experience implementing a production or production-relevant GenAI platform pattern and delivering an end-to-end use case.
  • Depth across application, integration, data, cloud, security and operations; strong knowledge of agents, tools, MCP, retrieval, APIs, distributed systems, identity, observability, evaluation and production governance.
  • Experience defining reusable platforms, reference architectures, standards and experimentation-to-production migration paths, with clear trade-off explanations, decision documentation and actionable guidance.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Financial services, regulated-industry or sensitive-information experience.
  • MLflow, Unity Catalog, Azure AI Search, containers, event-driven integration, API management and infrastructure as code.
  • Build-versus-buy assessments and approved open-source agent/orchestration frameworks.
  • Multimodal, document-intelligence or human-review solution design.
Success and Role Boundaries
Deliver coherent architectures that progress to production without fundamental redesign, reduce duplicated engineering, verify controls before release and provide tested reference implementations. Prove the foundation through at least one end-to-end use case, improve code quality and enable internal engineers to operate and extend shared capabilities.
The Lead Full-Stack GenAI Developer owns most use-case implementation, full-stack integration, delivery automation and production troubleshooting. Internal owners retain business prioritization, backlog and acceptance; enterprise, data, infrastructure and control functions retain their mandates and formal approvals.
The Architect does not replace formal enterprise architecture or control approvals. Security, privacy, risk and Responsible AI functions retain independent review or approval responsibilities.
Candidates who no longer actively write, debug and review code—including diagram-only architects, governance coordinators, delivery managers, pre-sales architects or vendor-product specialists—do not meet the requirement.

Why Syneos Health

• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.

Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Roles within the Clinical Trial Management job family are responsible for all aspects of the development, coordination, and implementation of Phase 1 through to Phase 4 clinical research studies at the organization's facilities. Collaborates with the principal investigator, liaisons between research subjects, client teams, investigators, and clinic operations teams, and plans logistics and resource usage. Tracks study progress in alignment with project milestones, client deliverables, and budget, and follows applicable regulations globally and by region.

    Impact and Contribution

    Includes executives as well as managers, supervisors and team leads providing strategic vision and/or tactical direction across a discipline and/or broader organization. The majority of time is spent overseeing their area of responsibility, planning, prioritizing, and/or directing the responsibilities of employees. Goal are achieved through management of process, policy, and performance of direct and/or indirect reports. Supervises experienced support employees and/or entry individual contributors. Delivers operational results that have moderate impact on the immediate achievement of results for the team. Broad job knowledge in an operational, administrative and/or specialized field, adapts new procedures, techniques, tools, etc. Understands basic management approaches such as work scheduling, prioritizing, coaching and process execution.

Responsible for site management oversight, clinical monitoring and central monitoring deliverables with a focus on patient safety, protocol/GCP/regulatory compliance and data integrity.

• Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities.

• May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).

• Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/CeMs) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters.

• Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables.

• Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.

• Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations.

• Participates and presents in key meetings such as Kick Off Meeting.

• Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.

• Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.

• Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.

• Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.

• Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality.

• Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.

• Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs), Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.

• Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.

• Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.

• Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.

• Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.

• Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. Develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.

• Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development.

• May be assigned to larger, more complex trials or may coordinate clinical activities for a team of CTMs across a portfolio of projects

• May coach and mentor CTMs regarding functional clinical delivery, evaluation of project risks, and action implementation.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

• Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones

• Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.

• Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)

• Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring

• Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management

• Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements

• Must demonstrate good computer skills

• Strong conflict resolution skills

• Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.

• Demonstrates critical thinking to determine the cause and appropriate solution in the identification of issues

• Moderate travel may be required, approximately 20%

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

DXC does not make offers of employment via social media networks and DXC never asks for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process, nor ask a job seeker to purchase IT or other equipment on our behalf. More information on employment scams is availablehere.

jobs.description:
About Phase2

Our remote first employees join and stay at Phase2 to be a force. In pursuit of digital experience that advances the human experience, you will do your best work, live fully, and succeed as a team.

Phase2 a digital agency passionate about customer experience, grounded in data & insights, and rooted in more than two decades of successful technology delivery. We guide industry-leading companies to what's next in their digital landscape.

And it all begins with finding the right people who align with our values and passion for impact.

About the role

A Software Architect has a strong command of software development across multiple technologies, with the judgment to assess technology fit and shape architecture decisions for a project, even in technologies new to them. They serve as a technical interpreter for clients, uncovering the real business need, framing options in plain language, and building trust as an advisor rather than working behind the scenes. Having led several projects of significant complexity to successful completion, they thrive in ambiguous client environments, using AI agents and tooling to absorb production work so their own contribution centers on the parts of delivery that require context, trust, and sound technical judgment. They collaboratively work with other developers and team members across internal and external organizations to build cutting-edge digital platforms and solve complex problems. They mentor other engineers and grow their impact by expanding beyond implementation into client leadership and strategic problem solving.

This position reports to: VP, Engineering or Sr. Software Architect

What You Are

  • An evangelist for the evolution of the software development discipline, passionate about continuous learning and skill growth, and a role model for how to maximize the effective use and benefits of AI agents, while retaining crucial human oversight skills.
  • A flexible thinker, who leads others through change in a role and industry that are evolving rapidly.
  • A rapid learner of unfamiliar technical domains who can get up to speed quickly through AI-assisted learning, SME support, and internal knowledge capture, rather than defaulting to outside help.
  • A partner with a genuine client-first mindset, naturally considering how your decisions and deliverables affect the teams and organizations depending on your work.
  • A calming force who remains constructive, and professional under pressure, adapting your approach to the context.
  • A mentor and leader who coaches and mentors more junior members of the engineering team and communicates and enforces standards within the company.
  • A forward-looking visionary who recognizes opportunities for improvement to Phase2's engineering practices and assists in developing a roadmap for emerging technologies.

What You'll Do

  • Drive work with structure and momentum, eliminating ambiguity and building confidence across delivery teams and client stakeholders.
  • Be the technical interpreter for client stakeholders: uncovering nuances of the business need; framing the requirements in actionable terms; articulating to stakeholders in plain language the available options and our recommendations; communicating how the designed solution meets the business need; building a relationship as a trusted advisor.
  • Analyze existing systems and recommend improvements in system architecture, development, and deployment process.
  • Create technical design of systems given desired functionality and project constraints such as budget and schedule.
  • Proactively spot risks, gaps, and opportunities, and design solutions in ambiguous situations before they require escalation.
  • When a client or project requires expertise in an unfamiliar technical domain, take ownership of closing the gap, learning on demand and adapting in real time.
  • Oversee and participate in implementation, including mentoring and guidance for development staff on a project.
  • Oversee and participate in deployment of systems and ensure maintenance and support capabilities for systems.
  • Provide high level estimates as inputs to project plans.
  • Prepare technical documentation.
  • Ensure development proceeds in accordance with the designed architecture and supports code and system quality.
  • Manage the AI agents used on the project team, including configuring, refining, and enhancing those tools, defining standards and constraints for their use across the team, and mentoring team members on them.
  • Own AI agent economics at the architecture level: caching strategy, model tiering, and fallback patterns that keep solutions performant and cost-appropriate.
  • Assist with proposed implementations and estimates for project proposals and RFP response activities.
  • Support the ownership and evolution of technical tools and practices used within the company, including improvements to the software development lifecycle and workflows.
  • Lead and support more junior members of the engineering team as a manager, mentor, technical resource, or career coach.

What You'll Need

  • Meets all qualifications for a Senior Developer.
  • 6+ years of industry experience with progressive increases in responsibility.
  • Ability to design system architecture and assess technology fit for requirements, with the breadth to weigh delivery, infrastructure, language, and architecture concerns together.
  • Well versed in architectural patterns and able to identify appropriate patterns for project implementation.
  • Familiar with multiple programming paradigms.
  • Proficient at debugging and troubleshooting of technical issues, and identifying appropriate solutions which consider the impact on a wider range of functionality and overall usability.
  • Proficient at requirements extraction and analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex ideas, including technical information, adapting your message to the audience and context, and identifying technical approaches to satisfy business requirements.
  • Able to bridge technical and business conversations, translating between client business goals and engineering execution.
  • Demonstrated experience with LLMs, AI coding agents, and prompt engineering.
  • Awareness of security and compliance considerations in system design, and able to ensure they are addressed across a project.

What Would be Nice to Have

  • Deep experience with at least two modern web or mobile stacks (for example React/Next.js, Drupal, decoupled CMS such as Sitecore/Optimizely/Adobe, mobile frameworks), and able to evaluate stack fit for a client's business needs.
  • Experience with CI/CD processes, especially GitHub Actions.
  • Experience architecting agentic AI coding workflows (using patterns such as Evaluator-Optimizer, Chaining, Parallelization, and Routing).
  • Experience building custom agentic AI applications.
  • Experience implementing prompt evaluation workflows.
  • Ability to identify areas for development efficiency and institute processes to support reuse.
  • Experience reading client or stakeholder signals, picking up on subtle cues of misalignment and adjusting your approach before friction escalates.
  • Architect-level AI certifications relevant to Phase2 partnerships (such as Claude Certified Architect – Foundations).
  • Public presentation capabilities.
  • Clear writing on development topics.

What Success Looks Like

  • History of successful project completion across multiple projects and a variety of technologies.
  • You lead the development of entire projects of large and small scales that demonstrably support clients’ real business needs.
  • Other engineers see you as a leader: adept at delivering software on time, with an appropriate level of quality, which meets the clients’ needs, while also creating an environment where team members can grow their skills and perform their best work.
  • You operate with broad independence: the organization trusts you to hold significant technical risk and make sound architectural calls without close oversight.
  • Clients and stakeholders feel confident and supported in your presence: they describe the experience as seamless, proactive, and dependable.

What You’ll Get

  • The chance to make a real impact, helping millions of people per year.
  • To work from wherever you thrive best. We’re a remote-first team built on trust, flexibility, and outcomes.
  • A competitive compensation package that considers various factors.
  • A comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, and supplemental insurance.
  • Our fun and interactive wellness program offers rewards for participation.
  • A 401(k) with a 3% employer contribution–no match required and 100% vested after just 90 days.
  • You’ll start with 16 paid vacation days, 4 personal days, and 1 volunteer day each year. Vacation and personal time increase with your tenure, recognizing your continued contributions.
  • Up to 12 weeks of fully paid leave for birthing parents and up to 6 weeks of fully paid bonding leave, based on your tenure. This includes support for adoption and foster placement, along with the option to extend time off through additional unpaid leave.
  • Inclusive fertility, adoption, and surrogacy benefits through Kindbody, along with virtual health coaching and care navigation.
  • A $500 stipend to personalize and equip your home workspace for success.

What the Environment Looks Like

Physical Demands

  • Frequently remain in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods of time.
  • Occasional adjusting or moving of light objects up to 20 pounds in all directions.
  • Continuous communication on live video chats, calls, and through emails and messaging platforms for the purpose of exchanging information.
  • Continuous repetitive movements that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Travel, sometimes frequent, is expected.

Mental Demands

  • Comprehension - Must continuously be able to understand direction and adhere to established procedures. Must also be able to gather information from clients and employees and synthesize this information in a meaningful way. May also be responsible for making improvements or recommendations to existing procedures.
  • Organization - Must continuously be able to gather and classify information, store information learned from conversations and communications, and then be and be able to quickly recall, interpret, and explain information.
  • Reasoning and Decision Making - Must continuously use logic to analyze and interpret information, and prioritize.
  • Communication - Must continuously express or exchange ideas and meaning with employees and clients.
  • Resilience - Must continuously adapt well in the face of workplace stressors.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)

Phase2 is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable laws regarding non-discrimination and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or any other protected status. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process.

Job title: Field Reimbursement Manager- Rare Blood Disorders, Patient Support Services

  • Location: US (Remote)

About You:

Sanofi, an innovative global healthcare company, is driven by one purpose: we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible. We provide potentially life-changing treatment options and life-saving vaccine protection to millions of people globally, while putting sustainability and social responsibility at the center of our ambitions.

The specialty care business unit of Sanofi focuses on rare diseases, rare blood disorders, multiple sclerosis, oncology, and immunology. We help people with debilitating and complex conditions that are often difficult to diagnose and treat. Our approach is shaped by our experience developing highly specialized treatments and forging close relationships with physician and patient communities. We are dedicated to discovering and advancing new therapies, providing hope to patients and their families around the world.

Rare Blood Disorders Patient Support Services supports patients and healthcare providers by providing education and resources to help navigate patient access, reimbursement, affordability offerings, and Sanofi patient support programs.

Field Reimbursement Manager- Rare Blood Disorders, Patient Support Services

The Rare Blood Disorders reimbursement environment for specialty biologics has proven to be highly challenging for Health Care Providers (HCPs) and Patients. Payer medical and pharmacy Utilization Management (UM) criteria create process delays for patients like required Benefits Investigations (BI), Prior Authorization (PA), Denial Appeals, detailed Clinical Documentation, and Peer to Peer reviews. Educating the HCPs on gaining access to prescribed treatments requires dedicated and knowledgeable customer facing support. This support is provided by our Field Reimbursement Management team.

The FRM team is a critical front-line member of the Sanofi Rare Blood Disorder Patient Services Program team. The primary purpose of this role is to provide information and education to support providers in obtaining appropriate access to Sanofi products. Goals include education of patient affordability offerings, and a strong understanding of the patient support programs of Sanofi. FRMs support the company and divisional reimbursement strategy, and this position also requires the ability to successfully navigate working across multiple internal and external stakeholders, and program vendors to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

Main Responsibilities:

  • FRMs will be subject matter experts on Sanofi’s rare blood disorder support program, payer claim processes, billing and coding education, access issue resolution, financial assistance and alternative funding options provided by our patient support program.
  • Develop effective business plans to execute brand strategies that are consistent with corporate brand and marketing plans and are tailored to geography and customer context.
  • Coordinate all business activities and drive results within geographic area of responsibility. Ensure effective execution of Sanofi strategies and tactics within assigned geographic area.
  • Establish and maintain knowledge on the local and national payer landscape, including Specialty Pharmacy and Utilization Management criteria for assigned products.
  • Monitor commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid communications on coverage, coding, and reimbursement.
  • Partner with internal and external colleagues to create a culture of respect, prioritization and focus on the launch of products.
  • Educate office personnel on appropriate billing information including approved codes for approved uses, medical & pharmacy benefits, patient support program offerings.
  • Establish relationships within targeted healthcare provider offices to assist HCPs in resolving payer coverage issues that may be barriers to Sanofi product access in a manner that complies with all company policies and standard operating procedures.
  • Ensure training is completed and demonstrate appropriate clinical knowledge of the respective products.
  • Manage and adhere to all company policies and Legal and Regulatory guidelines.
  • Must achieve and maintain compliance with all applicable Sanofi compliance policies, procedures, and legal requirements.

About You

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 4+ years in pharma, biotech, healthcare, or life science industries in pharmacy reimbursement/access
  • Ability to travel to meetings/trainings/programs as necessary - additional travel will be required within the assigned geography.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated success of cross functional teamwork and working in a matrix environment (sales, market & value access, case management, medical affairs, brand marketing, etc.)
  • Experience launching Hemophilia product(s) or complex specialty products.
  • Experience in coordinating patient and provider support services such as specialty pharmacy, reimbursement services, nursing services, specialty distributor, etc.
  • Rare Hematology experience preferred
  • Field Reimbursement Manager experience highly preferred.
  • Specialty pharmacy reimbursement experience highly preferred.
  • Must be a self-starter, energetic and driven to succeed in a collaborative team environment.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills required.
  • Strong understanding and experience supporting self-infused products preferred.
  • Significant experience and understanding of the ever-changing payer environment and its impact on patient access.

Why choose us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
