Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are looking for an experienced mobile application Product Designer with experience in the e-commerce, travel, and or banking sectors; someone who can hit the ground running and can make an impact from day one. This is an opportunity for the right person to join our multi-functional team working with a globally recognized client. A chance to work on projects that push the boundaries of brand and digital experience.

The product designer is responsible for creating and developing the strategic feature roadmap by using data, user research, and hypothesis testing. This role typically involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, including product managers, engineers, and other designers, in a client-blended team, to understand user needs and business goals. We need someone who uses their design, user research, and prototyping skills to create solutions that meet these requirements. Often to work on various stages of product development, from concept ideation to final implementation, ensuring that the product is both aesthetically pleasing and user-friendly.

Role responsibilities

  • Work on custom features for specific products, working very closely with the client team.
  • Keep healthy communication with your project manager and client.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define product requirements and specifications.
  • Collaborate on user research, interviews, and surveys to gather insights.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and user flows to communicate design ideas.
  • Iterate on designs based on feedback and testing results.
  • Work closely with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in product design.
  • Participate in design critiques and brainstorming sessions.
  • Advocate for the user throughout the product development process.

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

jobs.description:
We engage the most inspired minds to do their best work wherever they work best—powering the freedom to create worldwide.

WP Engine empowers companies and agencies of all sizes to build, power, manage, and optimize their WordPress websites and applications with confidence. Serving 1.5 million customers across 150+ countries, the global technology company provides premium, enterprise-grade solutions, tools, and services, including specialized platforms for WordPress, industry-tailored eCommerce and agency solution suites, and developer-centric tools like Local, Advanced Custom Fields, and more. WP Engine’s innovative technology and industry-leading expertise are why 8% of the web visits a WP Engine-powered site daily. Learn more at wpengine.com.

We engage the most inspired minds to do their best work wherever they work best—powering the freedom to create worldwide.

WP Engine is the most trusted WordPress technology company, powering over 1.5M digital experiences in 150+ countries for businesses of all sizes. WP Engine’s all-in-one platform enables customers to design, build, power, and manage extraordinary WordPress, eCommerce, and headless sites—all thanks to a nonstop commitment to innovation, award-winning WordPress expertise, and a set of core values that guides us every day.


Since launching in 2010, WP Engine has become the world’s leading WordPress technology company. Hundreds of thousands of customers across the world use our products every day to design, build, power, and manage their WordPress websites. We’re proud of the technology and service we offer our customers that move their businesses forward faster.


At WP Engine, we strive to do the best work of our careers, and feel empowered to do what is right for our customers. We love investing in employee success and uncovering opportunities for you, the best, to get better. 99 percent of employees believe you’re made to feel welcome at WP Engine. Be you. Be here.


What's cool about this job?

We are searching for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering organization and take a leading technical role on the domain-centric team that serves Finance.


The data this team produces is the financial picture of the company. We own the pipelines and models that turn raw data from our billing, payments, and financial systems into the trusted assets Finance, BI, and the wider business use to track revenue, subscriptions, and the metrics the company is reported on. This is a modeling-heavy role: most of the work ahead is designing and evolving the dimensional models behind those assets, and you will be the one deciding the grain, how history is tracked, how a restatement is handled, and how we prove a number reconciles back to the system of record.


The role also reaches beyond your own pull requests. You will lead projects that span the team, scope and break down technical work, and partner directly with Finance system owners, BI, and analysts - understanding what they actually need, pushing back where the request and the data disagree, and setting the direction the rest of the team builds against.


We apply software engineering best practices to our data work. You will build, test, and deploy changes through dbt with CI/CD inside our centralized Unified Analytics Model (UAM), and build ingestion pipelines in Python or Go that run on a Kubernetes-based ETL platform, landing data into BigQuery on Google Cloud Platform.


We also expect you to work with AI. Our engineers use agentic development tools such as Claude Code every day, and we want someone who is genuinely good at it - who uses these tools to move faster on real problems, and who reviews, tests, and owns every line that results. We have no appetite for unreviewed AI output in a pipeline that feeds financial reporting.


This role sits as a critical foundation for WP Engine. As our organization increasingly builds agentic systems that reason over and act on data, the quality, structure, and reliability of the data layer becomes critical. You will be shaping the bedrock that these systems depend on.


Our culture is renowned; we believe it is meaningful to hire the best and ensure that we provide an environment where the best get better. If you are great at solving problems, a hard worker with excellent interpersonal skills, and enjoy working across different time zones and cultures, you may be the person that we are looking for!

The day to day.

  • Design, build, and evolve the dbt models in our Unified Analytics Model (UAM) that turn raw financial and billing data into clean, tested, well-documented assets - owning grain, conformance, historical tracking, and the modeling standard the rest of the team follows. This is the core of the role.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL for transformation, validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting across large datasets.
  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end data pipelines that extract data from source systems and load it into BigQuery, writing ETL jobs that run on a Kubernetes-based ingestion platform.
  • Monitor pipelines and respond to alerts using data observability tooling, performing root cause analysis and implementing durable fixes rather than patches.
  • Lead the delivery of multi-sprint data initiatives across the team: scope the problem, break it into technical work, sequence it, and see it through to production.
  • Partner directly with Finance system owners, BI, analysts, and product managers to turn reporting requirements into reliable data solutions.
  • Build reconciliation and validation into what you ship, so that published financial assets can be traced and defended against the source system of record.
  • Maintain high-quality metadata across pipeline outputs and data models, ensuring assets are well-documented and discoverable for both human consumers and AI-driven workflows.
  • Raise the bar in code review - on correctness, modeling quality, testing, and readability - and mentor engineers on the team through it.
  • Use agentic development tools such as Claude Code as part of your daily workflow, applying good engineering judgement to what they produce.
  • Contribute to documentation, runbooks, ADRs, and internal knowledge sharing, and participate in team ceremonies.

Your skills and expertise.

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a closely related role, with a track record of owning significant data assets end to end.
  • Strong production experience with dbt - models, tests, macros, incremental strategies, and project structure.
  • Expert SQL - writing, debugging, and optimizing complex queries across large datasets.
  • Deep data modeling expertise. You can design a warehouse model suite from ambiguous source data and defend the choices: grain, conformed dimensions, fact design, slowly changing dimensions, point-in-time correctness, and the trade-offs between normalization and usability.
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines in production, utilizing Python, including monitoring, alerting, and root cause analysis when they break.
  • Hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse, preferably Google BigQuery, including cost and performance awareness.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker..
  • Fluency with Git and development workflows: branching, pull requests, code review, and CI/CD.
  • Experience with agentic development tools such as Claude Code or similar AI-assisted coding environments, combined with the judgement to use them well - you review what they generate, test it, and take full ownership of the result.
  • Experience modeling financial data for company reporting - billing, subscriptions, invoicing, payments, revenue, or an equivalent domain where the numbers are externally consequential and must reconcile to a system of record.
  • Excellent communication skills, written and verbal. You can hold your own with a system owner or are able to explain a modeling decision to a non-technical finance stakeholder.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical work across a team without formal authority - scoping, aligning people, unblocking others, and making the call when there is no obvious answer.
  • Strong ownership and accountability for the correctness and reliability of what you ship, and for the people who depend on it.
  • Ability to work effectively within a distributed team spanning multiple time zones and cultures.

    Desired Experience
  • Domain knowledge in finance, accounting, billing operations, or SaaS revenue and subscription metrics.
  • Experience with ERP, billing, or payments platforms as data sources, and with the realities of month-end close, period locking, and restatements.
  • Exposure to audit or control requirements around reported financial data.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform services beyond BigQuery, such as Cloud Monitoring, Kubernetes, or IAM.
  • Exposure to Go (Golang) for building data pipelines or backend services.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.
  • Experience with data observability platforms such as Monte Carlo.
  • Experience with managed data ingestion tools such as Fivetran.
  • Experience with data catalog or data governance tools.

The perks and benefits.


  • Health Benefits (LuxMed Premium Rehab + Dentistry III)
  • Pension Scheme with a match

Location:Remote (Candidate must be US-based)

Position Overview

We are seeking a Billing, AR, and Contracts Assistant to support billing, revenue cycle, and contracting operations across our clinical and administrative teams. This role is responsible for the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of billing processes, payer interactions, collections, reporting, and compliance activities.

This position supports the end-to-end Accounts Receivable workflow, including claim submission, payment posting, denial management, audit preparation, payer enrollment, rate and code maintenance, and financial reporting. The assistant will also contact funders to establish Single Case Agreements and explore potential new contracts. This requires someone skilled at building and maintaining professional relationships with funders, following up consistently, and ensuring all agreements and processes meet payer and regulatory compliance requirements.

The Billing, AR, and Contracts Assistant will serve as a key cross-functional partner to Clinical, Contract Fulfillment (CF), Accounting, and Leadership. They will help ensure services are billed correctly, reimbursements are optimized, payer requirements are met, and teams have reliable, transparent data to support operational and financial decisions.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong organizational and systems-thinking skills, close attention to detail, relationship-building abilities, and proactive problem-solving.

Key Responsibilities

Billing & Revenue Cycle

  • Own and manage all daily, weekly, and monthly billing and AR operations.

  • Oversee full-cycle billing for all payers, including:

    • PHC, SUSD, NVUSD, EL, NBRC, Carelon, Acumen, private pay, co-pay, and co-insurance.

  • Ensure timely and accurate claim submission, payment posting, and reconciliation.

  • Review AR weekly, follow up on outstanding balances, and update deposit and tracking sheets.

  • Analyze and resolve claim denials, rejections, and underpayments.
    Perform charge validation, charge corrections, and ongoing data integrity checks.

Financial Tracking & Reporting

  • Update and maintain:

    • Monthly trended hours for Contract Fulfillment and Accounting.

  • Prepare AR, revenue, and payer performance reports for leadership and CF review prior to billing.

  • Track payer performance, denial trends, and reimbursement timelines.

Funder Relations and Contract Development

  • Contact funders to establish and manage Single Case Agreements (SCAs).

  • Ensure Single Case Agreements and new contracts follow all payer, organizational, and regulatory compliance requirements.

  • Maintain accurate documentation and track the status of agreements, outreach, and contracting opportunities.

Audit, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Prepare and support insurance audits, internal audits, FSO audits, and charge validations.

  • Own audit preparation processes, documentation, and follow-ups.

  • Ensure compliance with payer, contractual, and regulatory requirements.

  • Lead discharge process review and billing closure.

Systems & Process Ownership

  • Own and maintain billing workflows across NPA and SimplePractice.

  • Support appointment verification, billing readiness, and system troubleshooting.

  • Identify inefficiencies, risks, or breakdowns in billing workflows and implement improvements.

  • Develop, document, and refine SOPs for billing and AR processes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Clinical Team

    • Contract Fulfillment Team

    • Accounting

      Admin and Operations

  • Support with co-pay and co-insurance billing and follow-ups.

Client & Payer Communication

  • Communicate with payers and clients regarding pending claims, discrepancies, and resolutions.

  • Maintain a high standard of service, professionalism, and confidentiality.

Requirements

  • Reliable internet, personal work computer, and a professional remote work environment.

  • Ability to work 9:00 am – 5:30 pm Pacific Time, with flexibility to work evenings during peak periods.

  • Ability to work consistently within the Pacific Time Zone.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in medical billing or accounts receivable.

  • Experience in an ABA or behavioral health setting strongly preferred.

  • Strong proficiency in Excel (formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, tracking).

  • Experience with billing systems and EHRs (NPA, SimplePractice, or similar).

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

Why Choose BTS?

At BTS, you’ll find a long-term career with mentorship, training, and growth opportunities. We collaborate with compassion and respect individuality, fostering an environment where everyone can thrive and grow.

BTS is a leader in Behavioral and Mental Health care and a pillar in the communities we serve.We are a privately owned agency based in California. jobs.description:
The Role:

We are hiring an internal growth and performance specialist who can turn data, research, specialist input, and client context into reliable analysis and practical recommendations. The role exists to improve the quality and speed of strategic decision support while reducing the need for senior leaders to reconstruct reports, correct assumptions, or rewrite recommendations.

This is not the primary client-relationship role. The successful candidate will own the analytical work, evidence, experimentation records, meeting preparation, and execution support that allow the Client Success & Delivery Lead to lead clients confidently. The role also requires current hands-on Google Ads and Meta Ads capability so the specialist can directly support a limited number of straightforward lead-generation accounts or provide temporary coverage when no media buyer is assigned.

Mission:

Convert performance data and business context into accurate findings, prioritized growth recommendations, controlled tests, and clear decision support for the Client Success & Delivery Lead and senior leadership.

Responsibilities:

  • PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS AND REPORTING

    • Review performance across paid media, websites, e-commerce, CRM, email, SEO, marketplaces, and other available channels.

    • Identify meaningful trends, anomalies, risks, tracking concerns, and growth opportunities.

    • Connect channel metrics to revenue, conversion rate, acquisition cost, ROAS, MER, lead quality, retention, and other commercial outcomes.

    • Produce concise weekly and monthly summaries that separate confirmed findings from assumptions and unresolved questions.

  • STRATEGIC RESEARCH AND RECOMMENDATIONS

    • Research opportunities across acquisition, funnels, CRO, creative, websites, email, SEO, automation, and customer journeys.

    • Prepare evidence-based recommendations with expected impact, required resources, dependencies, risks, and a measurement plan.

    • Prioritize recommendations instead of presenting an unfiltered list of ideas.

    • Identify opportunities without presenting unapproved ideas as committed client deliverables.

  • TRACKING FUNNELS AND EXPERIMENTATION

    • Review the journey from traffic through lead capture, CRM, follow-up, appointment, purchase, or other conversion outcomes.

    • Flag tracking, attribution, CRM, automation, and data-quality gaps before conclusions are presented as fact.

    • Create controlled experiments with a hypothesis, owner, timeline, success measure, and decision rule.

    • Maintain clear testing, opportunity, risk, and learning logs.

  • PAID MEDIA SUPPORT AND ACCOUNT COVERAGE

    • Maintain current hands-on working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads.

    • Directly manage a limited number of straightforward lead-generation accounts when assigned.

    • Step in during temporary media-buyer gaps to monitor performance, control budget pacing, troubleshoot issues, and complete necessary optimizations.

    • Review campaign structure, targeting, search terms, creative performance, lead quality, conversion tracking, and landing-page alignment.

    • Maintain a clear change log explaining what changed, why it changed, and how the result will be evaluated.

    • Escalate material budget changes, new campaign strategies, offer changes, and additional execution requirements before implementation.

    • Work with assigned media buyers when specialist support is available rather than duplicating or overriding their ownership.

  • MEETING PREPARATION AND DECISION SUPPORT

    • Prepare draft agendas, executive summaries, presentation content, talking points, and decision questions.

    • Give the Client Success & Delivery Lead the evidence needed to explain performance and defend a recommendation.

    • Anticipate likely client questions, objections, risks, and scope implications.

    • Present a defined analytical section during selected client meetings when requested, while the meeting owner retains control.

  • INTERNAL EXECUTION SUPPORT AND QUALITY ASSURANCE

    • Convert approved recommendations into organized internal briefs, tasks, dependencies, and definitions of done.

    • Coordinate with media buyers, analysts, designers, developers, SEO, email, and automation specialists to obtain accurate inputs.

    • Verify numbers, terminology, links, claims, scope, timelines, and supporting evidence before work becomes client-facing.

    • Clearly mark work as draft, internally approved, client-ready, or requiring specialist validation.

  • AI FORWARD PRODUCTION

    • Use AI for research, analysis, reporting, meeting preparation, documentation, QA, and workflow improvement.

    • Build reusable prompts, templates, checklists, and structured analysis methods.

    • Independently verify AI-generated calculations, claims, summaries, and recommendations.

    • Treat AI as an operating tool, not as proof that an output is accurate or ready for a client.

Requirements:

  • Strong experience in paid media, growth marketing, performance analysis, digital strategy, or marketing operations.

  • Ability to interpret data commercially and explain what changed, why it matters, and what should happen next.

  • Working knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, GTM, CRM and marketing automation, Shopify or comparable e-commerce platforms, and reporting tools.

  • Recent hands-on experience managing and optimizing both Google Ads and Meta Ads, particularly for lead-generation accounts.

  • Ability to enter an unfamiliar account, diagnose immediate performance or tracking issues, and implement controlled optimizations when coverage is required.

  • Understanding of CRO, funnels, landing pages, creative testing, lifecycle marketing, and customer acquisition.

  • Strong written English and the ability to present analytical findings clearly in spoken English.

  • Disciplined research, documentation, prioritization, and follow-through across several accounts.

  • Practical use of AI tools for real analytical and operational work, with reliable human verification.

  • Comfort receiving challenge, revising work accurately, and defending recommendations with evidence.

A Little Bit About Us:

Saphetor’s mission is to enable anyone to find, share and use the most comprehensive human genome data – and to collaborate to improve health and lives around the world. To do this we have built the VarSome suite of bioinformatic tools, the world’s leading resource for analysis and interpretation of human genome variant data, with more than 6 000 citations in scientific papers, and over 60 000 registered professional users. Our customers work around the globe across academic, clinical, and industry laboratories analysing NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) data for research and diagnostic purposes. Saphetor is a global precision medicine company with offices and distributed teams across Greece, Spain, the UK, Switzerland, France, USA, the MENA region, South America, and other countries, employing a diverse global workforce.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an Application Scientist, Team Lead to lead and scale our global team of Application Scientists within the commercial organization.Standing at the intersection of bioinformatics, clinical genomics and leadership, you will not only support our customers through their journey with VarSome, from pre-sales to post-sales support and expansion - but you will also drive the team’s strategic direction, optimize operational workflows and mentor team members to ensure commercial growth and customer success. You will play a key role in shaping and delivering solutions to our direct and indirect customers while acting as a senior stakeholder within the company.

We thrive in a high-pressure, high-performance environment where clinical precision and rapid growth meet. While our pace is fast, it is always directed by rigorous organization and clear processes, ensuring that our commitment to quality is never compromised by our drive for speed.

Role Responsibilities

  • Working manager: you will be the Application Scientist responsible for a defined territory.
  • Team Leadership: Lead, coach and scale the global Application Science team; establish KPIs, manage resource allocation, and foster a culture of continuous learning and high performance.
  • Pre-sales & Strategic Growth: Oversee the evaluation pipeline and act as the senior technical “closer”. Ensuring expert demonstrations bridge clinical/bioinformatic needs with the Varsome suite (Premium, Clinical, API)
  • Post-sales Excellence: Ensure seamless onboarding and rapid “time to value” across all global deployments; supervise complex cloud and on-premises delivery infrastructure specifications in coordination with DevOps.
  • Workflow Optimization & Support: Establish best practices for data filtering strategies and automation to maximize platform “stickiness” across the entire customer base
  • Scientific Advocacy: Represent the company at major international conferences (e.g. ESHG, ASHG, AMP, WHX); cultivate strategic relationships with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and guide the creation of high-impact technical white papers.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations colleagues to ensure product-market fit, translate market feedback into product roadmap priorities, and align technical capabilities with commercial strategy.

The Ideal Candidate (Profile)

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in clinical genomics or bioinformatics with a proven track record of leadership and a strong commercial mindset. You are a strategic thinker who can inspire a technical team and effectively communicate complex concepts to both laboratory professionals and executive-level stakeholders.

What you will bring:

  • Education: A Master’s or PhD in Human Genetics, Laboratory Medicine, Molecular Biology/Pathology, Life Sciences, or related field.
  • Leadership Experience: Experience managing, leading, or coaching directly or indirectly members of commercial or technical teams.
  • Expertise: Hands-on experience in clinical genomics, including NGS tertiary analysis workflows.
  • Technical Knowledge: A solid grasp of laboratory workflows, variant interpretation frameworks, and basic understanding of bioinformatics and IT workflows.
  • Communication: The ability to simplify complex bioinformatics and technical infrastructure concepts for researchers, clinicians, and IT professionals.
  • Languages: Proficiency in English and Spanish is a must. Fluency in other languages (e.g. French, German) will be considered a plus.

Strongly Valued

  • Industry Experience: Previous background in a bioinformatics software company.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with working in regulated environments, such as IVDR, CLIA/CAP, or similar standards.
  • Leadership experience: Leading a team
  • Global Mindset: Proven experience in multicultural environments and/or supporting international customers in a scale-up setting.

Mindset & Key Skills

  • Scientific Rigor: A curious, detail-oriented professional who maintains high scientific standards while managing complex data analysis.
  • Commercial Mindset: The ability to balance scientific accuracy with pragmatic sales decisions and translate features into customer benefits.
  • Self-Organization: A structured thinker with strong prioritization and project management skills, comfortable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Global Mobility: Αvailable and willing to undertake international business travel to support our global customer base.

While our foundation is in Athens, our talent pool is spread across Europe, with a strong culture of remote collaboration. Our team is highly experienced in distributed Agile workflows and communicates exclusively in fluent English.

Your career journey with us includes, among others:

  • A position in a fascinating healthcare growth domain, at the cutting edge of technology and research
  • A competitive compensation package tailored to your unique expertise and professional background.
  • A remote-first work environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance
  • Endless learning opportunities, while transferring new technologies from academics to clinical practice all over the world.

Saphetor is proud to be an Equal Opportunities Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and our employees, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, medical condition or disability, sexual orientation, gender expression, or marital status.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT:

  • You will serve as a senior engineering leader responsible for building and scaling our AI‑Assisted Software Development capability driving Mission Software growth and delivery excellence. This role goes far beyond “using AI tools” – you will be part of team that establishes the strategy, operating model, practices, and technical foundations required to transform how our teams design, build, test, and deliver software solutions and products using modern AI-enabled development approaches. As a Senior AI-assisted / Cloud-native Software Engineer SME, you will be trusted to help drive the technical solutions needed to win our most complex, large-scale, and strategic pursuits as well as extend our existing Mission Software portfolio
  • You will evaluate and rationalize existing AI-enabled tools and platforms across the organization, become the internal expert on their use and integration, define best practices, upskill our engineers, and operationalize AI‑assisted development as an enterprise capability we can confidently take to market
  • You will architect, engineer and demonstrate innovative proof of concept solutions that solve key customer challenges
  • The role blends technical leadership, solution architecture, go-to-market, organizational change management, and hands-on engineering expertise
  • This is a highly strategic and highly technical leadership role designed for an experienced engineering leader who thrives in emerging technology spaces and enjoys scaling new capabilities from the ground up


WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
Bring your initiative and drive for innovation to GDIT. The Senior AI-assisted / Cloud-Native Software Engineer SME must have:

Education & Experience:

  • BA/BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 15+ years of progressive software architecture and engineering experience including leading architecture and engineering best practices across complex teams required
  • Proven experience developing mission software products, capability development, and demonstrating developed solutions to customers
  • Must be a US Person (needed to access sensitive GDIT enterprise systems)

AI-assisted / AI-native Engineering experience:

  • Strong understanding of AI-enabled development workflows, not just tool usage: prompt and harness‑engineering patterns, code‑gen improvement loops, safety/quality validation, and architectural impacts, as well as ability to identify, track, and articulate ROI associated with AI and agentic automation
  • Ability to assess organizational AI-development maturity and define roadmaps, capability models, and adoption strategies, including ability to identify and implement new operational models (i.e., team size and composition, sprint planning, code reviews, etc.) to optimize delivery

  • Hands-on experience using LLM-based frameworks and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) as part of software delivery

Capability & Solution Development:

  • Ability to rapidly architect, engineer and demonstrate customer proof of concept solutions
  • Ability to develop and articulate technical solutions for complex Mission Software growth pursuits
  • Ability to identify, hire, coach, and scale engineers in AI-assisted development techniques, responsible use, productivity strategies, and integration patterns
  • Experience creating developer education programs, playbooks, best practices, or internal communities of practice to facilitate large-scale change management initiatives
  • Experience functioning as an internal SME, providing architectural guidance on how AI changes software engineering design patterns, quality models, and delivery processes

Technical Leadership & Architecture:

  • Demonstrated ability to drive technical vision, architecture standards, and execution across complex, multi-team programs
  • Experience leading full SDLC and product lifecycle delivery in both agile and hybrid environments
  • Strong background implementing operational and engineering standards including CI/CD, DevSecOps, TDD/BDD, automation frameworks, and quality engineering practices
  • Experience developing solutions within distributed, cross‑functional, or geographically dispersed teams

Software Engineering Experience:


  • Full-Stack development experience including proficiency across multiple programming languages, including Java, JavaScript, Python, .NET, and others
  • Hands-on experience using modern front-end and back-end frameworks (e.g., Angular, React, Spring Boot, Django, Next.js, etc.)
  • Experience implementing and integrating solutions across variety of operating systems (e.g., Linux, Unix) and Platforms as a Service (e.g., RHEL, OpenShift)
  • Deep experience with API/webservice design, secure coding standards, and scalable architectural patterns

Preferred Skills:

  • Understanding of Federal acquisition and security compliance including FedRAMP and Authority To Operate (ATO) implications across Government Cloud and classified environments
  • Experience building an enterprise AI-assisted development capability or platform offering
  • Prior experience productizing internal capabilities into customer-facing solutions or services
  • Familiar with Cloud-native platforms (AWS, GCP Azure,) and related AI/ML services including experience managing vendor relationships with OEM and ISVs
  • Expertise with CI/CD automation, IaC, Policy as Code, and governance automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, etc.)
  • Ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and influence across senior leadership levels
  • Demonstrated ability to stay current with emerging AI, development, and architecture trends, and drive organizational adoption strategies

Location: Remote

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

  • Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
  • Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
  • Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
  • Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY
Explore a career at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your sense of ownership and pride in the meaningful work we do.

Who is American College of Education

Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.

ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

Who You Are

You are passionate about helping students achieve their educational goals. You thrive in a competitive and collaborative team environment. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.

The Quality Engineer plays a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of ACE’s digital learning platforms and internal software systems. This position designs, develops, and maintains scalable automated testing frameworks and scripts, collaborates with cross-functional teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle, and drives continuous improvement in testing practices to support a seamless experience for students, faculty, and staff. Success in this role will be demonstrated through increased automated test coverage, reduced manual regression effort, earlier defect detection, improved pipeline reliability, faster release validation, and greater visibility into release risk.

Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality, affordable programs for our students. The starting salary range for this position is $112,000 plus all full-time employees are eligible for an annual bonus. Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and expertise being applied to the role.

What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

  • Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs.
  • Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills.
  • Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership.
  • Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set.
  • Consistently produces a high volume of quality work.
  • Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel.
  • Must support and embrace the College’s Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives.
  • Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills.
  • Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time-critical problems.
  • Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team-player.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail.
  • Builds and maintains student satisfaction.
  • Recognizes and anticipates student needs.
  • Uphold the College’s commitment to high-quality, accessible online education by ensuring systems are reliable, performant, and inclusive.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent combination of education and professional experience will be considered.
  • 5 or more years of progressive experience in software quality assurance with a primary focus on test automation.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages used for test automation (Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#).
  • Hands-on experience designing and implementing test automation frameworks with tools such as Selenium WebDriver, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, or comparable solutions.
  • Experience with API testing using tools/frameworks such as Postman, RestAssured, or similar.
  • Experience defining automated quality gates in CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with test reporting, observability, or engineering-quality dashboards.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD platforms and practices (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and active participation in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills combined with a high attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively in a fully remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Experience with accessibility standards (WCAG) and performance/load testing tools is highly desirable.
  • Prior experience in higher education, edtech, or SaaS product environments is a plus.

Our Commitment to Employees

Just as we strive to empower our students for success, we also aim to enrich the lives of our employees. For 6 consecutive years, ACE was recognized as one of Indiana’s Best Places to Work, winning the #1 spot for medium-sized companies in 2020. In addition, ACE has earned national recognition since 2022 for being a USA Today Top Workplace. As a virtual first organization, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a family-like inclusive work environment. For our full-time employees, we offer the following benefits:

•Medical, dental, & vision Insurance

•HSA and FSA options

•Paid parental leave

•Paid volunteer time

    • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

    • Can work independently and within a team; solution-oriented with a collaborative approach

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: AI Solutions Engineer & Full-Stack Developer

Compensation range: $2,500 AUD - $3,000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: We operate within the storage and logistics industry, providing flexible storage and moving solutions for individuals and businesses. Our focus is on making the storage process as convenient and hassle-free as possible by combining practical services with a customer-first approach.

We work closely with customers to support a wide range of storage needs, whether they are relocating, renovating, decluttering, managing business inventory, or requiring temporary space. By offering tailored storage options, transportation support, and secure storage facilities, we help simplify what can often be a time-consuming and stressful process.

Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced AI Solutions Engineer & Full-Stack Developer to lead the technical development and automation of our internal and external business tools. This is a commercially focused, hands-on role responsible for building, integrating, and scaling critical operational systems—including telephony, CRM pipelines, recurring billing, scheduling, and custom reporting software—across a multi-organisation structure.

You will own the technical architecture, development, and optimization of our business tools using modern web frameworks and AI-assisted development platforms. We are looking for a developer who understands how smart software and AI integration impact real operational outcomes. Success in this role is not measured by writing lines of code alone, but by your ability to automate workflows, build robust system integrations, and eliminate operational friction to drive business efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • AI Telephony Integration: Build, deploy, and maintain advanced human & AI-driven telephony systems using Replit, Twilio and Retell AI, configuring intelligent voice agents and routing pipelines across multi-organisation setups.
  • System Builds & Integrations: Architect and engineer custom business tools, bridging data silos across a telephone network, recurring billing, scheduling systems, CRM/ERPs, and automated reporting dashboards.
  • Web Development: Maintain, develop and optimise modern, fast, and responsive user interfaces and internal dashboards using Astro and React.
  • Rapid Prototyping & Automation: Leverage modern AI-assisted engineering environments including Replit and Hercules to prototype features rapidly, deploy code efficiently, and automate workflows.
  • CRM Data Pipeline Management: Manage deep technical integrations with HubSpot, ensuring clean data flow, webhook handling, proper mapping, and robust conversion tracking between external systems and our CRM.
  • Performance Tracking & Optimisation: Work closely with operations, marketing, and leadership teams to analyse tool performance against commercial KPIs, including lead capture efficiency, scheduling utilisation, and system uptime.
  • Security & Clean Architecture: Maintain clean codebase standards, secure API connection management, and safe data governance practices across all custom internal apps.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Proven Systems Engineering: Strong hands-on experience building custom internal tools, workflow automations, or SaaS integrations with measurable business impact.
  • AI Developer Tech Stack: Extensive, day-to-day experience working with conversational AI tools and sandboxes, specifically Replit and Hercules, alongside LLM API integrations.
  • Telephony & Web Experience: Deep technical familiarity with building voice or SMS workflows via Twilio, integrating AI voice layers with Retell AI, and creating frontends in Astro and React.
  • Deep CRM Knowledge: Advanced experience setting up webhooks, custom objects, data syncing, and API workflows within HubSpot.
  • Commercial & Analytical Mindset: Ability to connect software engineering choices to real business metrics, profitability, and operational scale.
  • Multi-Entity Infrastructure: Experience managing data flows and software applications built for multi-location, franchise, or multi-organisation business structures is highly regarded.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

deine benefits

Ohne Token-Limits, ohne Kontingente, ohne die Frage, ob sich der nächste Prompt lohnt. Wenn eine neue Software Deine Arbeit voranbringt, hast Du sie innerhalb von 24 Stunden auf dem Rechner, ohne IT-Ticket und ohne Budgetrunde.

  • Weiterbildung, die Du selbst bestimmst: 2.000 € Hardware- und Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr, über das Du frei entscheidest. Fachbücher, Kurse, Zertifikate, Konferenzen oder eigene Experimentier-Hardware. Wir schreiben Dir nicht vor, worin Du tiefer wirst, denn bei einer Technologie, die sich in Monaten neu erfindet, weißt Du das besser als jeder Weiterbildungskatalog.

  • Lernkurve, die Du sonst nirgends bekommst: Pairing mit dem Tech-Lead, Code-Reviews mit Begründung, viele unterschiedliche Produkte und KI-gestützte Entwicklung im Terminal als Standard. Unsere Entwickler sagen uns, dass sie hier in einem Jahr mehr gelernt haben als in jedem Unternehmen davor. In zwölf Monaten bist Du kein Junior mehr.

  • Maximale Reichweite für Deine Arbeit: Was Du baust, geht direkt an tausende Nutzer unserer Produkte und an über 3.500 Kunden, und der größte deutsche YouTube-Kanal für Künstliche Intelligenz zeigt, was das Team entwickelt. deine aufgaben

deine qualifikationen

jobs.description:
das erwartet dich:

Über SecureID

SecureID ist unser eigenes Produkt: eine PKI- und Credential-Wallet, die das Smartphone zur hardwaregestützten digitalen Identität macht. Das private Schlüsselmaterial liegt in Secure Enclave bzw. Android Keystore und verlässt die Hardware nie. Darauf aufbauend liefert SecureID Türzugang per NFC, E-Mail-Signatur, Push-2FA und passwortlose Anmeldung – alles aus einer App. Unternehmen verwalten ihre Nutzer, Karten und Integrationen selbst in SecureID Workspaces.

Das Backend ist das Herz dieses Systems: Hier liegt die Geschäftslogik, hier entscheidet sich, ob SecureID unter Last stabil und schnell bleibt. Grundkenntnisse in PKI bringst du idealerweise mit – tiefes Spezialwissen musst du nicht haben, das bauen wir gemeinsam aus.

Wie wir mit KI entwickeln

Wir setzen KI konsequent ein, um schneller zu entwickeln: Pläne werden mit Claude Code oder Codex zu Specs und Tickets, Agenten übernehmen Teile der Umsetzung. Das heißt ausdrücklich nicht, dass Code ungesehen durchgeht. Du verstehst, was du mergst, prüfst es kritisch und trägst die Verantwortung für deinen Code – egal, ob du ihn selbst geschrieben oder generiert hast.

Das System, das du weiterentwickelst

  • TypeScript-Backend: Node.js und Fastify mit Drizzle ORM, Zod-Validierung und OpenAPI-Spezifikation – Mandanten, Nutzer, Karten und Integrationen für Admin-Oberfläche, SecureID Workspaces und App
  • Python-Services: FastAPI-Microservices für Credential-Ausstellung, Türzugang, Authentifizierung und Wallet-Funktionen
  • Datenhaltung: PostgreSQL mit mandantenfähigem Datenmodell
  • Architekturprinzip: Thin Frontends – Geschäftslogik, Validierung und Berechtigungen liegen im Backend; Web-Dashboards und App konsumieren typisierte APIs
  • Betrieb & Qualität: Docker, Kubernetes, GitOps-Deployments mit Argo CD, Observability mit Grafana, CI/CD mit GitHub Actions, automatisierte Tests mit Vitest, Playwright und pytest

Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Ownership: Du trägst echte Verantwortung für die technische Weiterentwicklung des Backends und auf technischer Seite für das Produkt – von der Architekturentscheidung bis zum stabilen Betrieb.
  • Skalierbarkeit: Du entwickelst das Backend so weiter, dass es mit Kunden, Nutzern und Geräten mitwächst – mit effizienten Datenbankzugriffen, horizontaler Skalierung, Caching und Lasttests, wo es zählt.
  • Robustheit: Du baust Retry-Mechaniken mit Exponential Backoff und Jitter, Idempotenz, Timeouts, Circuit Breaker und Rate Limiting – damit aus einem Teilausfall kein Retry-Storm wird.
  • Performance & Observability: Du sorgst für schnelle Antwortzeiten und baust Logging, Metriken und Tracing aus, damit wir Probleme sehen, bevor Kunden sie merken.
  • Saubere APIs: Du ersetzt gewachsene Datenzugriffe durch klare REST-Endpunkte und ziehst Geschäftslogik konsequent ins Backend.
  • Integrationsplattform: Du baust eine Plattform mit auf, über die Kunden Integrationen wie OpenID Connect, SAML und SCIM auswählen und aktivieren.
  • Technische Führung: Du gibst im Backend die Richtung vor, reviewst Code und Agent-Ergebnisse und unterstützt Frontend und Mobile beim API-Design.

Unser Techstack

  • Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, Fastify, Drizzle ORM, Zod, OpenAPI · Python, FastAPI
  • Daten: PostgreSQL
  • Web: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, TanStack Query
  • Mobile: Flutter/Dart, Riverpod, GoRouter, Swift, Kotlin
  • Qualität & Betrieb: Vitest, Playwright, pytest, GitHub Actions · Docker, Kubernetes, Argo CD, Grafana
  • KI-Werkzeuge: Claude Code, Codex

das bringst du mit:

Must-have

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit TypeScript/Node.js oder Python in produktiven SaaS-Produkten
  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit API-Design (REST, OpenAPI) und relationalen Datenbanken, idealerweise PostgreSQL
  • Erfahrung mit Systemen unter Last: Retries, Idempotenz, Timeouts und Backpressure – du weißt, wie Systeme ausfallen, und baust sie so, dass sie es kontrolliert tun
  • Erfahrung darin, technische Verantwortung für ein Produkt oder System zu übernehmen
  • Routinierter Einsatz von KI-Werkzeugen in der Entwicklung – mit dem Anspruch, generierten Code zu verstehen, zu prüfen und dafür geradezustehen
  • Bereitschaft, dich in neue Technologien einzuarbeiten
  • Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Nice-to-have

  • Fastify, Drizzle oder Zod sowie Python/FastAPI
  • Resilience-Patterns in der Praxis: Circuit Breaker, Bulkheads, Queues, Outbox-Pattern
  • Mandantenfähige Architekturen (Multi-Tenancy, Row Level Security)
  • OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML oder SCIM
  • Kubernetes, Argo CD und Observability (z. B. Grafana, OpenTelemetry) sowie Lasttests
  • Anonymisierte Produkt-Analytics: datenschutzkonforme Erfassung und Auswertung, um Feature-Adoption zu messen und A/B-Tests zu steuern
  • Grundlagen PKI und X.509

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns ist wichtiger, dass du Verantwortung übernehmen willst und dich in neue Themen einarbeitest.

warum saltrock?

What You'll Do

    Build AI-Accelerated Test Automation

  • Build and maintain scalable automation suites using Playwright across web, API, and mobile, contributing to broader QA frameworks and release validation standards.

  • Determine what should be automated, what can be delegated to AI, and what requires human testing — balancing coverage, risk, and release timelines.

  • Turn every escaped defect into an automated regression check so the suite strengthens with each release.

  • Help define how to test AI-powered customer experiences (search, recommendations) where outputs are non-deterministic and need evaluation rubrics rather than exact assertions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally.

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Cross-Functional Impact: Your work touches every engineering team and every release — automation coverage and quality gates you build directly shape what ships to customers across web, mobile, and API.
  • AI-First Skill Building: You will work at the frontier of AI-assisted testing, using and evaluating emerging tools daily and building expertise that is defining the next generation of quality engineering.

Interview Process

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFlosum is looking for a visionary Senior Product Manager who lives and breathes the Salesforce ecosystem and wants to shape the future of how the world's largest enterprises build, secure, and scale on Salesforce.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Flosum is looking for a visionary Senior Product Manager who lives and breathes the Salesforce ecosystem and wants to shape the future of how the world's largest enterprises build, secure, and scale on Salesforce.

This is not a maintenance role. You will own the product roadmap for the only 100% Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform trusted by Fortune 100 companies, global brands like Hilton, Cargill, Barry Callebaut, Cushman & Wakefield, and AARP. You will work directly with the CEO and engineering leadership to define and ship products that create entirely new categories within the Salesforce ecosystem.

We are at an inflection point. AI-driven DevOps (powered by Agentforce), agent-aware governance, zero-trust security orchestration, and intelligent data lifecycle management are transforming the Salesforce landscape. We need a product leader who sees around corners, understands where this space is heading, and has the conviction and execution chops to get us there first.

About Flosum

Flosum is the only enterprise-grade DevOps, Data Backup & Archive, Trust Center, and Data Seeding platform built 100% native on the Salesforce platform. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and the only native solution certified by Salesforce, we operate within the Salesforce trust boundary, which means zero data exposure, no third-party cloud processing, and full compliance with Salesforce security standards.

Our customers are among the most demanding in the world: Fortune 500 enterprises in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government, life sciences) who require SOX compliance, zero-trust architecture, and audit-grade governance. We compete against Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, and Salto, and we win because our native architecture delivers security, speed, and extensibility that external tools simply cannot match.

We recently integrated Salesforce Agentforce into our platform, making Flosum the first and only Salesforce-native AI DevOps solution. This is just the beginning of what we plan to build.

What You Will Own

Product Vision & Strategy

  • Define and drive the multi-year product roadmap across Flosum's five product lines: DevOps, Backup & Archive, Trust Center, Data Seeding, and DevOps for Veeva.
  • Identify whitespace opportunities in the Salesforce ecosystem where Flosum can create new categories or capture market share from competitors.
  • Translate deep Salesforce platform knowledge (metadata architecture, deployment models, Agentforce, Data Cloud, multi-org environments) into product capabilities that enterprise customers will pay premium prices for.
  • Stay ahead of Salesforce's own product direction (three releases per year) and position Flosum to capitalize on every platform shift.

AI & Innovation

  • Lead the next wave of AI-powered DevOps capabilities built on Agentforce, including intelligent deployment agents, AI-driven code review, automated security scanning, and predictive release management.
  • Define how Flosum's extensibility platform enables customers to build custom AI-driven workflows within Salesforce's trust boundary.
  • Pioneer agent-aware governance: preparing Salesforce governance frameworks for autonomous systems and AI agents.

Customer & Market Insight

  • Engage directly with Fortune 500 customers and prospects to deeply understand their pain points around Salesforce development, security, compliance, and data management.
  • Translate complex enterprise requirements (SOX, zero-trust, multi-org, regulated industries) into elegant product solutions.
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to influence deal strategy, conduct product demos for strategic accounts, and close competitive evaluations.

Execution & Delivery

  • Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You do the work, not just delegate it.
  • Partner with engineering to deliver on aggressive timelines. Own sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and release coordination.
  • Define and track product KPIs: adoption, activation, expansion, NPS, competitive win rates.

Requirements

Who You Are

We are looking for a missionary, not a mercenary. Someone who takes genuine ownership of outcomes, thinks independently, and is driven by a need to build something that matters, not just advance their career.

  • 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with at least 3 years focused on the Salesforce ecosystem or Salesforce-adjacent platforms.
  • Deep technical understanding of the Salesforce platform: metadata-driven architecture, deployment pipelines, sandboxes, packaging, security models, Apex, Lightning, and the ISV partner ecosystem.
  • Proven track record of shipping products that enterprise customers (Fortune 500, regulated industries) adopted and paid for. Not features; products.
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, or security/compliance tooling is strongly preferred.
  • You understand the competitive landscape: Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, Salto, and native Salesforce DX. You know where each is strong and where they are vulnerable.
  • Strong perspective on how AI/ML (especially Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein, Data Cloud) will reshape the Salesforce development and governance landscape.
  • Hands-on executor. You write PRDs, you talk to customers, you review wireframes, you sit in sprint reviews. You do not manage from a distance.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can present a product vision to a C-suite audience and write a technical specification for an engineering team in the same day.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action. When you see a problem, you solve it. When you don't know something, you go learn it.

What Will Make You Exceptional in This Role

  • You have experience building products in the Salesforce AppExchange ecosystem, ideally as an ISV or within a Salesforce-native product company.
  • You have worked at the intersection of DevOps and security/compliance in regulated industries.
  • You have led product-led growth initiatives within an enterprise product, designing self-serve onboarding, in-product conversion, and expansion mechanics.
  • You have a point of view on the future of AI in Salesforce DevOps and can articulate a 3-year vision for how autonomous agents will change how enterprises build on Salesforce.
  • You have experience going head-to-head against well-funded competitors and winning through product superiority rather than just marketing spend.

What We Expect in the First 12 Months

First 90 Days: Learn and Diagnose

  • Achieve deep fluency in Flosum's five product lines and their technical architecture.
  • Conduct 25+ customer and prospect interviews to build a firsthand understanding of enterprise pain points.
  • Complete a competitive audit with specific, actionable recommendations on where Flosum should invest to win.
  • Deliver your first product roadmap refresh with clear prioritization rationale.

Months 3-6: Ship and Win

  • Own and deliver at least one major product release that directly addresses a competitive gap or customer-requested capability.
  • Establish a product-led feedback loop between Sales, CS, and Engineering that accelerates deal velocity and reduces churn.
  • Define the next generation of Flosum's AI capabilities and present a detailed execution plan.

Months 6-12: Scale and Lead

  • Drive measurable improvement in competitive win rates against Copado and Gearset.
  • Launch at least one net-new product capability that opens a new revenue stream or market segment.
  • Establish Flosum as a thought leader in AI-driven Salesforce DevOps through content, speaking, and ecosystem engagement.

Benefits

Why Flosum

  • Category-defining opportunity: You will shape the future of how enterprises build on Salesforce. This is not incremental; it is transformational.
  • Direct CEO partnership: You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with a founder who is deeply technical, product-obsessed, and committed to building the best platform in the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Fortune 100 customer base: Your product decisions will directly impact how the world's largest and most complex organizations operate.
  • AI inflection point: Agentforce and autonomous agents are rewriting the rules. Flosum is the first native platform to integrate these capabilities. You will define what comes next.
  • Missionary culture: We hire people who want to make a dent, not pad a resume. If you are looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are heard, this is it.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + performance bonus
  • Direct access to Salesforce ecosystem events, conferences (Dreamforce, TrailblazerDX), and customer engagement

The Role & Team:

As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will build, operate and improve Infovista's hybrid platform, spanning on-premises data centers and public cloud, supporting the Network Lifecycle Automation, Network Intelligence and SaaS product portfolios. Your core mission is to make automation the default way of working: replacing manual, ticket-driven processes with self-service, code-driven infrastructure that makes delivery faster, more reliable and more cost-effective across the business.

Reporting to the Head of Infrastructure & Platforms, you will be part of a hands-on team of infrastructure, DevOps and site reliability engineers, working alongside internal network teams and the offshore third-party delivery partner. You will work closely with product engineering, security and IT operations to identify automation opportunities and help drive their adoption. Success will be measured by the proportion of infrastructure and deployments automated, reduction in manual effort and lead times, platform availability against SLAs, deployment frequency, and the adoption of self-service tooling by engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities:

Deliver assigned work against the hybrid platform roadmap, with guidance from senior engineers and the Head of Infrastructure & Platforms.

  • Help build and operate a consistent hybrid estate across on-premises virtualization (VMware vSphere, Nutanix, ProxMox) and public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), including networking, identity and connectivity between them
    • Support enterprise storage across the hybrid estate (iSCSI, Fibre Channel, NFS/SMB and object storage), with provisioning and configuration delivered through automation
    • Help manage domain services (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP) and their integration with cloud identity, automating routine administration and changes
    • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using terraform, ansible, cloud formation and similar automation stacks, so that environments are provisioned, configured and changed through version-controlled code
    • Contribute to control plane management and automation across virtualization, container and cloud platforms, keeping management layers consistent, version-controlled and recoverable
    • Automate systems lifecycle management, from build and patching through upgrades and decommissioning, so that systems remain current, supported and compliant
    • Design automation strategies that take account of existing infrastructure, integrating with and progressively modernizing legacy systems rather than relying on greenfield replacement
    • Support and operate container platforms across on-premises and cloud (Kubernetes, OpenShift, EKS/AKS) with standardized Helm charts and GitOps deployment through Argo CD or Flux
    • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Jenkins) that give product teams fast, secure, repeatable releases
    • Identify automation opportunities across the business and help build a pipeline of use cases with clear ROI
    • Help integrate automation with IT service management (ServiceNow) to deliver self-service provisioning, automated change and event-driven remediation
    • Build self-service automation, workflows and catalogue items that let engineering teams request, change and retire infrastructure without manual intervention
    • Implement observability using Prometheus, Grafana, the ELK/OpenSearch stack and OpenTelemetry, and apply SRE practices including SLOs, incident response and blameless post-incident reviews
    • Go beyond alerting to automated remediation, developing support-focused runbooks and automations that enhance NOC and SRE operations and reduce time to resolution
    • Support systems health and capacity management, using monitoring data and trend analysis to forecast demand, plan capacity and address issues before they impact service
    • Explore and apply AI-driven improvements, such as AIOps, anomaly detection, intelligent reporting and AI-assisted automation, to improve platform reliability and operational insight
    • Help implement automated asset discovery and documentation (ITGlue), keeping inventory, configuration and dependency records accurate and up to date
    • Contribute to metadata and tagging standards across on-premises and cloud resources, so that assets are consistently described and ready for automation
    • Build security and compliance into the platform through policy as code, secrets management (HashiCorp Vault), image scanning and automated compliance checks
    • Follow and contribute to engineering standards and reusable automation modules, and support the review of offshore partner work
    • Support FinOps practices across cloud and on-premises, using automation to right-size, schedule and decommission resources
    • Share knowledge and document solutions, helping build automation skills across the wider infrastructure organization

Qualifications:

  • 5-7 years in infrastructure, platform or DevOps engineering
    • Hands-on experience building and operating hybrid environments that span on-premises data centers as well as various cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure, Hetzner, OVH, etc).
    • Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and configuration management
    • Experience with Kubernetes and container platforms, GitOps and CI/CD tooling
    • Solid understanding of enterprise networking (routing, load balancing, DNS, firewalls, VPN/Direct Connect/ExpressRoute) and Linux and Windows server environments
    • Working knowledge of enterprise storage (iSCSI, Fibre Channel, SAN/NAS) and domain services (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP)
    • Scripting and development skills in Python, Bash or PowerShell, with experience provisioning and delivering reliable and secure automation solutions.
    • Experience automating manual processes, supporting the development of runbooks or similar automation tools, and a keen interest in driving wider adoption of automation
    • Exposure to systems lifecycle, capacity and health management, including automated remediation and support-focused runbooks for NOC/SRE teams
    • Familiarity with automated asset discovery and documentation tools (e.g. ITGlue) and metadata or tagging standards that support automation
    • Interest in applying AI to infrastructure operations, such as AIOps, anomaly detection or AI-assisted reporting and automation
    • Experience introducing automation into existing environments, working alongside legacy infrastructure
    • Experience working with offshore or third-party engineering teams
    • Relevant certifications (e.g. AWS Solutions Architect – Associate, Azure Administrator, CKA, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, Red Hat Ansible) are desirable
